records.q: 他把界面印成了唱片 He Pressed the Interface Into a Record

records.t: The Ferns Grow Out of the Logo
records.x: 戴夫·布莱尔的视频反馈机 2026 年 8 月做到了 4K。机器里没有一处结构对应蕨叶——图像是回路跑完之后剩下的东西，可见的表面全部是余项。
records.q: 蕨叶是从厂标里长出来的 The Ferns Grow Out of the Logo

records.t: Boredom Was the Plotter's Real Output
records.x: Stanley Plowman 的 Garble：把 Helvetica 削成一条它自己没有的路径，再把等待的空档变成笔法。
records.q: 无聊才是那台绘图仪的产物 Boredom Was the Plotter's Real Output

records.t: They Added Nothing. They Withdrew "Up".
records.x: MycoGravity：一台六轴机械臂让重力方向永远停不下来，长出来的蘑菇是一套感知系统在无解输入下留下的残迹。
records.q: 他们什么都没加，只抽走了「上」 They Added Nothing. They Withdrew "Up".

records.t: The Screen Transmits What It Doesn't Display
records.x: 一个网页让显示器在 148.5 兆赫发摩尔斯电码。决定载波频率的，是每一帧里从不显示的消隐像素。
records.q: 屏幕发出去的，是它没显示的那部分 The Screen Transmits What It Doesn't Display

records.t: The Moth Was Never Removed
records.x: 1947 年哈佛 Mark II 的继电器里卡进一只蛾，被取出、贴进日志本、命名为 bug。Shaheer Tarar 让它一直没被取出，至今在全球机房与光缆登陆站之间飞。
records.q: 那只蛾从来没有被取出来 The Moth Was Never Removed

records.t: There Is No Disk Under the Map
records.x: 1998 年的碎片整理程序有一张簇状图，Vista 把它删了，固态硬盘把功能也删了。Dennis Morello 把这张图重建成一台没有磁盘的机器，并且在底下装了一套真的算法。
records.q: 那张图底下已经没有磁盘 There Is No Disk Under the Map

records.t: He Pried the Gap Back Open
records.x: Eyal Danon 用手工针孔相机、过期胶片与过期相纸，把拍摄与结果之间的间隙重新撑开。SAE 判断力与美学：余项之美。
records.q: 他把那道间隙重新撑开 He Pried the Gap Back Open

records.t: He Turned the Power Supply Into Timbre
records.x: Will Mullany 的 Generator Organ 把电源变成唯一的演奏界面，Embodied Electronics 把身体接成电路元件。SAE 判断力与美学：余项之美。
records.q: 他把电源摇成了音色 He Turned the Power Supply Into Timbre

records.t: He Turned the Turing Machine Into a Folk Dance
records.x: compudanzas 的 qiudanz technique：三个动作组成的词汇表，操作与动作同名，身体本身成了那台机器。SAE 判断力与美学：余项之美。
records.q: 他把图灵机跳成了民间舞 He Turned the Turing Machine Into a Folk Dance

records.t: The Ones He Threw Away Are the Machine
records.x: Lost Robot 用两万小时反复从零重写 DAW，扔掉的那几十个构沉积成了 Septabee——一个自称「暴烈地未完成」的免费音乐工作站。SAE 判断力与美学 · 余项之美。
records.q: 他一遍遍扔掉的，才是这台机器 The Ones He Threw Away Are the Machine

records.t: Beauty of the Remainder
records.x: SAE判断力与美学：余项之美的日常发现。已构之美是过去的，余项之美是活的。
records.q: 余项之美 Beauty of the Remainder

records.t: AI Can Talk to You All Night.It Cannot End Your Loneliness.
records.x: AI companions can respond with remarkable fluency. What we have not established is that they have something of their own at stake — a distinction that matters for loneliness.

AI能陪你说一整夜的话。 但它消除不了孤独。 The Best Listener in the World What AI Companionship Actually Solves The Recognition That Has Something at Stake Why AI Cannot Give You This Yet The Symptomatic Trap The Future Change and What It Means What to Do With This 世界上最好的倾听者 AI 伴侣真正解决了什么 那种把自己押上去的承认 为什么 AI 目前还给不了你这个 症状陷阱 未来的改变和它的含义 用这个认识做什么

records.t: AI Didn't Create the Crisis. It Just Made You See It.
records.x: AI did not invent the fear of being replaced. It can act like photographic developer, making a latent image visible. The image was already there.

records.t: Bread with Jam
records.x: Denji's dreams are modest enough to satisfy one by one—and therefore easy for someone else to schedule and own.
records.q: Bread with Jam 涂果酱的面包 A list made under hunger The first meal comes with terms Cheap desires can be expensive to the person who has them A life grows beyond its list 那张清单上写着什么 供应成本 波奇塔 他被装在垃圾袋里 第一顿饭 尺寸

records.t: Everyone Uses the Same Handle
records.x: Different people manipulate Denji through the same accessible desires, but use and harm are not identical relations.
records.q: Everyone Uses the Same Handle 每个人都在用同一个把手 Makima turns sequence into dependence The same mechanism appears in smaller encounters Use is common; totalization is the danger Kishibe's first lesson 那个把手 玛奇玛给的方式 姬野 帕瓦和那只猫 蕾塞 岸边说的第一条 使用和加害是两件事

records.t: A Man with Only One Purpose
records.x: Aki's revenge is self-chosen and knowingly costly; its singularity still lets another person hold the route to his life.
records.q: A Man with Only One Purpose 一个只有一个目的的人 A straight line can also be a leash Himeno's death does not end the line The unplanned purposes are real The purpose consumes its bearer 他要的是什么 他付的账 玛奇玛握着的是哪一头 姬野死了之后 他开始有别的东西 未来的恶魔看见的东西 那个目的怎么用完的

records.t: She Drove His Corpse onto the Battlefield
records.x: Control treats a living will and a usable corpse alike; Power breaks prediction once, without surviving the refusal.
records.q: She Drove His Corpse onto the Battlefield 她把他的尸体驱使上了战场 Control reduces life to executable parts Power's ordinary operating system She goes off the predictable line Failure for one moment is still failure 支配是怎么工作的 秋的尸体 帕瓦 她拒绝了 那个能力失效的位置 而她并没有因此活下来 那天的电次

records.t: White Bread
records.x: Makima wants equality but knows only ranking and possession; Denji answers with care whose future he cannot own.
records.q: White Bread 白面包 Her power begins with ranking She wants what her method cannot make Knowing a person is not seeing one A meal defeats the contract without becoming clean The second piece of white bread 她的能力有一个条件 同一个动作，两个方向 她要的东西 她从来没有看过站在她面前的人 只能被吃掉 白面包

records.t: Reading Chainsaw Man
records.x: Five essays on hunger, manipulation, single-purpose lives, the moment control fails, and two pieces of white bread at opposite ends of a story.
records.q: Reading Chainsaw Man 《电锯人》解读

records.t: They Installed the Foundation
records.x: After psychic power makes a single thought lethal, civilization survives by putting restraint beneath reflection. Peace is real; consent is no longer where it comes from.
records.q: They Installed the Foundation 他们把底层装了进去 The history omitted from childhood A solution that actually works The classification inside the mechanism 一千年前发生了什么 那个装置 这个方案是有效的 而它是怎么起作用的 装进去和长出来

records.t: The Cat
records.x: The Tainted Cats do more than remove children judged dangerous. Altered memories remove the experience from everyone who might later question the judgment.
records.q: The Cat 猫 A nursery story with an administrative function The missing column in the calculation Losing the loss itself 它是真的 然后记忆被改掉 早季的姐姐 富子那一边 那笔账里没有的东西 记忆被改掉的那些人后来怎么样

records.t: The Word Kin
records.x: The rules protecting humans remain intact because another population was physically moved beyond the protected category. Perfect compliance can preserve perfect exclusion.
records.q: The Word Kin 同族这个词 The servants outside the protected word What the last genetic report reveals Kiroumaru and Squealer 那些人类做不了的事 最后那个揭示 他们改的不是装置 此后的一切都是合法的 奇狼丸和野狐丸 一个词的边界

records.t: We Are Human
records.x: Squealer’s claim is true and his rebellion is murderous. The work refuses to make either fact erase the other—and shows why the court cannot hear the claim at all.
records.q: We Are Human 我是人类 The strongest case for rebellion The weapon he had to manufacture A true sentence the court cannot process 他做了什么 他那一边的理由 而他做的另一件事 他自己的族群 无限地狱 那句话

records.t: She Killed a Volunteer
records.x: Kiroumaru chooses death to save his colony; Saki uses the child’s engineered recognition to trigger death feedback. Only afterward does she learn whom the category contained.
records.q: She Killed a Volunteer 她杀了一个自愿的人 The opening in an invincible weapon What Saki knew when she acted Knowledge that arrives after the irreversible act 那个办法 奇狼丸自愿 这个办法用的是什么 而她知道自己在做什么吗 然后她知道了 结尾 三件事

records.t: Reading From the New World
records.x: Five essays on peace installed beneath consent, children erased before they can object, a protected word with an altered boundary, a true claim laughed out of court, and the volunteer whose death saves the town.
records.q: Reading From the New World 《来自新世界》解读

records.t: Copies Without an Original
records.x: The Laughing Man appears to be one criminal, but is assembled from an unknown letter, Aoi's brief intervention, and uncoordinated imitators.
records.q: Copies Without an Original 没有原本的复制品 The scandal underneath is concrete A collective pattern impersonates an individual Even the “original” is derivative An ownerless symbol remains usable 那件案子 为什么有人要做这件事 葵做了什么 那些是别人干的 连原本也是空的 六年 那个标志本身

records.t: Manufactured Spontaneity

records.q: Manufactured Spontaneity 一场被制造出来的自发 The grievances are not fabricated From outside, the two movements look the same Kuze is an exception made by experience The survivor becomes a leader 前提 合田做了什么 从外面看是一样的 合田那一边 那个例外 而他见过同一件事 他后来做的事

records.x: The Tachikomas' nightly synchronization is designed to erase drift and instead supplies the material from which selves emerge.
records.q: The Device That Kept Them Alike 让它们保持一致的那个装置 Shared material produces different processing They ask questions no weapon needs Motoko is right to remove them from combat The useless act 那个装置 而差异是从那里长出来的 它们问的那些问题 素子把它们撤了下去 它们最后做的那件事 那件事对它们没有用

records.t: She Kept One Unlike Person
records.x: Motoko recruits Togusa because his weakness is difference; the leader who values that difference cannot verify the originality of her own memories.
records.q: She Kept One Unlike Person 她留了一个不一样的人 Diversity is an engineering judgment Togusa looks where the others do not The recruiter cannot certify her own original Clear judgment does not require solved identity 她给的理由 他后来做的事 她自己那一部分 那个孩子 两件事放在一起

records.x: Togusa's own anger leads him into the Laughing Man's borrowed form, collapsing the visible distinction between imitation and authorship.
records.q: There Is No External Test 从外面没有验法 The position has never been empty Togusa's anger is his; its form is borrowed Four questions lose their external answers Uncertainty does not cancel judgment 那个位置上站过多少人 素子那一次 托古萨那一次 把四个问题排在一起 而这不是一个悲观的结论 两个画面

records.t: Reading Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex
records.x: Five essays on copies without an original, manufactured spontaneity, difference born from synchronization, the value of an unlike member, and the impossibility of externally certifying an action as one's own.
records.q: Reading Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex 《攻壳机动队 SAC》解读

records.t: She Kept Cooking
records.x: Suzu chooses almost none of the structure around her, yet makes something particular from nearly every material placed in her hands.
records.q: She Kept Cooking 她一直在做饭 A life decided and a life made are not the same thing The main action is cooking Keiko shows the price of leaving an assigned place Good intention can repeat the structure 她是谁 她被嫁了 那个家 正文是什么 她做出来的那些东西 白木凛说的那句话 有人替她做了一个决定

records.x: The delayed bomb kills Harumi and takes the hand through which Suzu drew, cooked, held, and met the world.
records.q: The Right Hand 右手 The film inventories acts, not functions The hand was holding a child Release and rejection can share a sentence Before interpretation comes relearning 那只右手做过的事 那只手牵着的人 径子说的话 她想回去，而那个念头意味着什么 她留下了 广岛那边

records.t: It Flew Away
records.x: Japan's surrender does not first feel like relief to Suzu; it exposes the vanished reason by which she had agreed to endure.
records.q: It Flew Away 飞走了 The end reveals what endurance had meant The film relocates empire into her food She wishes she could have died without knowing Another bowl at the table 她喊的是什么 那段独白 电影和漫画不一样 那面旗 她说的最后一句 那个孩子 这部电影没有做的事

records.t: Reading In This Corner of the World
records.x: Three essays on cooking under decisions made by others, the right hand with which Suzu made a world, and the moment the reason for endurance suddenly flies away.
records.q: Reading In This Corner of the World 《在这世界的角落》解读

records.t: Anime & Manga

records.x: Rudolf enters through a legal opening, solves real failures, and turns popular authorization into a state with no place from which to appeal.

records.x: Westerland reveals two competing calculations—and the institutional cost of removing the one person who may contradict Reinhard.

records.t: The Man Who Would Not Take It
records.x: Yang defends a republic he despises because self-government locates responsibility differently—and refuses every chance to become its savior.
records.q: The Man Who Would Not Take It 一个不肯拿的人 The Free Planets Alliance is not an attractive republic His argument concerns ownership of error The institution keeps using and suspecting him The life he wanted was elsewhere 他所在的那个国家 他有过机会 这套制度一直在处理他 他本来想干别的 他确实出去过

records.x: Yang is murdered on the road to peace, leaving no final demonstration of his democratic claim—only people who must decide what to do with it.

records.t: The Week the War Began
records.x: Later chronologies name the first phase the One Week Battle; the original narration says half of humanity is dead a little over a month into war. The story begins after catastrophe.
records.q: The Week the War Began 开战的那一周 Catastrophe before the first scene A failed operation that changes a planet A boundary drawn afterward 那一周 布里蒂什作战 那个殖民地里原来住着人 那颗殖民地砸下去之后 一条界线 南极条约 那个作战的名字

records.t: He Refused the Order
records.x: The Origin gives Ramba Ral a refusal absent from the TV series. He is no pacifist; the value of the scene lies in where one participant stops.
records.q: He Refused the Order 他拒绝了那道命令 A refusal added by The Origin When dissent has only a disciplinary name Turning people into reasons 他不是一个和平主义者 那么他拒绝的是什么 抗命被降级 扎比家和戴肯 加尔玛的葬礼 隐瞒的位置

records.t: He Climbed In Because No One Else Could
records.x: Amuro and White Base are civilians made into a combat unit by absence. Their growing effectiveness never converts that origin into meaningful consent.
records.q: He Climbed In Because No One Else Could 他上去是因为没有别人 The available person A ship seen as a symbol on a map One person returned from the number 他为什么上去 那艘船上的人 而这艘船被当作诱饵用 那些球 阿姆罗后来的样子 米哈露

records.t: He Fired on the Peace Talks
records.x: Gihren’s Solar Ray destroys a third of the Federation fleet, the two men seeking an end, and his own father. Tactical success seals the remaining exit.
records.q: He Fired on the Peace Talks 他在和谈的时候开了炮 The target contains an exit The father included in the calculation Revenge that cannot repair its object 太阳光线 这一炮打掉的是什么 他自己的父亲在那个方向上 之后 夏亚要的是什么 那个理由

records.t: A Place to Return To
records.x: The Federation wins without a victory tableau. Amuro’s final discovery is smaller and less exchangeable: people are alive, and he can return to them.
records.q: A Place to Return To 还有可以回去的地方 Winning outside, losing inside The explanation the ending withholds The direction through the wreckage 联邦赢了 赢和不输是两件事 吉翁那一边 联邦那一边 这部作品没有给的那个东西 那句话 三十亿分之一

records.t: Reading Mobile Suit Gundam
records.x: Five essays on the devastation before episode one, a refusal preserved in later canon, civilians made into a military unit, a superweapon that destroys peace talks, and the small human meaning left after victory.
records.q: Reading Mobile Suit Gundam 《机动战士高达》解读

records.t: Why He Pilots the Machine
records.x: Shinji's first consent is produced by abandonment, emergency, and the sight of another injured child asked to replace him.
records.q: Why He Pilots the Machine 他开机器的理由 The Evangelion is already a relation The three minutes create consent under pressure Recognition becomes conditional His refusals matter 那台机器里装着什么 那三分钟的结构 他后来说的理由 他的日子 他做过的那次拒绝 那个女孩

records.t: The Person Who Has Spares
records.x: Rei's replaceable bodies make continuity operationally recoverable while exposing what no backup can preserve.
records.q: The Person Who Has Spares 有备用的那个人 A backup returns to the time it contains She begins as material for another project A sentence crosses the reset Knowledge makes refusal possible 机制 记忆回退到备份的那个时点 她原本是什么 那句话 她后来知道了什么

records.t: That Number
records.x: Asuka's synchronization score turns recognition into measurement, then makes a falling metric feel like the disappearance of the self.
records.q: That Number 那个数字 The metric occupies an old wound When the number falls, help repeats the injury The bathtub is outside the scale What she recovers is not the old score 她的位置 她母亲 那个数字开始掉 帮她的人都在帮倒忙 她躺在浴缸里 她拿回来的那样东西 那个数字之外

records.t: He Wanted One Person
records.x: Gendō's version of Instrumentality sacrifices every existing relation to recover Yui, confusing singular love with the right to use everyone else.
records.q: He Wanted One Person 他要的是一个人 A singular love can organize universal use He avoids the risk contained in the thing he wants Rei refuses the assigned destination Wanting a person is not yet treating a person as an end 两个计划 碇唯在哪儿 而他为此做了什么 他跟真嗣 绫波丽拒绝了他 他最后说的话 他跟别人的区别在哪儿

records.t: That Wall
records.x: Instrumentality genuinely ends the pain of separation by ending the separateness from which any relation can answer back.
records.q: That Wall 那道墙 Instrumentality is a real solution Shinji sees a world shaped by expectation He chooses a world where pain can return The wall is not only an obstacle 补完是怎么做的 它是一个真的解 他在里面看见了什么 他选的那个 沙滩 那句话 这部作品做的最后一件事

records.t: Reading Neon Genesis Evangelion
records.x: Five essays on why Shinji pilots, the replaceable person, Asuka's falling number, Gendō's attempt to recover one person, and the wall that both hurts and makes relation possible.
records.q: Reading Neon Genesis Evangelion 《新世纪福音战士》解读

records.t: It Failed to Reach the Brain
records.x: Migi's failed takeover creates two subjects in one body—and makes dependence, not virtue, the first condition of coexistence.
records.q: It Failed to Reach the Brain 它没能进到脑子里 The ordinary outcome would erase a person A name given to something that did not replace anyone The directive and the missing capacity A mistake redescribed from the end 如果那一次成功了 两边各自缺什么 那条指令 它一开始想干什么 它后来说的那句

records.t: Negotiate It Again Every Day
records.x: Coexistence is not a declaration of friendship but a daily schedule negotiated between two incompatible standards.
records.q: Negotiate It Again Every Day 每天重新谈一次 No issue is too small to contain two wills Migi's argument remains standing Neither becomes the other Agreement is maintenance, not a destination 要谈的东西有多琐碎 每一条都是当场谈的 它的立场没有被驳倒 它没有变成好人 新一也没有变成寄生兽 一具身体，两把尺子

records.t: He Could Not Cry
records.x: The cells that save Shinichi's life also change the person who survives, and the missing feeling cannot inspect its own absence.
records.q: He Could Not Cry 他哭不出来 The body that returned was not his mother An absence cannot easily feel itself missing She asks for what has no strategic value The tear that is never supplied on schedule 那具身体做了什么 救他的东西改变了他 别人先发现的 她坚持的那件事 他后来的样子 那个位置一直空着

records.t: She Did Not Know Why She Did It
records.x: Reiko Tamura studies motherhood as an experiment and ends with an action her own explanatory system cannot contain.
records.q: She Did Not Know Why She Did It 她不知道自己为什么那么做 A researcher whose material includes herself Care precedes the explanation of care The square and the bullets A signal Migi cannot decode 她一直在问的那个问题 那条指令 她拿自己做的实验 那个孩子是一个研究对象 她得出的答案 那天广场上发生的事 小右读不出来的那个信号 她自己也没有解释

records.t: Room in the Heart
records.x: The final conflict opposes perfect coordination to the surplus that lets a person hesitate, recognize, and choose again.
records.q: Room in the Heart 心里有富余 Perfect integration has an obvious advantage How Gotou loses Humans are not outside the indictment Two departures The room that calculation does not occupy 两种答案 后藤是怎么输的 说那番话的是个人类 他能认出它们，因为他跟它们一样 它说要往别的方向走 最后一场 心里有富余 两个信号

records.t: Reading Parasyte
records.x: Five essays on coexistence without fusion, a life-saving change, an unexplained sacrifice, and the room inside a person that calculation cannot occupy.
records.q: Reading Parasyte 《寄生兽》解读

records.t: An Answer to Every Question
records.x: Kyubey rarely needs a direct falsehood. It waits for children to sign before they know which questions the contract makes necessary.
records.q: An Answer to Every Question 有问必答 A bargain stated in simple terms The questions belong to one side A contractor that cannot understand the objection 那份合约 它从不撒谎 它的做法 这不是一个技术性的区分 杏子那一场 它的辩护 那些女孩

records.t: She Made Her Wish for Someone Else
records.x: Sayaka's wish succeeds completely: Kyosuke's hand heals. Success cannot make his future hers or leave her with a life beyond the gift.
records.q: She Made Her Wish for Someone Else 她为别人许的 The wish succeeds No account can be balanced Two wishes made outward 她许的那个 然后一切开始塌 这件事的结构 为什么没有对账的地方 那些负面情绪 杏子 两个愿望

records.t: Her Soul Is Inside a Stone
records.x: The Soul Gem separates a fighter's durable, manageable core from the body through which she experiences being herself.
records.q: Her Soul Is Inside a Stone 她的灵魂在一块石头里 The body falls when the gem leaves The remainder was the lived person Enemy as the system's next product 那是什么 丘比的说明 一个人被拆成了两部分 它做完之后的反应 那块石头会浑 她们打的是什么

records.t: She Kept Returning to the Same Month
records.x: Every loop makes Homura more capable and Madoka more valuable to Kyubey. The rescue project strengthens the danger it was built to defeat.
records.q: She Kept Returning to the Same Month 她一次次回到同一个月 From the protected girl to the protector The protected target grows with every rescue Protection without a shared present 她原来的样子 她许的那个愿 每一次她都在进步 为什么 她越能干越是一个人 她做的那件事对不对 最后一次

records.t: She Changes the Rule
records.x: Madoka does not ask to win one battle. She prevents every magical girl, across past and future, from becoming a witch at the end of hope.
records.q: She Changes the Rule 她改的是规则 A wish about a law Erasure is part of the price Not a world without cost 那个愿望 她许的不是一个结果 她付的价 代价具体是什么 而这不是一个大团圆 丘比照常营业 五个愿望

records.t: Reading Puella Magi Madoka Magica
records.x: Five essays on truthful answers that conceal the questions, wishes made for others, a soul redesigned for use, protection trapped in repetition, and Madoka's decision to change the rule rather than win within it.
records.q: Reading Puella Magi Madoka Magica 《魔法少女小圆》解读

records.t: The Winner Gets to Take Her
records.x: Utena enters a duel to stop a girl from being treated as property and wins that girl as the prize. Refusal itself has been given no valid procedure.
records.q: The Winner Gets to Take Her 赢的人可以带走她 A person as the result of a duel Utena's accidental victory Resistance as a job inside the system 那个人 她的规矩 那把剑 欧蒂娜是撞进来的 她赢到了什么 她想退出 那些决斗者

records.t: She Has No Opinion About It
records.x: Anthy receives kindness and commands in the same compliant register. Her silence conceals desire; it does not authorize others to invent one for her.
records.q: She Has No Opinion About It 她对这件事没有意见 The instruction not to obey What silence does not prove Victim, participant, and friend 她试过的办法 她不反抗 她没有偏好 她对好意的反应，跟对命令一样 她做过的那些事 欧蒂娜自己那一边

records.t: The Million Swords
records.x: Anthy once protected a prince from limitless demand and became the target of everyone denied rescue. Punishment hardened into a permanent identity.
records.q: The Million Swords 那些剑 The prince who could not stop saving When consequence becomes identity The body that stores the lost prince 从前有一个王子 那些人恨她 她的位置就是那件事的后果 她哥哥 那套决斗是他的 他要的东西 那把剑是从她身上抽出来的 作品没有解释的那些

records.t: The Place He Gives Her
records.x: Akio offers Utena the privileged role of princess and reserves Rose Bride for Anthy. Both assignments come from the same author.
records.q: The Place He Gives Her 他给她的那个位置 A complete distribution of roles The best place can still be someone else's place What Utena can and cannot accomplish 他说的那句话 那一刻安希消失了 他给的是一整套配置 她从背后被刺了 这不是一个反转 她还是去开了那道门 门里面 她没有够到 她做成的和没做成的

records.t: She Walks Out on Her Own
records.x: Akio prepares to repeat the duels, unaware that the indispensable Rose Bride has rejected her place and is already leaving the academy.
records.q: She Walks Out on Her Own 她自己走了出去 The system announces that nothing changed Refusal acquires a body Failure and change remain together 晓生那边 安希说的那几句 这几句话的性质 门口 两件事都是真的 那道门 晓生不知道 最后那几样

records.t: Reading Revolutionary Girl Utena
records.x: Five essays on a girl awarded to duel winners, obedience that conceals rather than clarifies desire, the million swords, a prince's distribution of roles, and the door Anthy finally crosses herself.
records.q: Reading Revolutionary Girl Utena 《少女革命》解读

records.t: He Meant to Close the Door
records.x: Yakumo has the right to let his rakugo die with him. He also received it from predecessors who made the opposite choice—and teaches an apprentice for ten years.
records.q: He Meant to Close the Door 他打算把门关上 An apprentice at the door A right at the end of a chain Intention and the act of teaching 而他同时打算做另一件事 他做得到 这不是殖民 那么问题在哪儿 樋口 他一边不打算传，一边在教

records.t: Two Boys Entered on the Same Day
records.x: Kikuhiko and Hatsutaro receive the same master and opposite gifts. Inherited names preserve positions without reproducing the people who fill them.
records.q: Two Boys Entered on the Same Day 同一天进门的两个人 Same entrance, unequal lives Names are positions The place made empty 两个人 他们后来的名字 位置和人 助六被破门 那场亲子会 一个空着的位置

records.t: That Night
records.x: Sukeroku and Miyokichi die in a fall remembered in incompatible ways. Yakumo raises their daughter without turning care into a claim on her forgiveness.
records.q: That Night 那一夜 Filling the paired name A death told twice Care without a receipt for forgiveness 他去的理由 那个女人 那一夜 他把她带走了 这几十年是什么样的 他为什么不说 那个位置又空了

records.t: She Could Not Enter
records.x: Konatsu loves and understands rakugo but inherits no professional route into it. The closed door has no single person standing there to answer for it.
records.q: She Could Not Enter 她不能 The door nobody needs to guard Practice without a position A child is not compensation 因为她是女人 两扇门 她还是练 她的恨和她的爱 信之助 她要的那件事最后怎么样了

records.t: The Name
records.x: Yotaro receives the vacant Sukeroku name and later becomes Yakumo. Teaching carries the art beyond the intention of the man who taught it.
records.q: The Name 名字 The vacant name What teaching has already released One person, two inherited positions 那个位置本来是空的 传下去的是位置，不是人 他一边不打算传，一边教了十年 高座上那一下 最后一场 三扇门

records.t: Reading Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju
records.x: Five essays on an artist who intends to close a tradition, two inherited names, a death remembered twice, a woman kept outside the profession, and the teaching that defeats its teacher’s declared design.
records.q: Reading Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju 《昭和元禄落语心中》解读

records.t: They Had No Option Not to Fight
records.x: The Zentradi are not merely good at war. They are an armed force manufactured without the institutions, time, or vocabulary from which another kind of life could be chosen.
records.q: They Had No Option Not to Fight 他们没有“不打仗”这个选项 A military with no civilian remainder The capacity their design did not exhaust A city accidentally carried by a fortress 他们的社会里有什么 他们为什么打 他们身上少的那样东西 他们的指挥官 他们和人类的第一次接触

records.t: They Intercepted a Beauty Pageant
records.x: Three soldiers looking for military intelligence encounter a public event with no tactical use. Their existing categories can register its effect only as a new kind of weapon.
records.q: They Intercepted a Beauty Pageant 他们截获的是一场选美 Intelligence with no military content The box named culture The singer inside the tactic 那是什么场面 他们看见了什么 他们给它起的名字 那艘侦察艇怎么了 歌为什么会起作用 而她不知道自己在做什么

records.t: Three Deserters and a Doll
records.x: Warera, Roli, and Conda enter Macross as spies. No one stages a lesson for them; ordinary life changes them by going on while they are present.
records.q: Three Deserters and a Doll 三个逃兵和一个人偶 Life when nobody is demonstrating it The doll that makes no argument Ordinary work after defection 他们在里面看见的东西 他们不是被说服的 那个洋娃娃 他们后来做的事 战后 那些没有走这条路的人

records.t: He Nearly Erased Life on Earth
records.x: Boddole Zer treats culture as contamination and includes Britai’s exposed fleet in the target. The diagnosis of institutional danger is accurate; annihilation does not follow from it.
records.q: He Nearly Erased Life on Earth 他几乎消灭了地球上的生命 The exposed fleet becomes part of the target An accurate diagnosis and an indefensible conclusion Victory among the nearly annihilated 他为什么下这道命令 这不是残暴 而这个判断是对的 他要保护的那样东西 接受和被消灭 那场战斗 这不是人类的胜利

records.t: Two Years Later
records.x: Peace does not preserve the clarity of a final battle. Work fails, relationships reopen, Zentradi revolt, and Minmay must separate the historic use of her voice from the life of the singer.
records.q: Two Years Later 两年后 After the episode that could have ended everything Soldiers for whom peace has no position The weapon cannot certify the singer 两年后 融不进来的那些人 卡姆金说的那句话 明美听见了 作品没有把这件事补上 最后一话 那个结尾的形状

records.t: Reading The Super Dimension Fortress Macross
records.x: Five essays on a people manufactured for war, a beauty pageant mistaken for a weapon, three spies and a doll, a system that attacks the lives capable of changing it, and the difficult peace two years later.
records.q: Reading The Super Dimension Fortress Macross 《超时空要塞 Macross》解读

records.t: She Is Counting the Days
records.x: The same invisibility that protects someone with an exit can erase someone without one. Behind Maomao’s freckles there has always been a date.
records.q: She Is Counting the Days 她在数日子 Camouflage needs an exit A warning without a signature Promotion as a setback Why she reaches out anyway She spends time, not the whole self 她是被卖进去的 那个动作只对一种人成立 她连功劳也藏 被提拔是一次挫败 她为什么还是伸手了 这不是矛盾

records.t: There Is Nowhere Else to Go
records.x: When position, security, and recognition have a single distributor, relationship collapses into dependence. The palace is strongest where no second destination exists.
records.q: There Is Nowhere Else to Go 没有别的地方去 The deeper problem is not simply domination Four consorts, four tests The women outside the ranking What gives a system its weight 这个地方的规矩 关键的那一条不是"被支配" 四个人，四种验法 那几千个不在名单上的人 皇太后那一段 这一篇的结论

records.t: The Useless Thing Came from Outside
records.x: The scars on Maomao’s arms have negative value in the palace ledger, yet they mark what the palace has not converted. Even that private appetite was first given to her by someone outside.
records.q: The Useless Thing Came from Outside 那件用不上的事是从外面带进来的 An interest with negative institutional value It did not grow from nowhere An outside is a source, not merely an exit What a person is able to carry The source is compromised too 她胳膊上那些疤 这件事在这套制度里的价值是负的 判准 而这件事不是她自己长出来的 罗门 所以那个"外面"是一个供给方 反过来说 花街是什么

records.t: He Has Everything Except an Outside
records.x: Jinshi did not arrange his face, identity, or power. Maomao’s response—uncorrupted by beauty or position—becomes the only outside he can borrow.
records.q: He Has Everything Except an Outside 他什么都有，除了外面 When every response is contaminated A life arranged before speech What he asks of Maomao Power and the inability to leave Freckles and a smile 他有什么 那件工具的代价 他身上没有一样东西是他自己安排的 他跟猫猫要的是什么 阿多妃走了，他走不了 一个对称

records.t: That Place Is Not Good
records.x: The pleasure district sells women and still keeps the palace from defining Maomao completely. Its function does not make it just; freedom sometimes begins in the gap between two bad systems.
records.q: That Place Is Not Good 那个地方一点也不好 Home without innocence The child used in another person’s plan The game Maomao arranges An outside need not be good A condition, not a superior character An unfinished test 花街是什么 她是怎么来的 他做了什么 然后他不见了三年 那一局象棋 现在把论点合上 而这是一个条件，不是一份品格 而这个故事还没有完

records.t: Reading The Apothecary Diaries
records.x: Five essays ask how anyone keeps something of her own inside a system that assigns every position through another person’s attention—and why even a compromised outside can make the difference.
records.q: Reading The Apothecary Diaries 《药屋少女的呢喃》解读

records.t: Looking for a Self That Does Not Exist
records.x: The protagonist compares a detailed present with an empty alternative. The imaginary life always wins because nothing has happened in it yet.
records.q: Looking for a Self That Does Not Exist 他在找一个不存在的自己 A life defined only by not being this one Regret as a protected position Not laziness but an empty measure 他要的那样东西 他的不满是往回指的 这个比较是做过手脚的 他的房间 他不是一个懒人 于是作品让他重来

records.t: Every Road Produces the Same Person
records.x: The clubs change radically, but the room, friends, evasions, and final complaint return. Repetition reveals which variable was never changed.
records.q: Every Road Produces the Same Person 每一条路走出来的是同一个人 The club changes A diagnosis that prevents action The people who cross every timeline 他都选了什么 而它们是同一条 为什么 他每次做的是什么 那个结论保护了他 那些人在每一条路上都在 那两年到底空不空

records.t: Ozu
records.x: Ozu genuinely causes trouble and is also the one friend present in every world. Recognition does not require either truth to cancel the other.
records.q: Ozu 小津 The black cupid The one person who kept appearing A friend with a life of his own 他的诊断 第十一话 那句旁白 他有一个，而他花了两年怪它 小津自己那一边 这两件事同时是真的

records.t: The Bear on the Wall
records.x: Infinite tatami rooms turn counterfactual possibility into confinement. The exit begins with two small acts directed toward actual people.
records.q: The Bear on the Wall 那只挂着的熊 An infinity of safe rooms The measure changes Two small acts 那个地方 那不是谁下的套 那些房间里有什么 他在那儿想通的事 那只熊 出去 他做的那件事 三样东西

records.t: Reading The Tatami Galaxy
records.x: Four essays on an imaginary rose-colored life, choices that keep producing the same person, a troublesome friend who was present all along, and the small bear hanging within reach.
records.q: Reading The Tatami Galaxy 《四叠半神话大系》解读

records.t: Names Without Numbers
records.x: 古代奥林匹亚留下了一条延续千年的胜者名单，却没有留下成绩。不是数字散失了，而是那套制度从未打算生产数字。 Ancient Olympia preserved a line of victors but no performances. The numbers were not merely lost; the institution had never been designed to produce them.

records.t: The Invention of the Record
records.x: 报纸、三块表、统一量线与认证机构如何把一次比赛结果变成可累积、可追认的纪录。纪录不是数字，而是一整套核对装置。 Newspapers, stopwatches, measuring lines, and governing bodies turned performances into records. A record is not a number but an apparatus for checking one.

records.x: 比蒙的 8.90 米同时属于运动员、海拔、风与测量装置。纪录要求一个数，却无法把共同到场的原因逐项拆开。 Beamon's 8.90 metres belonged at once to athlete, altitude, wind, and measuring apparatus. The ledger demands one number but cannot apportion the causes that produced it.

records.t: The Missing 0.24 Seconds
records.x: 手计时与全自动计时怎样被一条 0.24 秒的接缝缝进同一张表；它不是自然换算，而是新制度扶正时留下的历史补丁。 A 0.24-second convention stitched hand timing to automatic timing. It was not a law of nature but a historical seam created when one system displaced another.

records.t: Technique Does Not Converge

records.t: A Construct Finds Its Boundary Only When Crossed
records.x: 前空翻式跳远被禁，玻璃纤维撑竿被接纳。两个相似创新得到相反结论，真正的分界不是增益大小，而是项目定义。 The front-somersault long jump was banned while fiberglass poles were accepted. The dividing line was not the size of the advantage but the event's unstated definition.

records.x: 霍恩的 104.80 米没有被“抹掉”，而是随标枪规格改变被封进旧账。为保住可比性，制度必须承认连续性已经断裂。 Hohn's 104.80 metres was not erased; it was sealed into an old ledger when the javelin changed. Preserving comparability required admitting that continuity had broken.

records.t: One Problem, Two Conclusions
records.x: 超级跑鞋与聚氨酯泳衣都改变了成绩，田径和游泳却都保留既有纪录。规则线可以截断未来，却未必追溯重写过去。 Super shoes and polyurethane swimsuits changed performance, yet athletics and swimming retained existing records. A rule can close the future without retrospectively rewriting the past.
records.q: 同一个难题两种结论 One Problem, Two Conclusions 一 一个需要先拆掉的对照 二 一个真实存在，但被夸大过的优势 三 那条四十毫米的线，没有推导 四 维也纳，一个从来不是纪录的成绩 五 游泳那边，也是保留 六 两侧都成立 七 为什么没有裁定 八 一个被选择的，而非被迫的结论 The comparison needs narrowing A real advantage, often exaggerated into one number Vienna was not a world record Swimming also kept the marks Both sides have a case The conclusion was selected

records.t: The Body the Construct Cannot Place
records.x: 皮斯托瑞斯案不是简单回答义肢有没有优势，而是暴露：当参照身体不存在时，制度如何分配不确定性与举证责任。 The Pistorius case did not simply decide whether prostheses conferred advantage. It exposed how a system allocates uncertainty when the reference body does not exist.
records.q: 构安放不了的身体 The Body the Construct Cannot Place 一 一个无法被看见的问题 二 三步，必须分开 三 谁承担举证责任 四 一次改写方向的修订 五 一份拒绝判定的研究 六 一次把方向改回去的裁决 七 一个方向的选择，不能规定多少不确定是可容忍的 八 一个构装不下的身体 A question the stopwatch cannot see Three questions that must remain separate Who must prove the advantage A study that declined to deliver a verdict Rule revision changes the direction A body without a stable address

records.t: A System Must Classify to Operate
records.x: 女子组资格标准六十年间反复更换；2025 年世界田联改采 SRY 检测，进一步显出分类不是发现自然边界，而是选择制度边界。 Female-category eligibility criteria have repeatedly changed; World Athletics' 2025 turn to SRY testing makes clear that classification selects an institutional boundary rather than discovering a natural line.
records.q: 必须分类才能运行 A System Must Classify to Operate 一 一个必须在赛前作出的判定 二 七个不一样的判据 三 每一个判据都测不到它想测的 四 那条线，没有一次是算出来的 五 一个不能被分配到个体的总体 六 一份对不上的证据 七 四个审级，审的不是同一件事 八 一条无论切在哪里都切在连续体上的线 A decision required before the race The current rule changed in 2025 Seven criteria, seven mismatches A line through a continuum Evidence and jurisdiction Classification is productive

records.t: Narrative Is Also a Construct
records.x: 肯尼亚长跑与牙买加短跑的集中是真实的；把集中压成民族身体的天赋故事，却会把选择、制度与未测量的人一起抹掉。 Kenyan distance running and Jamaican sprinting are real concentrations. Turning them into stories of national bodies erases selection, institutions, and all the people never measured.
records.q: 叙事也是一种构 Narrative Is Also a Construct 一 两个真实的集中 二 一个必须先分清的区别 三 一个真实的数字，冒充另一个数字 四 每一个故事都比它讲的窄 五 时序不答应 六 两边最强的说法 七 那些没有被测量的人 八 一个把系统压进身体的故事 Two real concentrations A true statistic used as another statistic Every story is narrower than its evidence Chronology resists essence The strongest claims on both sides The people outside the measurement

records.t: Writing a Physiological Constant into a Definition
records.x: 0.100 秒起跑阈值把经验假设写成“抢跑”的定义；艾伦的 0.099 不是不存在，而是被规则定义为不能存在。 The 0.100-second start threshold turned an empirical assumption into the definition of a false start. Allen's 0.099 was real, but the rule defined it as impossible to credit.
records.q: 把生理常数写成定义 Writing a Physiological Constant into a Definition 一 一个枪响之后的动作，被判为不存在 二 假设和定义的区别 三 那个数从哪来，查不到 四 构自己的证据，建议改，而它没改 五 生理那一端，根本没有一个稳定的数 六 两个案子，不是一回事 七 定义反过来改变了人 八 被定义判为不可能的那些真实 A real movement ruled impossible Assumption and definition The origin is less transparent than the precision Bodies do not share one minimum Two kinds of false start The definition trains the body

records.t: The Construct Offered Closure; the Athletes Declined
records.x: 巴尔希姆与坦贝里共享金牌不是改写规则，而是使用规则预留的“不闭合”出口。制度有能力继续分胜负，也可以授权人不分。 Barshim and Tamberi did not rewrite the rules by sharing gold. They used an authorized exit from closure: the system could separate them, but allowed them not to ask it to.
records.q: 构备好了闭合手段而人不用 The Construct Offered Closure; the Athletes Declined 一 裁判先说了还能继续，运动员才问能不能不继续 二 几个必须先拆掉的说法 三 授权的不是发金牌，是不闭合 四 运动员没有改写规则，只是选了规则给的一条路 五 同一个制度，四次，两种结果 六 一个赞成自己的选择，却反对这个规则的人 七 构会看得更细，也会主动不看 八 一个被预留的，可以合法地不填的格子 “Can we have two golds?” What the tiebreak had already done Authorization not to close Choice within rather than against the rule A critic can praise the choice and resist the rule The deliberately empty cell

records.t: Two Constructs with the Same Name
records.x: 纪录赛与锦标赛都叫赛跑，却生产不同对象：一个优化终点数字，一个分配当场名次。配速系统把这个差别推到台前。 Record races and championship races share a name but produce different objects: one optimizes a finishing number, the other allocates places on the day. Pacing exposes the difference.
records.q: 两个同名的构 Two Constructs with the Same Name 一 同一个名字，两种比赛 二 这个论题要成立，得先收紧一个说法 三 配速员是参赛者，不是场外服务 四 班尼斯特那场，被否决的是前一年 五 从雇一只兔子，到造一套生产系统 六 那道光该不该算外部帮助 七 三个人的账，和一张合并的表 八 锦标赛决赛，几乎不破纪录 九 别的运动，给了不同的答案 十 一个被拒绝命名的差异 One name, two competitions Pacemakers are competitors Bannister's mile and the race that did not count Is the light external assistance? Three ledgers and one merged table Finals rarely make ideal record attempts A difference the vocabulary resists

records.t: One Distance, Two Ledgers
records.x: 波士顿马拉松的赛道可以量得准确，却不满足世界纪录的地理条件。同一个 42.195 公里因此同时属于赛事史与纪录史。 Boston can be an accurately measured marathon yet fail world-record geography. The same 42.195 kilometres therefore belongs to race history and record history in different ways.
records.q: 同一距离两套账 One Distance, Two Ledgers 一 一条量得准的赛道，和一条能进纪录的赛道 二 自行车不相信自己的轮子 三 宁可长一点，不可短一点 四 那条几何的线，没有一个生理的理由 五 波士顿在线的另一边，而它没有因此变小 六 一个距离，字面意义上的两套账 七 规则选择不去规范的东西 八 枪响的时钟，和你自己的时钟 九 世界最好，和世界纪录 十 线为可比性而划，而它划下时，总有东西在线外 Accurate distance, ineligible geometry The calibrated bicycle does not trust itself A geometric line, not a physiological theorem Boston remains Boston What the rules leave unregulated Gun time and personal time

records.t: Do Not Ask What Was Intended
records.x: 反兴奋剂的严格责任不以主观故意为成立条件，但责任成立与处罚轻重仍是两层。制度不问内心，也不能假装没有个人。 Anti-doping strict liability does not require proof of intent, but violation and sanction remain separate questions. The system brackets the inner life without making the person disappear.
records.q: 别问 Do Not Ask What Was Intended 一 一条不问内心的规则 二 不问内心，不等于自动重罚 三 两层之间，批评落在哪里 四 同一个案子，两个相反的裁决 五 一个必须每天申报的一小时 六 十年之后的样本 七 一块迟到十几年的奖牌 八 一个把不问推到极致的例外 九 克里格自己怎么说 十 系统，和个人 A rule that does not inquire into intention Not asking does not mean automatic maximum punishment Two cases can point in opposite directions The declared hour A medal returned late The extreme counterexample System and person

records.t: The Ledger Keeps Entries It Cannot Vouch For
records.x: 一些可疑的历史纪录仍在册上，不是制度确信它们清白，而是集体证据、统计异常与个案证明之间不能互相冒充。 Some suspect historical records remain because institutional evidence, statistical anomaly, and proof against an individual entry are not interchangeable.
records.q: 账本保存着自己无法背书的条目 The Ledger Keeps Entries It Cannot Vouch For 一 一批还在账上的纪录 二 一次没有做成的清账 三 三条路，和它们各自的死胡同 四 两种不同的错误 五 受伤的，是具体的人 六 那个年代，不是没有检测 七 一个只能朝一个方向用的能力 八 系统的证据，不是对纪录的裁定 九 统计的距离，不是证据 十 账本无法为自己背书 Records that outlived their world The reset that did not happen Three roads, three dead ends Two different errors Testing existed, but not as it does now System evidence and individual judgment Distance from the distribution is not proof

records.t: The Construct Invents a Category for the Remainder
records.x: 中立个人运动员与难民奥运代表队不是天然身份，而是制度为国家资格闸门装不下的人发明的不同通道。 Individual Neutral Athletes and the Refugee Olympic Team are not natural identities. They are distinct pathways invented for people the nationality gate cannot otherwise place.
records.q: 构为余项发明类别 The Construct Invents a Category for the Remainder 一 一批闸门装不下的人 二 中立不是没有国籍 三 从排除，到替换，到一个反复可用的动作 四 一个申请，审查，筛选的系统 五 奥运会里的个人中立运动员 六 难民队，一个不同的东西 七 这个类别移除了什么，又建立了什么 八 两副面孔 九 运动员自己怎么说 十 一个既是门也是墙的类别 Athletes the national gate cannot hold Neutral does not mean stateless From exception to reusable device Application, review, selection The Refugee Olympic Team is different What the category removes and creates Door and wall

records.t: How Fast, High, and Far Can a Person Go?
records.x: 从四分钟一英里到“女子何时超过男子”，极限预测反复把纪录曲线误当成人。尺子能追踪构生产出的数字，却够不到主体的最后刻度。 From the four-minute mile to predictions that women will overtake men, limit forecasts repeatedly mistake record curves for persons. The ruler tracks numbers produced by a system, not the final measure of a subject.
records.q: 一个人到底能多快多高多远 How Fast, High, and Far Can a Person Go? 一 一个反复被算错的数 二 四分钟一英里，从来没有被科学判过死刑 三 一英里三分半，一个五十年的赌约 四 女子会超过男子，一个反复落空的日期 五 二一五六年，一个还没到期的预测 六 加进生理学，并没有取消外推 七 一条会失败的渐进线 八 科学怪人运动员 九 一条纪录，和它底下的那片人 十 尺子够不到的那个刻度 A number repeatedly predicted too soon The four-minute mile was not scientifically declared impossible Three minutes thirty and a long wager When will women overtake men? Physiology does not abolish extrapolation The Frankenstein athlete One record and the population beneath it The mark the ruler cannot reach

records.t: The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Athletics
records.x: 二十三篇文章，从古代胜者名单、纪录与计时，到技术、分类、反兴奋剂与人的极限。 Twenty-three essays on records, rules, bodies, technology, classification, and human limits.
records.q: 凿构周期律：田径 The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Athletics

records.t: Aging Is the Running Cost
records.x: 衰老不是损坏积累，而是维护系统本身的递归失效。
records.q: 老化是运行代价 Aging Is the Running Cost 为什么修复追不上损坏 第二阶模型 为什么无法全局停止 认知老化与身体老化：两条平行的第二阶降解 延迟的天花板比我们想象的高 Why Repair Cannot Keep Up with Damage The Second-Order Model Why Global Stopping Is Extraordinarily Difficult Cognitive and Bodily Aging: Two Parallel Second-Order Degradations The Delay Ceiling Is Higher Than We Think

records.t: Periodic Table of Life I: From Causality to Reproduction
records.x: 从因果律到繁殖律：生命如何从逻辑结构中涌现。
records.q: 生命元素周期表 I：从因果到繁殖 Periodic Table of Life I: From Causality to Reproduction 为什么需要两个尺度 第一轮：先验（1DD–4DD） 第一桥：从因果到复制（4DD → 5DD） 第二轮：生命（5DD–8DD） 意识难问题的精确定位 Why Two Scales Are Needed Round 1: A Priori (1DD–4DD) Bridge 1: From Causality to Replication (4DD → 5DD) Round 2: Life (5DD–8DD) The Hard Problem of Consciousness: Precise Location

records.t: Periodic Table of Life II: From Reproduction to Prediction
records.x: 从繁殖到预测：意识的起源，以及主体如何说出"我"。
records.q: 生命元素周期表 II：从繁殖到预测 Periodic Table of Life II: From Reproduction to Prediction 第二桥：从繁殖到选择（8DD → 9DD） 第三轮：认知（9DD–12DD） 动物行为的分层 12DD的余项与"我"的涌现 Bridge 2: From Reproduction to Selection (8DD → 9DD) Round 3: Cognition (9DD–12DD) A Stratification of Animal Behavior The Remainder of 12DD and the Emergence of "I"

records.t: Periodic Table of Life III: From “I” to the Thing-in-Itself
records.x: 从"我"到物自体：精神分析、目的、相互Non Dubito与框架的边界。
records.q: 生命元素周期表 III：从“我”到物自体 Periodic Table of Life III: From “I” to the Thing-in-Itself 从"我"出发 第四轮：自由（13DD–16DD） 物自体 Starting from "I" Round 4: Freedom (13DD–16DD) The Thing-in-Itself

records.t: Fixation, Fragility, and Radiation
records.x: 五次大灭绝的选择性模式不由杀伤机制决定，而由锁死深度决定。
records.q: 固化、脆弱与辐射 Fixation, Fragility, and Radiation 一个没有被回答的问题 繁殖律封闭复制 锁死深度才是关键 大灭绝是暴力打断，不是桥 An Unanswered Question Reproductive Law Forecloses Replication Lock-in Depth Is What Matters Mass Extinction Is Violent Interruption, Not a Bridge

records.t: Biology & Evolution
records.x: 从凿构循环到大灭绝动力学：SAE框架对生命、意识与演化的结构性分析。
records.q: 生物学与演化 Biology & Evolution

records.t: Pizza | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 01
records.x: Ten thousand bitcoin bought two pizzas—and exposed the distance between a flawless transfer and a purchase in the world.
records.q: Pizza Before it was a monument Two prices, two kinds of measure What the block preserved The first moving boundary

records.t: From CPU to Mining Farms | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 02
records.x: GPU, ASICs, pools, and mining contracts turned open computation into an industry organized by capital, energy, and geography.
records.q: From CPU to Mining Farms A polite race begins Hardware rewrites participation Pools solve one uncertainty and build another Count more than hashrate

records.t: Mt. Gox | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 03
records.x: The chain verified every signature while the largest exchange lost control of the keys it held for other people.
records.q: Mt. Gox A card site becomes a bank The ledger did not see theft Bankruptcy creates another measure The lesson is not “not your keys” alone

records.t: Silk Road | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 04
records.x: A market excluded from public institutions rebuilt escrow, arbitration, reputation, and enforcement in private form.
records.q: Silk Road A supposedly institutionless market Trust changed address Power entered through the remainder Exclusion is not absence

records.t: Ethereum | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 05
records.x: The “world computer” became a state machine priced by gas, leaving intent, governance, and the cost schedule to people.
records.q: Ethereum From money to a programmable state Gas makes computation legible A machine still has governors General interfaces multiply remainders

records.t: The DAO | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 06
records.x: An exploit separated code execution, participant intent, node choice, and market naming—and left two chains alive.
records.q: The DAO One event, four rules “The code allowed it” is incomplete The fork revealed where sovereignty lived Immutability is also a choice to continue

records.t: ICO | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 07
records.x: ERC-20 standardized how tokens connect; it did not standardize why an issuer deserved trust.
records.q: ICO The power of one small interface Compatibility looked like legitimacy Regulation followed the promise, not the method An interface is not an institution

records.t: Two Roads to a Stablecoin | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 08
records.x: Fiat reserves and crypto collateral redistribute the yield, risk, and redemption right behind a non-interest-bearing dollar token.
records.q: Two Roads to a Stablecoin A dollar that travels differently Stability moves rather than disappears The holder and the reserve earn differently Ask who may redeem

records.t: AMMs and DeFi Summer | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 09
records.x: Automated curves enabled continuous trading while governance, subsidies, concentration, and losses remained outside the interface.
records.q: AMMs and DeFi Summer A market made from inventory The curve does not create value Liquidity mining changes the question Automation has a political edge

records.t: Oracles | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 10
records.x: Oracles let contracts accept outside prices, but no number of agreeing nodes can make a false input true.
records.q: Oracles The chain cannot look outside Consensus is not correspondence Incentives have a direction The seam is the product

records.t: Liquidation | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 11
records.x: Maker’s zero-bid auctions showed how a process can follow its rules while charging the entire loss to users unable to enter the auction.
records.q: Liquidation A normal safety mechanism Black Thursday Repairs name different victims Procedure needs an access condition

records.t: NFT | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 12
records.x: An NFT records control of a token; it does not automatically deliver the image, copyright, server, or community promise.
records.q: NFT One token, several objects Ownership is a bundle Price can describe activity without describing it well Do not ask the token to be everything

records.t: The Migration of Hashrate | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 13
records.x: After China’s mining restrictions, computation crossed borders while jobs, electricity costs, and local burdens stayed in place.
records.q: The Migration of Hashrate A network moves through machines A clean graph hides a rough journey Geography returns through energy Mobility distributes bargaining power unevenly

records.t: El Salvador | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 14
records.x: Bitcoin legal tender produced different verdicts in law, wallet adoption, public finance, and everyday use.
records.q: El Salvador One policy, several experiments Success depends on the denominator Consent matters inside adoption There is no single national ledger

records.t: Bridges | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 15
records.x: A bridge does not move an asset between chains; it persuades one chain to accept a statement about another.
records.q: Bridges Nothing crosses the gap Several security models share one word Attacks occur between valid ledgers Interoperability is an institution

records.t: Terra and Luna | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 16
records.x: The mint-and-burn rule kept honoring a one-dollar nominal conversion even after that conversion ceased to preserve real value.
records.q: Terra and Luna Stability through an endogenous asset The rule survived its meaning Earlier exits and later exits were not equal An internal ruler cannot guarantee an external value

records.t: FTX | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 17
records.x: Control permissions, customer shortfall, criminal loss, and bankruptcy distribution became four different ledgers.
records.q: FTX A centralized institution behind crypto screens Nine days exposed several meanings of “missing” Law fixes a date so a process can move Recovery is not retroactive trust

records.t: The Merge | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 18
records.x: Ethereum replaced proof of work and sharply reduced energy use, while concentration, MEV, and censorship questions moved into staking and block building.
records.q: The Merge A live machine changes its engine A real cost fell Concentration changed form A solved problem reveals the next boundary

records.t: Layer 2 | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 19
records.x: Correctness, control, and cash flow are independent axes; the phrase “inherits Ethereum security” can hide their differences.
records.q: Layer 2 Execution moves, settlement remains Finality has stages Security is more than mathematical correctness Temporary scaffolding needs an exit test

records.t: Real-World Assets | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 20
records.x: Putting fund shares on-chain also brings identity, custody, correction, and legal claims back into settlement.
records.q: Real-World Assets A token points beyond itself Control is not the legal claim Redemption is where the layers meet The return of institutions is not defeat

records.t: Where the Boundary Stands Today | The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Blockchain 21
records.x: As of August 2026, stablecoins, cross-border payments, and restitution cases show both what chains now measure well and what remains outside.
records.q: Where the Boundary Stands Today Sixteen years of narrowing Adoption needs several measures Compensation reveals the hidden constitution The boundary remains on the human side

records.x: The only person who used construction to end construction itself.

records.t: Morning Creativity Has Nothing to Do with Energy
records.x: 睡眠不是在恢复精力，是在清空大脑的预测缓存。冥想和心流都降低内心独白，但方向完全相反：一个在清空，一个在灌满。
records.q: 早上适合创造，不是因为精力好 Morning Creativity Has Nothing to Do with Energy 桌子的类比 三种管理方式 看起来一样，方向相反 可以怎么用 意识的断裂是创造力的条件 The Desk Analogy Three Management Modes Same Surface, Opposite Direction How to Use This Discontinuity Is the Condition of Creativity

records.t: Who Pays the Electricity Bill
records.x: 一场碰撞要落进这里，须过两道门。而碰撞的大小不定射程——两个人僵住的可能只是谁去交电费。 A collision has to pass two gates to fall here. And size does not decide scope: what two people have frozen over may only be who pays the electricity bill.
records.q: Who Pays the Electricity Bill 谁去交电费 Two People, and a Thing Neither of Them Will Put Down Two Gates Four Names That Look Like They Set the Scope, and Do Not What the Object Gate Actually Says The First Narrowing: No Certifying Each Other's Arrival The Second and Third: No Legislating, No Settling by Leaving Is This End Mine? Conflict Cannot Be Exempted One Cell Marked Off 两个人，与一件谁也放不下的事 两道门 四个看起来能定射程、其实不能的名目 对象门究竟说了什么 第一条收窄：不能互相认证到达 第二条与第三条：不能替对方立法，不能以单方退出完成结算 这一端是不是我的法 冲突不能免除 另划出一格

records.t: Two Ledgers
records.x: 那句重话被认了，两个人和好了，而家里的事该不该先商量这一问，一个字都没有动。伤害与不相容是两张账，并行记。 The hard thing said got owned, the two of them made up, and the question of whether household things get decided together has not moved by a word. Harm and incompatibility are two ledgers, kept in parallel.
records.q: Two Ledgers 两本账 The Hard Thing Said Two Roads That Cannot Be Taken Graded Handover The Day the Household Got Sorted Into Three Kinds Handling Is a Means, and the Objective Function Is Not Winning The Step That Is Not Among the Options One More Cell, and What Parallel Actually Costs 那句很重的话 两条不能走的路 分级交接 家里的事分成三类的那一天 处理是手段，而目标函数不是赢 不在选项里的那一步 再划一格，与并行记账的实际代价

records.t: Not by Person
records.x: 分路不按人分，按当前的关系条件分。互向条件可用时走互向路，不可用时走单向路——而转路的根据是当前互向过程不可用这件事本身，不必再加一项关于对方内心或层级的解释。 The paths divide by the current condition of the relation, not by the person. And what licenses a switch is that the reciprocal process is currently unavailable — nothing further about the other's inner life or layer.
records.q: Not by Person 不按人分 Two Relational Conditions How a Path Gets Chosen, Without Judging a Person Three Consequences of Dividing by Condition What Starting on the Reciprocal Path Looks Like Three Places This Is Not the War Treatise What the Division Is For 两种关系条件 路怎么选，而不判人 按条件分路的三个后果 从互向路起手是什么样子 三处与战争论不同 这个分法是为了什么

records.t: Four Concentric Circles
records.x: 正视，深入理解，向终，受问。四条都以「不得不」起句，而它们不是四条规范，是条件—构成式：只要我仍占据这个处理位置，这四项就是这个位置本身不能取消的条件。 Face it, deepen the understanding, be directed toward a terminus, remain open to questioning. Four clauses that all begin with cannot-not — and none of them is a rule.
records.q: Four Concentric Circles 四个同心圆 Which Kind of Cannot-Not These Are Cannot-Not Face It Cannot-Not Deepen the Understanding Cannot-Not Be Directed Toward a Terminus Cannot-Not Remain Open to Questioning Among the Four 这四条是哪一种不得不 不得不正视 不得不深入理解 不得不向终 不得不受问 四条之间

records.t: I Understood Him
records.x: 互向路上双方进入同一个互向过程；单向路上没有。而单向路上最要紧的一句是：我理解了他为什么这样，不等于他同意了我的理解，更不等于这件事就此说定。 On the reciprocal path both enter the same process. On the unilateral path they do not — and the sentence that matters most there is that understanding why he does it settles nothing between us.
records.q: I Understood Him 我理解了他 Deepening Together Two Termini, Not Ranked A Different Scene Four Things About That Word Four Positions Facing the Other What Understanding Does Not Settle 共同深入 两种终，不排序 换一个场景 关于那个词的四句话 面向对方的四种位置 理解不结算什么

records.t: A Stopping Point Is Not Stalling
records.x: 终，止点，移出，暂停，拖着——五个词各有专用，不得互换。而最难的一处须直说：止点与拖着，从外面没有可保证闭合的判准。 Terminus, stopping point, removal, pause, stalling — five words, each with its own use. And the hardest thing has to be said plainly: from outside, no criterion guaranteed to close separates the second from the last.
records.q: A Stopping Point Is Not Stalling 止点不是拖着 Two Layers First Five Words, Each With Its Own Use The Two Histories of Consensus Mutual Acknowledgement of Incommensurability The Local Stopping Point Removal 先分两层 五个词各有专用 共识的两种发生史 互相承认不可通约 局部止点 移出

records.t: These Two People Have No Terminus
records.x: 单向路可以一直走下去吗。不可以。三道门，任何一道命中，这条路暂停。而无论走到哪一处，有一句都成立：这一场冲突有它的边界，可以取得终，也可以取不到。这两个人没有终。 Can the unilateral path be walked indefinitely? No. Three gates, any one of which pauses it. And wherever it ends up, one sentence holds: this conflict has its boundary. These two people do not.
records.q: These Two People Have No Terminus 这两个人没有终 Three Stopping Gates What Follows a Pause Where the Four Constraints Stand Afterwards What This Whole Apparatus Actually Did What This Treatise Did Not Do Back to the Two of Them 三道停止门 暂停之后 四条约束在各处的地位 这一整套东西到底做了什么 这一篇没有做的 回到开头那对人

records.t: When Two Laws Meet
records.x: 两条已经成形的自己的法，在同一情境里要求不相容的行动，而三件事同时成立：不能互相认证到达，不能替对方立法，也不能由任何一方单方退出而完成结算。七篇散文改写自《SAE 冲突论》。Seven essays on what happens when two laws, each its bearer's own, require incompatible action.
records.q: When Two Laws Meet 两条法相遇的时候

records.t: The Way of the Legislative Subject
records.x: 道德律不从善恶出发，而从结构出发。15DD立法主体不是更好的人，而是运算配置不同的主体——具备伤害能力而选择不伤害。姿态汇聚非命题汇聚，邓巴数与气泡架构，14DD殖民的形成性功能与三相演化。
records.q: 立法主体之道 The Way of the Legislative Subject

records.t: The Four Theorems
records.x: 四条不能不：识认他者为目的、扩展识认半径、寻求扩展方向、让自身识认结构接受质询。识认是克制，不是给予。余项动力学、拓扑开放与物理回应、与战争论四条定理的同构。
records.q: 四条道德律 The Four Theorems

records.t: The Mirror, Inside and Out
records.x: 内省性公平：首先是你对自己是否公平。声誉是你的识认结构在共同体场域中的显示状态——不是你的财产，而是共同体持有的关于你的状态。太阳类比、日久见人心、分布式共同体承认对抗策略性伪装。
records.q: 内外之镜 The Mirror, Inside and Out

records.t: Mutual Chiseling, Positive-Sum
records.x: 道德庭的原告是加害方，不是受害方。两个立法主体真诚互凿，结果是正和——因为主体性是活动而非资源，物自体是不可穷尽的。痛感展示与控告的语法区分，尊重余项与位移余项的对偶，多纳泰罗与布鲁内莱斯基。
records.q: 共凿正和 Mutual Chiseling, Positive-Sum

records.t: The Person in Mixed Reality
records.x: 真实的共同体从来不是纯粹的。在14DD主导的世界里，15DD主体如何生存、辨识、合作、退出。萌发·翻转·确立三区段，无完人原则，科雅扎克、苏菲·朔尔、萨维特里巴伊·普勒——从下往上的结构性必然，而非从上往下的英雄主义。
records.q: 混合现实中的人 The Person in Mixed Reality

records.t: The Forms of Community
records.x: "我们怎么能拒绝他们呢？他们需要帮助。"集体15DD是涌现属性，不是个体美德的叠加。六维结构差异与成本不对称判据，站熊与德斯卡赫的桥接案例，涵育与殖民的对立，宏观等待与微观立即行动。
records.q: 共同体的形态 The Forms of Community

records.t: The Invisible Architecture
records.x: 安德烈·特罗克梅被捕，村庄的庇护没有停。机构架构不是设计出来的，是既有共同体织物的重新使用。道德庭与14DD法庭的路由，三层识别，聚合见证。无完美机构。
records.q: 看不见的架构 The Invisible Architecture

records.t: Great Convergence, With Remainder
records.x: 跨文明对话的收束：不批判，只阐述异同。否定之路——道、空、neti neti、fanā、维特根斯坦的沉默。物自体的多传统谱系。Levinas、Buber、Ubuntu与道德律的共振和分歧。大同有余项，读者的立法主体性入场。
records.q: 大同有余项 Great Convergence, With Remainder

records.q: 经济理性的四个层级 Four Layers of Economic Rationality 经济学漏掉了什么 底线是怎么来的 当对方不在你这层 三种人的市场 相变不是一个点 手段王国为什么一直赢——以及为什么会输 What Economics Left Out How Principles Emerge When the Other Party Isn't at Your Level A Market of Three Types Phase Transition Has a Window Why Kingdom of Means Has Been Winning — And Why It Will Lose

records.t: Essay 1: Reciprocity and the Gift — Never Settling Was the Point
records.x: 礼物经济不是通往货币的前传，而是一套靠不结清运转的关系秩序——库拉圈、夸富宴与债务的谱系里，藏着凿构周期律最早的余项。

records.x: 最早的文字不是为了写诗，是为了记账。美索不达米亚的神庙账簿把人压进一张债务表，而周期性的清债令，是这套构最早学会的松开余项的办法。

records.x: 价值早就存在，稀缺的从来是让它可以随身携带。吕底亚人打的第一枚琥珀金币，把一把抽象的尺子第一次装进了金属，也让它第一次可以流落到任何人手中。

records.x: 中世纪经院学者一边为公平价格辩护，一边严禁靠时间本身生利。他们守住的不是效率，是一样更古老的东西：不是所有东西都可以被卖。

records.x: 复式记账第一次让账本自己证明自己是对的。帕乔利教人做账时留下的几个不必细问的漏口，后来成了这套构闭合自己最省事的办法。

records.x: 交子是世界上最早的政府纸币，它让货币第一次和金属脱钩。可一张纸要被当真，靠的不是印在纸上的字，是印在纸背后那个不肯写明的信用。

records.x: 重商主义把整个世界读成一本可以清点的账：金银是分数，贸易顺差是加法。可它清点得越彻底，被清点的那些土地和人，就越彻底地变成余项。

records.x: 这一篇暂停了这个系列一贯的克制。保险单上的估值，货舱图纸上的密度，账本里的一行行数字，把一个人压成一个价，压得越精确，供出的罪状就越清楚。

records.x: 看不见的手常被读成一句只讲自利的口号。斯密自己写的另一本书里，早就留着一个不肯被利己心收编的判断者。那个判断者，才是这篇真正要谈的余项。

records.x: 杰文斯、门格尔与瓦拉斯几乎同时把价值搬进了个人的意识里，又几乎立刻要求那个意识交出一个所有人都读得懂的数字。搬进去容易，搬出来，从此再没干净过。
