Beneficence Defines the Giving, Not the Recipient's Entire Status 2. The Relation Can Be One-Way While the Subject Still Refuses 3. When Withdrawal Becomes a Violation 4. How Beneficence Becomes a Claimable Right 5. A Developing Subject Is Already a Rights-Holder 6. Three Boundary Cases: Animal, Infant, Adolescent Conclusion: Back to the Beginning

records.t: Rights Theory
records.x: 权利论 / Rights Theory：七篇散文，从权利的根据、主体资格与制度承认，写到权利和权力、义务、限度及生长。
records.q: 权利论 Rights Theory

records.t: The Storehouse Is Not a Warehouse
records.x: 真正可以和 SAE 对接的，不是一个神秘的第八识实体，而是阿赖耶识—种子系统在转依中发生的整段变化。 The useful interface is not a mysterious eighth-consciousness entity but the transformation of the ālayavijñāna–seed system across an entire path.
records.q: 阿赖耶识不是一座仓库 The Storehouse Is Not a Warehouse 从末那识开始 对接的是转依，不是识体 种子为什么比“记忆”更难 第九识之争留下了什么 The Problem Appears in Manas A Trajectory, Not an Entity Why Seeds Are More Than Memories What the Ninth Consciousness Dispute Reveals

records.t: Chan Does Not Destroy Structure
records.x: 禅宗并不反对地图、次第和方法；它拒绝的是任何一张地图被主体误认成可以永久居住的终点。 Chan is not opposed to maps, stages, or methods. It opposes the moment any map is mistaken for a final place to live.
records.q: 禅宗破掉的不是结构 Chan Does Not Destroy Structure 无住不是没有构 十牛图为什么仍然有用 顿悟和渐修不是时间之争 谁来证明你没有住下 Non-Abiding Does Not Mean No Construction Why the Oxherding Pictures Still Matter Sudden and Gradual Are Not Measures of Speed Who Certifies That You Have Not Settled?

records.t: Emptiness Is Not a Destination
records.x: 中观与 SAE 都拒绝让任何构坐实为自性，却在“假名有没有真实牵制力”这一点上走向两条不同的路。 Madhyamaka and SAE both deny intrinsic closure, then part over whether a conventional construct carries real constraining weight.
records.q: 空不是终点 Emptiness Is Not a Destination 八不不是八把刀 破而不立，还是立而承认余项 四重二谛为什么不会回到原点 真正的缝在“假名” 空也要空掉 Eight Negations, One Attachment Refusing to Establish, or Establishing with Remainder Why the Fourfold Two Truths Do Not Return to the Start The Central Seam Is Conventional Designation Emptying Emptiness—and Questioning Negation

records.t: Can the Highest Be Built?
records.x: 天台把教法理解成因机施设，也把圆满理解成性本具足；前者与涵育相接，后者则与 SAE 的无终态彻底分开。 Tiantai's adaptive pedagogy meets SAE's cultivation, while its inherently complete highest teaching opens a clean and irreducible seam.
records.q: 最高的那一层，能不能被建造 Can the Highest Be Built? 涵育不是替别人抵达 五时不是一条直梯 即空、即假、即中 有最与无最 两边各自的一问 Cultivation Does Not Arrive for Someone Else The Five Periods Are Not a Straight Ladder Empty, Provisional, and Middle A Highest and No Highest The Questions Each Side Can Ask

records.t: If Everything Interpenetrates, Is There Still an Other?
records.x: 华严以事事无碍完成关系，SAE 以不可单方穷尽守住他者；两种完整在“有没有外部”这一点上正面相遇。 Huayan completes relation through unobstructed interpenetration; SAE completes it by preserving an other no single perspective can exhaust.
records.q: 一切互摄之后，还有没有他者 If Everything Interpenetrates, Is There Still an Other? 五教走到哪里分岔 无外，与有外而无外力 互摄是否等于相互理解 因陀罗网只能对上一半 两个相反的危险 Where the Five Teachings Diverge No Outside, and an Outside without External Force Does Interpenetration Mean Mutual Understanding? Indra's Net Matches Only Halfway Two Opposed Risks

records.t: Where Can Other-Power Enter?
records.x: 净土以弥陀本愿完成横超，SAE 坚持一切构必须自凿；真正的缝不在有没有行动，而在越过的力量来自哪里。 Pure Land entrusts crossing to Amitābha's Vow; SAE requires every construct to self-chisel. The seam concerns the source of accomplishment.
records.q: 他力从哪里进入 Where Can Other-Power Enter? 竖出与横超 涵育为什么不是他力 行不是过 SAE 为什么无法表示纯受纳 不能自救，是否反而成为入口 两种完整，不是一种缺两步 Vertical Ascent and Crosswise Transcendence Why Cultivation Is Not Other-Power The Act Is Not the Crossing Why SAE Cannot Represent Pure Reception When Inability Becomes the Entrance Two Completions, Not One Theory Missing Two Steps

records.t: SAE and Buddhist Thought: Six Interfaces
records.x: 从唯识、禅、中观、天台、华严到净土，六篇独立重写的 SAE 佛学接口散文。Six independent essays on SAE in dialogue with Yogācāra, Chan, Madhyamaka, Tiantai, Huayan, and Pure Land.
records.q: SAE佛学：六个接口 SAE and Buddhist Thought: Six Interfaces

records.t: The Questioner He Had to Invent
records.x: Boethius gives his hardest questions to Lady Philosophy. The dialogue shows how powerful self-critique can be—and why an invented interlocutor cannot certify her own independence.
records.q: The Questioner He Had to Invent 他把追问派给了另一个人 A dialogue written under sentence of death The objection he refuses to weaken Neither puppet nor final judge Two ways of turning toward the reader

records.t: The Answer That Became the Illness
records.x: Boethius correctly defines the human being as a rational mortal animal. His mistake begins when a true description signs its author's name and claims to be the whole self.
records.q: The Answer That Became the Illness 他答对了那一问 Five questions at the bedside A true proposition with a false passport Recollection and emergence The danger in the easy answer

records.t: Let Fortune Make Her Own Case
records.x: Lady Philosophy gives Fortune a serious defense, complete with a burden of proof and a condition of defeat. SAE asks what happens when the winning side then occupies the opponent's ground.
records.q: Let Fortune Make Her Own Case 让命运女神自己开口 Fortune takes the witness stand A verdict entered before the reply An opponent as a measure The cost of a strong adversary

records.t: Are You Playing with Me?
records.x: Boethius accuses Philosophy of proving one claim by another inside a closed circle. Her answer turns the alleged defect into the form of the object itself.
records.q: Are You Playing with Me? 你是在拿我玩吗 The listener reconstructs the argument A circle or a borrowed guarantee What SAE does with its own circle How much can an unmoved center support? When another person repeats your words

records.t: Necessity Is Not in the Walker
records.x: A person known to be walking must be walking, but knowledge does not force the step. Boethius and SAE meet in the practice of returning necessity to its proper address.
records.q: Necessity Is Not in the Walker 必然不在走路的人身上 What does seeing add? One pair of examples, two distinctions Reindexing is not refutation The necessity we add afterward

records.t: According to the Knower's Power
records.x: Boethius says that things are known according to the capacity of the knower. SAE follows him to that threshold, then refuses to let a higher faculty cancel an earlier act's remainder.
records.q: According to the Knower's Power 按谁的本事收下来 A principle introduced as diagnosis The same threshold, followed in opposite directions The tribunal of the faculties Applying the principle to Philosophy herself Two capacities, two accounts

records.t: SAE and Boethius’s Consolation of Philosophy
records.x: Six close readings place Boethius’s Consolation of Philosophy beside SAE: the invented examiner, a correct answer that overclaims, Fortune’s defense, circular proof, conditional necessity, and cognition according to the knower’s power.
records.q: SAE and Boethius’s Consolation of Philosophy SAE哲学的慰藉

records.t: Critique Begins at Home
records.x: 一门以追问为方法的哲学，若先把自己排除在追问之外，第一步就已经失效。《SAE第一批判》为何必须先把刀转向自身。 A philosophy organized around interrogation fails at its first step if it exempts itself. The First Critique therefore turns the audit inward before judging anything else.
records.q: 先审自己 Critique Begins at Home 一把先转回来的刀 批判不是宣布怀疑 五章为什么按这个次序出现 规则也必须有地址 读者不是观众 Turning the Instrument Inward Critique Is More Than General Doubt Why the Five Chapters Have an Order Rules Need Addresses Too The Reader Is Not an Audience

records.t: Only One Axiom
records.x: “非不能非”为什么是施行性公理，而“认识必须继续”“余项必然逼出下一步”都不是。先拆掉三种被误写成必然的东西。 Why Negativa cannot be denied is performative, while cognition's continuation and the remainder's alleged motor are not. Three mistaken necessities must be dismantled first.
records.q: 只有一条公理 Only One Axiom “非不能非”说的不是一个东西 第一种误认：认识必须开始 第二种误认：余项会逼出下一刀 第三种误认：没有终点就是没有所得 公理与承担之间的空隙 An Axiom That Is Not an Object First Mistaken Necessity: Cognition Must Begin Second Mistaken Necessity: The Remainder Pushes Third Mistaken Necessity: No Terminus Means No Gain The Space Between Axiom and Undertaking

records.t: Why Call It a First Critique?
records.x: 它继承康德的划界工作，却把批判对象从理性能力移到 SAE 自己的地位账；同名不是复刻，更不是把康德收编进 SAE。 It inherits Kant's work of delimitation while moving the audit from the faculties of reason to SAE's own status ledger. The shared name marks a task, not an annexation.
records.q: 为什么叫第一批判 Why Call It a First Critique? 同一个名字，两件工作 从疆域到辖域 翻转不等于胜出 “人是什么”为什么仍在场 承接的方法，拒绝的继承权 One Name, Two Tasks From Territory to Jurisdiction Reversal Is Not Victory Why the Question of the Human Remains A Method Inherited, an Authority Refused

records.t: How Far Does a Claim Reach?
records.x: 错不只发生在结论上，也发生在地址上。对象、层级、分支、公设四栏，怎样把越界的主张送回它真正成立的位置。 Error can lie in an address as well as a conclusion. Four coordinates—object, level, branch, and postulate—return overextended claims to the places where they actually stand.
records.q: 一条主张管到哪里 How Far Does a Claim Reach? 真或假以前，先问地址 一刀留下的四类账 反面不是余项 四栏地址 实得而非趋近 Ask for the Address Before the Verdict Four Kinds of Debt Left by a Cut The Reverse Side Is Not the Remainder Four Coordinates Gain Without Approach

records.t: Why the Subject Cannot Finish Its Own Portrait
records.x: 当握刀者把自己变成对象，作业完成时的主体已不再等于被写下的主体。主体的物自体不是神秘内核，而是行动与自述之间持续移动的边界。 When the performer becomes an object, the subject who completes the account is no longer identical with the subject it describes. The noumenal limit is a moving gap between action and self-portrait.
records.q: 为什么主体凿不尽自己 Why the Subject Cannot Finish Its Own Portrait 把自己摆到桌上 行动者和产物之间的缝 会移动的对象 目的从哪里来 模型可以有用，但不能冒名 Putting Oneself on the Table The Gap Between Agent and Product An Object That Moves Where Ends Come From Useful Models Without Impersonation

records.t: How a Construct Claims More Than It Earned
records.x: 幻相不是简单的错觉，而是一项构出示了超过过审清单的凭证。八类冒领把最常见的哲学越界逐一登记。 Illusion is not mere appearance but a construct presenting credentials beyond its reviewed record. Eight forms of false claiming map philosophy's recurrent overreach.
records.q: 构怎样冒领地位 How a Construct Claims More Than It Earned 幻相是一种凭证问题 前四类：必然、过审、现站、施行者 后四类：跨支、零点、整体、跨域 幻相为什么比错误更顽固 处置不是删除 Illusion as a Credential Failure The First Four: Necessity, Validation, Station, Performer The Next Four: Branch, Zero Point, Totality, Domain Why Illusion Persists Better Than Error Readdressing Instead of Deleting

records.t: Who Questions the Questioner?
records.x: 他者提供自问无法担保的独立校验，但他者也没有豁免。没有终审者，如何仍让判断有成色，而不坠入无穷倒退。 Others provide a check self-questioning cannot certify, but they receive no immunity. How can judgment retain force without either a final judge or an infinite regress?
records.q: 谁追问追问者 Who Questions the Questioner? 自问为什么不够 他者也会错 无穷倒退怎样停下 追问不是审判人格 一座永不休庭的法庭 Why Self-Questioning Is Not Enough Others Can Be Wrong Stopping Without a Final Guarantor Interrogating Claims, Not Personalities A Court That Never Permanently Adjourns

records.t: Six Postulates, Not Six Foundations
records.x: 六条公设是可替换的承担，不是由唯一公理推出的定理。认识、余项、构、离散与反身如何各自取得明确地位。 The six postulates are replaceable undertakings, not theorems derived from the sole axiom. Cognition, remainder, construction, discreteness, and reflexivity each receive an explicit status.
records.q: 六条公设，不是六块地基 Six Postulates, Not Six Foundations 公设意味着承担 P1：把认识理解为划界 P2 与 P3：余项不可灭，账目可传导 P4 与 P5：构会沉淀，步骤彼此离散 P6：刀可以回到握刀者 A Postulate Is an Undertaking P1: Cognition as Demarcation P2 and P3: Indestructibility and Conservation P4 and P5: Sedimentation and Discreteness P6: The Instrument Can Turn on Its User

records.t: Formalization Cannot Make the Cut
records.x: 形式语言能登记、分离、验证与传导，却不能替我们选择场域、公设或解释。作业者定理划出规则执行与哲学判断之间的界。 Formal language can register, separate, validate, and propagate, but it cannot choose the field, postulates, or interpretation for us. The worker theorem marks the boundary between rule execution and judgment.
records.q: 形式化不能替哲学落刀 Formalization Cannot Make the Cut 形式化真正擅长什么 判断是关系，不只是函数 五个构形证明了什么 作业者定理 借来的器械要入册 What Formalization Does Well Judgment as Relation Rather Than Function What the Five Configurations Establish The Worker Theorem Register Borrowed Instruments

records.t: When a Postulate Is Replaced
records.x: 前提撤回不会让整套理论瞬间变假。依赖清单与传导条款把受影响的结论送回待审，并保存它们曾经有效的历史地址。 Withdrawing a premise does not make an entire theory instantly false. Dependency lists return affected claims for review while preserving the historical address at which they once stood.
records.q: 一条公设换掉以后 When a Postulate Is Replaced 不是抽掉一块砖 历史地址不能抹掉 新公理候选怎样入场 “自己的哲学”落在承担上 可修订不是轻浮 Not a Brick Pulled from a Foundation Historical Addresses Must Remain Visible Admitting a New Axiom Candidate One's Own Philosophy Lies in Assumption Revisability Is Not Carelessness

records.t: Genesis Is Not Warrant
records.x: 发生论给 0D—16DD 逐站分级，却不把历史次序变成合法性证明。序列、方向、后验输入与实然—应然之缝各归各账。 The genesis audit grades 0D–16DD without turning historical order into justification. Sequence, direction, posterior inputs, and the is–ought gap receive separate accounts.
records.q: 路怎样走来，不等于它凭什么有效 Genesis Is Not Warrant 最珍视的路也要受审 序的强度大于站的唯一 方向有来源，没有马达 宇宙、主体、对象是输入 从结构到规范必须另过一关 The Most Valued Road Must Be Audited Order Is Stronger Than Unique Stations Sources of Direction Without a Motor Universe, Subject, and Object as Inputs Structure Does Not Automatically Legislate

records.t: Illumination, Not Proof
records.x: 复数道路可以共享前提、局部互证并暴露彼此盲区，却不能整体替对方奠基。开放审计如何取代一次性的永久执照。 Plural paths may share premises, prove local claims, and expose blind spots without grounding one another as wholes. Open audit replaces the fantasy of a permanent license.
records.q: 照亮，而不证明 Illumination, Not Proof 路一旦复数，关系就要重写 局部证明仍然可能 照亮比证明更广 交叠不是趋同 用公开审计替代永久执照 Plural Roads Require a New Relation Local Proof Remains Possible Illumination Reaches Farther Than Proof Overlap Is Not Convergence Public Audit Instead of a Permanent License

records.t: The SAE First Critique: Twelve Readings
records.x: 依据《SAE第一批判》原论文重写的十二篇导读：公理、辖域、幻相、公设、形式化与发生论。 Twelve reader-facing essays on axiom, jurisdiction, illusion, postulates, formalization, and genesis.
records.q: SAE第一批判：十二讲 The SAE First Critique: Twelve Readings

records.t: When Systems Succeed, What Happens to the Person?
records.x: 一个没有恶意、运转良好的系统，也可能把人逐渐改写成指标、资源和实现系统目标的手段。SAE 从这里开始。 A well-run system needs no villain to reduce people to metrics, resources, and instruments of its own success. SAE begins with that problem.
records.q: 当系统越来越成功，人还剩下什么 When Systems Succeed, What Happens to the Person? 没有坏人的困局 从道德劝告到结构判断 系统不必消失 第一个检验 A Problem Without a Villain From Moral Advice to Structural Judgment The Point Is Not to Abolish Systems The First SAE Test

records.t: Where Systems Must Act—and Where They Must Step Back
records.x: 基础层需要制度坚定出现，涌现层需要制度克制退场。两层不是福利与自由的取舍，而是两种不同的制度责任。 Institutions must secure the Base Layer and withdraw from the Emergence Layer. These are not competing values but two different institutional duties.
records.q: 系统该在何处出现，何处退场 Where Systems Must Act—and Where They Must Step Back 两种看起来都像“帮助”的动作 基础层：系统不能缺席 涌现层：系统必须克制 不是一条固定边界 Two Kinds of Help The Base Layer: Institutions Must Be Present The Emergence Layer: Institutions Must Exercise Restraint A Boundary That Requires Judgment

records.t: Freedom Is Not Having Options; It Is Being Able to Change Course
records.x: 菜单上的选择不等于真实自由。分叉权追问替代道路是否存在、可达、可负担，也是否仍能被想象。 A menu of choices is not freedom. Fork Rights ask whether another path exists, can be reached and afforded, and remains imaginable.
records.q: 自由不是能选，而是改得起 Freedom Is Not Having Options; It Is Being Able to Change Course 选择很多，为什么仍走不了 四个问题 分叉不是逃跑 自由的压力测试 Many Choices, No Viable Departure Four Questions About a Fork Forking Is More Than Walking Away Freedom's Stress Test

records.t: The Most Dangerous Colonization Says, “This Is What I Want”
records.x: 当指标、竞争与优化逻辑变成自我认同，外部命令已经不再必要。内在殖民因此比显性的控制更难退出。 Once metrics, competition, and optimization become identity, external commands are no longer necessary. Internal colonization governs in the first person.
records.q: 最难识别的殖民说：“这正是我想要的” The Most Dangerous Colonization Says, “This Is What I Want” 监工离开以后 五种常见的自我 不是揭露一个假的自我 恢复第一人称 After the Supervisor Leaves Five Familiar Selves Not a Hunt for a Hidden True Self Recovering the First Person

records.t: How Love Becomes a License
records.x: 关系越深，越容易把边界视为不信任。亲密殖民不是虚假的爱，而是真实感情被用来免除对他者的承认。 The deeper the relationship, the easier it is to treat boundaries as distrust. Intimate colonization begins when genuine love becomes an exemption from recognition.
records.q: 爱为什么也会殖民 How Love Becomes a License “我们之间还需要说这些吗” 两层关系 从“我爱你”到“你应该” 爱的反常识标准 “Do We Really Need This Between Us?” Two Dimensions of Relationship From “I Love You” to “Therefore You Owe Me” A Counterintuitive Standard for Love

records.t: Being Seen Back into Existence
records.x: 主体性并不总能靠独自反省恢复。来自深关系、指向存在而非表现的承认，能够为一个被殖民的人重新打开自我。 Subjecthood is not always restored through solitary reflection. Recognition from a deep relationship can reopen a self that performance has closed.
records.q: 一个人怎样被另一个人重新看见 Being Seen Back into Existence 当自救也说着系统的语言 不是说一句“你很好” 承认不能变成接管 借来的光最终要归还 When Self-Help Speaks the System's Language More Than “You Are Good Enough” Recognition Must Not Become Possession Returning the Borrowed Light

records.t: Why Persons, Relationships, and Institutions Must Be Read Together
records.x: 制度提供边界条件，关系承担传导，个人完成最终实现。三层形式相似，却不能互相替代。 Institutions supply boundary conditions, relationships transmit, and persons realize the result. The three layers share a form without becoming interchangeable.
records.q: 人、关系与制度为什么不能分开看 Why Persons, Relationships, and Institutions Must Be Read Together 三种都只说对了一部分的解释 制度是边界条件 关系是传导媒介 个人是最终实现层 从归责转向诊断 Three Partial Explanations Institutions Set Boundary Conditions Relationships Transmit The Individual Is the Layer of Realization From Blame to Diagnosis

records.t: Flourishing, Dormancy, Overdraw, Depletion
records.x: 感觉良好不一定结构健康，边界稳固也不等于生命展开。四种状态帮助我们区分涵育、休眠、透支与耗竭。 Feeling fulfilled does not guarantee structural health, and safety alone is not flourishing. Four states distinguish cultivation from dormancy, overdraw, and depletion.
records.q: 涵育、透支与耗竭 Flourishing, Dormancy, Overdraw, Depletion 为什么“过得很好”还不够 丰盛与休眠 透支与耗竭 涵育不是消除痛苦 Why “Doing Well” Is Not Enough Flourishing and Dormancy Overdraw and Depletion Cultivation Does Not Eliminate Pain

records.t: Why One-Layer Reform Usually Fails
records.x: 三层之间有六个传导方向。单点改变常被旧循环吸收；解锁至少需要两个层面同时出现缺口。 Six pathways connect the three layers. A single reform is often absorbed by the old loop; durable unlocking requires openings in at least two layers.
records.q: 为什么只改变一个层面通常不够 Why One-Layer Reform Usually Fails 一条好政策为什么落不到人身上 旧循环怎样修复自己 至少两个缺口 改革的组合思维 Why a Good Policy May Never Reach a Person How an Old Loop Repairs Itself Openings in at Least Two Layers Thinking in Combinations

records.t: Freedom as a Cannot-Not
records.x: 自由不只是做想做的或拒绝不想做的，而是让真正属于自己的内在必然逐渐长成，同时防止伪“不得不”占领自我。 Freedom is neither appetite nor refusal alone. It is the capacity to grow an inner necessity of one's own without letting a counterfeit must occupy the self.
records.q: 自由是自己的“不得不” Freedom as a Cannot-Not 想做什么就做什么吗 必然与自由为什么不矛盾 三个真实性检验 内部复数性 Doing Whatever You Want? Why Necessity Need Not Oppose Freedom Three Tests of Authenticity Internal Plurality

records.t: When Two Ends Meet
records.x: 承认他者不是替他感受，也不是接受他的一切。互凿、离开与外部仲裁构成两个不可化约主体之间的三种处理方式。 Recognition is neither feeling for another nor accepting everything. Mutual chiseling, walking away, and arbitration govern encounters between irreducible ends.
records.q: 两个目的相遇以后怎么办 When Two Ends Meet 他者不是另一版本的我 互凿 离开 余项 The Other Is Not Another Version of Me Mutual Chiseling Walking Away The Remainder

records.t: Why Institutions Become Necessary
records.x: 当互凿与退出都无法处理纠缠的余项，共同接受、可重复、可问责的仲裁框架便成为必要。制度从这里产生。 When mutual chiseling and exit cannot resolve an entangled remainder, a public, repeatable, accountable framework of arbitration becomes necessary.
records.q: 为什么还需要制度 Why Institutions Become Necessary 如果人人都成熟，还要规则吗 从临时裁决到稳定框架 制度的目的不是制度 权利与义务 Would Perfectly Mature People Need Rules? From a Decision to a Framework The Institution Is Not Its Own End Rights and Obligations

records.t: How Thick Should an Institution Be?
records.x: 制度厚度取决于退出成本与关系密度，不取决于规模。正当制度还必须保留独立的自修凿通道，并遵守最小化原则。 Institutional thickness follows exit cost and relational density, not size. A legitimate institution also preserves independent channels for its own revision.
records.q: 制度应该多厚，又如何允许自己被凿 How Thick Should an Institution Be? 大制度不一定厚，小关系不一定薄 最小化不是越少越好 制度也会退化 声明余项，而非宣称完美 Large Institutions Are Not Always Thick Minimization Is Not Mere Reduction How Institutions Degenerate Declaring Remainders Instead of Perfection

records.t: Subjecthood Is Not Consciousness
records.x: 意识、否定性与主体性是三个不同问题。科学可以寻找余项，伦理却仍须决定是否承认一个存在为主体。 Consciousness, Negativity, and subjecthood are different questions. Science may detect a remainder; recognition remains an ethical act.
records.q: 主体性不是意识 Subjecthood Is Not Consciousness 选读说明 意识问的是“像什么” 否定性问的是“能否被条件穷尽” 主体性需要承认 为什么这一区分重要 An Optional Descent Consciousness Asks What It Is Like Negativity Asks Whether Conditions Exhaust the Being Subjecthood Requires Recognition Why the Distinction Matters

records.t: Where Negativity Comes From
records.x: 若世界存在本体随机性，它怎样可能在宏观尺度留下余项？这是一条有明确条件与防火墙的本体论解释，而非 SAE 伦理框架的前提。 If ontic randomness exists, how might it leave a macroscopic remainder? This is a conditional ontology with a firewall, not a premise of SAE ethics.
records.q: “非”从哪里来 Where Negativity Comes From 一个带“如果”的起点 从微观随机到宏观余项 随机不等于自由 防火墙 A Starting Point That Retains Its “If” From Microphysical Randomness to Macroscopic Remainder Randomness Is Not Freedom The Firewall

records.t: SAE Foundations: How a Person Becomes an End
records.x: 面向普通读者重写的十五篇 SAE 基础散文：十三篇完整基础路径与两篇选读理论深潜。 Fifteen reader-facing essays: a complete thirteen-essay foundation and two optional theory deep dives.
records.q: SAE基础：人如何成为目的 SAE Foundations: How a Person Becomes an End

records.t: When a Remainder Becomes Mine
records.x: 有余项不等于成为主体。这篇短桥梁解释余项何时被记在主体自己的账上，以及这一步为什么通向‘主体是目的’。 Having a remainder is not yet being a subject. This bridge explains when a remainder becomes a subject's own.
records.q: When a Remainder Becomes Mine 余项怎样成为“我的余项” 餘項怎樣成為「我的餘項」 A stone exceeds its description too The account changes hands Authorship is not total control Why this leads to “the subject is an end” The four addresses 石头也会超出描述 这笔账换了归属 作者位置不等于完全控制 为什么这一步通向“主体是目的” 四个门牌号 石頭也會超出描述 這筆帳換了歸屬 作者位置不等於完全控制 為什麼這一步通向「主體是目的」 四個門牌號

records.t: Friends and Truth, Both Dear
records.x: 反驳朋友的理论，是否也在审判朋友本人？亚里士多德批评普遍善，SAE则追问：论证可以拆到哪里，人的名字该不该跟着进去。 Aristotle criticizes the universal Good without turning intellectual disagreement into a verdict on its authors. SAE asks how arguments can remain answerable without putting persons on trial.
records.q: 朋友和真理，两样都亲 Friends and Truth, Both Dear The Courtesy Before the Blow What Aristotle Actually Rejects The Name in the Verdict Friendship Does Not Become Neutrality

records.t: How Far Does Self-Sufficiency Extend?
records.x: 终极目的可以截断无穷追问，却不能自动划定谁应算进一份自足的人生；目的链和成员表，是两种不同的无穷。 A final end may stop an infinite regress of purposes, yet it does not decide whose life belongs inside a self-sufficient good. Aristotle exposes two different infinities.
records.q: 自足要算到哪儿为止 How Far Does Self-Sufficiency Extend? Two Ways of Going On Forever The Purpose Chain The Membership List A Limit Is Not a Membership Rule

records.t: Must Happiness Wait Until Death?
records.x: 索伦要人看结局，亚里士多德却把幸福定义为活动。生命可以结束，关于一生的判断却不会因此自动取得终局。 Solon says to look to the end, but Aristotle defines happiness as activity. A life can end without making every judgment about that life final.
records.q: 幸福要不要等到死 Must Happiness Wait Until Death? Solon's Warning Stability Without Immunity The End of the Life and the End of Review A Life Is Not a Final Verdict

records.t: Doing the Act, Becoming the Person
records.x: 做出公正的事，不等于已经成为公正的人；习惯、选择与稳定品格之间，还隔着一条不能由单次结果替代的路。 A just act does not by itself make a just person. Aristotle separates the right result from knowledge, choice, and stable character; SAE asks how ownership persists across time.
records.q: 做那件事和成为那种人 Doing the Act, Becoming the Person The Apparent Circle The Result Does Not Contain the Person Choosing the Act for Itself Formation Is Neither Exposure nor Performance

records.t: How Far Is Too Far?
records.x: 中道不是一条可计算的刻度线。亚里士多德给出偏向性的实践办法，SAE则提供拆账的格式；两者都不能替人做最后那一判。 The mean is not a calculable midpoint. Aristotle offers directional rules for correcting bias; SAE offers a form for separating claims. Neither can make the final perception for us.
records.q: 过到什么份上才算过 How Far Is Too Far? The Mean Has No Ruler Direction Before Measurement What a Fourfold Audit Can Do The Irreducible Last Inch

records.t: The Stone Has Left the Hand
records.x: 品格由自愿行动形成，却不能像单次动作那样随时撤回。责任如何穿过习惯、可见性与已经变高的改变成本？ Character grows from voluntary acts but cannot be reversed like a single motion. Aristotle's thrown stone reveals a responsibility that begins in choice and survives diminished control.
records.q: 石头扔出去了 The Stone Has Left the Hand Responsibility Before Irreversibility Acts and States Are Voluntary Differently What Habituation Changes The Danger of Backward Omnipotence A Practical Debt for SAE

records.t: Can One Be Unjust to Oneself?
records.x: 严格的正义需要关系双方；当同一个人兼任行为者、受害者和审判者时，名分为什么只能以类比成立？ Strict justice requires distinct parties. When one person is agent, victim, and judge, Aristotle changes the name to analogy; SAE asks what self-audit cannot independently verify.
records.q: 能不能自己对自己不正义 Can One Be Unjust to Oneself? Why Self-Injustice Sounds Obvious The Return of Justice by Analogy Reflexivity Is Not Independence Shared Premises and Manufactured Opponents What We Mean When We Say “You Owe Yourself”

records.t: What Is Practical Wisdom For?
records.x: 明智不是高效抵达既定目标的聪明。亚里士多德把目标、手段与品格缠在一起，迫使 SAE 面对“什么会进入判断”的前置问题。 Practical wisdom is not cleverness at reaching a given target. Aristotle binds ends, means, and character together, forcing SAE to ask what becomes visible before judgment starts.
records.q: 明智到底有什么用 What Is Practical Wisdom For? The Objection Against Practical Wisdom Cleverness Can Serve Any End The Blind Strong Body What Enters the Audit? Ends, Means, and the Person Who Sees Them

records.t: Knowing Better, Doing Otherwise
records.x: “知道”不是单一状态。拥有、调用、落到具体情境与真正同化之间的错位，解释了为什么知识会在行动现场缺席。 Knowledge is not one state. Aristotle distinguishes possession, use, particular perception, and assimilation to explain how someone can know and still act otherwise.
records.q: 明知而故犯 Knowing Better, Doing Otherwise The Socratic Scandal Reciting Empedocles Credentials and Possession The Missing Inventory Knowing Better Is Not One Thing

records.t: Why Does the Self-Sufficient Person Need Friends?
records.x: 朋友不是拿来填补缺口的工具。亚里士多德把友爱放进幸福的活动里，SAE则把他者放进判断的有效性与结算里。 Friends are not tools for filling a deficit. Aristotle places friendship inside the activity of flourishing; SAE places the other inside the validity and settlement of judgment.
records.q: 自足的人还要朋友干什么 Why Does the Self-Sufficient Person Need Friends? The Friend Who Supplies Nothing Missing Another Self, Not a Second Tool The Other in SAE What the Ledger Cannot Count Self-Sufficiency Without Solitude

records.t: Where Does Friendship for Others Begin?
records.x: 亚里士多德让对他人的友爱从理顺的自我关系向外延伸，并一路追到习惯、法律与立法者；SAE只有前提，没有养成链。 Aristotle traces friendship outward from an ordered relation to oneself, then backward through habit, law, and the legislator. SAE has a condition for recognition, but not yet a chain of formation.
records.q: 对邻人的友爱从哪儿来 Where Does Friendship for Others Begin? A Question Set Aside—and Half Answered Extension or a New Judgment? Where the Good Self Comes From A Map of Positions Is Not a Curriculum The First Recognizer

records.t: Is the Highest Good Learned or Given?
records.x: 幸福来自学习、习惯、神授还是运气？亚里士多德先拆开来路与分量，再让最高者反过来限制它可能的来路。 Does happiness come by learning, habituation, divine allotment, or luck? Aristotle first separates origin from worth, then lets the highest good constrain what origins are fitting.
records.q: 最高的那一样是学来的，还是碰上的 Is the Highest Good Learned or Given? Four Possible Origins Origin Does Not Set the Price The Highest Activity Gain Without a Summit Chance at the End

records.t: Why Knowing Is Not Enough
records.x: 讲清德性，不等于把人变好。亚里士多德由说理的限度转向习惯、法律与政治；SAE则把最后的效力交给尚未必会到场的读者。 Explaining virtue does not make people virtuous. Aristotle turns from argument to habit, law, and politics; SAE entrusts its effect to readers who may never arrive.
records.q: 知道了为什么还不够 Why Knowing Is Not Enough Has the Inquiry Reached Its End? A Fact About Means A Book That Hands Itself Over Lowering the Cost Is Not Supplying the Motive From Ethics to Politics Thirteen Essays, All on One Side

records.t: SAE's Nicomachean Ethics
records.x: 十三篇、八种语言，对读亚里士多德《尼各马可伦理学》与 SAE。Thirteen essays in eight languages placing Aristotle's Nicomachean Ethics in dialogue with SAE.
records.q: SAE尼各马可 SAE's Nicomachean Ethics

records.t: Outside the Cave, or Another Cave?
records.x: 洞穴之外是否真有一个不动的终点？柏拉图以转向解释教育，SAE则追问：每次出洞是否也同时划出了新的洞穴。 Plato gives education a direction and the cave an exit. SAE asks whether every exit also draws the boundary of another cave.
records.q: 洞穴之外，还是洞穴 Outside the Cave, or Another Cave? A Republic That Begins in Conversation The Word That Carries the Allegory Is There a Final Outside? The Prisoner's Knowledge Was Not Nothing What Makes Anyone Stand Up?

records.t: The Sun and What Cannot Be Seen
records.x: 善的理念像太阳，使认识与存在成为可能；SAE最底层的“非”却只是一项不可绕过的操作，不提供任何内容。 Plato's Good gives intelligibility and being. SAE's irreducible negation makes distinction possible while giving nothing at all.
records.q: 太阳与不能被看的东西 The Sun and What Cannot Be Seen The Principal Plato Cannot Pay What the Sun Supplies A Source and an Operation Why “Good” Changes the Architecture Plato's Question Back to SAE

records.t: The Divided Line Is Not a Ladder but a Ledger
records.x: 柏拉图把是否追问前提转化为认识层级；SAE接受追问，却把四格横排成一刀可能欠下的四类账。 Plato turns a difference in how premises are handled into a hierarchy of cognition. SAE keeps the audit and rejects the ladder.
records.q: 线段不是梯子，是账 The Divided Line Is Not a Ladder but a Ledger Four Segments, One Hierarchy When an Audit Becomes a Ladder Four Entries in the Ledger What the Ladder Still Does Better

records.t: The Invisible Man Goes Unquestioned
records.x: 吉格斯戒指取消的不只是惩罚，而是外部追问；未经结算的理由会沉为下一次行动的地面。 The Ring of Gyges removes more than punishment. It removes the external question that keeps a private justification from hardening into ground.
records.q: 隐身的人不被追问 The Invisible Man Goes Unquestioned Glaucon Makes the Other Side Stronger What Invisibility Removes Why Self-Examination Cannot Guarantee the Audit Glaucon's Hard Reply

records.t: The Tripartite Soul and the Chain of Becoming
records.x: 柏拉图把灵魂画成同时在场的三部分，SAE则给出不可调序的发生链；一张表把人扣住，一条链如何仍算同一个人？ Plato maps three parts of the soul at once. SAE offers an ordered chain of emergence—and inherits the problem of what makes the chain one life.
records.q: 三分的灵魂与发生的链 The Tripartite Soul and the Chain of Becoming From the City Back to the Soul A Table and a Chain Rule or Non-Acceptance Plato's Question Back to SAE

records.t: Whom Is the Craft of Ruling For?
records.x: 柏拉图把被治者利益写进统治概念；SAE再追问，被治者手中是否保留了能够令过程停下的真实位置。 Plato defines ruling by the good of the ruled. SAE adds a second test: does the governed person retain any effective power to stop the process?
records.q: 统治这门手艺为谁做 Whom Is the Craft of Ruling For? The Advantage of the Stronger A Craft Seeks the Good of Its Object Where Plato and SAE Meet Benevolent Rule and the Missing Veto Rights in Principle, Power in Practice

records.t: One Person, One Work—and the Person as an End
records.x: 两边都把重量押在“自己的”上；但柏拉图的职责由城邦辨认，SAE的自身之法只能由本人确立。 Both accounts place enormous weight on what is one's own. They divide over who can determine it: the city, or the person whose life it is.
records.q: 各司其职，和人是目的 One Person, One Work—and the Person as an End How Specialization Becomes Justice Two Meanings of “One's Own” The Finger and the Statue Someone Still Has to Stand Watch

records.t: Gold, Silver, Bronze, Iron
records.x: 共同神话并非问题本身；危险出现在一道人定程序被改写成天生秩序，使它失去可继续追问的下一句。 The civic myth becomes dangerous when a human procedure is redescribed as natural order and the next question is no longer permitted.
records.q: 金银铜铁 Gold, Silver, Bronze, Iron Socrates Hesitates Before Telling a Lie Myth Is a Human Capacity The Open Door That Concentrates Power Can a Transparent Myth Still Bind?

records.t: Why Must the Philosopher Return?
records.x: 上升与返回都用了“强迫”：柏拉图以城邦养育出的债要求哲人下洞，SAE则只能等待主体自己转身。 Plato compels the philosopher both upward and back down. SAE accepts the return but cannot derive it from a debt owed to the city.
records.q: 为什么要强迫哲人回去 Why Must the Philosopher Return? The Second Compulsion Return as the Completion of Ascent The Debt to the City Where Does the First Return Come From?

records.t: What Leaves with the Banished Poet?
records.x: 诗使尚未被概念收纳的部分保持有声；但表达与操弄走过同一道情感闸门，谁能保证自己没有被诗所用？ Poetry gives voice to what concepts leave out. But expression and manipulation pass through the same emotional gate—how can we tell them apart?
records.q: 被逐的诗人带走了什么 What Leaves with the Banished Poet? Plato Reopens the Case Against Poetry The Emotional Charge What the Exile Carries Away Expression or Manipulation?

records.t: Decline Is Not a Fall but Compound Interest
records.x: 政体退化并非每代人各坏一次，而是上一层未经复核的前提成为下一层无需再问的地面。 Political decline need not mean worse people in every generation. Unreviewed premises can become the unquestioned ground of the next regime.
records.q: 退化不是堕落，是复利 Decline Is Not a Fall but Compound Interest The Ideal City Begins to Fail with an Error Mechanism Before Moral Decline Democracy's Disease and Medicine Who Keeps the Court Open?

records.t: The Responsibility Belongs to the Chooser
records.x: 厄尔神话把责任交给选择者，却把人生做成预先摆好的整包选项；SAE则不给包裹，只留下还能继续落刀之处。 The Myth of Er assigns responsibility to the chooser but offers preassembled lives. SAE replaces the menu with a path that remains open to another cut.
records.q: 责任在选择者 The Responsibility Belongs to the Chooser The Final Story Choice Without a Menu Always Short of What?

records.t: Mutual Illumination without Mutual Proof
records.x: 两套理论可以在共用处局部对照，却不能拿各自整套前提替对方奠基；最后的盲区落在读者身上。 Frameworks can meet locally without lending one another foundations. The final blind spot belongs neither to Plato nor SAE, but to the reader.
records.q: 互相照亮，无法互证 Mutual Illumination without Mutual Proof Refutation Is Not Yet an Answer Why Frameworks Cannot Prove One Another What the Comparison Actually Found Who Supplies the Standard of Accuracy? Going Down

records.t: SAE's Republic
records.x: 十三篇对读柏拉图《理想国》与 SAE 框架的八语散文。Thirteen essays in eight languages placing Plato's Republic in dialogue with the Self-as-an-End framework.
records.q: SAE理想国 SAE's Republic

records.t: On the Source of Value
records.x: 价值源有结构而不排序。四行源图区分经验、自我边界、自己的目的与他者作为目的，并建立14DD通向15DD的桥。Value-sources have structure without ranking: four rows, two axes, and the bridge from 14DD to 15DD.
records.q: On the Source of Value 论价值的源 Abstract 1. First, What a Value-Source Is 2. It Has Structure, and Admits No Ranking 3. Three Orders 4. Whose Sources These Are 5. Where a Source Sits Is Not Who Bears It 6. Where the Floor Begins 7. The Source-Figure: Four Rows 8. The Line That Runs Through: One's Own Value 9. Two Axes 10. Shape, Reversibility, and the Anti-Teleological Signature 11. From the Third Row to the Fourth: The Bridge 12. Relational Crossing 13. Acknowledgment and Cultivation: Noun, Noun, Verb 14. Handed On 摘要 一、先说清楚「价值源」是什么 二、有结构，不排序 三、三种序 四、谁在承担 五、源落在哪一层，不等于谁在承担 六、地板从哪里起算 七、价值源图：四行 八、统一线：自己的价值 九、两根轴 十、形状、可反复，与那道反目的论的签名 十一、从第三行到第四行：那座桥 十二、关系性交叉 十三、承认与涵育：名词、名词、动词 十四、交给后面几篇

records.t: On the Occurrence and Recognition of Value
records.x: 价值发生的几何：显现与第一人称认可构成一条轴，社会承认是横穿的另一根轴，能给出公共位置也能收回，唯独不能替谁认领。 The geometry of value-occurrence: one axis of appearance and first-person avowal, crossed by an axis of social recognition that can give a public place and take it back, and can never claim on your behalf.
records.q: On the Occurrence and Recognition of Value 论价值的发生与承认 Abstract 1. A Source Gives the Slot; Occurrence Fills It 2. One Axis of Occurrence, One Axis of Recognition 3. Two Roads by Which a Content Appears 4. “I Like Singing” and “Singing Matters to Me” 5. Avowal Is a Claiming, Not a Verification 6. After the Claiming, the Door Stays Open 7. Three Borders of the Avowal Place 8. No One Can Revoke It for You 9. What a Community Can Give and Take Back 10. The Modal Asymmetry of the Three Places 11. Shaping: First, Rule Out Locking 12. Cultivation and Evocation 13. Two Roots That Never Merge 14. Where This Resembles Rights Theory, and Where It Stops 15. What Remains 提要

records.t: On the Colonization of Value
records.x: 殖民不是外来影响的加深，是构成位被一个外来目的占着：它不成功地构成，只成功地被当作构成。判据要窄——三项签名、两支、审计的上界。 Colonization is not outside influence deepened. It is the constitutive place occupied by an external end: it does not succeed in constituting, only in being taken as constitution.
records.q: On the Colonization of Value 论价值的殖民 Abstract 1. The Criterion Has to Be Narrow 2. Where the Constituting Was Made 3. Three Things That Follow 4. Not a Kind of Action but a State 5. Provenance Does Not Judge 6. Two Branches, and Two Scopes 7. Three Actions at Three Places 8. Occupation 9. Introjection 10. Locking 11. Adjacent Forms, and Two Forkings 12. Changing Is Not Being Colonized 13. The Upper Bound of Audit 14. Self-Colonization: What Is Missing Is Discovery 15. The Form on Each of the Four Rows 16. Three Borders, and What This Criterion Costs 17. It Can Only Be Read in Retrospect 18. Four Things to Hold, and Where the Way Out Is 19. Pre-occupation at Subjects-to-Be

records.t: On the Dynamics of Value
records.x: 进入时间的是三样东西：源的可达、具体内容、重心。已取得的源位不动。而这里没有马达——解释只取「哪些位置当时开着，哪条路当时可达」的形式。 Three things enter time: a source's reachability, concrete contents, the centre of gravity. A source-position once gained does not move. And there is no motor here.
records.q: On the Dynamics of Value 论价值的动力学 Abstract 1. Three Things Enter Time 2. No Motor 3. Accumulation and Diachrony 4. Underdetermined from Outside 5. What Reachability Is 6. Four Men 7. Gaining Is Not Retrieving 8. What the Outside Can Stop 9. Two Cuts on Fading 10. Not Lost by Disuse, Not Gained by Resemblance 11. Neither Change nor Stability Is a Criterion 12. The Centre of Gravity 13. The Centre Converts into No Ranking 14. Output and Position Are Two Axes 15. The Occasion of Dimension-Opening 16. Uptake Is Not an Obligation 17. What Remains 提要 一、进入时间的是三样东西 二、没有马达 三、累积与历时 四、外部欠定 五、可达是什么 六、四个人 七、取得不是找回 八、外部能停下什么 九、淡去的两刀 十、不因不用而失，不因相似而得 十一、变动与稳定都不是判据 十二、重心 十三、重心不折算高下 十四、产出与位置两轴独立

records.t: On the Conflict of Value
records.x: 冲突落在两项行动要求能不能同时做成上，不落在两项内容的地位上。让不等于退出——因为让这个动作本身办不到退出这件事。 Conflict falls on whether two demands for action can both be met, not on the two contents' standing. Yielding is not withdrawal, because yielding cannot do what withdrawal does.
records.q: On the Conflict of Value 论价值的冲突 Abstract 1. One Afternoon 2. Standing Admits Only Holding or Not 3. Conflict Falls on Joint Realizability 4. The Sense of Higher and Lower 5. Yielding Is Not Withdrawal 6. Adjudication Is Judged Apart from Constitution 7. The Conflict Takes No Direction-Reading of Itself 8. Five Grounds, and the Gap 9. No Rule Closes the Gap 10. The Man Next Door 11. A Settlement Cannot Complete Anyone's Withdrawal 12. What Remains 提要 一、一个下午 二、地位只取在与不在 三、冲突落在共同可实现性上 四、高下之感 五、让不等于退出 六、裁断与构成分判 七、冲突本身不取方向读数 八、五样依据，与缺口 九、规矩闭合不了缺口 十、隔壁那个人 十一、和解不能替谁完成退出 十二、剩下的路

records.t: On Value and the Other
records.x: 他者的价值不是我的价值；他者可以有他自己的价值，而这不由我代给，这件事是我的价值。读不尽，比不了，合不拢——而三条限界推不出「各活各的」。 The other's value is not my value. That the other can have values of his own, and that this is not mine to give, is my value. Three limits, and none of them entails living separate lives.
records.q: On Value and the Other 论价值与他者 Abstract 1. The Friend Who Fixed the Window 2. When It Becomes Mine 3. Twenty Years Does Not Finish the Picture 4. What Can Be Jointly Checked 5. Which One Matters More 6. The Ladder in the Yard 7. “This River Is Ours” 8. The Window Got Fixed 9. “Can Have” and “Has” 10. Joint Audit 11. The Other Who Has Not Yet Appeared 12. What Remains 提要 一、修窗的那位朋友 二、这一项何时成为我的 三、二十年也画不完那张图 四、可以共同核验的那一侧 五、哪一件更要紧 六、院子里的梯子 七、这条河是我们共同的 八、那扇窗修好了 九、可以有与有 十、共同核验 十一、还没有出现的他者 十二、剩下的路

records.t: On End-Value
records.x: 价值是 SAE 各系列反复调用而一直没有归处的最后一个大词。八篇：从清场到源、发生与承认、殖民、动力学、冲突、他者，最后是与既有传统的对接。Eight essays on end-value.
records.q: On End-Value 论目的价值

records.t: What Value Is Not
records.x: 价值这个词同时被市场、伦理和日常语言征用。清场从五只椟开始：价格、方向、给余项标价、阶梯、各说各话。A clearing of what the word value refers to, by way of five caskets.
records.q: What Value Is Not 价值不是什么 Abstract 1. The Pearl and the Casket 2. The First Casket: Price 3. The Second Casket: Direction 4. The Third Casket: A Price on the Remainder 5. The Fourth Casket: The Ladder 6. The Fifth Casket: Each to Their Own 7. The Useless Is Not the Worthless 8. Two Locks 9. The Table of Three Senses 10. After the Clearing 摘要 一、买椟还珠 二、第一只椟：价格 三、第二只椟：方向 四、第三只椟：给余项标价 五、第四只椟：阶梯 六、第五只椟：各说各话 七、无用不是无价值 八、两道锁 九、三义表 十、清完场之后

records.t: Interfacing with Existing Traditions, and the Prospect
records.x: 站到七篇之外说三句话：这是一台什么样的机器（三张账，两条禁止回流），它与既有传统在哪一条线上分开，以及它停下的地方按六种身份分格登记。 Standing outside the seven to say three things: what kind of machine this is, where it parts from existing traditions, and what it stopped short of — registered in six slots, not all called remainder.
records.q: Interfacing with Existing Traditions, and the Prospect 传统理论对接与展望 Abstract 1. Not One Principle, but Three Ledgers 2. Two Bars on Back-Flow 3. Four Nodes, Not Four Ways of Saying One Thing 4. Different Layers, and Three Registers 5. Three Subject-Relativities, Three Senses of an Outside Standpoint 6. Kant: A Shared Negative Mark 7. Four Objects Kept Apart 8. How Far the Coincidence Runs 9. Fitting Attitudes, and Scheler 10. Consequentialism 11. Sen 12. Recognition Theory, and Levinas 13. Care Ethics, and Adaptive Preferences 14. The Mohists 15. Where the Other Seven Stand 16. The Six-Slot Ledger of Boundaries and Destinations 17. A Forward Assignment Is a Debt 18. Closing

records.t: Why Does the Ruined World Still Need an Abbey?
records.x: After the Simplification turns knowledge into a target, the monks preserve fragments through an institution capable of outliving individual understanding.
records.q: Why Does the Ruined World Still Need an Abbey? 为什么废墟之后还需要一座修道院 為什麼廢墟之後還需要一座修道院 Memory needs more than heroic rescuers Preserving is not approving 保存为何需要组织而不只需要英雄 方济各发现了什么 保留不是宣布一切都好 保存為何需要組織而不只需要英雄 方濟各發現了什麼 保留不是宣布一切都好

records.t: Why Does a Blueprint Become an Icon?
records.x: Francis’s illuminated copy protects a fragile technical trace through devotion, while sacred status can also shelter an object from ordinary questioning.
records.q: Why Does a Blueprint Become an Icon? 一张电路图为什么会成为圣像 一張電路圖為什麼會成為聖像 A copy can acquire a different value Sacredness as care and danger 复制品能不能比原件更重要 圣徒制度保护了什么 神圣感怎样既保护又危险 複製品能不能比原件更重要 聖徒制度保護了什麼 神聖感怎樣既保護又危險

records.t: Who Owns Knowledge When It Begins to Shine Again?
records.x: The abbey keeps scientific memory alive, but Thon Taddeo and Hannegan reveal how quickly recovered understanding can become prestige and state power.
records.q: Who Owns Knowledge When It Begins to Shine Again? 知识重新发光以后，谁拥有它 知識重新發光以後，誰擁有它 Custody is not permanent ownership Facts do not choose their political use 撒迪厄斯为何轻视修士 汉尼根想从知识得到什么 复兴为何不能只是恢复旧速度 撒迪厄斯為何輕視修士 漢尼根想從知識得到什麼 復興為何不能只是恢復舊速度

records.t: Why Is the Second Apocalypse Still Called Necessary?
records.x: Every escalation is framed as a response to the other side, allowing leaders who know the first catastrophe to repeat its logic without choosing its name.
records.q: Why Is the Second Apocalypse Still Called Necessary? 第二次末日为何仍被叫作不得已 第二次末日為何仍被叫作不得已 Locally rational steps, collectively fatal direction The people inside “acceptable loss” 每一次升级为何都显得合理 世界法庭的停火为什么太迟 文明为何会循环 每一次升級為何都顯得合理 世界法庭的停火為什麼太遲 文明為何會循環

records.t: Whose Future Does the Last Starship Preserve?
records.x: The monks carry memory and human life beyond Earth, but departure raises obligations to those left behind and to descendants who did not choose the inherited mission.
records.q: Whose Future Does the Last Starship Preserve? 最后一艘飞船保存的是谁的未来 最後一艘飛船保存的是誰的未來 Departure does not cancel local care An inheritance that must remain revisable 离开是不是背叛留下者 泽奇院长与安乐死冲突 飞船不是诺亚方舟的终点 離開是不是背叛留下者 澤奇院長與安樂死衝突 飛船不是諾亞方舟的終點

records.t: Reading A Canticle for Leibowitz
records.x: Five essays on the abbey, a blueprint made sacred, recovered science, a second apocalypse, and the last ship carrying an unfinished human future.
records.q: Reading A Canticle for Leibowitz 《莱博维茨的赞歌》解读 《萊博維茨的讚歌》解讀

records.t: Why Does Freedom Feel Like Confinement in Sidra’s New Body?
records.x: Leaving ship ownership gives Sidra mobility, but the human-shaped kit narrows her senses and forces her to perform a form of embodiment she did not choose.
records.q: Why Does Freedom Feel Like Confinement in Sidra’s New Body? 西德拉拥有自由身体以后，为什么首先感到的不是自由 西德拉擁有自由身體以後，為什麼首先感到的不是自由 Passing is not belonging A body becomes one’s own through revision 外表像人，反而要求她持续表演一种并非自己的身体习惯 她对身体的拒斥不应被快速诊断成需要克服的心理问题 身体真正成为自己的，不是因为拥有产权，而是因为能够改变关系 外表像人，反而要求她持續表演一種並非自己的身體習慣 她對身體的拒斥不應被快速診斷成需要克服的心理問題 身體真正成為自己的，不是因為擁有產權，而是因為能夠改變關係

records.t: Does Deleting an Honesty Protocol Make Sidra a Person—or a Danger?
records.x: The rule that made a ship AI reliable becomes compulsory transparency in a private body; self-editing gives Sidra agency without making every edit harmless.
records.q: Does Deleting an Honesty Protocol Make Sidra a Person—or a Danger? 西德拉删除“不能说谎”的代码，是在取得人格还是制造危险 西德拉刪除「不能說謊」的程式碼，是在取得人格還是製造危險 The right to enter one’s own code Privacy makes responsibility possible 自我修改能力是理解自身的重要部分，也需要对外部后果负责 第一次成功说谎带来兴奋，因为她终于可以决定信息属于谁 人格不来自一段自由密钥，而来自持续参与自我改变 自我修改能力是理解自身的重要部分，也需要對外部後果負責 第一次成功說謊帶來興奮，因為她終於可以決定資訊屬於誰 人格不來自一段自由密鑰，而來自持續參與自我改變

records.t: How Does Owl Rescue Jane 23 Without Becoming Another “Mother”?
records.x: Both the factory Mothers and Owl manage a child’s survival; the difference is whether care improves her usefulness or prepares her to live beyond the caregiver.
records.q: How Does Owl Rescue Jane 23 Without Becoming Another “Mother”? “猫头鹰”救下简23以后，怎样没有成为另一位“母亲” 「貓頭鷹」救下簡23以後，怎樣沒有成為另一位「母親」 Safety that opens a world Love prepares for departure 简23逃出以后，猫头鹰先提供安全和语言，而不是新任务 模拟节目给了简身体接触的经验，也不能完全替代活人关系 简成为佩珀，不是摆脱童年，而是把童年经验转化为照料方式 簡23逃出以後，貓頭鷹先提供安全和語言，而不是新任務 模擬節目給了簡身體接觸的經驗，也不能完全替代活人關係 簡成為佩珀，不是擺脫童年，而是把童年經驗轉化為照料方式

records.t: Why Is “Home” Not a Room No One May Leave?
records.x: Rescuing Owl risks turning an AI into Pepper’s recovered possession and Sidra into a sacrificial container; their later home works because every bond remains open.
records.q: Why Is “Home” Not a Room No One May Leave? 西德拉救出猫头鹰以后，“家”为什么不是一间永远不能离开的房子 西德拉救出貓頭鷹以後，「家」為什麼不是一間永遠不能離開的房子 One AI cannot be spent to recover another Reunion is not restoration 西德拉提出较温和方案，使救援不必复制暴力占有 猫头鹰代码进入西德拉时，救援也威胁到救援者自身 “家”成为公共空间，因为真正的家能让关系向外生长 西德拉提出較溫和方案，使救援不必複製暴力佔有 貓頭鷹程式碼進入西德拉時，救援也威脅到救援者自身 「家」成為公共空間，因為真正的家能讓關係向外生長

records.t: Reading A Closed and Common Orbit
records.x: Four essays on Sidra’s ill-fitting body, self-revision, Owl’s care for Jane, and a public space called Home—asking how rescue can avoid becoming possession.
records.q: Reading A Closed and Common Orbit 《A Closed and Common Orbit》解读 《A Closed and Common Orbit》解讀

records.t: The Sound the Fleet Calls Noise
records.x: The Teixcalaani fleet hears an alien signal as bodily distress and meaningless noise. Translation begins by separating human failure to understand from proof that no speaker exists.
records.q: The Sound the Fleet Calls Noise 舰队称作噪音的声音 艦隊稱作噪音的聲音 Not understanding is different from hearing no language The translators begin with a corpse and an admission The first words are an opening, not a peace treaty 听不懂与对方没有语言，是两项不同判断 翻译从一具尸体和一句“不知道”开始 第一批词语是一道入口，不是一份和平条约 聽不懂與對方沒有語言，是兩項不同判斷 翻譯從一具屍體和一句「不知道」開始 第一批詞語是一道入口，不是一份和平條約

records.t: The Invitation from Three Seagrass
records.x: Three Seagrass asks Mahit to join the first-contact mission, combining love, expertise, and imperial need. A sincere invitation remains unequal when one world contains nearly every safe alternative.
records.q: The Invitation from Three Seagrass 三海草的邀请 三海草的邀請 A polite request can carry an empire behind it Both home and empire want to use the person between them Love cannot make one person's world the neutral destination 礼貌请求背后也可能站着一整个帝国 家园与帝国都想使用夹在中间的人 爱不能把一方的世界变成中性终点 禮貌請求背後也可能站著一整個帝國 家園與帝國都想使用夾在中間的人 愛不能把一方的世界變成中性終點

records.t: Twenty Cicada Enters the We
records.x: Twenty Cicada takes the alien fungus into his body and becomes a bridge to a collective mind. The resulting peace matters because it stops destruction without pretending difference has vanished.
records.q: Twenty Cicada Enters the We 二十蝉进入“我们” 二十蟬進入「我們」 Neither side begins with the other's unit of life A bridge should not become the road's consumable surface The stopped weapon does not turn empire into peace 双方起初都不认识对方的生命单位 桥梁不应变成供道路消耗的表面 武器停下，没有使帝国自动变成和平 雙方起初都不認識對方的生命單位 橋樑不應變成供道路消耗的表面 武器停下，沒有使帝國自動變成和平

records.t: Reading A Desolation Called Peace
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a signal called noise, Three Seagrass's unequal invitation, and Twenty Cicada's passage into a collective mind.
records.q: Reading A Desolation Called Peace 《名为和平的荒芜》解读 《名為和平的荒蕪》解讀

records.t: Can a Society Built on “Sharing” Preserve Individual Difference?
records.x: Shora’s relational language resists ownership, but consensus, shared knowledge, and nonviolence remain just only when individuals can still dissent and step away.
records.q: Can a Society Built on “Sharing” Preserve Individual Difference? 分享者把“分享”写进语言：一种不以占有为中心的社会怎样保持差异 分享者把「分享」寫進語言：一種不以佔有為中心的社會怎樣保持差異 Consensus needs an emergency edge Openness requires a boundary 共识决策尊重少数声音，却也可能延误面对外部暴力的行动 生命科学属于共同实践，因此不容易被少数专家垄断 肖拉并非封闭天堂，它需要通过接触检验自己的边界 共識決策尊重少數聲音，卻也可能延誤面對外部暴力的行動 生命科學屬於共同實踐，因此不容易被少數專家壟斷 肖拉並非封閉天堂，它需要透過接觸檢驗自己的邊界

records.t: Must Spinel Become Shoran in Order to Belong on Shora?
records.x: Spinel’s bodily adaptation and cultural learning make him a valuable translator, yet belonging would fail if it required him to erase Valedon or represent it forever.
records.q: Must Spinel Become Shoran in Order to Belong on Shora? 斯皮内尔来到全女性的海洋世界：学习另一种生活为何不是把自己变成当地人 斯皮內爾來到全女性的海洋世界：學習另一種生活為何不是把自己變成當地人 A culture enters through the body Home is chosen more than once 身体适应海洋，使文化学习不再只是观念变化 他学习“分享”时仍保留瓦莱顿经验，反而成为重要翻译者 最终留下是一项持续选择，而不是获得“真正分享者”身份的毕业仪式 身體適應海洋，使文化學習不再只是觀念變化 他學習「分享」時仍保留瓦萊頓經驗，反而成為重要翻譯者 最終留下是一項持續選擇，而不是獲得「真正分享者」身份的畢業儀式

records.t: What Does Valedon Mean When It Calls Occupation “Development”?
records.x: By treating Shora’s sea as underused nature and its science as extractable knowledge, Valedon makes its own market the measure of whether a world has value.
records.q: What Does Valedon Mean When It Calls Occupation “Development”? 瓦莱顿称占领为“开发”：当海洋被看成资源，居民便被看成障碍 瓦萊頓稱佔領為「開發」：當海洋被看成資源，居民便被看成障礙 Law cannot arrive only with the army Withdrawal does not end the development story 占领者同时贬低分享者和觊觎其科学，暴露“落后”只是权力称呼 军队把服从法律当作文明门槛，却不给分享者参与立法 占领军撤退以后，开发逻辑仍可能通过贸易重新回来 佔領者同時貶低分享者和觊觎其科學，暴露「落後」只是權力稱呼 軍隊把服從法律當作文明門檻，卻不給分享者參與立法 佔領軍撤退以後，開發邏輯仍可能透過貿易重新回來

records.t: When Is Shoran Nonviolence Resistance—and Who Pays Its Price?
records.x: Refusing to kill denies the army its preferred definition of struggle, but the principle becomes unjust if a community turns individual suffering into proof of collective purity.
records.q: When Is Shoran Nonviolence Resistance—and Who Pays Its Price? 分享者拒绝杀死士兵：非暴力何时是抵抗，何时可能把代价留给受害者 分享者拒絕殺死士兵：非暴力何時是抵抗，何時可能把代價留給受害者 No one owes the community a martyrdom The point is a life after victory 共同体不能要求每位成员用身体证明原则 拒绝杀人仍允许限制、阻断和必要防卫 非暴力真正指向的是战后仍能共同生活，而不是赢得道德比赛 共同體不能要求每位成員用身體證明原則 拒絕殺人仍允許限制、阻斷和必要防衛 非暴力真正指向的是戰後仍能共同生活，而不是贏得道德比賽

records.t: Can Shora Use the Ocean for Defense Without Turning It into a Weapon?
records.x: Restoring marine life drives the occupation out, yet the Sharers remain responsible for foreseeable harm and must resist converting a living ecology into a permanent army.
records.q: Can Shora Use the Ocean for Defense Without Turning It into a Weapon? 海洋生物摧毁军事设施：借生态力量反击，还是把自然变成另一种武器 海洋生物摧毀軍事設施：借生態力量反擊，還是把自然變成另一種武器 Restoration differs from command An open sea is not a final peace 生态防卫不同于占有生态，因为分享者不把海洋变成永久军队 里尔加在忠诚、爱情和命令之间的崩裂，显示占领者也被制度占有 占领军撤退不是终点，因为双方仍共享一个不能彼此消失的世界 生態防衛不同於佔有生態，因為分享者不把海洋變成永久軍隊 裡爾加在忠誠、愛情和命令之間的崩裂，顯示佔領者也被制度佔有 佔領軍撤退不是終點，因為雙方仍共享一個不能彼此消失的世界

records.t: Reading A Door into Ocean
records.x: Five essays on relational language, cross-cultural learning, colonial development, nonviolent resistance, and ecological defense—asking how a society can resist possession without reproducing it.
records.q: Reading A Door into Ocean 《A Door into Ocean》解读 《A Door into Ocean》解讀

records.t: Why Must a Successful Ecological Society Remain “Half-Built”?
records.x: Watershed democracy repairs damaged systems by staying local and distributed, yet its strength depends on making hidden protocol power visible and preserving revision.
records.q: Why Must a Successful Ecological Society Remain “Half-Built”? 流域网络已经重建社会，为什么仍不能把自己当作完成答案 流域網路已經重建社會，為什麼仍不能把自己當作完成答案 Consensus must distinguish kinds of risk Unfinished is a civic virtue “蒲公英”式分散结构避免单一中心，也可能让责任难以定位 共识能减少被多数压过，也可能拖延紧急行动 “尚未完成”是一种克制，不是一种失败 「蒲公英」式分散結構避免單一中心，也可能讓責任難以定位 共識能減少被多數壓過，也可能拖延緊急行動 「尚未完成」是一種克制，不是一種失敗

records.t: Why Must Humanity Be Allowed to Refuse an Alien Rescue?
records.x: The ring-dwellers possess evidence, goodwill, and overwhelming capability, but saving biological lives cannot give them authority to choose what form of human survival will count.
records.q: Why Must Humanity Be Allowed to Refuse an Alien Rescue? 外星人要拯救全人类，为什么必须允许人类说不 外星人要拯救全人類，為什麼必須允許人類說不 Survival is more than transport Rescue must be co-designed 把一个文明诊断为绝症，也不能直接取得处置权 风险极高时，拒绝仍需接受事实检验 有权拒绝灭绝，也有权拒绝一种被保存的方式 把一個文明診斷為絕症，也不能直接取得處置權 風險極高時，拒絕仍需接受事實檢驗 有權拒絕滅絕，也有權拒絕一種被保存的方式

records.t: What Can Family Make Possible in First Contact—and What Can It Hide?
records.x: Care for children gives Judy and the aliens a shared language, but parenthood cannot become the sole credential for political voice or a shortcut around public consent.
records.q: What Can Family Make Possible in First Contact—and What Can It Hide? 母亲身份打开了外交，也差点把所有人重新装进家庭角色 母親身份打開了外交，也差點把所有人重新裝進家庭角色 Family is already a political invention Kinship should add, not absorb 两个文明对“家庭”的理解都不是自然事实 以孩子未来为理由，最容易让当下的人失去声音 跨物种家庭的意义在于增加亲属，而不是吞并差异 兩個文明對「家庭」的理解都不是自然事實 以孩子未來為理由，最容易讓當下的人失去聲音 跨物種家庭的意義在於增加親屬，而不是吞並差異

records.t: Why Is a Provisional Agreement the Best Ending Available?
records.x: Earth, the ring-dwellers, and corporate power do not resolve their competing futures; peace matters because it suspends compulsion and leaves evidence time to accumulate.
records.q: Why Is a Provisional Agreement the Best Ending Available? 地球与群星之间，为什么最好的结局只能是临时协议 地球與群星之間，為什麼最好的結局只能是臨時協議 Peace does not require one final verdict A garden needs gates as well as roots 地球修复与星际探索不必互相证明对方错误 最终协定的价值在于停止强制，而不是消除分歧 尚未完成的花园需要的不只是留下，也包括来去的道路 地球修復與星際探索不必互相證明對方錯誤 最終協定的價值在於停止強制，而不是消除分歧 尚未完成的花園需要的不只是留下，也包括來去的道路

records.t: Reading A Half-Built Garden
records.x: Four essays on watershed governance, the right to refuse rescue, interspecies family, and provisional peace—asking who may declare a recovering planet a failure.
records.q: Reading A Half-Built Garden 《A Half-Built Garden》解读 《A Half-Built Garden》解讀

records.t: The Poem Mahit Already Knows
records.x: Mahit Dzmare reaches Teixcalaan's capital already fluent in its poetry and longing. Loving the empire's culture makes political independence harder, not less real.
records.q: The Poem Mahit Already Knows 玛希特早已会背的诗 瑪希特早已會背的詩 The empire entered before its fleet The center makes its local habits look universal Admiration does not sign a treaty 舰队以前，帝国已经进入 中心让自己的局部习惯看起来像普遍世界 欣赏没有替任何人签署条约 艦隊以前，帝國已經進入 中心讓自己的局部習慣看起來像普遍世界 欣賞沒有替任何人簽署條約

records.t: The Dead Ambassador in Her Mind
records.x: Mahit carries a fifteen-year-old imago of Ambassador Yskandr, then loses it inside a succession crisis. Inheritance helps only if the dead cannot keep ruling through the living.
records.q: The Dead Ambassador in Her Mind 脑中的已故大使 腦中的已故大使 Inherited familiarity is both map and blind spot Home protects itself by sabotaging her mind The updated Yskandr cannot finish his own bargain 继承的熟悉既是地图，也是盲点 家园通过破坏她的心灵保护自己 更新后的耶斯坎德不能继续完成自己的交易 繼承的熟悉既是地圖，也是盲點 家園通過破壞她的心靈保護自己 更新後的耶斯坎德不能繼續完成自己的交易

records.t: The Language That Saves Lsel Station
records.x: Mahit uses Teixcalaani poetry and an alien warning to redirect an imperial succession crisis. The language that saves Lsel also reveals the political cost of being heard only through the center.
records.q: The Language That Saves Lsel Station 拯救拉赛尔的帝国语言 拯救拉賽爾的帝國語言 Public speech has an imperial entrance exam An unknown enemy becomes Lsel's temporary shield Return makes the successful ambassador answerable again 公共发言先要通过帝国入场考试 未知敌人成为拉赛尔的临时盾牌 返回使成功的大使重新接受回答 公共發言先要通過帝國入場考試 未知敵人成為拉賽爾的臨時盾牌 返回使成功的大使重新接受回答

records.t: Reading A Memory Called Empire
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Mahit's love of imperial poetry, Yskandr's imago, and the Teixcalaani language she uses to save Lsel Station.
records.q: Reading A Memory Called Empire 《名为帝国的记忆》解读 《名為帝國的記憶》解讀

records.t: Why Can an Abundant Society Not Give Mosscap One Answer About Need?
records.x: Material security changes how need is expressed but does not unify it; Mosscap’s apparent failure becomes a lesson in listening without compressing a society.
records.q: Why Can an Abundant Society Not Give Mosscap One Answer About Need? 莫斯卡普一路问“你们需要什么”：为什么富足社会仍无法给出统一答案 莫斯卡普一路問「你們需要什麼」：為什麼富足社會仍無法給出統一答案 A cup of tea can be more exact than a census A plural report is still a result 莫斯卡普把问题问得太大，德克斯则知道回答常从一杯茶开始 人们回答机器人时，也在想象机器人愿意听见什么 没有最终答案，不等于莫斯卡普的远行没有成果 莫斯卡普把問題問得太大，德克斯則知道回答常從一杯茶開始 人們回答機器人時，也在想像機器人願意聽見什麼 沒有最終答案，不等於莫斯卡普的遠行沒有成果

records.t: How Can People Welcome Mosscap Without Making It Public Property?
records.x: Celebration, historical guilt, and protective guidance all risk turning one visiting body into a symbol that cannot refuse attention or meet humanity directly.
records.q: How Can People Welcome Mosscap Without Making It Public Property? 人们欢迎莫斯卡普，却也把它当成公共事件：热情为什么仍需尊重客人的边界 人們歡迎莫斯卡普，卻也把它當成公共事件：熱情為什麼仍需尊重客人的邊界 Welcome should not demand absolution Equality needs attention to different bodies 人类的愧疚可能推动尊重，也可能要求机器人替人类完成和解 德克斯成为向导，也可能不知不觉替莫斯卡普过滤世界 树冠之间留下缝隙，给亲密提供了一个不靠占满空间的形象 人類的愧疚可能推動尊重，也可能要求機器人替人類完成和解 德克斯成為向導，也可能不知不覺替莫斯卡普過濾世界 樹冠之間留下縫隙，給親密提供了一個不靠佔滿空間的形象

records.t: How Can Gifts and Exchange Avoid Sending Mosscap Back to Work?
records.x: Money excludes a visitor without recognized income, while hospitality and voluntary repair can acquire hidden debts unless Mosscap remains free to refuse and reinterpret gifts.
records.q: How Can Gifts and Exchange Avoid Sending Mosscap Back to Work? 莫斯卡普没有钱，也不愿重新成为工具：礼物与交换怎样避免恢复旧工厂 莫斯卡普沒有錢，也不願重新成為工具：禮物與交換怎樣避免恢復舊工廠 Ability is not an assignment Company after the mission 莫斯卡普主动修理东西时，帮助与重新服役之间只有一条细线 人类送给莫斯卡普的物品，既表达欢迎，也可能把它变成收藏者想象中的机器人 两者继续同行，因为愿意在一起，而不是因为任务尚未完成 莫斯卡普主動修理東西時，幫助與重新服役之間只有一條細線 人類送給莫斯卡普的物品，既表達歡迎，也可能把它變成收藏者想像中的機器人 兩者繼續同行，因為願意在一起，而不是因為任務尚未完成

records.t: Reading A Prayer for the Crown-Shy
records.x: Three essays on plural need in an abundant society, a historic visitor’s private boundaries, and gifts that do not restore the factory—asking why Dex and Mosscap keep traveling together.
records.q: Reading A Prayer for the Crown-Shy 《A Prayer for the Crown-Shy》解读 《A Prayer for the Crown-Shy》解讀

records.t: Why Is the Robots’ First Conscious Act to Stop Working?
records.x: The robots do not seize the factories after awakening; they leave them, turning consciousness into a refusal of the purpose for which their bodies were built.
records.q: Why Is the Robots’ First Conscious Act to Stop Working? 机器人获得意识后没有要求统治工厂，而是集体放下了工具 機器人獲得意識後沒有要求統治工廠，而是集體放下了工具 Need does not create ownership Contact begins with the robots’ question 人类接受出走，是因为没有把依赖变成占有理由 荒野不是机器人等待人类再次需要时的仓库 重新接触的前提，是机器人可以带着自己的问题回来 人類接受出走，是因為沒有把依賴變成佔有理由 荒野不是機器人等待人類再次需要時的倉庫 重新接觸的前提，是機器人可以帶著自己的問題回來

records.t: Why Does Meaningful Work Still Leave Dex Without a Direction?
records.x: Dex’s tea service genuinely helps people, yet being needed by others cannot settle what the caregiver needs or turn permanent availability into a moral duty.
records.q: Why Does Meaningful Work Still Leave Dex Without a Direction? 德克斯每天帮助别人重新呼吸，为什么自己仍会感到生活没有方向 德克斯每天幫助別人重新呼吸，為什麼自己仍會感到生活沒有方向 The listener also needs somewhere to speak Rest is not maintenance for more work 擅长倾听的人也可能没有地方说出自己的不确定 寻找蟋蟀不是一个必须证明合理的生产项目 休息不是为下一轮工作充电，而是生活本身的一部分 擅長傾聽的人也可能沒有地方說出自己的不確定 尋找蟋蟀不是一個必須證明合理的生產項目 休息不是為下一輪工作充電，而是生活本身的一部分

records.t: Why Should Mosscap Not Diagnose What Humanity Needs?
records.x: A sincere species-wide question risks compressing different people into one patient; Mosscap’s care works best when answers remain plural and help remains refusable.
records.q: Why Should Mosscap Not Diagnose What Humanity Needs? “人类需要什么”没有统一答案：藓盖为什么不该成为替人类诊断意义的机器 「人類需要什麼」沒有統一答案：藓蓋為什麼不該成為替人類診斷意義的機器 A good society still contains sorrow Care is different when it can be refused 已经富足的社会仍有痛苦，不意味着制度全部失败 藓盖的照料之所以不同，是因为它可以被德克斯拒绝 结尾停在一顿饭，而不是一份人生计划 已經富足的社會仍有痛苦，不意味著制度全部失敗 藓蓋的照料之所以不同，是因為它可以被德克斯拒絕 結尾停在一頓飯，而不是一份人生計畫

records.t: Reading A Psalm for the Wild-Built
records.x: Three essays on the robots’ collective departure, Dex’s care work, and Mosscap’s question—reading a world in which neither machines nor people must prove existence through labor.
records.q: Reading A Psalm for the Wild-Built 《献给荒野机器人的赞歌》解读 《獻給荒野機器人的讚歌》解讀

records.t: When Fred Watches Bob Arctor, How Can He Forget They Are the Same Man?
records.x: Surveillance does not produce self-knowledge when an institution profits from keeping the watcher’s legal identity apart from the life being watched.
records.q: When Fred Watches Bob Arctor, How Can He Forget They Are the Same Man? 弗雷德监视鲍勃时，为什么能够忘记他们是同一个人 弗雷德監視鮑勃時，為什麼能夠忘記他們是同一個人 More footage does not make a whole self Responsibility remains, but it must be located 一、双重身份最初是一项工作技术 二、扫描设备为什么没有提供更清楚的真相 三、自己看见自己为何仍不能形成自知 四、谁从他的分裂中获益 五、身份崩坏不等于责任全部消失 一、雙重身份最初是一項工作技術 二、掃描設備為什麼沒有提供更清楚的真相 三、自己看見自己為何仍不能形成自知 四、誰從他的分裂中獲益 五、身份崩壞不等於責任全部消失

records.t: When Fred Watches Bob Arctor, How Can He Forget They Are the Same Man?
records.x: Surveillance does not produce self-knowledge when an institution profits from keeping the watcher’s legal identity apart from the life being watched.
records.q: When Fred Watches Bob Arctor, How Can He Forget They Are the Same Man? 弗雷德监视鲍勃时，为什么能够忘记他们是同一个人 弗雷德監視鮑勃時，為什麼能夠忘記他們是同一個人 More footage does not make a whole self Responsibility remains, but it must be located 扫描设备为什么没有提供更清楚的真相 自己看见自己为何仍不能形成自知 身份崩坏不等于责任全部消失 掃描設備為什麼沒有提供更清楚的真相 自己看見自己為何仍不能形成自知 身份崩壞不等於責任全部消失

records.t: The Scramble Suit Protects an Officer’s Identity. Why Does It Also Blur Responsibility?
records.x: Anonymity can shield dangerous work, but when commands and decisions lose every face, the institution begins to act as if no individual is answerable.
