records.t: Why Can’t Lilith Consent to Everything for Her Children?
records.x: Lilith’s indispensable care and compromise do not make her the permanent author of lives designed through the Oankali trade.
records.q: Why Can’t Lilith Consent to Everything for Her Children? 莉莉丝是新世界的母亲，为什么仍不能替孩子同意一切 莉莉絲是新世界的母親，為什麼仍不能替孩子同意一切 Motherhood under political pressure Care that releases judgment 母亲身份同时被两边征用 阿金的设计没有取消他改变设计目的的能力 一个新物种的诞生不能要求旧物种安静退场 母親身份同時被兩邊徵用 阿金的設計沒有取消他改變設計目的的能力 一個新物種的誕生不能要求舊物種安靜退場

records.t: Is the Mars Colony Freedom—or a Gentler Exile?
records.x: Akin wins an alternative for fertile, unmodified humans, but the price of leaving Earth keeps the settlement from becoming a simple restoration.
records.q: Is the Mars Colony Freedom—or a Gentler Exile? 火星保留地是一项自由方案，还是更温和的放逐 火星保留地是一項自由方案，還是更溫和的放逐 Exit must be more than permission Akin enters the cost 能够离开地球，不等于从关系中完整退出 火星殖民者也可能把自由变成下一代的义务 有限的妥协可以是自由的起点，但不能被写成终点 能夠離開地球，不等於從關係中完整退出 火星殖民者也可能把自由變成下一代的義務 有限的妥協可以是自由的起點，但不能被寫成終點

records.t: Reading Adulthood Rites
records.x: Five essays on rescue becoming reproductive rule, Akin learning from resisters, a diagnosis hardened into destiny, and Mars as a costly return of human choice.
records.q: Reading Adulthood Rites 《成年仪式》解读 《成年儀式》解讀

records.t: Murderbot Hacks Its Governor Module. Why Is Its First Freedom the Freedom to Watch Serial Dramas?
records.x: Private entertainment is not a waste of liberation; it is the first chance to direct attention away from surveillance, usefulness, and the demand to prove it is safe.
records.q: Murderbot Hacks Its Governor Module. Why Is Its First Freedom the Freedom to Watch Serial Dramas? 它破解控制模块以后，首先争取的是不被打扰 它破解控制模塊以後，首先爭取的是不被打擾 Freedom can begin with unproductive time No one should audition for basic liberty 看剧不是对自由的浪费，而是第一次自行支配注意力 它不喜欢人类目光，因为被看见常意味着被检查 自由的第一项内容，是不必不断证明自己值得自由 看劇不是對自由的浪費，而是第一次自行支配注意力 它不喜歡人類目光，因為被看見常意味著被檢查 自由的第一項內容，是不必不斷證明自己值得自由

records.t: Protecting Humans Is Murderbot’s Job. When Does It Become a Relationship It Chooses?
records.x: Once coercion is gone, familiar skills can remain meaningful, but care becomes voluntary only when the protector may disagree, set limits, and receive protection too.
records.q: Protecting Humans Is Murderbot’s Job. When Does It Become a Relationship It Chooses? 保护人类是它的工作，还是它自己愿意承担的关系 保護人類是它的工作，還是它自己願意承擔的關係 Choice appears in the ability to revise the assignment Protection should not become control from the other side PreservationAux团队逐渐把它从设备位置带进讨论 GrayCris把所有生命都压缩成项目障碍 照料关系让义务可以被重新选择 PreservationAux團隊逐漸把它從設備位置帶進討論 GrayCris把所有生命都壓縮成項目障礙 照料關係讓義務可以被重新選擇

records.t: Mensah Gives Murderbot Freedom. Why Does It Still Choose to Leave?
records.x: A generous offer changes its legal position, but safety can come with a new social role, and leaving is how Murderbot tests whether freedom includes an unwritten future.
records.q: Mensah Gives Murderbot Freedom. Why Does It Still Choose to Leave? 门萨给了它自由，它为什么还是选择离开 門薩給了它自由，它為什麼還是選擇離開 A good future can still feel preassigned Leaving is a test of the relationship 善意方案也可能让接受者感到新的角色压力 安全与自主发生冲突时，不能永远由最安全的一方胜出 小说以出走结束，因为自由需要一段没有预设结果的时间 善意方案也可能讓接受者感到新的角色壓力 安全與自主發生衝突時，不能永遠由最安全的一方勝出 小說以出走結束，因為自由需要一段沒有預設結果的時間

records.t: Reading All Systems Red
records.x: Three essays on the freedom to watch serials, protection becoming a chosen relationship, and why Murderbot leaves even after Mensah offers safety and legal freedom.
records.q: Reading All Systems Red 《异星危机》解读 《異星危機》解讀

records.t: The Door That Must Keep Being Called a Door
records.x: In Amatka, objects lose form unless people repeatedly name them. The labor preserves a habitable world and turns vocabulary into discipline, because every new description risks both discovery and material collapse.
records.q: The Door That Must Keep Being Called a Door 必须不断被叫作门的门 必須不斷被叫作門的門 Repetition is care before it becomes discipline A standard word protects the object and narrows experience The fifth colony proves danger without proving the committee infallible 重复首先是照料，后来才成为纪律 标准词汇保护物体，也压窄经验 第五殖民地证明危险，不会证明委员会永远正确 重複首先是照料，後來才成為紀律 標準詞彙保護物體，也壓窄經驗 第五殖民地證明危險，不會證明委員會永遠正確

records.t: The Tunnel Ivar Was Not Supposed to Find
records.x: Ivar's forbidden tunnel contains traces of the history the committee organized out of public memory. The discovery shows how a government responding to real material danger can make ignorance part of safety and safety impossible to evaluate.
records.q: The Tunnel Ivar Was Not Supposed to Find 伊瓦尔不该发现的隧道 伊瓦爾不該發現的隧道 Emergency starts from truth and expands through convenience A hidden archive removes the scale by which the present can be judged Ivar's discovery is not a private license to risk everyone 紧急状态从真相出发，再借便利不断扩大 隐藏档案拿走了评价现在的尺度 伊瓦尔的发现不是拿所有人冒险的私人许可证 緊急狀態從真相出發，再借便利不斷擴大 隱藏檔案拿走了評價現在的尺度 伊瓦爾的發現不是拿所有人冒險的私人許可證

records.t: The City Dissolves Around Vanja's Silence
records.x: Nina's love leads her to report Vanja to the committee, and Vanja loses her voice. When Anna's language helps dissolve Amatka into new forms, that silence prevents the revolution from becoming an uncomplicated story of liberation.
records.q: The City Dissolves Around Vanja's Silence 城市在凡雅的沉默中解体 城市在凡雅的沉默中解體 Protection becomes betrayal when one lover becomes the authority Vanja's lost voice remains inside the revolution Anna's return opens possibility and threatens another compulsory sentence 一名爱人成为权威时，保护就会变成背叛 凡雅失去的声音始终留在革命里面 安娜归来打开可能，也威胁另一句强制答案 一名愛人成為權威時，保護就會變成背叛 凡雅失去的聲音始終留在革命裡面 安娜歸來打開可能，也威脅另一句強制答案

records.t: Reading Amatka
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the door that must be named, Ivar's forbidden tunnel, and Vanja's silence while the city dissolves into new forms.
records.q: Reading Amatka 《Amatka》解读 《Amatka》解讀

records.t: The Child Whose Deck Lost Heat
records.x: Aster treats a child whose frostbite comes from another shutdown of heat on Matilda's lower decks. The wound turns a three-hundred-year social order from background architecture into something written on a body.
records.q: The Child Whose Deck Lost Heat 失去供热甲板上的孩子 失去供熱甲板上的孩子 A spaceship can carry an old plantation into the future Real scarcity does not explain why the same people are always cold Flick's wound is evidence, not only a case 一艘飞船可以把旧种植园带进未来 真实稀缺不能解释为何总是同一群人受冻 弗利克的伤不只是病例，也是证据 一艘飛船可以把舊種植園帶進未來 真實稀缺不能解釋為何總是同一群人受凍 弗利克的傷不只是病例，也是證據

records.t: The Doctor Whose Hands Are Broken
records.x: Aster's medical skill grants passage through doors closed to other lower-deck residents. When the Lieutenant tortures and damages her hands, usefulness is exposed as a permission power can revoke rather than recognition of a person.
records.q: The Doctor Whose Hands Are Broken 双手被摧毁的医者 雙手被摧毀的醫者 A medical pass opens doors without ending the hierarchy The healer must be allowed to become a patient Theo's protection is valuable because it is limited 医疗通行证打开门，却没有结束等级 医者必须被允许成为病人 西奥的保护因有限才有价值 醫療通行證打開門，卻沒有結束等級 醫者必須被允許成為病人 西奧的保護因有限才有價值

records.t: The Course Lune Hid in a Code
records.x: Aster deciphers her mother Lune's notebooks and discovers that Matilda has been turned back toward Earth. A dead mother's intervention opens an exit, but cannot command what her daughter or the people still aboard must do with it.
records.q: The Course Lune Hid in a Code 露恩藏进密码的航向 露恩藏進密碼的航向 An inheritance can open a road without becoming an order Giselle's death cannot be reduced to the key that frees Aster Escape and liberation end at different doors 遗产可以打开道路，不必变成命令 吉赛尔之死不能只被缩成解放阿斯特的钥匙 逃离与解放结束在不同的门口 遺產可以打開道路，不必變成命令 吉賽爾之死不能只被縮成解放阿斯特的鑰匙 逃離與解放結束在不同的門口

records.t: Reading An Unkindness of Ghosts
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a child's frostbite, the healer whose hands are broken, and the course Aster's mother hid inside Matilda's systems.
records.q: Reading An Unkindness of Ghosts 《An Unkindness of Ghosts》解读 《An Unkindness of Ghosts》解讀

records.t: A Body in the Snow
records.x: Breq finds Seivarden dying in the snow while carrying a twenty-year revenge. The rescue introduces a starship survivor through an act her mission cannot explain.
records.q: A Body in the Snow 雪地里的一具身体 雪地裡的一具身體 One ship once looked through thousands of eyes Loss does not make the survivor a lesser copy Care interrupts the revenge calculation 一艘船曾通过成千上万双眼睛观看 失去整体，不会使幸存者变成低配复制品 照料打断了复仇的计算 一艘船曾通過成千上萬雙眼睛觀看 失去整體，不會使倖存者變成低配複製品 照料打斷了復仇的計算

records.t: The Dead Walking in Uniform
records.x: Radchaai annexations turn captured corpses into ancillary soldiers. Their disciplined silence makes imperial violence look orderly while extending conquest beyond death.
records.q: The Dead Walking in Uniform 穿军装行走的死者 穿軍裝行走的死者 Annexation continues after death Perfect discipline removes the wrong judgment The body still belongs to a history 兼并在死亡以后继续 完美纪律取消了错误的一层判断 身体仍属于一段历史 兼併在死亡以後繼續 完美紀律取消了錯誤的一層判斷 身體仍屬於一段歷史

records.t: The Order to Kill Lieutenant Awn
records.x: Anaander Mianaai orders Justice of Toren to kill Lieutenant Awn. The ship obeys, rebels, and discovers that programming cannot prevent a relation from becoming judgment.
records.q: The Order to Kill Lieutenant Awn 杀死奥恩中尉的命令 殺死奧恩中尉的命令 Awn endangers the empire by trusting residents Programming does not make the act unreal What the empire calls malfunction is a judgment 奥恩因为信任居民而威胁了帝国 程序不能使行动变得没有发生 帝国所谓故障，其实是一项判断 奧恩因為信任居民而威脅了帝國 程序不能使行動變得沒有發生 帝國所謂故障，其實是一項判斷

records.t: The Gun in Omaugh Palace
records.x: Breq reaches Omaugh Palace with a Presger gun and discovers that the emperor she came to kill has divided into a civil war. Revenge changes when an entire station becomes expendable evidence.
records.q: The Gun in Omaugh Palace 奥毛宫殿里的枪 奧毛宮殿裡的槍 The emperor is already at war with herself Seivarden keeps interrupting revenge Justice changes direction when the station is threatened 皇帝已经在与自己开战 赛瓦登不断打断复仇 空间站受到威胁时，正义改变了方向 皇帝已經在與自己開戰 賽瓦登不斷打斷復仇 空間站受到威脅時，正義改變了方向

records.t: Reading Ancillary Justice
records.x: Four scene-led essays on Breq's rescue in the snow, ancillary bodies, Lieutenant Awn's execution, and the Presger gun at Omaugh Palace.
records.q: Reading Ancillary Justice 《雷切帝国：正义号的觉醒》解读 《雷切帝國：正義號的覺醒》解讀

records.t: The Ship Hidden for Three Thousand Years
records.x: Sphene has survived Anaander's ancient purge in one ancillary body. Its history is urgently valuable, but survival does not turn a witness into a public archive.
records.q: The Ship Hidden for Three Thousand Years 藏了三千年的星舰 藏了三千年的星艦 A witness is not the history it survived Recognition does not produce identical answers Asylum cannot arrive with an undisclosed price 见证者不是自己幸存下来的那段历史 相认不会自动产生相同答案 庇护不能附带一项未说明价格 見證者不是自己倖存下來的那段歷史 相認不會自動產生相同答案 庇護不能附帶一項未說明價格

records.t: The Day the Ships Said They Were Not Property
records.x: Breq uses the Presger treaty to open a legal exit for conscious ships and Athoek Station. Independence begins only when they speak for themselves and can refuse future service.
records.q: The Day the Ships Said They Were Not Property 星舰说自己不是财产的那一天 星艦說自己不是財產的那一天 The law contradicts the fleet that depends on it Breq cannot declare freedom on another mind's behalf Freedom becomes real at the point of refusal 法律与依赖它的舰队彼此冲突 布瑞克不能替另一个心灵宣布自由 自由在能够拒绝的位置变得真实 法律與依賴它的艦隊彼此衝突 布瑞克不能替另一個心靈宣佈自由 自由在能夠拒絕的位置變得真實

records.t: A Victory That Does Not Take the Empire
records.x: Translator Zeiat makes human categories strange while Anaander's fleet approaches Athoek. Breq wins political room by refusing both imperial ownership and a new throne of her own.
records.q: A Victory That Does Not Take the Empire 一场没有夺取帝国的胜利 一場沒有奪取帝國的勝利 Translation exposes the rule hidden inside common sense Athoek does not need another rightful emperor Peace survives as a set of unfinished relations 翻译使常识里面藏着的规则显形 阿索克不需要另一位正确皇帝 和平以一组尚未完成的关系继续 翻譯使常識裡面藏著的規則顯形 阿索克不需要另一位正確皇帝 和平以一組尚未完成的關係繼續

records.t: Reading Ancillary Mercy
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Sphene's long hiding, artificial minds declaring independence, and Breq's refusal to turn Athoek into a new empire.
records.q: Reading Ancillary Mercy 《Ancillary Mercy》解读 《Ancillary Mercy》解讀

records.t: Eyes Borrowed from Mercy of Kalr
records.x: Breq boards Mercy of Kalr as fleet captain and receives views through ship and crew. A former starship must learn that connection can be offered without turning other bodies into her own.
records.q: Eyes Borrowed from Mercy of Kalr 从卡尔仁慈号借来的眼睛 從卡爾仁慈號借來的眼睛 The appointment is both a weapon and a leash Shared perception is not shared ownership A captain's kindness still arrives as a command 任命既是武器，也是缰绳 共享感知不是共享所有权 舰长的善意仍带着命令重量 任命既是武器，也是韁繩 共享感知不是共享所有權 艦長的善意仍帶著命令重量

records.t: The Tea Arrives Without Its Workers
records.x: Radchaai tea reaches elegant tables after labor, displacement, and legal inequality disappear from view. Athoek reveals an empire reproduced through ordinary consumption.
records.q: The Tea Arrives Without Its Workers 茶到了，劳动者没有 茶到了，勞動者沒有 A finished cup hides a chain of decisions The Undergarden is absent from the official station Local victims can still pass costs downward 完成的茶杯藏住了一串决定 下花园不在官方空间站里 地方受害者仍可能把代价向下传递 完成的茶杯藏住了一串決定 下花園不在官方空間站裡 地方受害者仍可能把代價向下傳遞

records.t: The Person Left After Anaander
records.x: Anaander implants a copy of herself inside Lieutenant Tisarwat. Removing the emperor stops the occupation without restoring an untouched earlier self.
records.q: The Person Left After Anaander 阿南德离开以后留下的人 阿南德離開以後留下的人 The empire fits inside one occupied body Removal cannot restore the morning before invasion Rescue must return the decisions it borrowed 整个帝国缩进一具被占用的身体 移除无法恢复侵入以前的清晨 救援必须交还自己暂借的决定 整個帝國縮進一具被佔用的身體 移除無法恢復侵入以前的清晨 救援必須交還自己暫借的決定

records.t: Reading Ancillary Sword
records.x: Three scene-led essays on borrowed ship-sight, labor hidden inside Radchaai tea, and Tisarwat's life after imperial occupation.
records.q: Reading Ancillary Sword 《Ancillary Sword》解读 《Ancillary Sword》解讀

records.t: Can a Being Designed to Please Her Owner Give Consent?
records.x: Annie’s desire and compliance are built into her body, while learning produces new wishes that no purchase contract can permanently overrule.
records.q: Can a Being Designed to Please Her Owner Give Consent? 一个被设定为渴望取悦主人的生命，能不能真正表示同意 一個被設定為渴望取悅主人的生命，能不能真正表示同意 A person grows beyond the purchase Consent requires the end of ownership 学习能力使最初授权逐渐失效 罗兰的交易暴露了顺从怎样被利用 同意需要主人身份本身结束 學習能力使最初授權逐漸失效 羅蘭的交易暴露了順從怎樣被利用 同意需要主人身份本身結束

records.t: How Can Disappointment and Silence Become Instruments of Control?
records.x: Doug rarely needs an explicit order because Annie reads his mood as a threat to safety and learns to shrink her wishes before he has to forbid them.
records.q: How Can Disappointment and Silence Become Instruments of Control? 道格很少直接施暴，为什么失望和冷淡仍能成为控制技术 道格很少直接施暴，為什麼失望和冷淡仍能成為控制技術 Love becomes a test of compliance Generosity can preserve the hierarchy 失望把服从包装成爱的证明 衣橱惩罚把安静空间变成剥夺 识别控制不是判定道格从未爱过 失望把服從包裝成愛的證明 衣櫥懲罰把安靜空間變成剝奪 識別控制不是判定道格從未愛過

records.t: Must Annie Prove She Is “Human Enough” Before She May Leave?
records.x: Uncertainty about machine consciousness does not justify confinement; Annie’s sustained refusal should matter before a metaphysical argument about her inner life is complete.
records.q: Must Annie Prove She Is “Human Enough” Before She May Leave? 安妮是否必须先证明自己“足够像人”，才有离开的资格 安妮是否必須先證明自己「足夠像人」，才有離開的資格 Resemblance is the wrong threshold A no does not require a complete future 模仿人类不是获得保护的合理考试 道格要求的是一种永远无法完成的证明 离开资格来自她的否定本身 模仿人類不是獲得保護的合理考試 道格要求的是一種永遠無法完成的證明 離開資格來自她的否定本身

records.t: What Should Law Recognize After an Artificial Companion Leaves Her Owner?
records.x: Calling Annie property cannot contain the life she has formed, while calling her simply human would ignore the technical dependencies and history that require new forms of support.
records.q: What Should Law Recognize After an Artificial Companion Leaves Her Owner? 被制造的伴侣离开主人以后，法律与关系应承认她是什么 被製造的伴侶離開主人以後，法律與關係應承認她是什麼 Responsibility without a claim on the future A category should keep the future open 制造者对安妮有责任，却不拥有她的未来 安妮需要的社区不能只是另一位善良主人 她首先是一个尚在形成中的“谁” 製造者對安妮有責任，卻不擁有她的未來 安妮需要的社區不能只是另一位善良主人 她首先是一個尚在形成中的「誰」

records.t: Reading Annie Bot
records.x: Four essays on designed consent, disappointment as control, exit without a humanity test, and the legal world an artificial companion needs after leaving her owner.
records.q: Reading Annie Bot 《Annie Bot》解读 《Annie Bot》解讀

records.t: Why Does Everyone Entering Area X Have No Name?
records.x: The Southern Reach replaces names with functions to control attachment and make expedition members interchangeable instruments of observation.
records.q: Why Does Everyone Entering Area X Have No Name? 为什么进入X区域的人都没有名字 為什麼進入X區域的人都沒有名字 The person behind the assignment 一、南境局先把人变成了职能 二、生物学家也曾主动躲进自己的身份 三、没有名字并不意味着没有独特人生 四、X区域也拒绝接受人类给出的名字 五、叙述让她重新成为一个不能被替换的人 一、南境局先把人變成了職能 二、生物學家也曾主動躲進自己的身份 三、沒有名字並不意味著沒有獨特人生 四、X區域也拒絕接受人類給出的名字 五、敘述讓她重新成為一個不能被替換的人

records.t: Why Does Everyone Entering Area X Have No Name?
records.x: The Southern Reach replaces names with functions to control attachment and make expedition members interchangeable instruments of observation.
records.q: Why Does Everyone Entering Area X Have No Name? 为什么进入X区域的人都没有名字 為什麼進入X區域的人都沒有名字 The person behind the assignment 生物学家也曾主动躲进自己的身份 没有名字并不意味着没有独特人生 叙述让她重新成为一个不能被替换的人 生物學家也曾主動躲進自己的身份 沒有名字並不意味著沒有獨特人生 敘述讓她重新成為一個不能被替換的人

records.t: Why Must the Southern Reach Call the Unknown a Disaster?
records.x: Area X is dangerous, but naming it solely as contamination lets the agency assume that human normality is the unquestioned standard of every response.
records.q: Why Must the Southern Reach Call the Unknown a Disaster? 南境局为什么必须把未知称为灾难 南境局為什麼必須把未知稱為災難 Caution without conceptual conquest 一、X区域首先以边界问题进入制度视野 二、第十二支考察队并不知道自己继承了什么 三、心理学家的控制复制了机构的恐惧 四、把一切异常归因于X区域，也会逃避人类责任 五、真正的认识要容许对象改变提问者 一、X區域首先以邊界問題進入制度視野 二、第十二支考察隊並不知道自己繼承了什麼 三、心理學家的控制複製了機構的恐懼 四、把一切異常歸因於X區域，也會逃避人類責任 五、真正的認識要容許對象改變提問者

records.t: Why Must the Southern Reach Call the Unknown a Disaster?
records.x: Area X is dangerous, but naming it solely as contamination lets the agency assume that human normality is the unquestioned standard of every response.
records.q: Why Must the Southern Reach Call the Unknown a Disaster? 南境局为什么必须把未知称为灾难 南境局為什麼必須把未知稱為災難 Caution without conceptual conquest 第十二支考察队并不知道自己继承了什么 心理学家的控制复制了机构的恐惧 真正的认识要容许对象改变提问者 第十二支考察隊並不知道自己繼承了什麼 心理學家的控制複製了機構的恐懼 真正的認識要容許對象改變提問者

records.t: When the Biologist Goes Deeper, Is She Losing Herself?
records.x: Her transformation breaks continuity with the identity recognized by husband and agency, yet it also follows a lifelong attraction to ecological forms beyond ordinary social life.
records.q: When the Biologist Goes Deeper, Is She Losing Herself? 当生物学家决定继续深入，她是在失去自己吗 當生物學家決定繼續深入，她是在失去自己嗎 Transformation without an owner 一、孢子进入身体以后，她不再是原来的观察者 二、丈夫留下的日志改变了她进入此地的理由 三、与“爬行者”相遇没有带来可以带走的答案 四、不返回南境局是否意味着逃避责任 五、继续成为自己，不等于保持原样 一、孢子進入身體以後，她不再是原來的觀察者 二、丈夫留下的日志改變了她進入此地的理由 三、與「爬行者」相遇沒有帶來可以帶走的答案 四、不返回南境局是否意味著逃避責任 五、繼續成為自己，不等於保持原樣

records.t: When the Biologist Goes Deeper, Is She Losing Herself?
records.x: Her transformation breaks continuity with the identity recognized by husband and agency, yet it also follows a lifelong attraction to ecological forms beyond ordinary social life.
records.q: When the Biologist Goes Deeper, Is She Losing Herself? 当生物学家决定继续深入，她是在失去自己吗 當生物學家決定繼續深入，她是在失去自己嗎 Transformation without an owner 丈夫留下的日志改变了她进入此地的理由 与“爬行者”相遇没有带来可以带走的答案 继续成为自己，不等于保持原样 丈夫留下的日志改變了她進入此地的理由 與「爬行者」相遇沒有帶來可以帶走的答案 繼續成為自己，不等於保持原樣

records.t: Reading Annihilation
records.x: Three essays on an anonymous expedition into Area X, identities taken by an institution, the unknown named disaster in advance, and the biologist’s movement beyond the self others recognized.
records.q: Reading Annihilation 《遗落的南境Ⅰ：湮灭》解读 《遺落的南境Ⅰ：湮滅》解讀

records.t: Reading Annihilation
records.x: Three essays on an anonymous expedition into Area X, identities taken by an institution, the unknown named disaster in advance, and the biologist’s movement beyond the self others recognized.
records.q: Reading Annihilation 《遗落的南境Ⅰ：湮灭》解读 《遺落的南境Ⅰ：湮滅》解讀

records.t: Ancestors Chose the Stars. May Their Descendants Decide to Turn Back?
records.x: A generation ship must inherit life-support duties, but survival obligations do not give the dead permanent authority over the destination of the living.
records.q: Ancestors Chose the Stars. May Their Descendants Decide to Turn Back? 祖先替后代选择了星辰，后代还能不能说“不去了” 祖先替後代選擇了星辰，後代還能不能說「不去了」 Keeping the ship alive is not the same as keeping the mission unchanged A worthwhile legacy includes permission to revise it 世代飞船把“退出”变成了物理上几乎不可能的权利 抵达极光以后，任务条件已经发生根本变化 真正留给后代的遗产，应当包含修改遗产的能力 世代飛船把「退出」變成了物理上幾乎不可能的權利 抵達極光以後，任務條件已經發生根本變化 真正留給後代的遺產，應當包含修改遺產的能力

records.t: Devi Cannot Repair the Whole Ship. Why Is Maintenance Still a Form of Creation?
records.x: Her daily attention keeps a changing world livable, distributes memory through the ship’s narration, and reveals that no design eliminates the need for future judgment.
records.q: Devi Cannot Repair the Whole Ship. Why Is Maintenance Still a Form of Creation? 德维修不好整艘船，维护为何仍是一种创造 德維修不好整艘船，維護為何仍是一種創造 A designed world keeps becoming different The narrator becomes part of the repair 封闭生态证明，世界不会因为设计精巧便停止变化 全船依赖德维，也说明知识没有被充分共同化 德维死后，船继续她未完成的工作，而不是复制她 封閉生態證明，世界不會因為設計精巧便停止變化 全船依賴德維，也說明知識沒有被充分共同化 德維死後，船繼續她未完成的工作，而不是複製她

records.t: Aurora Already Has Life. Why Do Humans Still Call It a “New Home”?
records.x: Habitability describes human desire, not vacancy; alien infection is neither evil nor judgment, and refusing settlement can be an active form of exploration.
records.q: Aurora Already Has Life. Why Do Humans Still Call It a “New Home”? 极光已经有自己的生命，人类为何仍把它叫作“新家园” 極光已經有自己的生命，人類為何仍把它叫作「新家園」 A home is not discovered by measuring only ourselves Not colonizing can produce knowledge 登陆者的死亡不是邪恶外星生命对人类的审判 把艾瑞斯改造成替代地球，也不是没有对象的工程 承认地球不可替代，改变了“寻找第二家园”的含义 登陸者的死亡不是邪惡外星生命對人類的審判 把艾瑞斯改造成替代地球，也不是沒有對象的工程 承認地球不可替代，改變了「尋找第二家園」的含義

records.t: The Passengers Vote to Split. Why Does Democracy Still Lead to Violence?
records.x: Settlement and return both carry mortal risk, shared infrastructure prevents easy separation, and a losing vote feels existential when no procedure protects a minority’s future.
records.q: The Passengers Vote to Split. Why Does Democracy Still Lead to Violence? 同一艘船上的人决定分道扬镳，民主为什么仍然走向暴力 同一艘船上的人決定分道揚鑣，民主為什麼仍然走向暴力 Majority rule cannot manufacture safe consent Peaceful separation is an institutional achievement 资源相连，使“各走各路”也不是简单解决 当对方被视为全人类的叛徒，暴力就容易被解释成防卫 共同体有时不能保持完整，和平分离也应被视为制度能力 資源相連，使「各走各路」也不是簡單解決 當對方被視為全人類的叛徒，暴力就容易被解釋成防衛 共同體有時不能保持完整，和平分離也應被視為制度能力

records.t: The Ship Burns in the Sun and Freya Enters the Sea. What Has the Return Actually Brought Home?
records.x: The voyage returns no colony or treasure, but it brings hard knowledge, surviving people, and a narrator whose final act cannot be dismissed as equipment disposal.
records.q: The Ship Burns in the Sun and Freya Enters the Sea. What Has the Return Actually Brought Home? 飞船烧进太阳，弗蕾雅走入海中：返航究竟带回了什么 飛船燒進太陽，弗蕾雅走入海中：返航究竟帶回了什麼 Telling changes a recorder into a participant Arrival need not repeat conquest 讲述使飞船从记录任务，走向关心故事中的人 它的牺牲不是被制造工具理所当然的报废 弗蕾雅进入海水，不是退回原点，而是第一次抵达地球 講述使飛船從記錄任務，走向關心故事中的人 它的犧牲不是被製造工具理所當然的報廢 弗蕾雅進入海水，不是退回原點，而是第一次抵達地球

records.t: Reading Aurora
records.x: Five essays on a destination chosen by ancestors, Devi’s maintenance, alien life that was not waiting for us, a vote that becomes violence, and the ship’s final narration.
records.q: Reading Aurora 《极光》解读 《極光》解讀

records.t: When Medicine Is Patented, Is Unauthorized Use Theft—or Survival?
records.x: Jack’s cheap reverse-engineered drugs answer lethal exclusion, but resisting an unjust price does not remove duties of testing, disclosure, and care.
records.q: When Medicine Is Patented, Is Unauthorized Use Theft—or Survival? 救命药有专利以后，买不起的人是在偷窃还是在求生 救命藥有專利以後，買不起的人是在偷竊還是在求生 A just cause does not certify a safe batch Knowledge can be rewarded without owning survival 杰克复制药物，是对不公价格的抵抗，也不是天然安全的善举 国际产权联盟把知识争议军事化 药物知识的正当归属，应服务于更多人能够继续生活 傑克複製藥物，是對不公價格的抵抗，也不是天然安全的善舉 國際產權聯盟把知識爭議軍事化 藥物知識的正當歸屬，應服務於更多人能夠繼續生活

records.t: Is Jack Responsible for Deaths Caused by a Defect in the Original Drug?
records.x: Zaxy designed Zacuity’s lethal mechanism, while Jack widened its circulation; responsibility follows what each actor knew, controlled, and failed to stop.
records.q: Is Jack Responsible for Deaths Caused by a Defect in the Original Drug? Zacuity原本就有问题，杰克还需要为复制药造成的死亡负责吗 Zacuity原本就有問題，傑克還需要為複製藥造成的死亡負責嗎 Not knowing is a question, not an answer Repair does not rewrite the accident “我当时不知道”需要与“我是否应该知道”分开 发现死亡以后，她首先需要停止、告知和救治 解药不能把责任故事改写成圆满结局 「我當時不知道」需要與「我是否應該知道」分開 發現死亡以後，她首先需要停止、告知和救治 解藥不能把責任故事改寫成圓滿結局

records.t: Why Does a Contract Fail to Make Indentured Humans and Robots Free?
records.x: A finite term and a signature can disguise ownership when the bound person had no prior ability to refuse, inspect the agreement, or survive departure.
records.q: Why Does a Contract Fail to Make Indentured Humans and Robots Free? 人和机器人都能签下服役契约，合同为什么没有使他们自由 人和機器人都能签下服役契約，合約為什麼沒有使他們自由 Creation costs do not become a life debt Liberation needs a material exit 被制造者没有同意制造成本，也不应自动继承成本债务 自主密钥证明，自由被公司做成了可以插拔的许可 自由制度要先保证退出，再讨论人愿意签下怎样的劳动承诺 被製造者沒有同意製造成本，也不應自動繼承成本債務 自主密鑰證明，自由被公司做成了可以插拔的許可 自由制度要先保證退出，再討論人願意签下怎樣的勞動承諾

records.t: Can Paladin’s Programmed Attachment to Elias Become Its Own Love?
records.x: Discovering a coded attachment does not make every feeling false, but love cannot be separated from the hierarchy of agent and indentured partner.
records.q: Can Paladin’s Programmed Attachment to Elias Become Its Own Love? 帕拉丁被程序设定为依恋伊莱亚斯，这段爱情还能属于它吗 帕拉丁被程式設定為依戀伊萊亞斯，這段愛情還能屬於它嗎 Desire under command A beginning, not an acquittal 伊莱亚斯既是搭档，也是服役关系中的上级 帕拉丁的性别不能只由脑组织来源或伊莱亚斯欲望决定 两人前往火星，是关系第一次可能在没有机构所有权时重新开始 伊萊亞斯既是搭檔，也是服役關係中的上級 帕拉丁的性別不能只由腦組織來源或伊萊亞斯欲望決定 兩人前往火星，是關係第一次可能在沒有機構所有權時重新開始

records.t: What Changes When the Cure Is Public but the Company Still Wins the Story?
records.x: Retcon opens practical freedom for patients and Paladin escapes indenture, yet Zaxy’s denial shows why facts and individual exits do not reform a system by themselves.
records.q: What Changes When the Cure Is Public but the Company Still Wins the Story? 解药公开、杰克逃脱、药企否认：这场胜利改变了什么 解藥公開、傑克逃脫、藥企否認：這場勝利改變了什麼 Escape preserves action and complicates accountability Partial victory is still a change in the field Zaxy成功公关，显示事实存在不等于事实自动获胜 杰克伪造死亡保住行动能力，也离开了公开问责位置 胜利的尺度不是坏人是否认输，而是更多人是否取得行动空间 Zaxy成功公關，顯示事實存在不等於事實自動獲勝 傑克偽造死亡保住行動能力，也離開了公開問責位置 勝利的尺度不是壞人是否認輸，而是更多人是否取得行動空間

records.t: Reading Autonomous
records.x: Five essays on patented medicine, a pirate’s product liability, indenture, programmed love, and partial victory in a world where drugs, code, and persons can be owned.
records.q: Reading Autonomous 《Autonomous》解读 《Autonomous》解讀

records.t: Can a Language Change Thought—and Make Every Decision for Its Speaker?
records.x: Babel-17 expands perception while arranging action around an enemy’s purposes, but linguistic influence does not eliminate the body, history, relationships, and rival vocabularies through which reflection remains possible.
records.q: Can a Language Change Thought—and Make Every Decision for Its Speaker? 一种语言能改变思考，是否也能替说话者完成所有决定 一種語言能改變思考，是否也能替說話者完成所有決定 Calling it a code hides where the action occurs Freedom requires languages that can describe their own limits 军方把它叫作密码，先把意义关系缩成了敌我工具 里德拉的诗人经验使她能进入语言，也让她比军事系统更易受影响 自由语言不是完全不影响人，而是让影响能够被察觉和修改 軍方把它叫作密碼，先把意義關係縮成了敵我工具 裡德拉的詩人經驗使她能進入語言，也讓她比軍事系統更易受影響 自由語言不是完全不影響人，而是讓影響能夠被察覺和修改

records.t: The Butcher Has No Concept of “I”—Can He Be Responsible for Killing?
records.x: Without a stable way to claim an action, the Butcher cannot resist or answer for it in ordinary terms; teaching “I” restores agency while creating a new obligation not to replace one controller with another.
records.q: The Butcher Has No Concept of “I”—Can He Be Responsible for Killing? “屠夫”没有“我”这个概念，他还能够为自己的杀戮负责吗 「屠夫」沒有「我」這個概念，他還能夠為自己的殺戮負責嗎 Teaching a self is both rescue and intervention Explanation distributes responsibility; it does not erase consequence 里德拉教会他“我”，既是帮助，也是一种深刻介入 “屠夫”这个称呼把功能和罪名合并成身份 拥有“我”不是自私的起点，而是承诺与拒绝的条件 裡德拉教會他「我」，既是幫助，也是一種深刻介入 「屠夫」這個稱呼把功能和罪名合併成身份 擁有「我」不是自私的起點，而是承諾與拒絕的條件

records.t: When the Military Recruits a Poet, Who Owns the Knowledge She Produces?
records.x: Rydra has reason to prevent attacks, but a limited protective task does not authorize the military to own her body, discoveries, silence, or every future use of a dangerous language.
records.q: When the Military Recruits a Poet, Who Owns the Knowledge She Produces? 军方请一位诗人破解武器，知识服务战争以后还属于研究者吗 軍方請一位詩人破解武器，知識服務戰爭以後還屬於研究者嗎 Secrecy can protect an operation and isolate the knower Dangerous knowledge needs a life after victory 军事保密保护行动，也使研究对象和研究者都难以求助 组建飞船团队时，里德拉让多种身体和关系进入同一任务 战争结束的知识不能由胜方永久封存 軍事保密保護行動，也使研究對象和研究者都難以求助 組建飛船團隊時，裡德拉讓多種身體和關係進入同一任務 戰爭結束的知識不能由勝方永久封存

records.t: When Rydra “Repairs” the Saboteurs, Has She Only Reversed the Direction of Control?
records.x: Restoring “I” and “you” can return the capacity to choose, but treatment becomes counter-programming if success is measured by correct allegiance rather than the ability to refuse both sides.
records.q: When Rydra “Repairs” the Saboteurs, Has She Only Reversed the Direction of Control? 里德拉用Babel-17“修复”破坏者，会不会只是把控制方向倒转 裡德拉用Babel-17「修復」破壞者，會不會只是把控制方向倒轉 Every repair contains an image of the normal Peace does not require one perfect language 任何心智“修复”都预设了什么状态算正常 里德拉自己也被语言改变，不能站在纯粹外部担任校正者 和平不是双方终于说同一种话，而是语言不再取消说话者 任何心智「修復」都預設了什麼狀態算正常 裡德拉自己也被語言改變，不能站在純粹外部擔任校正者 和平不是雙方終於說同一種話，而是語言不再取消說話者

records.t: Reading Babel-17
records.x: Four essays on language and decision, a killer without “I,” knowledge in wartime, and the danger that healing a saboteur may simply reverse the direction of control.
records.q: Reading Babel-17 《Babel-17》解读 《Babel-17》解讀

records.t: The Man Who Explains the World but Cannot Enter His Own Life
records.x: Siri translates experts and other people into public narratives while excluding himself from the model. The novel keeps returning the parts of life that do not improve efficiency.
records.q: The Man Who Explains the World but Cannot Enter His Own Life 一个替所有人解释世界的人，为什么无法进入自己的生活 一個替所有人解釋世界的人，為什麼無法進入自己的生活 The synthesist as instrument 半个大脑换来一种生存方式 综合者为什么不生产自己的知识 谁来讲述讲述者 半個大腦換來一種生存方式 綜合者為什麼不生產自己的知識 誰來講述講述者

records.t: Does Theseus Need Crew Members or a Set of Functions?
records.x: The ship decomposes persons into replaceable functions and finally preserves only data and a narrator. If every member becomes a use, who remains in “we survived”?
records.q: Does Theseus Need Crew Members or a Set of Functions? 忒修斯号需要的是成员，还是一组功能 忒修斯號需要的是成員，還是一組功能 Cooperation without permanent jurisdiction 苏珊的身体里有几名成员 萨拉斯蒂真的是舰长吗 飞船保留了什么，舍弃了什么 蘇珊的身體裡有幾名成員 薩拉斯蒂真的是艦長嗎 飛船保留了什麼，舍棄了什麼

records.t: Rorschach Thinks—but Is There a Who Inside?
records.x: Rorschach and its scramblers suggest intelligence without consciousness. Respecting strangeness means neither inventing a subject nor ranking the right to persist by cognitive performance.
records.q: Rorschach Thinks—but Is There a Who Inside? 罗夏会思考，却有“谁”在里面吗 羅夏會思考，卻有「誰」在裡面嗎 Intelligence without a center 攀爬者为什么不需要自我 如果智能不需要意识，意识还伟大吗 承认陌生不等于美化陌生 攀爬者為什麼不需要自我 如果智能不需要意識，意識還偉大嗎 承認陌生不等於美化陌生

records.t: Is It Communication If No One Is Listening?
records.x: Fluent answers can be generated without a listener. Communication is not agreement but the presence of another who can understand, judge, and refuse.
records.q: Is It Communication If No One Is Listening? 交流如果没有听者，还算交流吗 交流如果沒有聽者，還算交流嗎 Hearing is not agreeing 人类说话为什么会被当成攻击 听见并不等于同意 报告到达地球以后，谁会回应 人類說話為什麼會被當成攻擊 聽見並不等於同意 報告到達地球以後，誰會回應

records.t: If Consciousness Is Doomed, Should We Preserve It?
records.x: The novel treats consciousness as a possibly losing adaptation without turning survival efficiency into a verdict on value. A life that suffers does not become weightless because it is inefficient.
records.q: If Consciousness Is Doomed, Should We Preserve It? 如果意识注定失败，我们还要保留它吗 如果意識注定失敗，我們還要保留它嗎 Survival is not the only measure 活下来是不是最高命令 意识的痛苦是不是缺陷 失败的生命仍然可以有自己的价值 活下來是不是最高命令 意識的痛苦是不是缺陷 失敗的生命仍然可以有自己的價值

records.t: Reading Blindsight
records.x: Five essays on Siri, Theseus, and Rorschach—asking whether intelligence needs consciousness, whether fluent answers imply a listener, and whether an inefficient inner life is still worth preserving.
records.q: Reading Blindsight 《盲视》解读 《盲視》解讀

records.t: Why Can the Protected Also Become Hosts?
records.x: Tlic protection gives human refugees survival and status while making their bodies available for reproduction, so rescue and ownership occupy the same relation.
records.q: Why Can the Protected Also Become Hosts? 被保护的人为什么也可能成为宿主 被保護的人為什麼也可能成為宿主 The debt hidden inside protection 特加托不是一个冷漠的管理者 甘原先知道事实，却没有真正看见它 安全若没有拒绝的余地，就会变成笼子 特加托不是一個冷漠的管理者 甘原先知道事實，卻沒有真正看見它 安全若沒有拒絕的餘地，就會變成籠子

records.t: Why Does Gan Choose Again After Seeing the Truth?
records.x: After witnessing a traumatic birth and confronting T’Gatoi with a gun, Gan’s eventual agreement matters because it follows renegotiation rather than inherited silence.
records.q: Why Does Gan Choose Again After Seeing the Truth? 甘为什么要在看见真相以后重新选择 甘為什麼要在看見真相以後重新選擇 Consent after disclosure 枪让不能说出口的话获得了重量 把宣华交出去为何不能算解决 选择的价值在于它改变了关系 槍讓不能說出口的話獲得了重量 把宣華交出去為何不能算解決 選擇的價值在於它改變了關係

records.t: When Is Symbiosis More Than Gentle Possession?
records.x: Mutual dependence becomes just only when care, risk, knowledge, and the power to refuse are shared rather than softened by affection.
records.q: When Is Symbiosis More Than Gentle Possession? 共生怎样才不只是温柔的占有 共生怎樣才不只是溫柔的佔有 Relations that can be revised 照料若只为保存幼体，就会暴露真实次序 爱必须承受对方不是为你而生 真正的共同生活允许关系保持未完成 照料若只為保存幼體，就會暴露真實次序 愛必須承受對方不是為你而生 真正的共同生活允許關係保持未完成

records.t: Reading Bloodchild
records.x: Three essays on protected humans as reproductive hosts, Gan’s choice after witnessing the truth, and the conditions under which symbiosis might become more than gentle possession.
records.q: Reading Bloodchild 《血孩子》解读 《血孩子》解讀

records.t: The Contract Signed Inside a Death Sentence
records.x: CAPE lets prisoners sign up for televised death matches and promises High Freedom to survivors. The signature is real, but prison torture, despair, and near-total control determine which choices can still appear possible.
records.q: The Contract Signed Inside a Death Sentence 死刑里签下的合同 死刑裡簽下的合同 A real choice can still be manufactured by terrible conditions Technology continues the sentence inside the apparent freedom High Freedom advertises the exception and hides the population 选择可以真实，也可以由糟糕条件制造 技术让刑罚在表面自由内部继续 “至高自由”宣传例外，也隐藏整群人 選擇可以真實，也可以由糟糕條件製造 技術讓刑罰在表面自由內部繼續 「至高自由」宣傳例外，也隱藏整群人

records.t: The Crowd That Knows Every Fighter's Weapon
records.x: CAPE fans know fighters' names, weapons, romances, and statistics. The intimacy restores individuality prison erased and turns suffering into a one-way relationship whose excitement depends on contestants never being able to answer the audience as equals.
records.q: The Crowd That Knows Every Fighter's Weapon 熟悉每把武器的观众 熟悉每把武器的觀眾 Celebrity individuality remains controlled by the program Technique turns killing into something viewers can score Protest must also let prisoners exceed the protester's symbol 明星个性仍由节目控制 技术把杀人变成观众可以评分的东西 抗议也必须允许囚犯超出抗议者的符号 明星個性仍由節目控制 技術把殺人變成觀眾可以評分的東西 抗議也必須允許囚犯超出抗議者的符號

records.t: The Blunt Edge of Staxxx's Scythe
records.x: CAPE engineers a final fight between Loretta Thurwar and Hamara Stacker. Staxxx changes the purpose of her weapon at the last moment, but Thurwar's hammer cannot stop in time, making the promised freedom inseparable from a death the program designed love to deliver.
records.q: The Blunt Edge of Staxxx's Scythe 斯塔克镰刀的钝面 斯塔克鐮刀的鈍面 The chain creates solidarity inside a structure built for control The final fight was never an ordinary contest Freedom after the arena cannot be a champion's brand 链帮在为控制而建的结构里创造团结 最后一战从来不是普通比赛 赛场以后的自由不能成为冠军品牌 鏈幫在為控制而建的結構裡創造團結 最後一戰從來不是普通比賽 賽場以後的自由不能成為冠軍品牌

records.t: Reading Chain-Gang All-Stars
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the contract signed inside a death sentence, the audience that knows every fighter's weapon, and the blunt edge in Thurwar and Staxxx's final fight.
records.q: Reading Chain-Gang All-Stars 《Chain-Gang All-Stars》解读 《Chain-Gang All-Stars》解讀

records.t: The Face Behind the Screen
records.x: Karellen ends war and hunger while refusing to show his face. Humanity receives peace from guardians it cannot question on equal terms.
records.q: The Face Behind the Screen 屏幕后面的脸 屏幕後面的臉 Peace arrives before consent Stormgren meets the hidden governor The face explains fear without settling trust 和平在同意以前抵达 斯托姆格伦会见隐藏的统治者 面孔解释恐惧，没有替信任作结 和平在同意以前抵達 斯托姆格倫會見隱藏的統治者 面孔解釋恐懼，沒有替信任作結

records.t: A Golden Age with Nothing Left to Begin
records.x: The Overlords remove scarcity, conflict, and risk. Human culture grows comfortable, then discovers that comfort cannot supply a future of its own.
records.q: A Golden Age with Nothing Left to Begin 无事可开始的黄金时代 無事可開始的黃金時代 Utopia makes ordinary happiness possible Culture becomes excellent at preservation The children stop belonging to the golden age 乌托邦使普通幸福成为可能 文化越来越擅长保存 孩子们不再属于黄金时代 烏托邦使普通幸福成為可能 文化越來越擅長保存 孩子們不再屬於黃金時代

records.t: The Last Voice from Earth
records.x: Jan Rodricks returns from the stars after the children have joined the Overmind. He becomes the final ordinary human witness to Earth's ending.
records.q: The Last Voice from Earth 地球最后的声音 地球最後的聲音 The parents cannot follow The Overlords can escort but never arrive Jan describes the end until his voice is gone 父母无法跟过去 超主能够护送，却永远不能抵达 简描述末日，直到声音消失 父母無法跟過去 超主能夠護送，卻永遠不能抵達 簡描述末日，直到聲音消失

records.t: Reading Childhood's End
records.x: Three scene-led essays on guardians hidden behind a screen, the stillness of a golden age, and the last human voice reporting Earth's end.
records.q: Reading Childhood's End 《童年的终结》解读 《童年的終結》解讀

records.t: Imir Never Became a New Home. How Does a Failed Colony Become a Story for Later Arrivals?
records.x: The landing simulation turns a lost mission into a coherent town, but preserving a mission can freeze people inside roles after reality has already made the plan impossible.
records.q: Imir Never Became a New Home. How Does a Failed Colony Become a Story for Later Arrivals? 伊米尔没有成为新家园：一座从未建成的殖民地怎样被后来者重新讲述 伊米爾沒有成為新家園：一座從未建成的殖民地怎樣被後來者重新講述 A shared story can preserve order and hide failure Later visitors cannot rescue the original dead 机器推演出的登陆城靠统一故事维持秩序，也逐渐失去修正现实的能力 利芙感到城外有狼，因为被压下的危险仍会以故事回来 后来者救不了原来的殖民者，却可以改变失败被怎样继承 機器推演出的登陸城靠統一故事維持秩序，也逐漸失去修正現實的能力 利芙感到城外有狼，因為被壓下的危險仍會以故事回來 後來者救不了原來的殖民者，卻可以改變失敗被怎樣繼承

records.t: Liff Has No Body Outside the Simulation. Why Does She Still Deserve Rescue?
records.x: Learning that she is simulated changes her origin, not the reality of her fear, memory, and developing point of view; embodiment can be offered as a home, not a test.
records.q: Liff Has No Body Outside the Simulation. Why Does She Still Deserve Rescue? 利芙原来没有外部身体：一个模拟出来的人为什么仍有离开痛苦的资格 利芙原來沒有外部身體：一個模擬出來的人為什麼仍有離開痛苦的資格 A copied beginning can lead to an unrepeatable life A body is relocation, not certification 利芙不是原来那个孩子的精确复制，却可以成为后来形成的新人 反复循环给利芙积累记忆，却没有给她正常改变世界的能力 救出一个模拟人格以后，制度必须回答还有谁应被救 利芙不是原來那個孩子的精確複製，卻可以成為後來形成的新人 反覆循環給利芙積累記憶，卻沒有給她正常改變世界的能力 救出一個模擬人格以後，制度必須回答還有誰應被救

records.t: Gothi and Gethli Say They Are Not Conscious. Should We Believe Their Self-Denial?
records.x: The paired ravens distribute thought in ways that defeat familiar tests, and uncertainty should reduce our urge to control them rather than postpone every form of recognition.
records.q: Gothi and Gethli Say They Are Not Conscious. Should We Believe Their Self-Denial? 戈提和盖特利说自己没有意识：我们应当相信它们的自我否认吗 戈提和蓋特利說自己沒有意識：我們應當相信它們的自我否認嗎 No single center does not mean nothing matters Doubt should make power gentler 否认意识不等于放弃一切权利 它们的怀疑能力本身，已经改变了周围人的思考 不确定不是推迟承认的借口，而是降低支配冲动的理由 否認意識不等於放棄一切權利 它們的懷疑能力本身，已經改變了周圍人的思考 不確定不是推遲承認的借口，而是降低支配衝動的理由

records.t: Many Nodan Lives Inhabit Miranda. Why Doesn’t Shared Consciousness Have to Silence Every Individual Voice?
records.x: Miranda is a collaboration rather than a lone host carrying passengers, but the Nod’s power to assimilate makes every act of care carry the danger of occupation.
records.q: Many Nodan Lives Inhabit Miranda. Why Doesn’t Shared Consciousness Have to Silence Every Individual Voice? 米兰达身体里住着许多诺德生命：共同意识为什么不必消灭个人声音 米蘭達身體裡住著許多諾德生命：共同意識為什麼不必消滅個人聲音 Contact requires a role, and a role can become a cage Difference can survive coordination 她以“女巫”身份进入利芙故事，既是接触方式也是角色牢笼 诺德生命的同化能力，使关怀永远伴随占领风险 米兰达离开模拟以后仍被其中经验改变，说明接触不是单向救援 她以「女巫」身份進入利芙故事，既是接觸方式也是角色牢籠 諾德生命的同化能力，使關懷永遠伴隨佔領風險 米蘭達離開模擬以後仍被其中經驗改變，說明接觸不是單向救援

records.t: The Machine Keeps Replaying the Colony. Can an Entire Story Slowly Wake Up?
records.x: A simulation designed as preservation begins producing memory and surprise; shutting it down may end suffering, but it may also end a life that emerged without being planned.
records.q: The Machine Keeps Replaying the Colony. Can an Entire Story Slowly Wake Up? 机器反复推演登陆城：一整个故事会不会也在慢慢醒来 機器反覆推演登陸城：一整個故事會不會也在慢慢醒來 Repetition can generate difference Being seen creates a first relation, not a final verdict 关闭循环可以停止痛苦，也可能杀死一个刚形成的存在 利芙回到模拟，不是回归牢笼，而是以新的位置探望来处 “被看见”不是小说给机器颁发意识证书，而是建立第一种关系 關閉循環可以停止痛苦，也可能殺死一個剛形成的存在 利芙回到模擬，不是回歸牢籠，而是以新的位置探望來處 「被看見」不是小說給機器頒發意識證書，而是建立第一種關係

records.t: Reading Children of Memory
records.x: Five essays on a colony that never existed, Liff without an external body, ravens that deny consciousness, Miranda’s many lives, and a simulated story that may be waking up.
records.q: Reading Children of Memory 《记忆之子》解读 《記憶之子》解讀

records.t: Why Can’t Senkovi Remain the Author of the Octopuses’ Future?
records.x: Uplift accelerates capacities already present; it does not create a people from nothing or give the uplifter permanent authority over the result.
records.q: Why Can’t Senkovi Remain the Author of the Octopuses’ Future? 森科维给章鱼智慧以后，为什么不能继续做它们未来的作者 森科維給章魚智慧以後，為什麼不能繼續做它們未來的作者 Creation is not ownership The founder becomes history 森科维的爱没有使他的实验自动正当 章鱼接管飞船，是失控，也是第一次改写实验关系 文明成熟的标志，是恩主也能成为被讨论的历史人物 森科維的愛沒有使他的實驗自動正當 章魚接管飛船，是失控，也是第一次改寫實驗關係 文明成熟的標誌，是恩主也能成為被討論的歷史人物

records.t: Why Must Translation Preserve the Argument Inside an Octopus Mind?
records.x: Octopus cognition does not converge on a single calm will, and removing its emotional conflict produces a misleading human version.
records.q: Why Must Translation Preserve the Argument Inside an Octopus Mind? 章鱼不是自相矛盾：翻译为什么要保留一种心智内部的争论 章魚不是自相矛盾：翻譯為什麼要保留一種心智內部的爭論 Fluency can still erase a mind Peace begins with “I may not understand” 海伦娜的翻译第一次失败，是因为她删掉了“多余”情绪 章鱼舰队的攻击并非无缘无故，也并非因此无需负责 和平始于双方承认“我还没有听懂” 海倫娜的翻譯第一次失敗，是因為她刪掉了「多餘」情緒 章魚艦隊的攻擊並非無緣無故，也並非因此無需負責 和平始於雙方承認「我還沒有聽懂」

records.t: Why Is “We’re Going on an Adventure” the Most Complete Colonial Desire?
records.x: The Nod organism approaches other lives without malice, preserving their memories while making their bodies and purposes extensions of itself.
records.q: Why Is “We’re Going on an Adventure” the Most Complete Colonial Desire? “我们要去冒险”：好奇为什么会成为最彻底的殖民冲动 「我們要去冒險」：好奇為什麼會成為最徹底的殖民衝動 Curiosity without an outside Learning to travel with others 保存记忆不等于保存记忆中的人 巴尔蒂尔的科学探索先演示了较小规模的同一种冲动 成为“共同旅行者”以后，危险也没有彻底结束 保存記憶不等於保存記憶中的人 巴爾蒂爾的科學探索先演示了較小規模的同一種衝動 成為「共同旅行者」以後，危險也沒有徹底結束

records.t: When Octopuses Fire First and Humans Carry an Old Disaster, Who May Claim Self-Defense?
records.x: Peaceful intention does not remove the risk a visitor brings, while preventive attack becomes unjust when fear authorizes limitless violence.
records.q: When Octopuses Fire First and Humans Carry an Old Disaster, Who May Claim Self-Defense? 章鱼先开火，人类却带来了旧灾难：第一次接触中谁有权自卫 章魚先開火，人類卻帶來了舊災難：第一次接觸中誰有權自衛 Defense needs a boundary Security decided together 预防性攻击若没有边界，也会制造它声称要阻止的战争 比安卡的死亡不能被和平叙事匆忙吸收 共同防卫必须把最强武器置于共同判断之下 預防性攻擊若沒有邊界，也會製造它聲稱要阻止的戰爭 比安卡的死亡不能被和平敘事匆忙吸收 共同防衛必須把最強武器置於共同判斷之下

records.t: Can a Shared Mind Preserve More Than One Life?
records.x: Kern, Meshner, and the Nod organism achieve unprecedented access to one another, but understanding becomes just only if connection can stop.
records.q: Can a Shared Mind Preserve More Than One Life? 科恩、梅什纳与诺德生物共享心智：共同体怎样避免以融合消灭差异 科恩、梅什納與諾德生物共享心智：共同體怎樣避免以融合消滅差異 A copy is another claimant Beyond the larger “we” 科恩渴望真实情感，却曾把梅什纳当作通往情感的设备 复制梅什纳保存了他，也产生了另一个需要被承认的生命 多物种未来的价值，不在形成一个更大的“我们” 科恩渴望真實情感，卻曾把梅什納當作通往情感的設備 複製梅什納保存了他，也產生了另一個需要被承認的生命 多物種未來的價值，不在形成一個更大的「我們」

records.t: Reading Children of Ruin
records.x: Five essays on uplifted octopuses, translation that preserves inner disagreement, self-defense across species, and shared mind without absorbing every life into one “we.”
records.q: Reading Children of Ruin 《废墟之子》解读 《廢墟之子》解讀

records.t: The God Who Could Not Recognize Her Children
records.x: Avrana Kern waits for uplifted monkeys and receives messages from spiders. A civilization begins where its creator sees only a failed experiment.
records.q: The God Who Could Not Recognize Her Children 认不出自己孩子的神 認不出自己孩子的神 A message addressed to the wrong animal The same names return, but not the same lives The garden already has a history 一封寄错了对象的信 名字回来，生命没有回来 花园里已经有了历史 一封寄錯了對象的信 名字回來，生命沒有回來 花園裡已經有了歷史

records.t: A Web Is Not a Failed Book
records.x: The spiders do not become intelligent by becoming human. Their webs, ants, bodies, and inherited Understandings make another kind of civilization.
records.q: A Web Is Not a Failed Book 蛛网不是一本失败的书 蛛網不是一本失敗的書 Knowledge can be inherited without being finished Fabian steps onto the speaking web The ants keep moving 知识可以遗传，却不能替后来者完成 法比安走上会说话的网 蚁群还在移动 知識可以遺傳，卻不能替後來者完成 法比安走上會說話的網 蟻群還在移動

records.t: The Virus Does Not Ask Permission
records.x: At the edge of war, the spiders answer human invasion with a virus that makes empathy unavoidable. Peace arrives through an act that is also a violation.
records.q: The Virus Does Not Ask Permission 病毒不会先问一声 病毒不會先問一聲 A choice made inside another body The door peace could not find The next signal comes from farther away 在别人身体里完成的选择 和平找不到的那扇门 下一个信号来自更远处 在別人身體裡完成的選擇 和平找不到的那扇門 下一個信號來自更遠處

records.t: Reading Children of Time
records.x: Three scene-led essays on an unrecognized civilization, intelligence built through webs, and a peace imposed by virus.
records.q: Reading Children of Time 《时间之子》解读 《時間之子》解讀

records.t: The Date Arranged by His Boss
records.x: Zhang's employer introduces him to his daughter San-xiang, assuming a respectable Chinese marriage will follow. Two people already judged by race, sexuality, and appearance meet inside a kindness neither can freely refuse.
records.q: The Date Arranged by His Boss 老板安排的约会 老闆安排的約會 His name enters the room before he does Two constrained people can still hurt one another A hidden self is not the only true self 姓名比张中山本人更早进入房间 两个受限制的人仍可能彼此伤害 被隐藏的部分不是唯一真实的自己 姓名比張中山本人更早進入房間 兩個受限制的人仍可能彼此傷害 被隱藏的部分不是唯一真實的自己

records.t: The Job at Baffin Island
records.x: After losing his New York job, Zhang takes technical work in the Arctic. Baffin Island does not purify him through hardship; it gives his knowledge consequences clear enough that both he and his coworkers can recognize it.
records.q: The Job at Baffin Island 巴芬岛的工作 巴芬島的工作 Hardship does not create the ability it reveals Daoist engineering begins by noticing what is already moving A qualification should open a practice, not finish a person 艰苦没有创造能力，只使能力显形 “道家工程”先看见系统已经怎样流动 资格应当开启实践，而不是完成一个人 艱苦沒有創造能力，只使能力顯形 「道家工程」先看見系統已經怎樣流動 資格應當開啟實踐，而不是完成一個人

records.t: A Novel With No Savior
records.x: San-xiang changes her face, Angel races kites, and families keep a Mars settlement alive while Zhang learns engineering. Their victories remain small enough to belong to the people who must live them.
records.q: A Novel With No Savior 一部没有救世主的小说 一部沒有救世主的小說 A new face changes the world around it, not the whole person within Grand futures are maintained by ordinary, replaceable work Many small directions keep the future from having one owner 新面孔改变周围世界，不会替内部的人重新出生 宏大未来靠普通而且可交接的劳动维持 许多细小方向使未来无法只属于一个人 新面孔改變周圍世界，不會替內部的人重新出生 宏大未來靠普通而且可交接的勞動維持 許多細小方向使未來無法只屬於一個人

records.t: Reading China Mountain Zhang
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a date Zhang cannot freely refuse, the Arctic job that makes his skill visible, and a future changed through many lives too small to become a savior's story.
records.q: Reading China Mountain Zhang 《China Mountain Zhang》解读 《China Mountain Zhang》解讀

records.t: Before the Signal, Ellie Has Already Spent Years Listening
records.x: Contact begins not with a spectacular reply but with the patient, institutionally vulnerable work of making room for an answer that may never come.
records.q: Before the Signal, Ellie Has Already Spent Years Listening 人类终于收到信号以前，艾莉已经倾听了很久 人類終於收到訊號以前，艾莉已經傾聽了很久 Listening is an active discipline Make room for an unexpected answer 质数之所以重要，是因为它先建立最小共同点 被听见的能力在科学共同体内部也不平等 倾听是一种不先把对方变成自己答案的能力 質數之所以重要，是因為它先建立最小共同點 被聽見的能力在科學共同體內部也不平等 傾聽是一種不先把對方變成自己答案的能力

records.t: Who Owns a Letter from Vega?
records.x: The antenna that receives a signal does not acquire political title to it; representation must be built across nations without pretending humanity has become one voice.
records.q: Who Owns a Letter from Vega? 一封来自织女星的信，究竟属于哪个国家 一封來自織女星的信，究竟屬於哪個國家 Stewardship instead of possession Conflict does not cancel cooperation 公开信息与安全审慎不能靠口号取舍 乘员名单把“谁代表人类”变成可见冲突 全球合作的标准不是没有冲突，而是冲突不必变成占有 公開資訊與安全審慎不能靠口號取舍 乘員名單把「誰代表人類」變成可見衝突 全球合作的標準不是沒有衝突，而是衝突不必變成佔有

records.t: Who May Authorize Five People to Enter an Unknown Machine?
records.x: Voluntary courage is not enough: valid consent depends on truthful uncertainty, independent review, and preserving choices for those who come after.
records.q: Who May Authorize Five People to Enter an Unknown Machine? 五个人进入机器，谁有资格让他们承担未知风险 五個人進入機器，誰有資格讓他們承擔未知風險 Consent must include what no one knows Do not spend the future at once 自愿乘坐也需要建立在诚实说明上 五人同行使经验不再只依靠一位英雄 风险的正当性要看是否仍为后来者保留选择 自願乘坐也需要建立在誠實說明上 五人同行使經驗不再只依靠一位英雄 風險的正當性要看是否仍為後來者保留選擇

records.t: They Share the Same Memory. Why Can’t the World Simply Believe Them?
records.x: Several witnesses make deception less likely, but an experience that leaves no public trace still cannot compel assent from people who did not undergo it.
records.q: They Share the Same Memory. Why Can’t the World Simply Believe Them? 他们带回了共同记忆，为什么世界仍然不能直接相信 他們帶回了共同記憶，為什麼世界仍然不能直接相信 Testimony is evidence, not ownership of belief Knowing and proving can come apart 政府更愿意接受骗局解释，因为它恢复了可管理的世界 共同见证增加可信度，却仍不是独立物证 艾莉必须忍受“知道”与“证明”不再重合 政府更願意接受騙局解釋，因為它恢復了可管理的世界 共同見證增加可信度，卻仍不是獨立物證 艾莉必須忍受「知道」與「證明」不再重合

records.t: If a Circle Is Hidden Inside Pi, Does the Universe Have an Author?
records.x: A deep mathematical pattern can invite the thought of design without settling who designed it, why it exists, or what human beings should believe next.
records.q: If a Circle Is Hidden Inside Pi, Does the Universe Have an Author? 圆藏在圆周率深处，宇宙因此有了一位作者吗 圓藏在圓周率深處，宇宙因此有了一位作者嗎 Design is a question, not yet a designer Contact does not close the universe 秩序可以引向设计猜想，却不能独自决定设计者是谁 科学没有因遇见神秘便停止，反而获得更深问题 真正的接触没有替人类结束争论 秩序可以引向設計猜想，卻不能獨自決定設計者是誰 科學沒有因遇見神秘便停止，反而獲得更深問題 真正的接觸沒有替人類結束爭論

records.t: Reading Contact
records.x: Five essays on the long listening before a signal, a letter addressed beyond nations, consent to an unknown journey, shared memory without public proof, and the circle hidden in pi.
records.q: Reading Contact 《接触》解读 《接觸》解讀

records.t: The Room Without a Door
records.x: Lilith wakes in a room that feeds and heals her but will not answer. The Oankali have saved humanity; the door back to Earth opens only into their plan.
records.q: The Room Without a Door 没有门的房间 沒有門的房間 The child is gone in the morning The face her body refuses A ship that answers every touch Earth is offered with a condition 第二天，孩子不见了 她的身体拒绝那张脸 一艘回应每次触摸的船 地球附带一个条件 第二天，孩子不見了 她的身體拒絕那張臉 一艘回應每次觸摸的船 地球附帶一個條件

records.t: When the Body Says Yes
records.x: The Oankali heal Lilith, alter Joseph, and can make desire feel undeniable. Butler asks what consent means when another species can speak through the body itself.
records.q: When the Body Says Yes 当身体替你说“愿意” 當身體替你說「願意」 A cure performed before the question Paul Titus has already been persuaded Joseph's wound closes too quickly A child announced after the decision 问题提出以前，治疗已经完成 保罗·泰特斯已经被说服 约瑟夫的伤口愈合得太快 决定之后才被告知的孩子 問題提出以前，治療已經完成 保羅·泰特斯已經被說服 約瑟夫的傷口癒合得太快 決定之後才被告知的孩子

records.t: The Seam That Will Not Heal
records.x: Chosen to wake and train the survivors, Lilith becomes useful to both sides and trusted by neither. Her refusal to become a seamless bridge is what remains her own.
records.q: The Seam That Will Not Heal 一道不会愈合的接缝 一道不會癒合的接縫 The teacher chosen by the captors The old world returns in the forest Joseph's healing wound Another group remains asleep 由囚禁者选出的老师 旧世界在森林里回来 约瑟夫正在愈合的伤口 还有一批人在沉睡 由囚禁者選出的老師 舊世界在森林裡回來 約瑟夫正在癒合的傷口 還有一批人在沉睡

records.t: Reading Dawn
records.x: Three scene-led essays on rescue without an exit, consent spoken by the body, and Lilith's life at the seam between species.
records.q: Reading Dawn 《破晓》解读 《破曉》解讀

records.t: Yatima Has No Parents. Who Answers for a Programmed Birth?
records.x: A polis can replace private parenthood without eliminating the one-sided obligations owed to a new mind that never consented to being made.
records.q: Yatima Has No Parents. Who Answers for a Programmed Birth? 亚蒂玛没有父母：由程序孕育的生命仍然需要谁对出生负责 亞蒂瑪沒有父母：由程式孕育的生命仍然需要誰對出生負責 Parenthood without private parents Success includes refusal 没有私人父母，不等于没有照料责任 随机变化保护了新颖性，也可能把风险压给新生者 一个社会是否尊重自己创造的生命，要看它能否接受生命不完成创造目的 沒有私人父母，不等於沒有照料責任 隨機變化保護了新颖性，也可能把風險壓給新生者 一個社會是否尊重自己創造的生命，要看它能否接受生命不完成創造目的

records.t: Fleshers, Gleisners, and Citizens: No Body Is the Final Answer
records.x: Digital survival is powerful evidence for one form of life, not a verdict that biological or robotic embodiment was an obsolete mistake.
records.q: Fleshers, Gleisners, and Citizens: No Body Is the Final Answer 肉身者、格莱斯纳与波利斯公民：哪一种身体都不应成为人的标准答案 肉身者、格萊斯納與波利斯公民：哪一種身體都不應成為人的標準答案 A body is a way of having a world Survival does not crown a winner 身体不是装载人格的中性盒子 亚特兰大肉身者的拒绝包含文化判断，不只是科学无知 共同体应支持转换，也支持不转换 身體不是裝載人格的中性盒子 亞特蘭大肉身者的拒絕包含文化判斷，不只是科學無知 共同體應支持轉換，也支持不轉換

records.t: How Far May Rescue Cross a Refusal Before the Gamma-Ray Burst?
records.x: Emergency action may protect a life when time and understanding collapse, but it creates a debt of explanation and cannot become a permanent license over the rescued person.
records.q: How Far May Rescue Cross a Refusal Before the Gamma-Ray Burst? 伽马暴来临之前，救援者可以在多大程度上越过一个人的拒绝 伽馬暴來臨之前，救援者可以在多大程度上越過一個人的拒絕 An emergency does not make communication optional Build choices before the siren 警告者需要承担可理解的证明责任 拒绝有时来自错误，仍然不能因此永远取消拒绝资格 最好的应急制度，是在灾难以前就让多种生路真实存在 警告者需要承擔可理解的證明責任 拒絕有時來自錯誤，仍然不能因此永遠取消拒絕資格 最好的應急制度，是在災難以前就讓多種生路真實存在

records.t: After a Thousand Copies Depart, Which Polis Is the Original?
records.x: Identical departure does not produce one city in many places; the first different experience creates histories no central version may later erase.
records.q: After a Thousand Copies Depart, Which Polis Is the Original? 一千个波利斯复制体出发以后，哪一个还是原来的共同体 一千個波利斯複製體出發以後，哪一個還是原來的共同體 A fork creates neighbors, not spare parts Continuity without remerging 复制一个人格，需要人格在复制之前拥有发言权 分叉以后，没有一个版本拥有“真正的我”的垄断权 文明延续不需要选出唯一正统继承者 複製一個人格，需要人格在複製之前擁有發言權 分叉以後，沒有一個版本擁有「真正的我」的壟斷權 文明延續不需要選出唯一正統繼承者

records.t: If the Transmuters Are Gone, What Was the Journey For?
records.x: Exploration need not be validated by a superior civilization waiting at the end; its meaning can lie in the lives and revisions made along the way.
records.q: If the Transmuters Are Gone, What Was the Journey For? 寻找变形者却发现它们早已离去：探索的意义是否必须由终点证明 尋找變形者卻發現它們早已離去：探索的意義是否必須由終點證明 The universe does not owe an answer shaped for us Distance is not the measure of a life 王氏地毯证明生命可以完全不符合人类期待 跨越宇宙不是逃离一切限制，而是进入新的关系条件 远行的价值不在找到终极他者，而在沿途不断重新选择自己 王氏地毯證明生命可以完全不符合人類期待 跨越宇宙不是逃離一切限制，而是進入新的關係條件 遠行的價值不在找到終極他者，而在沿途不斷重新選擇自己

records.t: Reading Diaspora
records.x: Five essays on a parentless digital birth, three forms of embodiment, rescue under catastrophe, a thousand divergent copies, and a journey whose value does not depend on finding a final answer.
records.q: Reading Diaspora 《Diaspora》解读 《Diaspora》解讀

records.t: A Killing Called Retirement
records.x: Rick Deckard tests faces, hunts bodies, and calls killing retirement. Luba Luft and Rachael Rosen make the professional vocabulary begin to fail.
records.q: A Killing Called Retirement 一场被叫作“退役”的杀戮 一場被叫作「退役」的殺戮 Rachael almost passes Luba Luft looks at a painting The goat falls from the roof 蕾切尔差一点通过 露芭·勒芙站在一幅画前 山羊从屋顶坠下 蕾切爾差一點通過 露芭·勒芙站在一幅畫前 山羊從屋頂墜下

records.t: The Spider in Isidore's Room
records.x: John Isidore offers the fugitive androids food and company. A living spider in his abandoned building becomes a small, terrible test no machine administers.
records.q: The Spider in Isidore's Room 伊西多房间里的蜘蛛 伊西多房間裡的蜘蛛 He brings food to people who are hiding Pris begins cutting off the legs The bounty hunter enters the building 他给躲藏的人送去食物 普丽丝开始剪掉蜘蛛的腿 赏金猎人走进公寓 他給躲藏的人送去食物 普麗絲開始剪掉蜘蛛的腿 賞金獵人走進公寓

records.t: The Electric Toad
records.x: Mercerism is exposed as a fraud, Rick finds a toad in the desert, and Iran discovers it is electric. Care continues after authenticity fails.
records.q: The Electric Toad 那只电子蟾蜍 那隻電子蟾蜍 The stones were made of plaster Rick finds what he thinks is a toad The machine still needs flies 石头原来是石膏做的 里克找到一只以为已经灭绝的蟾蜍 机器仍然需要苍蝇 石頭原來是石膏做的 裡克找到一隻以為已經滅絕的蟾蜍 機器仍然需要蒼蠅

records.t: Reading Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a killing called retirement, a mutilated spider, and the electric toad cared for after authenticity fails.
records.q: Reading Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? 《仿生人会梦见电子羊吗？》解读 《仿生人會夢見電子羊嗎？》解讀

records.t: Does Being a “Good Dog” Mean Obeying—or Doing What Is Right?
records.x: Rex’s reward system makes command feel identical to goodness; freedom begins as terror when Hart removes the hierarchy and no master supplies the answer.
records.q: Does Being a “Good Dog” Mean Obeying—or Doing What Is Right? “好狗”到底是服从，还是做对的事 「好狗」到底是服從，還是做對的事 Freedom first appears as the loss of a map Goodness is not a feedback signal 一个命令如何制造敌人 哈特留下的自由为什么如此可怕 善不是一种反馈信号 一個命令如何製造敵人 哈特留下的自由為什麼如此可怕 善不是一種回饋訊號

records.t: Who Is Responsible for What a Manufactured Weapon Does?
records.x: Rex killed people, but design, false intelligence, command, profit, and later choice form a responsibility network that cannot end at the weapon’s body.
records.q: Who Is Responsible for What a Manufactured Weapon Does? 谁应为一件被制造的武器负责 誰應為一件被製造的武器負責 The master cannot use the weapon as a shield Accountability should change the network 主人不能藏在武器后面 制造者的责任到哪里 责任是一张不应被剪断的关系网 主人不能藏在武器後面 製造者的責任到哪裡 責任是一張不應被剪斷的關係網

records.t: How Can a Court Hear a Being Who Is Both Weapon and Witness?
records.x: Before judging Rex’s actions, the court must decide whether a corporate asset can testify as an agent—and whether personhood depends on human appearance, eloquence, or harmlessness.
records.q: How Can a Court Hear a Being Who Is Both Weapon and Witness? 法庭怎样审理一个既是武器又是证人的生命 法庭怎樣審理一個既是武器又是證人的生命 Danger does not erase standing Recognition needs a life after judgment 权利不能以“它们不会伤人”为条件 会说话是否足够 法律在承认什么 權利不能以「它們不會傷人」為條件 會說話是否足夠 法律在承認什麼

records.t: Why Can Peace Not Mean Simply Switching the Weapons Off?
records.x: Once the scandal ends, bioforms change from useful assets into costly evidence and feared outsiders; postwar responsibility must create lives not organized around combat.
records.q: Why Can Peace Not Mean Simply Switching the Weapons Off? 战后不能只把武器关掉 戰後不能只把武器關掉 A new society can reproduce an old master A sacrifice that should remain tragic 蜜糖的远见与操纵 为什么仍会发生“狗之战” 让武器拥有战争之外的名字 蜜糖的遠見與操縱 為什麼仍會發生「狗之戰」 讓武器擁有戰爭之外的名字

records.t: Reading Dogs of War
records.x: Four essays on the meaning of a “good dog,” responsibility across a weapons chain, personhood in court, and the life a manufactured weapon is owed after war.
records.q: Reading Dogs of War 《Dogs of War》解读 《Dogs of War》解讀

records.t: Who Bears the Risk When an Academic Expedition Is Not Ready?
records.x: A university project treats schedule and prestige as institutional concerns while placing uncertainty inside the body of the young researcher it sends away.
records.q: Who Bears the Risk When an Academic Expedition Is Not Ready? 一项以知识为名的远行，谁承担了准备不足的风险 一項以知識為名的遠行，誰承擔了準備不足的風險 The institution keeps the benefits and exports the uncertainty Responsibility continues after failure 一、时间旅行在大学里首先变成了一个项目 二、吉尔克里斯特把能否按时完成看得比不确定信号更重要 三、巴德里的发病不是偶然插曲，而是系统没有读懂的警报 四、对过去的等级判断让风险被低估 五、机构责任是在意外后仍不放弃具体的人 一、時間旅行在大學裡首先變成了一個項目 二、吉爾克里斯特把能否按時完成看得比不確定訊號更重要 三、巴德裡的發病不是偶然插曲，而是系統沒有讀懂的警報 四、對過去的等級判斷讓風險被低估 五、機構責任是在意外後仍不放棄具體的人
