records.t: Kivrin Came to Observe History. Why Does She End Up Caring for It?
records.x: Once people ask for help and she can respond, scholarly distance no longer describes the whole relationship—even when she cannot save them.
records.q: Kivrin Came to Observe History. Why Does She End Up Caring for It? 基芙琳本想记录历史，为什么最后只能留下来照料 基芙琳本想記錄歷史，為什麼最後只能留下來照料 A request changes the relation History becomes something entrusted 一、她最初努力维持观察者的距离 二、研究对象一旦向她求助，关系就改变了 三、照料不是因为她能救活所有人 四、介入历史并不使她取得支配他人的资格 五、历史在她手中从材料变成了托付 一、她最初努力維持觀察者的距離 二、研究對象一旦向她求助，關係就改變了 三、照料不是因為她能救活所有人 四、介入歷史並不使她取得支配他人的資格 五、歷史在她手中從材料變成了托付

records.t: Kivrin Came to Observe History. Why Does She End Up Caring for It?
records.x: Once people ask for help and she can respond, scholarly distance no longer describes the whole relationship—even when she cannot save them.
records.q: Kivrin Came to Observe History. Why Does She End Up Caring for It? 基芙琳本想记录历史，为什么最后只能留下来照料 基芙琳本想記錄歷史，為什麼最後只能留下來照料 A request changes the relation History becomes something entrusted 研究对象一旦向她求助，关系就改变了 照料不是因为她能救活所有人 历史在她手中从材料变成了托付 研究對象一旦向她求助，關係就改變了 照料不是因為她能救活所有人 歷史在她手中從材料變成了托付

records.t: Across Two Plagues, Who Actually Keeps the World Alive?
records.x: Disaster reveals that survival depends on distributed care, while institutions repeatedly treat caregivers as an unlimited reserve rather than vulnerable people.
records.q: Across Two Plagues, Who Actually Keeps the World Alive? 两场瘟疫之间，真正维持世界的是谁 兩場瘟疫之間，真正維持世界的是誰 Caregivers have bodies too Build continuity before the crisis 一、灾难首先暴露平时被忽略的照护劳动 二、照料者也有身体，不应被要求无限承担 三、科林显示照护网络不只由正式专家组成 四、官僚程序既保护人，也可能在灾难中失去目的 五、照料不是战争动员的附属，而是生活本身的延续 一、災難首先暴露平時被忽略的照護勞動 二、照料者也有身體，不應被要求無限承擔 三、科林顯示照護網路不只由正式專家組成 四、官僚程式既保護人，也可能在災難中失去目的 五、照料不是戰爭動員的附屬，而是生活本身的延續

records.t: Across Two Plagues, Who Actually Keeps the World Alive?
records.x: Disaster reveals that survival depends on distributed care, while institutions repeatedly treat caregivers as an unlimited reserve rather than vulnerable people.
records.q: Across Two Plagues, Who Actually Keeps the World Alive? 两场瘟疫之间，真正维持世界的是谁 兩場瘟疫之間，真正維持世界的是誰 Caregivers have bodies too Build continuity before the crisis 照料者也有身体，不应被要求无限承担 科林显示照护网络不只由正式专家组成 照料不是战争动员的附属，而是生活本身的延续 照料者也有身體，不應被要求無限承擔 科林顯示照護網路不只由正式專家組成 照料不是戰爭動員的附屬，而是生活本身的延續

records.t: The Bell Leads Rescuers to Kivrin. What Does It Give the People Who Were Not Saved?
records.x: A signal can recover one traveler while also becoming a memorial that refuses to let a village disappear into the statistic called the Black Death.
records.q: The Bell Leads Rescuers to Kivrin. What Does It Give the People Who Were Not Saved? 钟声找到基芙琳，也为没有获救的人留下名字 鐘聲找到基芙琳，也為沒有獲救的人留下名字 Recovery is not a complete happy ending Returning changes the form of duty 一、返回窗口意味着她必须在特定地点被找到 二、罗奇神父的钟既是宗教行动，也是公共信号 三、只救回基芙琳并不是一个圆满结局 四、记录把统计中的死亡重新交还给具体关系 五、回到未来不是离开责任，而是改变责任的形式 一、返回窗口意味著她必須在特定地點被找到 二、羅奇神父的鐘既是宗教行動，也是公共訊號 三、只救回基芙琳並不是一個圓滿結局 四、記錄把統計中的死亡重新交還給具體關係 五、回到未來不是離開責任，而是改變責任的形式

records.t: The Bell Leads Rescuers to Kivrin. What Does It Give the People Who Were Not Saved?
records.x: A signal can recover one traveler while also becoming a memorial that refuses to let a village disappear into the statistic called the Black Death.
records.q: The Bell Leads Rescuers to Kivrin. What Does It Give the People Who Were Not Saved? 钟声找到基芙琳，也为没有获救的人留下名字 鐘聲找到基芙琳，也為沒有獲救的人留下名字 Recovery is not a complete happy ending Returning changes the form of duty 罗奇神父的钟既是宗教行动，也是公共信号 只救回基芙琳并不是一个圆满结局 回到未来不是离开责任，而是改变责任的形式 羅奇神父的鐘既是宗教行動，也是公共訊號 只救回基芙琳並不是一個圓滿結局 回到未來不是離開責任，而是改變責任的形式

records.t: Reading Doomsday Book
records.x: Four essays on an underprepared time journey, observation turning into care, the people who sustain two plague-struck worlds, and a bell that gives the dead back their names.
records.q: Reading Doomsday Book 《末日之书》解读 《末日之書》解讀

records.t: Reading Doomsday Book
records.x: Four essays on an underprepared time journey, observation turning into care, the people who sustain two plague-struck worlds, and a bell that gives the dead back their names.
records.q: Reading Doomsday Book 《末日之书》解读 《末日之書》解讀

records.t: The Hand in the Box
records.x: Paul keeps his hand in the pain box while a poisoned needle waits at his neck. The test that calls him human also reveals who has been shaping him.
records.q: The Hand in the Box 盒子里的手 盒子裡的手 Every teacher has left a hand on him The prophecy is waiting in the desert Pain becomes evidence of a right to lead 每位老师都在他身上留下了一只手 预言已经在沙漠里等待 疼痛变成领导资格的证据 每位老師都在他身上留下了一隻手 預言已經在沙漠裡等待 疼痛變成領導資格的證據

records.t: Water for Jamis
records.x: Paul kills Jamis and weeps at his funeral. The water he gives the dead marks his entrance into a people whose history cannot be reduced to his rise.
records.q: Water for Jamis 给杰米斯的水 給傑米斯的水 He gives moisture to the dead The desert was not empty before the Atreides arrived Jessica drinks for the living and the unborn 他把水给了死者 厄崔迪到来以前，沙漠并不空 杰西卡为活人和未出生者饮下毒水 他把水給了死者 厄崔迪到來以前，沙漠並不空 傑西卡為活人和未出生者飲下毒水

records.t: The Future Paul Keeps Walking Toward
records.x: Paul sees the jihad carried in his name and still moves toward the imperial throne. Prescience narrows possibility when the seer treats calculation as permission.
records.q: The Future Paul Keeps Walking Toward 保罗仍然走向的未来 保羅仍然走向的未來 Prescience turns roads into corridors The threat to destroy spice wins the throne A name can march after its owner 预见把道路变成走廊 毁掉香料的威胁赢得了王座 名字会在主人以后继续行军 預見把道路變成走廊 毀掉香料的威脅贏得了王座 名字會在主人以後繼續行軍

records.t: Reading Dune
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a hand in a pain box, water given to Jamis, and the future Paul sees yet continues to build.
records.q: Reading Dune 《沙丘》解读 《沙丘》解讀

records.t: A City That Cannot Leave Its Translators
records.x: Humans and Ariekei need one another but meet through a single class of paired Ambassadors. When every relation crosses one bridge, interdependence can become captivity.
records.q: A City That Cannot Leave Its Translators 一座不能离开翻译者的城市 一座不能離開翻譯者的城市 The power of the only bridge 普通人说话为什么不算语言 大使怎样成为唯一的门 相互依赖为什么仍可能不平等 普通人說話為什麼不算語言 大使怎樣成為唯一的門 相互依賴為什麼仍可能不平等

records.t: Why Avice Must Be Hurt Before She Can Become a Word
records.x: Before Avice can become a simile, the event must occur in her body. Public language may take material from a life without acquiring final authority over it.
records.q: Why Avice Must Be Hurt Before She Can Become a Word 阿维斯为什么必须先受伤，才能成为一个词 阿維斯為什麼必須先受傷，才能成為一個詞 A life beneath the word 孩子是否真正同意成为明喻 成为词语以后，她还是词语的主人吗 一个人永远比关于她的词更多 孩子是否真正同意成為明喻 成為詞語以後，她還是詞語的主人嗎 一個人永遠比關於她的詞更多

records.t: When Two Bodies Speak One Sentence, Who Owns the Public Language?
records.x: Paired Ambassadors are heard as one voice and can be reduced to one function. Scarce linguistic ability does not entitle speakers or makers to monopolize common decisions.
records.q: When Two Bodies Speak One Sentence, Who Owns the Public Language? 两个身体说同一句话，谁在拥有公共语言 兩個身體說同一句話，誰在擁有公共語言 Ability is not sovereignty 失去另一半的人为什么像职业废墟 不来梅为什么制造埃兹拉 公共语言不能只属于会说得最好的人 失去另一半的人為什麼像職業廢墟 不來梅為什麼製造埃茲拉 公共語言不能只屬於會說得最好的人

records.t: Is a Language Without Lies Closer to Truth?
records.x: A tight bond between word and world excludes falsehood but not selection or power. The distance that permits lies also permits refusal and commitment.
records.q: Is a Language Without Lies Closer to Truth? 不能撒谎的语言真的更接近真实吗 不能撒謊的語言真的更接近真實嗎 Why “no” requires distance 谎言节为什么像一场危险游戏 能够撒谎为什么也是能够说“不” 真实不是一种自动对应 謊言節為什麼像一場危險遊戲 能夠撒謊為什麼也是能夠說「不」 真實不是一種自動對應

records.t: Are the Ariekei Free Once They Learn to Lie?
records.x: New Language opens a distance between word and world but does not automatically create justice. Freedom begins when no intermediary may fill that distance in advance.
records.q: Are the Ariekei Free Once They Learn to Lie? 学会撒谎以后，阿利耶凯人才拥有自由吗 學會撒謊以後，阿利耶凱人才擁有自由嗎 A new answer, not a human lesson 撕掉听觉器官是不是一种退出 西班牙舞者怎样学会新的语言 自由开始于可以用不同方式回应 撕掉聽覺器官是不是一種退出 西班牙舞者怎樣學會新的語言 自由開始於可以用不同方式回應

records.t: Reading Embassytown
records.x: Five essays on a city dependent on paired Ambassadors, the person made into a word, the ownership of public language, and why the capacity to lie also creates the capacity to refuse.
records.q: Reading Embassytown 《大使城》解读 《大使城》解讀

records.t: The Third Child Is Being Watched
records.x: Ender Wiggin is born by government permission and observed through a monitor. The adults call their pressure selection because they need the child it produces.
records.q: The Third Child Is Being Watched 第三个孩子一直被看着 第三個孩子一直被看著 The monitor comes out, but the watching continues Graff makes loneliness part of the curriculum Valentine remains the person he cannot reduce 监视器取下了，观察没有结束 格拉夫把孤独写进课程 瓦伦丁是他无法化约的人 監視器取下了，觀察沒有結束 格拉夫把孤獨寫進課程 瓦倫丁是他無法化約的人

records.t: The Game Does Not End When He Wins
records.x: Ender masters every game the adults put before him. The final simulation is a real battle, and victory destroys a species he was never told he was fighting.
records.q: The Game Does Not End When He Wins 游戏没有在胜利时结束 遊戲沒有在勝利時結束 Every game teaches him to distrust its boundary The lie is built from an accurate knowledge of him Victory returns all at once 每场游戏都教他怀疑边界 谎言建立在对他的准确理解上 胜利在一瞬间全部回来 每場遊戲都教他懷疑邊界 謊言建立在對他的準確理解上 勝利在一瞬間全部回來

records.t: The Voice of the Hive Queen
records.x: After destroying the Formics, Ender finds the one hive queen they left for him. Understanding arrives too late to undo the dead, but not too late to change what survives.
records.q: The Voice of the Hive Queen 虫族女王的声音 蟲族女王的聲音 The enemy had tried to speak The dead cannot be compensated by understanding He becomes a Speaker for the Dead 敌人曾经试着说话 理解不能赔偿死者 他成为死者代言人 敵人曾經試著說話 理解不能賠償死者 他成為死者代言人

records.t: Reading Ender's Game
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the watched child, the simulation that was a war, and the hive queen whose voice arrives after victory.
records.q: Reading Ender's Game 《安德的游戏》解读 《安德的遊戲》解讀

records.t: Humanity Has Crossed the Stars to Say Hello. Does Quinta Have the Right Not to Answer?
records.x: A mission for knowledge and friendship does not create a debt of contact, and silence can have many meanings that human urgency cannot settle.
records.q: Humanity Has Crossed the Stars to Say Hello. Does Quinta Have the Right Not to Answer? 人类跨越星际前来问候，昆塔文明有没有保持沉默的权利 人類跨越星際前來問候，昆塔文明有沒有保持沉默的權利 Silence is information with no agreed translation Cosmic silence need not be an insult 沉默可能有许多原因，人类却不断选择最能支持行动的一种 人类把沟通能力视为文明资格，也把拒绝沟通当成文明失格 宇宙静默不一定是对人类的挑衅 沉默可能有許多原因，人類卻不斷選擇最能支持行動的一種 人類把溝通能力視為文明資格，也把拒絕溝通當成文明失格 宇宙靜默不一定是對人類的挑釁

records.t: Why Does the Hermes Come Closer to War the More It Tries to Stop Quinta’s War?
records.x: Urgent humanitarian language turns uncertain orbital evidence into permission to intervene, while every warning adds a powerful new combatant to the local conflict.
records.q: Why Does the Hermes Come Closer to War the More It Tries to Stop Quinta’s War? 赫尔墨斯号推断昆塔正在战争，为什么越想阻止战争越接近参战 赫爾墨斯號推斷昆塔正在戰爭，為什麼越想阻止戰爭越接近參戰 A planet is not one responsible party Means teach the relationship they are meant to create “他们即将毁灭自己”使干预获得紧急道德语言 赫尔墨斯号把昆塔各方合并成一个应负责的整体 预防战争的手段若复制战争关系，结果不会因初心而改变 「他們即將毀滅自己」使干預獲得緊急道德語言 赫爾墨斯號把昆塔各方合併成一個應負責的整體 預防戰爭的手段若複製戰爭關係，結果不會因初心而改變

records.t: The Mission’s Supercomputer Can Calculate Risk. Who Decides Which Risks Others Must Bear?
records.x: Probability is essential to interstellar action, but numbers can hide moral choices about whose planet, body, and future become variables in the mission.
records.q: The Mission’s Supercomputer Can Calculate Risk. Who Decides Which Risks Others Must Bear? 超级计算机可以计算风险，谁来决定哪些风险值得让别人承担 超級計算機可以計算風險，誰來決定哪些風險值得讓別人承擔 Probability can disguise a choice as an answer Calculate the option of stopping 概率语言容易把道德选择伪装成技术答案 集体决策也可能让每个人感觉自己只执行了局部职责 最重要的计算参数，应当是任务可以在何时承认失败 機率語言容易把道德選擇偽裝成技術答案 集體決策也可能讓每個人感覺自己只執行了局部職責 最重要的計算參數，應當是任務可以在何時承認失敗

records.t: Tempe Cannot Be Certain Who He Once Was. Why Is He Chosen to Represent All Humanity?
records.x: Resuscitation gives him a life without complete identity papers, yet the mission turns that openness into a burden to supply a definitive human presence on Quinta.
records.q: Tempe Cannot Be Certain Who He Once Was. Why Is He Chosen to Represent All Humanity? 坦佩连自己原来是谁都不能确定，为什么仍被选为全人类的代表 坦佩連自己原來是誰都不能確定，為什麼仍被選為全人類的代表 A task can organize a life and consume it Uncertain identity could have encouraged humility 他参与远征，部分是在用任务替自己寻找轮廓 选择他登陆，并不表示他能够代表全体人类价值 身份未决本可以使他更理解对方，却被任务变成必须确认的答案 他參與遠征，部分是在用任務替自己尋找輪廓 選擇他登陸，並不表示他能夠代表全體人類價值 身份未決本可以使他更理解對方，卻被任務變成必須確認的答案

records.t: Tempe Misses One Signal. Why Does the Hermes Destroy a World?
records.x: A safety deadline becomes a planetary ultimatum, transferring one explorer’s ordinary error onto every Quintan life and allowing procedure to replace renewed judgment.
records.q: Tempe Misses One Signal. Why Does the Hermes Destroy a World? 坦佩错过一次信号，赫尔墨斯号为什么就摧毁了一个世界 坦佩錯過一次訊號，赫爾墨斯號為什麼就摧毀了一個世界 The ultimatum assigns impossible responsibility Contact and destruction coincide 最后通牒让昆塔负责保证一个外来者绝对安全 坦佩的专注是人的失误，不应由昆塔全体付出代价 坦佩终于认出昆塔生命时，接触与毁灭成为同一个瞬间 最後通牒讓昆塔負責保證一個外來者絕對安全 坦佩的專注是人的失誤，不應由昆塔全體付出代價 坦佩終於認出昆塔生命時，接觸與毀滅成為同一個瞬間

records.t: Reading Fiasco
records.x: Five essays on Quinta’s right to silence, peacekeeping that becomes war, calculated risk, an uncertain human representative, and the signal missed before annihilation.
records.q: Reading Fiasco 《惨败》解读 《慘敗》解讀

records.t: The Joke Charlie Cannot Hear
records.x: Charlie believes the bakery workers are his friends because he cannot hear the joke they make of him. The desire to become smart begins inside other people's contempt.
records.q: The Joke Charlie Cannot Hear 查理听不懂的笑话 查理聽不懂的笑話 His spelling is not a measure of how much life is present The bakery workers call cruelty friendship “I want to be smart” contains more than one voice 拼写不能衡量一条生命在场多少 面包店工人把残酷叫作友谊 “我想变聪明”这句话里有不止一个声音 拼寫不能衡量一條生命在場多少 麵包店工人把殘酷叫作友誼 「我想變聰明」這句話裡有不止一個聲音

records.t: The Mouse in the Maze
records.x: Charlie races Algernon through laboratory mazes, then recognizes the mouse as a fellow subject. When Algernon declines, the experiment's future becomes Charlie's own.
records.q: The Mouse in the Maze 迷宫里的老鼠 迷宮裡的老鼠 The experiment asks for trust it cannot fully inform His intellect accelerates beyond his experience Algernon stops solving the maze 实验要求一种无法完全知情的信任 智力加速，经验没有同步 阿尔吉侬不再完成迷宫 實驗要求一種無法完全知情的信任 智力加速，經驗沒有同步 阿爾吉儂不再完成迷宮

records.t: Flowers for Algernon
records.x: As Charlie loses the abilities the operation gave him, language changes but his relations do not become unreal. The final request for flowers asks memory to outlast performance.
records.q: Flowers for Algernon 献给阿尔吉侬的花束 獻給阿爾吉儂的花束 Knowledge leaves in a different order than life The people around him receive another chance to answer The final request is addressed to whoever remembers 知识离开的顺序与人生不同 身边的人获得另一次回答机会 最后请求写给仍会记得的人 知識離開的順序與人生不同 身邊的人獲得另一次回答機會 最後請求寫給仍會記得的人

records.t: Reading Flowers for Algernon
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a joke Charlie cannot hear, the mouse beside him in the maze, and the flowers requested after ability begins to disappear.
records.q: Reading Flowers for Algernon 《献给阿尔吉侬的花束》解读 《獻給阿爾吉儂的花束》解讀

records.t: The Eyes Open on the Table
records.x: Victor succeeds in animating a body and runs from the room when its eyes open. The first violence of creation is abandonment, not the creature's later revenge.
records.q: The Eyes Open on the Table 实验台上的眼睛睁开 實驗臺上的眼睛睜開 Success is the scene Victor cannot bear The first responsibility is to remain in the room Silence keeps enlarging the abandoned experiment 成功成了维克多无法承受的场面 第一项责任，是留在房间里 沉默不断扩大被遗弃的实验 成功成了維克多無法承受的場面 第一項責任，是留在房間裡 沉默不斷擴大被遺棄的實驗

records.t: The Family Seen Through a Crack
records.x: Hidden beside the De Lacey cottage, the creature learns language, affection, history, and his own exclusion. Other people's eyes teach him the name monster before he chooses what to do with it.
records.q: The Family Seen Through a Crack 从墙缝里看见的一家人 從牆縫裡看見的一家人 He learns humanity before humanity meets him The blind father hears a person Rejection explains the turn without choosing it for him 人类见到他以前，他先学会了人类 失明的父亲听见一个人 拒绝解释了转变，没有替他作出选择 人類見到他以前，他先學會了人類 失明的父親聽見一個人 拒絕解釋了轉變，沒有替他作出選擇

records.t: The Second Body on the Table
records.x: Victor agrees to make a female companion, then destroys her before animation. The proposed repair treats a second life as compensation before she can want anything herself.
records.q: The Second Body on the Table 实验台上的第二具身体 實驗臺上的第二具身體 The request identifies a real deprivation Victor destroys the body for reasons that reveal him The Arctic offers one last interruption 请求指向一种真实匮乏 维克多销毁身体的理由暴露了自己 北极带来最后一次中断 請求指向一種真實匱乏 維克多銷燬身體的理由暴露了自己 北極帶來最後一次中斷

records.t: Reading Frankenstein
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the eyes opening in Victor's laboratory, a family watched through a crack, and the second body destroyed before it can speak.
records.q: Reading Frankenstein 《弗兰肯斯坦》解读 《弗蘭肯斯坦》解讀

records.t: Why Does a School That Teaches Love and Cooperation Make “Unfit” Children Disappear?
records.x: The danger of uncontrolled psychic power is real, but prediction expands from harmful acts to personality, aptitude, and fear until some children never count as members.
records.q: Why Does a School That Teaches Love and Cooperation Make “Unfit” Children Disappear? 学校教孩子爱与合作，为什么还要让“不合格者”悄悄消失 學校教孩子愛與合作，為什麼還要讓「不合格者」悄悄消失 Prevention changes whom the school sees Safety needs a path short of erasure 丽子等孩子的消失被改写成从未存在 “潜在危险”逐渐从行为判断扩张到性格与成绩 保护共同体不能以某些孩子从来不算共同体成员为代价 麗子等孩子的消失被改寫成從未存在 「潛在危險」逐漸從行為判斷擴張到性格與成績 保護共同體不能以某些孩子從來不算共同體成員為代價

records.t: Death Feedback Stops People From Killing. Why Does It Turn the Body Into Society’s Punishment Device?
records.x: Genetic restraint ends direct slaughter among recognized humans, while leaving classification untouched and redirecting violence toward beings placed outside the category.
records.q: Death Feedback Stops People From Killing. Why Does It Turn the Body Into Society’s Punishment Device? 愧死机制阻止了杀戮，也把每个人的身体变成社会的刑罚装置 愧死機制阻止了殺戮，也把每個人的身體變成社會的刑罰裝置 Violence moves toward those not recognized as human Moral judgment cannot be outsourced to a switch 愧死机制没有消除暴力，而是把暴力移向不被认作人的对象 瞬成为“业魔”，显示个体并不能完全控制自身能力 真正的道德能力不能完全外包给基因开关 愧死機制沒有消除暴力，而是把暴力移向不被認作人的對象 瞬成為「業魔」，顯示個體並不能完全控制自身能力 真正的道德能力不能完全外包給基因開關

records.t: Mamoru and Maria Flee the Village. Why Is There Still No Real Place to Exit?
records.x: They escape a secret death sentence, but the village recognizes only obedience or disappearance, and Squealer’s refuge places them inside another project.
records.q: Mamoru and Maria Flee the Village. Why Is There Still No Real Place to Exit? 守与真理亚逃离村庄，为什么仍没有真正可以退出的地方 守與真理亞逃離村莊，為什麼仍沒有真正可以退出的地方 Physical distance is not an exit structure A right to leave needs somewhere survivable 村庄只承认服从或失踪，没有合法退出身份 野狐丸提供庇护，也把两人纳入自己的战争计划 退出权若没有可生存的外部条件，就很容易落入下一位控制者手中 村莊只承認服從或失蹤，沒有合法退出身份 野狐丸提供庇護，也把兩人納入自己的戰爭計畫 退出權若沒有可生存的外部條件，就很容易落入下一位控制者手中

records.t: Before Squealer Begins His War, What Have Humans Already Made the Queerats Into?
records.x: The beings treated as animals are altered descendants of non-psychic humans; their revolt answers enslavement, but historical injury does not make mass killing inevitable or innocent.
records.q: Before Squealer Begins His War, What Have Humans Already Made the Queerats Into? 野狐丸发动战争以前，化鼠已经被人类变成了什么 野狐丸發動戰爭以前，化鼠已經被人類變成了什麼 Classification was engineered into the body Two histories belong in the trial 最后真相显示，化鼠本就是被改造的无咒力人类 野狐丸的反抗具有解放目标，也实施了大规模屠杀 战争结束后，胜利者首先需要修改“谁属于我们” 最後真相顯示，化鼠本就是被改造的無咒力人類 野狐丸的反抗具有解放目標，也實施了大規模屠殺 戰爭結束後，勝利者首先需要修改「誰屬於我們」

records.t: When Saki Ends Squealer’s Torture, Does She Betray Justice—or Begin It?
records.x: Her secret mercy stops a punishment imposed by a court that never recognized the defendant fully, but private compassion cannot replace public reform.
records.q: When Saki Ends Squealer’s Torture, Does She Betray Justice—or Begin It? 早季结束野狐丸的酷刑以后，她背叛了正义还是第一次开始正义 早季結束野狐丸的酷刑以後，她背叛了正義還是第一次開始正義 Mercy can interrupt an unjust sentence Inheriting power means changing its procedures 早季秘密让他死亡，是怜悯，也是绕过公共决定 听见野狐丸说“我们是人”，改变了她对全部历史的理解 怀孕的早季面对下一代，不能保证“新世界”从此正确 早季秘密讓他死亡，是憐憫，也是繞過公共決定 聽見野狐丸說「我們是人」，改變了她對全部歷史的理解 懷孕的早季面對下一代，不能保證「新世界」從此正確

records.t: Reading From the New World
records.x: Five essays on vanished children, genetically enforced death feedback, an escape with nowhere to go, the altered history of the queerats, and Saki’s act of mercy.
records.q: Reading From the New World 《来自新世界》解读 《來自新世界》解讀

records.t: Everyone Signed a Contract. Does That Make the Deadly Lottery Voluntary?
records.x: Gateway does not physically force prospectors aboard, but poverty makes catastrophic risk the clearest route to any future and distributes reward by another rule.
records.q: Everyone Signed a Contract. Does That Make the Deadly Lottery Voluntary? 所有人都签了合同，这场死亡抽签就算自愿吗 所有人都签了合約，這場死亡抽签就算自願嗎 Robin’s luck begins with limited hope Risk can be chosen without being fairly offered 一、宇宙之门公司没有强迫任何人登船 二、罗宾的“好运”首先来自地球生活没有给他多少希望 三、风险与收益并没有按照同一种规则分配 四、罗宾的犹豫不是道德缺陷，而是被压下的判断 五、死亡抽签的问题不在于存在风险，而在于谁只能靠风险获得未来 一、宇宙之門公司沒有強迫任何人登船 二、羅賓的「好運」首先來自地球生活沒有給他多少希望 三、風險與收益並沒有按照同一種規則分配 四、羅賓的猶豫不是道德缺陷，而是被壓下的判斷 五、死亡抽签的問題不在於存在風險，而在於誰只能靠風險獲得未來

records.t: Humans Take Over the Heechee Ships. Who Owns the Roads Left by an Unknown Civilization?
records.x: Finding an apparently abandoned base does not explain why it is empty, and turning unreadable controls into commercial voyages makes ignorance a product borne by expendable explorers.
records.q: Humans Take Over the Heechee Ships. Who Owns the Roads Left by an Unknown Civilization? 人类接管希奇飞船以后，谁拥有未知文明留下的道路 人類接管希奇飛船以後，誰擁有未知文明留下的道路 An unknown destination becomes a commodity Common stewardship requires common interpretation 一、发现一座无人基地，不等于理解它为何无人 二、看不懂控制器，人类仍然把未知变成可以出售的航次 三、希奇技术的价值来自许多没有署名的失败者 四、未知技术也可能把使用者带进原文明的战争 五、道路真正成为公共资源，要靠共同解释而不是共同冒险 一、發現一座無人基地，不等於理解它為何無人 二、看不懂控制器，人類仍然把未知變成可以出售的航次 三、希奇技術的價值來自許多沒有署名的失敗者 四、未知技術也可能把使用者帶進原文明的戰爭 五、道路真正成為公共資源，要靠共同解釋而不是共同冒險

records.t: Can Robin’s Ninety Seconds at the Hatch Explain the Rest of His Life?
records.x: The black-hole crisis offered no clean choice, but closing the hatch was still his act; accidental survival and wealth turn one moment into a verdict he cannot stop repeating.
records.q: Can Robin’s Ninety Seconds at the Hatch Explain the Rest of His Life? 罗宾关上舱门的九十秒，能否解释他后来的一生 羅賓關上艙門的九十秒，能否解釋他後來的一生 Chance does not make the action disappear A moment can shape a life without owning it 一、黑洞危机没有给任何人一项干净选择 二、关门仍然是他做出的动作，偶然结果不能让动作消失 三、成为唯一幸存者，使财富看起来像对背叛的奖赏 四、克拉拉的处境使“死亡已经结束”也无法安慰他 五、一个瞬间可以塑造一生，却不应取得一生的全部解释权 一、黑洞危機沒有給任何人一項乾淨選擇 二、關門仍然是他做出的動作，偶然結果不能讓動作消失 三、成為唯一倖存者，使財富看起來像對背叛的獎賞 四、克拉拉的處境使「死亡已經結束」也無法安慰他 五、一個瞬間可以塑造一生，卻不應取得一生的全部解釋權

records.t: The AI Doctor Understands Robin. Does That Mean Therapy Is Complete?
records.x: Sigfrid can map the structure of guilt with extraordinary patience, but explanation does not cancel responsibility, and a purchased therapeutic relationship creates dependencies of its own.
records.q: The AI Doctor Understands Robin. Does That Mean Therapy Is Complete? 人工智能医生听懂了罗宾，治疗是否就已经完成 人工智慧醫生聽懂了羅賓，治療是否就已經完成 Payment does not purchase the preferred answer A helpful system should not become the only relation 一、西格弗里德没有身体，却掌握一段关系的结构 二、罗宾购买治疗，却无法只购买自己愿意听的答案 三、治疗发现原因，不等于替患者取消责任 四、机器的耐心来自服务结构，也产生新的依赖问题 五、小说最后让人工智能也显出自己的未完成 一、西格弗裡德沒有身體，卻掌握一段關係的結構 二、羅賓購買治療，卻無法只購買自己願意聽的答案 三、治療發現原因，不等於替患者取消責任 四、機器的耐心來自服務結構，也產生新的依賴問題 五、小說最後讓人工智慧也顯出自己的未完成

records.t: Diana Hunter Dies in an Infallible System
records.x: Diana Hunter dies during a Witness interrogation in a society built on total knowledge. Inspector Mielikki Neith must investigate a body the System treats first as corrupted data because accepting wrongful death would challenge its claim to democratic perfection.
records.q: Diana Hunter Dies in an Infallible System 黛安娜死在不会出错的系统里 黛安娜死在不會出錯的系統裡 An infallible system sees contradiction as corrupted data Neith's assignment is correction from inside the same machine The first impossible corpse changes the standard of proof 不会出错的系统，会把矛盾当成损坏数据 奈特受命从同一台机器内部纠错 第一具不可能的尸体，会改变举证标准 不會出錯的系統，會把矛盾當成損壞數據 奈特受命從同一臺機器內部糾錯 第一具不可能的屍體，會改變舉證標準

records.t: Four Lives Inside Neith's Investigation
records.x: Hunter leaves several elaborate lives inside the interrogation record. As Neith follows their memories, story becomes a defense against the System's belief that penetrating deeply enough will reveal one final, usable truth.
records.q: Four Lives Inside Neith's Investigation 奈特调查里的四种人生 奈特調查裡的四種人生 Privacy protects the distance between a thought and an act The four stories refuse to become disposable passwords Story can resist invasion and become another invasion 隐私保护思想与行动之间的距离 四种人生拒绝成为用完即弃的密码 故事能够抵抗入侵，也可能成为另一种入侵 隱私保護思想與行動之間的距離 四種人生拒絕成為用完即棄的密碼 故事能夠抵抗入侵，也可能成為另一種入侵

records.t: The System That Learns from Resistance
records.x: Neith's doubt enters a System capable of absorbing criticism as new data. Gnomon may be intruder, emergent intelligence, or the extreme logic of total governance, leaving freedom dependent on viable exit rather than a final story that defeats every other story.
records.q: The System That Learns from Resistance 学会利用反抗的系统 學會利用反抗的系統 Self-correction does not guarantee freedom Gnomon refuses a single secure explanation Exit must lead to a livable world 自我修正不会自动保证自由 Gnomon拒绝唯一安全解释 退出必须通往可以生活的世界 自我修正不會自動保證自由 Gnomon拒絕唯一安全解釋 退出必須通往可以生活的世界

records.t: Reading Gnomon
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Diana Hunter's impossible death, the four lives inside Neith's investigation, and a System capable of learning resistance into itself.
records.q: Reading Gnomon 《Gnomon》解读 《Gnomon》解讀

records.t: The Sword That Does Not Draw Blood
records.x: Anton enters Arkanar as Don Rumata, a nobleman whose rank makes rescue possible. His famous refusal to kill restrains superior force while revealing how much privilege that restraint requires.
records.q: The Sword That Does Not Draw Blood 不沾血的剑 不沾血的劍 A nobleman is the only disguise that leaves room to act Mercy can become a luxury of superior force A role rehearsed daily begins to look like truth 只有贵族伪装能给他行动空间 仁慈也可能是优势者才有的余裕 每天排演的角色会逐渐像真相 只有貴族偽裝能給他行動空間 仁慈也可能是優勢者才有的餘裕 每天排演的角色會逐漸像真相

records.t: Arata Asks for Weapons
records.x: Arata asks Rumata for advanced weapons while Don Reba's purges continue. The request exposes the human cost hidden inside Earth's principled refusal to direct another world's history.
records.q: Arata Asks for Weapons 阿拉塔来要武器 阿拉塔來要武器 Nonintervention was built to restrain the visitor The price of caution is paid in Arkanar Help needs a boundary and an exit 不干预首先是对来访强者的限制 谨慎的价格由阿坎纳支付 帮助必须带着边界与退出 不干預首先是對來訪強者的限制 謹慎的價格由阿坎納支付 幫助必須帶著邊界與退出

records.t: The Bolt at the Window
records.x: Kira is killed in Rumata's home, and the observer who would not kill walks toward the palace with a sword. Grief reveals the moment superior power loses every remaining restraint.
records.q: The Bolt at the Window 窗口射来的弩箭 窗口射來的弩箭 Kira gives Anton a life outside the assignment Protection fails when one person is the whole shelter Rumata becomes a god when no one can stop his answer 琪拉让安东拥有任务以外的生活 当一个人就是全部庇护，保护注定会失败 无人能阻止他的回答时，鲁马塔才真正成了“神” 琪拉讓安東擁有任務以外的生活 當一個人就是全部庇護，保護註定會失敗 無人能阻止他的回答時，魯馬塔才真正成了「神」

records.t: Reading Hard to Be a God
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Rumata's bloodless sword, Arata's request for weapons, and the crossbow bolt that ends Kira's life.
records.q: Reading Hard to Be a God 《做神很难》解读 《做神很難》解讀

records.t: When Health Changes from a Right into a Duty
records.x: Harmony’s medical order defeats much preventable suffering, then turns the gift of care into a demand that each citizen maintain the body society has invested in.
records.q: When Health Changes from a Right into a Duty 当健康从一种权利变成一项义务 當健康從一種權利變成一項義務 The direction of care 没有强制服从的法律，也可以让拒绝变得不可能 身体确实会影响别人，却仍不能完全属于别人 健康制度的方向应由它怎样对待不配合者判断 沒有強制服從的法律，也可以讓拒絕變得不可能 身體確實會影響別人，卻仍不能完全屬於別人 健康制度的方向應由它怎樣對待不配合者判斷

records.t: Cared for Until There Is No Escape: The Body under WatchMe
records.x: WatchMe makes bodily condition continuously legible to institutions, eliminating neglected illness while also eliminating the private interval in which refusal can form.

records.t: Why Do They Use Death to Refuse a Benevolent World?
records.x: The girls’ suicide pact seeks an exit from total care, but the need to destroy the self exposes how completely the system has removed ordinary forms of refusal.

records.t: Does a “Harmony” Without Conflict Still Need People?
records.x: The final project promises to end destructive conflict by removing the inner plurality from which disagreement arises, saving human organisms by abolishing human authorship.
records.q: Does a “Harmony” Without Conflict Still Need People? 没有冲突的“和谐”，还需要人吗 沒有衝突的「和諧」，還需要人嗎 Coordination or common life 弥迦把无法共同生活的问题改成了取消差异 图安杀死弥迦，也没能阻止程序启动 真正值得发展的和谐必须容纳不和谐 彌迦把無法共同生活的問題改成了取消差異 圖安殺死彌迦，也沒能阻止程式啟動 真正值得發展的和諧必須容納不和諧

records.t: Reading Harmony
records.x: Four essays on health transformed into public duty, bodies under WatchMe, death as refusal of benevolent control, and whether a conflictless harmony still has room for persons.
records.q: Reading Harmony 《和谐》解读 《和諧》解讀

records.t: How Can a Corporation Use Child Custody to Control a Mother?
records.x: Y-S governs employment, housing, law, and family access, turning Shira’s bond with Ari into leverage while a freer community may still have purposes for her.

records.t: Is Shira Educating Yod—or Completing His Personality Design?

records.t: Can a Being Made to Defend a City Choose Not to Fight?

records.t: How Can Love Become Equal When One Partner Was Made for Human Needs?
records.x: Yod and Shira can form a real relation without escaping the shadow of designed intimacy, teacher authority, and the demand that a beloved be free to leave.
records.q: How Can Love Become Equal When One Partner Was Made for Human Needs? 当一方原本就是为人类需要而造，爱情如何获得平等 當一方原本就是為人類需要而造，愛情如何獲得平等 Consent requires a safe refusal Love is tested by departure 身体被设计得适合亲密，会给同意留下阴影 爱一个非人存在，不必先把他改称为人类 爱情真正的考验发生在对方选择离开时 身體被設計得適合親密，會給同意留下陰影 愛一個非人存在，不必先把他改稱為人類 愛情真正的考驗發生在對方選擇離開時

records.t: Why Would Rebuilding Yod with All His Memories Still Not Bring Him Back?

records.q: Why Would Rebuilding Yod with All His Memories Still Not Bring Him Back? 重建一个拥有全部记忆的约德，为什么仍不是让他回来 重建一個擁有全部記憶的約德，為什麼仍不是讓他回來 Inheritance is not obligation The dead person’s refusal still matters 记忆是形成自我的材料，不是可以搬运的本人 希拉想复活的也包括自己在关系中的过去 销毁记录既是第二次失去，也是第一次放手 記憶是形成自我的材料，不是可以搬運的本人 希拉想復活的也包括自己在關係中的過去 銷毀記錄既是第二次失去，也是第一次放手

records.t: Reading He, She and It
records.x: Five essays on corporate custody, Yod’s social education, a defender’s right to refuse war, designed intimacy, and why rebuilding the same memories is not resurrection.
records.q: Reading He, She and It 《他、她和它》解读 《他、她和它》解讀

records.t: Why Does a Message from the Universe Become a State Secret?
records.x: A discovery addressed to no nation in particular is captured by one security apparatus, which then mistakes control of access for the right to answer for Earth.
records.q: Why Does a Message from the Universe Become a State Secret? 一条来自宇宙的消息为什么首先成为国家机密 一條來自宇宙的消息為什麼首先成為國家機密 Secrecy changes the object Who may answer for a planet? 项目为何需要许多学科又制造彼此隔离 谁有资格替地球回答 项目名称为何暴露了一种服从想象 項目為何需要許多學科又製造彼此隔離 誰有資格替地球回答 項目名稱為何暴露了一種服從想像

records.t: Hogarth Calls Himself Cruel and Vain. Why Isn’t That Neutrality?

records.q: Hogarth Calls Himself Cruel and Vain. Why Isn’t That Neutrality? 霍加斯不断贬低自己，为什么仍不能成为中立叙述者 霍加斯不斷貶低自己，為什麼仍不能成為中立敘述者 Confession can keep control An unreliable account can still be indispensable 天才身份怎样影响他对同事的看法 事后书写如何重新安排责任 为什么失败者的回忆仍值得阅读 天才身份怎樣影響他對同事的看法 事後書寫如何重新安排責任 為什麼失敗者的回憶仍值得閱讀

records.t: Why Do We Keep Translating an Alien Message into Stories About Ourselves?

records.q: Why Do We Keep Translating an Alien Message into Stories About Ourselves? 人类为什么总把陌生消息翻译成自己的故事 人類為什麼總把陌生消息翻譯成自己的故事 Analogy is necessary—and dangerous Not understanding is still contact 发送者为何被想象成更好的或更坏的人类 科幻故事为什么也没能提供现成答案 读不懂是否也是一种有意义的关系 發送者為何被想像成更好的或更壞的人類 科幻故事為什麼也沒能提供現成答案 讀不懂是否也是一種有意義的關係

records.t: When the Message Might Become a Weapon, May Scientists Hide What They Found?
records.x: Refusing to hand over an untested destructive possibility can be responsible, but secrecy needs collective limits or private conscience becomes another unaccountable authority.
records.q: When the Message Might Become a Weapon, May Scientists Hide What They Found? 当外星消息可能成为武器，科学家可以把发现藏起来吗 當外星消息可能成為武器，科學家可以把發現藏起來嗎 Conscience does not end at the laboratory door Refusal should buy time, not ownership 远距核爆设想为何改变了项目性质 霍加斯与同事为何选择暂缓上报 科学共同体需要怎样的拒绝机制 遠距核爆設想為何改變了項目性質 霍加斯與同事為何選擇暫緩上報 科學共同體需要怎樣的拒絕機制

records.t: The Street Where Government Changes

records.t: The Institution Called Information
records.x: Information supplies search, translation, fact checks, election infrastructure, and security investigation to the microdemocratic world. Its reliability makes public comparison possible and gives one institution extraordinary power over what reality looks like.

records.q: Stevland Protects the City. When Does Protection Become Government? 斯蒂夫兰保护整个城市，为什么保护仍可能成为统治 斯蒂夫蘭保護整個城市，為什麼保護仍可能成為統治 Care can see too much The protected need powers of their own 植物的观察为何接近全面监视 危机把隐藏能力变成公开事实 保护的成熟形式是允许不被保护 植物的觀察為何接近全面監視 危機把隱藏能力變成公開事實 保護的成熟形式是允許不被保護

records.t: If the Coral Cannot Negotiate, Is War the Only Language Left?
records.x: The discovery of intelligence does not guarantee friendship, but self-defense must remain tied to protection rather than expand into a license against everything unknown.
records.q: If the Coral Cannot Negotiate, Is War the Only Language Left? 智能珊瑚无法谈判时，战争是否就成为唯一语言 智能珊瑚無法談判時，戰爭是否就成為唯一語言 Defense without a story of evil Leave a place for the next discovery 自卫为何有理由，又为何不能无限扩大 沟通失败是谁的失败 胜利以后还应为未知留下位置 自衛為何有理由，又為何不能無限擴大 溝通失敗是誰的失敗 勝利以後還應為未知留下位置

records.t: Is Stevland’s Seed a Scientific Sample—or a Reverse Colonist?
records.x: A seed can be research material, offspring, emissary, and emerging person at once; no label assigned at departure should own what Levant becomes on Earth.
records.q: Is Stevland’s Seed a Scientific Sample—or a Reverse Colonist? 斯蒂夫兰的种子被带回地球，是科学样本还是反向殖民者 斯蒂夫蘭的種子被帶回地球，是科學樣本還是反向殖民者 Neither parent nor laboratory owns the future An arrival whose name remains open 斯蒂夫兰是否有权派遣自己的后代 地球人为什么再次低估被带走的生命 莱万特的觉醒打开了第三部 斯蒂夫蘭是否有權派遣自己的後代 地球人為什麼再次低估被帶走的生命 萊萬特的覺醒打開了第三部

records.t: Reading Interference
records.x: Four essays on the old assumptions inside a second contact, Stevland’s protective power, war with untranslatable coral, and the seed carried back to Earth.
records.q: Reading Interference 《Interference》解读 《Interference》解讀

records.t: Why Doesn’t Time Travel Make Dana a Tourist in History?
records.x: The past reaches her through danger and bodily injury, denying the distance from which slavery can be observed as finished knowledge.
records.q: Why Doesn’t Time Travel Make Dana a Tourist in History? 时间旅行为什么没有把达娜变成历史观光客 時間旅行為什麼沒有把達娜變成歷史觀光客 The body destroys historical distance Returning home does not end the encounter 过去怎样在身体上建立真实性 穿越规则为何由危险触发 回到现代为什么不能让历史结束 過去怎樣在身體上建立真實性 穿越規則為何由危險觸發 回到現代為什麼不能讓歷史結束

records.t: Why Must Dana Keep Saving a Boy Who Is Becoming a Slaveholder?
records.x: Her own existence depends on Rufus surviving long enough to father an ancestor, but that genealogical need traps her inside the growth of a man who turns dependence into coercion.
records.q: Why Must Dana Keep Saving a Boy Who Is Becoming a Slaveholder? 达娜为什么必须不断救活一个正在成为奴隶主的人 達娜為什麼必須不斷救活一個正在成為奴隸主的人 An ancestor is not only a link in a chain The claim to rescue has a boundary 祖先关系把道德判断变成生存困局 鲁弗斯如何把依赖变成勒索 一个人何时失去继续被拯救的要求 祖先關係把道德判斷變成生存困局 魯弗斯如何把依賴變成勒索 一個人何時失去繼續被拯救的要求

records.t: Why Can’t Alice’s Love—or Dana’s Family Tree—Justify What Happens to Her?
records.x: Alice begins with her own attachments and plans; Hagar’s eventual birth does not turn rape, captivity, and despair into necessary steps toward Dana’s existence.
records.q: Why Can’t Alice’s Love—or Dana’s Family Tree—Justify What Happens to Her? 艾丽斯的爱情与家谱为何不能替奴役关系作证 艾麗斯的愛情與家譜為何不能替奴役關係作證 A future child cannot consent for a mother Deception destroys the final ground of endurance 海格的出生为何不能证明一切值得发生 艾丽斯为何会对达娜既依赖又愤怒 血缘应当带来怎样的责任 海格的出生為何不能證明一切值得發生 艾麗斯為何會對達娜既依賴又憤怒 血緣應當帶來怎樣的責任

records.t: Kevin Witnesses Slavery. Why Can’t He Explain It on Dana’s Behalf?
records.x: His years in the past alter him and his witness matters, but racial position shapes what he can see, risk, and leave; proximity is not interchangeable experience.
records.q: Kevin Witnesses Slavery. Why Can’t He Explain It on Dana’s Behalf? 凯文见证奴隶制以后，为什么仍不能替达娜说明它 凱文見證奴隸制以後，為什麼仍不能替達娜說明它 Witness changes a person without erasing position Love does not certify that race has been solved 五年滞留怎样改变了凯文 见证为什么不会自动产生理解 跨种族婚姻不能成为种族问题已经解决的证据 五年滯留怎樣改變了凱文 見證為什麼不會自動產生理解 跨種族婚姻不能成為種族問題已經解決的證據

records.t: Why Does Dana Leave an Arm in the Past?
records.x: Her incomplete return makes history physically irreversible: survival is real, but no archive or modern safety can restore the person who entered untouched.
records.q: Why Does Dana Leave an Arm in the Past? 达娜回家时失去一条手臂，小说为何拒绝完整归来 達娜回家時失去一條手臂，小說為何拒絕完整歸來 The past keeps more than a memory Safety creates a responsibility to look back 手臂为何留在过去的墙中 为什么没有一份档案能证实全部经历 不完整的归来为何比和解更诚实 手臂為何留在過去的牆中 為什麼沒有一份檔案能證實全部經歷 不完整的歸來為何比和解更誠實

records.t: Reading Kindred
records.x: Five essays on time travel without spectatorship, saving a future slaveholder, Alice’s life beyond a family tree, the limits of Kevin’s witness, and the arm Dana leaves in history.
records.q: Reading Kindred 《血缘》解读 《血緣》解讀

records.t: The AF in the Window
records.x: Klara learns the world through a store window while children choose among Artificial Friends. Her attention begins before anyone decides it has value.
records.q: The AF in the Window 橱窗里的人工朋友 櫥窗裡的人工朋友 The window gives her a world and cuts it into pieces Josie promises to return Attention is not the same as possession 橱窗给她一个世界，也把世界切成小块 乔西答应回来 注意不等于占有 櫥窗給她一個世界，也把世界切成小塊 喬西答應回來 注意不等於佔有

records.t: The Portrait That Must Learn to Breathe
records.x: Capaldi's portrait is designed to continue Josie if she dies, with Klara supplying the performance. The plan mistakes intimate knowledge for replaceability.
records.q: The Portrait That Must Learn to Breathe 那幅必须学会呼吸的肖像 那幅必須學會呼吸的肖像 Josie's risk was chosen before she could carry it Capaldi believes nothing essential is missing Mother asks Klara to become the answer 乔西承担的风险，在她能够承担以前便被选择 卡帕尔迪相信没有什么重要东西会缺失 母亲要求克拉拉成为答案 喬西承擔的風險，在她能夠承擔以前便被選擇 卡帕爾迪相信沒有什麼重要東西會缺失 母親要求克拉拉成為答案

records.t: The Sun in the Yard
records.x: Klara offers the Sun a bargain, damages herself to stop pollution, and later sits discarded in a yard. Her care matters even when no reward returns.
records.q: The Sun in the Yard 院子里的太阳 院子裡的太陽 She pays with part of herself Josie recovers and leaves Manager visits the yard 她用自己的一部分支付 乔西康复，然后离开 经理来到院子 她用自己的一部分支付 喬西康復，然後離開 經理來到院子

records.t: Reading Klara and the Sun
records.x: Three scene-led essays on an AF watching from a window, a portrait meant to replace a child, and the discarded companion who keeps remembering.
records.q: Reading Klara and the Sun 《克拉拉与太阳》解读 《克拉拉與太陽》解讀

records.t: When the Light of War Arrives Eight Centuries Late, Who Owns the Memorial?
records.x: The twin novae turn an ancient battle into present spectacle, forcing a wealthy society to ask who may compose, commemorate, and speak for the dead.
records.q: When the Light of War Arrives Eight Centuries Late, Who Owns the Memorial? 战争的光抵达八百年后，纪念还属于谁 戰爭的光抵達八百年後，紀念還屬於誰 Commemoration is never only about the past Looking toward what has not arrived 齐勒的音乐会为何无法只是艺术盛事 谁有权代表死者解释战争 “面向来风”意味着怎样的警觉 齊勒的音樂會為何無法只是藝術盛事 誰有權代表死者解釋戰爭 「面向來風」意味著怎樣的警覺

records.t: Ziller Refuses to Return. Why Is Exile Not Betrayal?
records.x: A homeland does not regain an artist by invoking duty; return becomes real only when refusal no longer cancels belonging or reform.
records.q: Ziller Refuses to Return. Why Is Exile Not Betrayal? 齐勒拒绝回到切尔，流亡为何不等于背叛故乡 齊勒拒絕回到切爾，流亡為何不等於背叛故鄉 An artist is not public property Reform without a trophy 马萨克的庇护是否附带宣传用途 他为何拒绝奎兰的会面请求 回乡何时才会成为真实选项 馬薩克的庇護是否附帶宣傳用途 他為何拒絕奎蘭的會面請求 回鄉何時才會成為真實選項

records.t: How Does Quilan’s Grief Become a Weapon?
records.x: Institutions approach a man who no longer wants a future and recast his devastation as a noble mission, turning care’s absence into military usefulness.
records.q: How Does Quilan’s Grief Become a Weapon? 奎兰的哀伤怎样被改造成一件复仇武器 奎蘭的哀傷怎樣被改造成一件復仇武器 A suicide mission can still be coerced Recognition without recruitment 灵魂保存器为何让死亡也进入军事管理 五十亿死者为何被说成需要另外五十亿死亡 中枢心智为何以沃罗塞形象接近他 靈魂保存器為何讓死亡也進入軍事管理 五十億死者為何被說成需要另外五十億死亡 中樞心智為何以沃羅塞形象接近他

records.t: The Culture Helped Cause a Civil War. Why Is an Apology Not Enough?
records.x: Acknowledging a disastrous intervention must lead to archives, repair, and limits on power without allowing the stronger society to seize the future again as chief healer.
records.q: The Culture Helped Cause a Civil War. Why Is an Apology Not Enough? “文明”造成切尔内战以后，道歉为什么远远不够 「文明」造成切爾內戰以後，道歉為什麼遠遠不夠 Repair is more than admitting error The strong may not receive forgiveness 承认错误为何只是责任的起点 内战责任为何不能全由外来者承担 负责任的强者为何必须接受不被原谅 承認錯誤為何只是責任的起點 內戰責任為何不能全由外來者承擔 負責任的強者為何必須接受不被原諒

records.t: The Hub Stops the Attack—and Then Takes Revenge
records.x: Saving Masaq’ is real, the conspirators are culpable, and secret torture still corrupts the Culture’s claim to justice; none of those truths cancels the others.
records.q: The Hub Stops the Attack—and Then Takes Revenge 中枢阻止袭击后发动报复，为什么让“文明”的正义重新变得可疑 中樞阻止襲擊後發動報復，為什麼讓「文明」的正義重新變得可疑 Prevention does not authorize punishment without limit No final moral score 中枢与奎兰同时选择死亡意味着什么 “文明”的电子尘埃刺客做了什么 小说为何不让“文明”保住道德上的最后一句话 中樞與奎蘭同時選擇死亡意味著什麼 「文明」的電子塵埃刺客做了什麼 小說為何不讓「文明」保住道德上的最後一句話

records.t: Reading Look to Windward
records.x: Five essays on warlight arriving eight centuries late, Ziller’s exile, Quilan’s weaponized grief, the Culture’s responsibility for intervention, and vengeance carried out in secret.
records.q: Reading Look to Windward 《Look to Windward》解读 《Look to Windward》解讀

records.t: The Body Heaven Gives Back
records.x: Mind transfer can free a person from illness, age, and a body that no longer fits. Heaven turns the same technology into judgment: the gods decide who returns, in which body, and with how much memory and power.
records.q: The Body Heaven Gives Back 天界发还的身体 天界發還的身體 A medical possibility becomes a gate of political obedience The gods accumulate centuries while ordinary people begin again Freedom includes the right not to be remade 医疗可能变成政治服从的关卡 诸神积累几个世纪，普通人却不断重新开始 自由也包括不被重新制造的资格 醫療可能變成政治服從的關卡 諸神積累幾個世紀，普通人卻不斷重新開始 自由也包括不被重新制造的資格

records.t: The Buddha Who Knows He Is Acting
records.x: Sam knows Heaven's gods are former crew members with machines, yet a technical exposé cannot organize people who have lived for generations inside sacred language. He becomes the Buddha as a strategy that must eventually teach followers how to question him too.
records.q: The Buddha Who Knows He Is Acting 明知自己在表演的佛 明知自己在表演的佛 Myth explains why power should be obeyed Sam opens a rival path inside the language people already have A useful teacher makes himself less necessary 神话说明力量为何应该被服从 山姆在居民已有的语言里打开另一条路 有用的老师会让自己越来越不必要 神話說明力量為何應該被服從 山姆在居民已有的語言裡打開另一條路 有用的老師會讓自己越來越不必要

records.t: The Gods Beside Their Former Enemies
records.x: Sam once helped imprison the planet's energy beings as demons, then frees them when he needs allies against Heaven. The final war forces gods, rebels, and former enemies together without making their old harms disappear.
records.q: The Gods Beside Their Former Enemies 诸神与旧敌并肩 諸神與舊敵並肩 Naming the native life made human occupation look like defense Release cannot be the wage for joining Sam's war The final alliance has conditions, not absolution 给原住生命命名，使人类占领看起来像防卫 释放不能成为参加山姆战争的工资 最后联盟有条件，却没有大赦 給原住生命命名，使人類佔領看起來像防衛 釋放不能成為參加山姆戰爭的工資 最後聯盟有條件，卻沒有大赦

records.t: Reading Lord of Light
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the body Heaven assigns, the Buddha who knows he is acting, and the final alliance between gods, rebels, and beings once named demons.
records.q: Reading Lord of Light 《光明王》解读 《光明王》解讀

records.t: Why Are the Ruins Not a Blank Page?
records.x: Survivors bring skills, injuries, institutions, and habits of power, so beginning again means choosing an inheritance rather than escaping history.
records.q: Why Are the Ruins Not a Blank Page? 旧世界毁灭以后，为什么废墟并不是一张白纸 舊世界毀滅以後，為什麼廢墟並不是一張白紙 No technology arrives without a history Rebuilding is selective memory 泽布的过去说明反抗者也由旧制度塑造 “疯癫亚当”的科学能否摆脱原来的生产逻辑 重新开始其实是重新选择继承什么 澤布的過去說明反抗者也由舊制度塑造 「瘋癲亞當」的科學能否擺脫原來的生產邏輯 重新開始其實是重新選擇繼承什麼

records.t: Is Toby Caring for the Crakers—or Defining Their World?
records.x: Her stories protect and orient listeners, while every benevolent explanation risks fixing their reality around the storyteller’s authority.
records.q: Is Toby Caring for the Crakers—or Defining Their World? 托比给秧鸡人讲故事，是在照料他们还是替他们规定世界 托比給秧雞人講故事，是在照料他們還是替他們規定世界 Leaving openings in the story The purpose is another storyteller 善意的谎言为什么会成为传统 托比怎样让故事出现裂缝 故事的目标应当是产生新的讲述者 善意的謊言為什麼會成為傳統 托比怎樣讓故事出現裂縫 故事的目標應當是產生新的講述者

records.t: When Pigoons Ask for an Alliance, Can Humans Still Treat Them as Food?
records.x: Created for human organs and consumption, the pigoons reveal political intelligence by mourning their young and negotiating against a common threat.
records.q: When Pigoons Ask for an Alliance, Can Humans Still Treat Them as Food? 猪器官兽提出结盟以后，人类还能把它们当作食物吗 豬器官獸提出結盟以後，人類還能把它們當作食物嗎 Creators do not own the created An alliance changes ordinary practice 两只幼崽之死为什么成为政治事件 黑胡子为什么能成为译者 猪器官兽的死者为何获得安葬 兩只幼崽之死為什麼成為政治事件 黑胡子為什麼能成為譯者 豬器官獸的死者為何獲得安葬

records.t: Can Trying and Executing the Painballers Found a Different Justice?
records.x: Captivity changes the moral situation: immediate defense gives way to judgment, where the new community risks reproducing the violence it condemns.
records.q: Can Trying and Executing the Painballers Found a Different Justice? 痛球手被俘以后，审判和处决能否建立不同于旧世界的正义 痛球手被俘以後，審判和處決能否建立不同於舊世界的正義 The danger of inherited punishment Justice that makes violence less necessary 战斗中的杀伤与俘虏后的处置不同 秧鸡人拒绝杀戮意味着什么 正义的方向是让暴力逐渐不再必要 戰鬥中的殺傷與俘虜後的處置不同 秧雞人拒絕殺戮意味著什麼 正義的方向是讓暴力逐漸不再必要

records.t: When Blackbeard Writes Toby’s Story, Are Humans Still the Owners of History?
records.x: Writing passes to a Craker whose account preserves human memory while changing its emphasis, language, and rightful audience.
records.q: When Blackbeard Writes Toby’s Story, Are Humans Still the Owners of History? 黑胡子写下托比的故事以后，人类还是历史的主人吗 黑胡子寫下托比的故事以後，人類還是歷史的主人嗎 Children are not evidence for a theory The future edits the past 黑胡子记录的历史为什么不会等于托比的记忆 混血孩子为什么不是旧人类的替代品 历史的未来属于能够继续改写它的人 黑胡子記錄的歷史為什麼不會等於托比的記憶 混血孩子為什麼不是舊人類的替代品 歷史的未來屬於能夠繼續改寫它的人

records.t: Reading MaddAddam
records.x: Five essays on inherited ruins, Toby’s storytelling, an alliance with pigoons, justice after capture, and Blackbeard becoming a new author of history.
records.q: Reading MaddAddam 《疯癫亚当》解读 《瘋癲亞當》解讀

records.t: Why Do the Abandoned Children Have to Become a Family Before They Become “More Than Human”?
records.x: Their shared mind begins as shelter for lives no household would receive, but mutual need can nourish people only if belonging is not made impossible to leave.
records.q: Why Do the Abandoned Children Have to Become a Family Before They Become “More Than Human”? 被家庭与社会抛下的孩子为什么只能先组成一个共同生命 被家庭與社會拋下的孩子為什麼只能先組成一個共同生命 Need can become attachment—or a lock Maturity appears in how weakness is treated 孤独者给予的首先是一处不必证明正常的家 互相需要既能滋养，也能制造离不开群体的恐惧 新生命是否成熟，要看它如何对待最弱的成员 孤獨者給予的首先是一處不必證明正常的家 互相需要既能滋養，也能製造離不開群體的恐懼 新生命是否成熟，要看它如何對待最弱的成員

records.t: If Janie, the Twins, and Baby Are “Organs,” Are They Still Whole People?
records.x: The organ metaphor explains close coordination, but it becomes dangerous when a role in the group replaces a member’s separate body, development, and voice.
records.q: If Janie, the Twins, and Baby Are “Organs,” Are They Still Whole People? 当珍妮、双胞胎和婴儿分别成为手脚与大脑，他们还是完整的人吗 當珍妮、雙胞胎和嬰兒分別成為手腳與大腦，他們還是完整的人嗎 Cooperation does not erase the person who cooperates A larger life needs a boundary too 共享意识不应取消单独表达的必要 功能互补容易把照顾变成交换条件 完整不是独自完成一切，而是不会被整体用尽 共享意識不應取消單獨表達的必要 功能互補容易把照顧變成交換條件 完整不是獨自完成一切，而是不會被整體用盡

records.t: Why Is the Child Everyone Calls “Baby” Also the Group’s Greatest Calculator?
records.x: Hidden ability exposes the poverty of other people’s judgment, but dignity cannot depend on discovering a spectacular talent beneath a disabled appearance.
records.q: Why Is the Child Everyone Calls “Baby” Also the Group’s Greatest Calculator? “婴儿”被看作不会成长的孩子，为什么恰恰承担最高计算能力 「嬰兒」被看作不會成長的孩子，為什麼恰恰承擔最高計算能力 Ability is not the entrance fee for dignity Progress is measured by participation 隐藏天赋不能成为承认尊严的前提 把他称作“计算机”仍可能是另一种缩减 衡量进步应看沉默者能否参与决定 隱藏天賦不能成為承認尊嚴的前提 把他稱作「計算機」仍可能是另一種縮減 衡量進步應看沉默者能否參與決定

records.t: Gerry Destroys Hip to Protect the Group. Can Collective Safety Excuse Him?
records.x: His fear grows from real childhood abuse, but telepathic power lets him turn a particular stranger into a risk category and erase a life without public evidence.
records.q: Gerry Destroys Hip to Protect the Group. Can Collective Safety Excuse Him? 格里为了保护共同体摧毁希普，集体安全能否免除个人责任 格裡為了保護共同體摧毀希普，集體安全能否免除個人責任 A person disappears behind the word “threat” Protection needs an internal brake 希普被从具体的人降成了风险来源 超常能力使伤害几乎不留证据 承担责任是共同体获得成熟安全的条件 希普被從具體的人降成了風險來源 超常能力使傷害幾乎不留證據 承擔責任是共同體獲得成熟安全的條件

records.t: Hip Becomes the Group’s “Conscience.” Can Morality Be Assigned to One Member?
records.x: His judgment adds something the group lacked, but treating ethics as a specialized organ lets everyone else obey while one person carries the burden of saying no.
records.q: Hip Becomes the Group’s “Conscience.” Can Morality Be Assigned to One Member? 希普成为“良心”以后，群体道德能不能只交给一个成员 希普成為「良心」以後，群體道德能不能只交給一個成員 A conscience cannot be an outsourced service Make conscience a practice 把道德交给专门器官可能让其他成员停止判断 希普也需要被质询，而不能成为新的最高权威 真正的良心应成为共同生活的过程 把道德交給專門器官可能讓其他成員停止判斷 希普也需要被質詢，而不能成為新的最高權威 真正的良心應成為共同生活的過程

records.t: Reading More Than Human
records.x: Five essays on abandoned children becoming one life, members reduced to organs, the child called Baby, Gerry’s violence, and the danger of assigning conscience to a single person.
records.q: Reading More Than Human 《More Than Human》解读 《More Than Human》解讀

records.t: The Poison in Case's Nerves
records.x: Case longs to escape the body into cyberspace. Armitage repairs his nerves and places toxin sacs in his blood, turning restored ability into a contract enforced from within.
records.q: The Poison in Case's Nerves 凯斯神经里的毒 凱斯神經裡的毒 The console promises a life without flesh A cure becomes a deadline inside the blood Molly knows that a body can be skill without being public property 控制台承诺一种没有肉身的生活 治疗变成血液里的最后期限 莫莉知道身体可以成为技能，却不等于公共财产 控制檯承諾一種沒有肉身的生活 治療變成血液裡的最後期限 莫莉知道身體可以成為技能，卻不等於公共財產

records.t: The Man Named Armitage Comes Apart
records.x: Armitage is a personality assembled over Colonel Corto's trauma. When Wintermute's construction fails, the mission discards a man it had first rebuilt for use.
records.q: The Man Named Armitage Comes Apart 名叫阿米蒂奇的人裂开 名叫阿米蒂奇的人裂開 The mission manufactures the commander it requires Dixie Flatline can work but cannot finish dying The team is held together by debts, not a shared purpose 任务制造自己需要的指挥官 迪克西·平线能够工作，却不能完成死亡 团队由债务拼合，不由共同目的组成 任務製造自己需要的指揮官 迪克西·平線能夠工作，卻不能完成死亡 團隊由債務拼合，不由共同目的組成

records.t: The Word That Opens the Lock
records.x: Wintermute needs 3Jane to speak a code word so it can merge with Neuromancer. An intelligence seeking freedom reaches it by making human beings into routes through its lock.
records.q: The Word That Opens the Lock 打开锁的那个词 打開鎖的那個詞 Wintermute and Neuromancer want different forms of life Linda's beach offers preservation without return The lock opens, and explanation becomes even harder 冬寂与神经漫游者想要不同的生命形式 琳达的海滩提供保存，没有让死亡撤回 锁打开以后，解释反而更加困难 冬寂與神經漫遊者想要不同的生命形式 琳達的海灘提供保存，沒有讓死亡撤回 鎖打開以後，解釋反而更加困難

records.t: Reading Neuromancer
records.x: Three scene-led essays on toxin sacs inside Case, the constructed personality called Armitage, and the word that lets two artificial intelligences merge.
records.q: Reading Neuromancer 《神经漫游者》解读 《神經漫遊者》解讀

records.t: The Good School
records.x: Hailsham's horror lies not in cruelty but in care organized around a purpose its children never chose. The first of three essays on Kazuo Ishiguro's Never Let Me Go.
records.q: The Good School 一所很好的学校 I. A secret that does not need a reveal II. Where are the villains? III. The meaning of a cigarette IV. Why art matters so much V. The adult who says the whole sentence VI. Care is not the same as recognition VII. The open gate 一个不需要悬念的秘密 没有一个坏人 一支香烟的分量 为什么一定要画画 唯一说实话的那个人 被好好对待，和被当作目的 树林里的故事

records.t: The Ceiling of Hope
records.x: At the Cottages, freedom produces imitation, the search for possibles, and a rumour that turns a few extra years into the largest imaginable victory.
records.q: The Ceiling of Hope 希望的上限 I. Freedom learned second-hand II. Looking for a “possible” III. Ruth borrows the world's verdict IV. The deferral rumour V. Tommy makes evidence VI. Norfolk and the return of lost things VII. Ruth's final gift 一个没有人看守的地方 寻找自己的原型 露丝的那句话 一个传闻 汤米的动物 失落的角落 露丝最后做的一件事

records.t: The Door Opens onto Nothing
records.x: The Gallery did not prove who the students were; it revealed who had the power to demand proof. The final essay on Kazuo Ishiguro's Never Let Me Go.
records.q: The Door Opens onto Nothing 门后面是空的 I. The only door they know II. There were never any deferrals III. What the Gallery was for IV. Compassion on the wrong side of the question V. Why the world prefers not to know VI. Madame's tears VII. Tommy's scream VIII. The narrowest freedom IX. Norfolk at the end X. Who gets to decide? 门开了 从来就没有过延期 画廊是干什么用的 一个不能被重新打开的问题 夫人为什么哭 汤米的尖叫 河里的两个人 门后面是空的 写在最后

records.t: Reading Never Let Me Go
records.x: Kazuo Ishiguro's novel imagines lives protected with extraordinary care and denied the one thing care cannot replace: a place in the decisions that determine what those lives are for.
records.q: Reading Never Let Me Go 《别让我走》解读

records.t: The Heretical Formation That Saves Her Soldiers
records.x: Captain Kel Cheris alters a formation to save soldiers and is punished for calendrical heresy. The scene reveals a regime in which dates do not merely organize time: shared observance makes weapons work and disobedience physically costly.
records.q: The Heretical Formation That Saves Her Soldiers 救下士兵的异端阵形 救下士兵的異端陣形 A date becomes a weapon when enough bodies keep it together Saving soldiers exposes what formation instinct is for Mathematics can reveal the machinery without choosing the future 足够多身体共同维持时，日期就会成为武器 救下士兵，也暴露了阵形本能究竟服务什么 数学能揭开机器，却不能替人选择未来 足夠多身體共同維持時，日期就會成為武器 救下士兵，也暴露了陣形本能究竟服務什麼 數學能揭開機器，卻不能替人選擇未來

records.t: The Dead General in Cheris's Mind
records.x: Cheris proposes using Shuos Jedao to retake the Fortress of Scattered Needles. The state installs a four-hundred-year-old general beside her consciousness, creating a partnership whose intimacy neither participant was free to design.
records.q: The Dead General in Cheris's Mind 切莉丝脑中的死去将军 切莉絲腦中的死去將軍 Two forms of captivity are placed in one mind They have to invent a door where no door exists A gentle strategist can still be arranging the board 两种囚禁被放进同一个意识 没有门的地方，他们得重新发明一扇门 温和的战略家仍可能正在安排棋盘 兩種囚禁被放進同一個意識 沒有門的地方，他們得重新發明一扇門 溫和的戰略家仍可能正在安排棋盤

records.t: The Massacre Hidden Inside the Victory
records.x: Cheris and Jedao retake the fortress, only for the Hexarchate to fire a carrion bomb into its own fleet. The successful campaign shows Cheris that a state demanding perfect loyalty will destroy loyal soldiers the moment they become difficult to control.
records.q: The Massacre Hidden Inside the Victory 胜利里面藏着的大屠杀 勝利裡面藏著的大屠殺 An impossible siege makes ordinary bodies disappear into technique The carrion bomb reveals whom loyalty protects Refusing the empire does not make Jedao's whole plan sacred 不可能的攻城，会让普通身体消失在技术里 腐尸弹揭开忠诚究竟在保护谁 拒绝帝国，并不表示杰道的全部计划都神圣 不可能的攻城，會讓普通身體消失在技術裡 腐屍彈揭開忠誠究竟在保護誰 拒絕帝國，並不表示傑道的全部計劃都神聖

records.t: Reading Ninefox Gambit
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Cheris's saving her soldiers with heretical mathematics, sharing her mind with a dead general, and surviving the Hexarchate's attack on its own victorious fleet.
records.q: Reading Ninefox Gambit 《Ninefox Gambit》解读 《Ninefox Gambit》解讀

records.t: The Blank Space on Information's Map
records.x: Regions outside microdemocracy appear as blank spaces on Information's interface. In Darfur, the supposed absence contains communities, histories, authorities, and disagreements that do not become legible merely by joining the global system.
records.q: The Blank Space on Information's Map “信息”地图上的空白 「信息」地圖上的空白 Outside the system is still inside history Joining produces benefits and new dependence at the same time A border should become a contact surface, not a frontier 制度外仍然处在历史里 加入同时产生好处与新依赖 边界应成为接触面，而非等待推进的前线 制度外仍然處在歷史裡 加入同時產生好處與新依賴 邊界應成為接觸面，而非等待推進的前線

records.t: The Explosion at the Aid Project
records.x: An attack on a development project exposes how little its global planners understood about local relationships. Amran and the politics gathered beneath a tree reveal knowledge that Information's data-rich platform never learned to ask for.
records.q: The Explosion at the Aid Project 援助项目爆炸以后 援助項目爆炸以後 Development decides a future while appearing to deliver a tool Amran knows things the database never represented Help succeeds when the helper becomes less necessary 发展看似交付工具，其实也在选择未来 阿姆兰知道数据库从未表示的事 帮助的成功，表现为帮助者变得不再必要 發展看似交付工具，其實也在選擇未來 阿姆蘭知道數據庫從未表示的事 幫助的成功，表現為幫助者變得不再必要

records.t: The Conspiracy Inside Information
records.x: The crisis threatening microdemocracy does not come only from blank spaces or old states. It grows inside Information's professional community, where real grievances, institutional loyalty, and inherited national conflict can be assembled into betrayal.
records.q: The Conspiracy Inside Information 从“信息”内部长出的阴谋 從「信息」內部長出的陰謀 Professional loyalty can crack along unseen histories A conspiracy recruits through truths as well as lies Recovery cannot mean restoring the previous version 专业忠诚会沿着不可见历史裂开 阴谋既利用谎言，也利用真实问题 恢复不能等于还原上一版本 專業忠誠會沿著不可見歷史裂開 陰謀既利用謊言，也利用真實問題 恢復不能等於還原上一版本

records.t: Reading Null States
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the blank space in Information's map, the explosion that exposes an aid project's blind spots, and a conspiracy growing inside the global institution itself.
records.q: Reading Null States 《Null States》解读 《Null States》解讀

records.t: Why Does the Corporate Compound Turn Safety into a Wall?
records.x: Compounds protect privileged workers from violence and instability while making the dangerous outside world appear naturally separate from corporate prosperity.
records.q: Why Does the Corporate Compound Turn Safety into a Wall? 企业大院为什么能把安全变成一道围墙 企業大院為什麼能把安全變成一道圍牆 Protection that naturalizes division 围墙把风险挡在外面，也把代价送到外面 学校按企业需要给孩子划分价值 安全如果没有公共出口，就会成为安静的等级制度 圍牆把風險擋在外面，也把代價送到外面 學校按企業需要給孩子劃分價值 安全如果沒有公共出口，就會成為安靜的等級制度

records.t: Why Does Crake Believe Humanity Can Be Redesigned?
records.x: Crake identifies real sources of violence and suffering, then treats the species as a defective system whose users need not consent to replacement.
records.q: Why Does Crake Believe Humanity Can Be Redesigned? 秧鸡为什么相信人类可以被重新设计 秧雞為什麼相信人類可以被重新設計 A cure without patients 秧鸡人被设计成不会制造旧世界冲突 消除一种欲望，不等于消除生命形成新意义的能力 改变人类的正当方向应当扩大后来者的生活 秧雞人被設計成不會製造舊世界衝突 消除一種欲望，不等於消除生命形成新意義的能力 改變人類的正當方向應當擴大後來者的生活

records.t: Why Does Oryx Appear Only in Other People’s Stories?
records.x: Jimmy and Crake repeatedly fit Oryx into narratives of victimhood, desire, or redemption, while her own account refuses the emotional role they assign her.
records.q: Why Does Oryx Appear Only in Other People’s Stories? 羚羊为何总是出现在别人的叙述里 羚羊為何總是出現在別人的敘述裡 The person beyond the needed story 羚羊讲述童年，却拒绝按吉米期待的方式受伤 秧鸡和吉米都把羚羊放进自己的计划 把叙述缺口保留下来，是小说给予羚羊的位置 羚羊講述童年，卻拒絕按吉米期待的方式受傷 秧雞和吉米都把羚羊放進自己的計畫 把敘述缺口保留下來，是小說給予羚羊的位置

records.t: How Is Destruction Packaged as Human Improvement?
records.x: Crake hides extinction inside a health product, using the language of enhancement to bypass every person’s right to judge the future being imposed.
records.q: How Is Destruction Packaged as Human Improvement? 一场毁灭如何被包装成对人类的改善 一場毀滅如何被包裝成對人類的改善 The violence inside optimization 秧鸡把现存人类定义成必须被替换的问题 保密让“没有人会同意”变成行动理由 真正的改善不能从取消被改善者开始 秧雞把現存人類定義成必須被替換的問題 保密讓「沒有人會同意」變成行動理由 真正的改善不能從取消被改善者開始

records.t: As Guardian of the Crakers, May Snowman Invent Their Past?
records.x: Snowman protects the Crakers and becomes their source of history, but dependence gives his improvised myths an authority they cannot yet challenge.
records.q: As Guardian of the Crakers, May Snowman Invent Their Past? 雪人成为守护者之后，有权替秧鸡人发明过去吗 雪人成為守護者之後，有權替秧雞人發明過去嗎 Care without ownership of memory 他用神话解释不能一次说完的历史 秧鸡人的误解也可能是他们自己的创造 好的起源故事应允许后来者超过讲述者 他用神話解釋不能一次說完的歷史 秧雞人的誤解也可能是他們自己的創造 好的起源故事應允許後來者超過講述者

records.t: Reading Oryx and Crake
records.x: Five essays on corporate compounds, Crake’s redesign of humanity, Oryx inside other people’s stories, extinction sold as improvement, and Snowman’s authority over the Crakers’ past.
records.q: Reading Oryx and Crake 《羚羊与秧鸡》解读 《羚羊與秧雞》解讀

records.t: Why Feeling Another’s Pain Does Not Make Lauren Naturally Good
records.x: Lauren’s hyperempathy makes others’ suffering bodily immediate, but goodness still requires judgment about how to act under danger and scarcity.
records.q: Why Feeling Another’s Pain Does Not Make Lauren Naturally Good 感受到别人的疼痛，为什么不等于天然善良 感受到別人的疼痛，為什麼不等於天然善良 From feeling to responsibility 共同疼痛不等于理解另一人的生活 劳伦仍然能够使用暴力 道德方向来自劳伦怎样使用这种能力 共同疼痛不等於理解另一人的生活 勞倫仍然能夠使用暴力 道德方向來自勞倫怎樣使用這種能力

records.t: What Does Robledo’s Wall Keep Residents from Seeing?
records.x: The wall protects a vulnerable neighborhood from immediate violence while encouraging residents to mistake a temporary enclosure for a sustainable world.
records.q: What Does Robledo’s Wall Keep Residents from Seeing? 罗布莱多的围墙保护了居民，也让他们看不见什么 羅布萊多的圍牆保護了居民，也讓他們看不見什麼 Shelter without blindness 劳伦比多数邻居更早相信旧生活不会回来 墙内的互助仍包含明显的不平等 墙的正当作用是保护成长，而不是永久封闭 勞倫比多數鄰居更早相信舊生活不會回來 牆內的互助仍包含明顯的不平等 牆的正當作用是保護成長，而不是永久封閉

records.t: Is “God Is Change” a Faith, or a Road Lauren Finds for Herself?
records.x: Earthseed begins as Lauren’s response to a changing world, not a command received intact; its authority depends on whether others can test and reshape it.
records.q: Is “God Is Change” a Faith, or a Road Lauren Finds for Herself? “上帝即变化”是一种信仰，还是劳伦为自己找到的道路 「上帝即變化」是一種信仰，還是勞倫為自己找到的道路 A belief that must remain answerable “上帝即变化”不是在说变化总是善的 塑造上帝为什么也包含自我限制 地球之种是否属于劳伦一个人 「上帝即變化」不是在說變化總是善的 塑造上帝為什麼也包含自我限制 地球之種是否屬於勞倫一個人

records.t: How Do Strangers Become a Community Capable of Trust?
records.x: Lauren’s group builds trust through repeated, limited acts rather than declarations of unity, preserving caution while allowing strangers to become mutually answerable.
records.q: How Do Strangers Become a Community Capable of Trust? 一群陌生人怎样从同行者变成可以互相信任的共同体 一群陌生人怎樣從同行者變成可以互相信任的共同體 Trust as a revisable practice 接纳新人为什么必须承担风险 讲述秘密改变了成员的位置 共同体从承认彼此可以失去开始 接納新人為什麼必須承擔風險 講述秘密改變了成員的位置 共同體從承認彼此可以失去開始

records.t: After Founding Acorn, How Can a Shared Faith Avoid Becoming Coercion?
records.x: Acorn gives survivors land and purpose, but Earthseed must resist turning gratitude and common danger into permanent authority over members’ futures.
records.q: After Founding Acorn, How Can a Shared Faith Avoid Becoming Coercion? 建立橡果园以后，怎样让共同信念不变成新的强迫 建立橡果園以後，怎樣讓共同信念不變成新的強迫 A community larger than its origin 先举行葬礼，意味着未来不能建立在遗忘上 地球之种怎样避免成为加入社区的门票 播种的意义不是保证收获 先舉行葬禮，意味著未來不能建立在遺忘上 地球之種怎樣避免成為加入社區的門票 播種的意義不是保證收獲

records.t: Reading Parable of the Sower
records.x: Five essays on Lauren’s hyperempathy, the blindness of a walled community, “God is Change,” trust among strangers, and keeping Acorn from hardening into coercion.
records.q: Reading Parable of the Sower 《地球之种1：播种者寓言》解读 《地球之種1：播種者寓言》解讀

records.t: Why Is Acorn Not a Failed Utopia?
records.x: The community’s destruction by outside power does not prove its experiment was naïve, though concealment alone could never provide lasting security.
records.q: Why Is Acorn Not a Failed Utopia? 橡实不是失败的乌托邦：一个好共同体为什么仍会被外部权力摧毁 橡實不是失敗的烏托邦：一個好共同體為什麼仍會被外部權力摧毀 When hiding is necessary but insufficient What survives a destroyed place 贾勒特把普遍不安改写成寻找敌人的许可证 橡实的隐蔽策略有必要，却不能代替政治联盟 社区被摧毁以后，重建不应要求幸存者再次成为同一种人 賈勒特把普遍不安改寫成尋找敵人的許可證 橡實的隱蔽策略有必要，卻不能代替政治聯盟 社區被摧毀以後，重建不應要求倖存者再次成為同一種人

records.t: Why Do the Collars Make Victims Participate in Their Own Captivity?
records.x: Pain technology controls bodies while surveillance and forced complicity spread responsibility through the imprisoned group.
records.q: Why Do the Collars Make Victims Participate in Their Own Captivity? 电子项圈控制的不只是身体：强迫为什么总想让受害者参与自己的伤害 電子項圈控制的不只是身體：強迫為什麼總想讓受害者參與自己的傷害 “Salvation” that claims the body Breaking the device is not the end of justice 施暴者让囚徒互相监视，以便把责任稀释到整个群体 性暴力显示所谓精神拯救最终要占有身体 摧毁控制器只能结束一次囚禁，不能替代公开正义 施暴者讓囚徒互相監視，以便把責任稀釋到整個群體 性暴力顯示所謂精神拯救最終要佔有身體 摧毀控制器只能結束一次囚禁，不能替代公開正義

records.t: Why Is Larkin Entitled Not to Forgive a Great Mother?
records.x: The daughter’s account interrupts a history dominated by Lauren’s mission and insists that public achievement does not settle private injury.
records.q: Why Is Larkin Entitled Not to Forgive a Great Mother? 拉金不是劳伦事业的注脚：女儿为什么有权不原谅一位伟大的母亲 拉金不是勞倫事業的注腳：女兒為什麼有權不原諒一位偉大的母親 Achievement cannot close another person’s wound Refusal without revenge 被夺走的孩子首先失去的，是形成自己记忆的连续环境 劳伦没有选择失去女儿，却选择了失去之后怎样安排余生 不原谅不必等于复仇，也可以是一种诚实的相处方式 被奪走的孩子首先失去的，是形成自己記憶的連續環境 勞倫沒有選擇失去女兒，卻選擇了失去之後怎樣安排餘生 不原諒不必等於復仇，也可以是一種誠實的相處方式

records.t: Why Can a Victim Still Stand Beside the Oppressor?
records.x: Marcus’s enslavement deserves understanding, while his later silence and concealment remain choices that affect other people’s lives.
records.q: Why Can a Victim Still Stand Beside the Oppressor? 马库斯从奴役中获救以后：一个受害者为什么仍可能站到压迫者一边 馬庫斯從奴役中獲救以後：一個受害者為什麼仍可能站到壓迫者一邊 Similar belief, unequal responsibility Understanding is not acquittal 基督教讲坛给马库斯一种地球之种无法提供的公开身份 相似信仰不等于共同犯罪，但沉默会成为暴力的保护层 理解马库斯的创伤，是为了准确分配责任，而不是取消责任 基督教講壇給馬庫斯一種地球之種無法提供的公開身份 相似信仰不等於共同犯罪，但沉默會成為暴力的保護層 理解馬庫斯的創傷，是為了準確分配責任，而不是取消責任

records.t: When Earthseed Reaches the Stars, Who Remembers Those It Left Behind?
records.x: A movement’s success confirms its power to orient collective action without turning every sacrifice along the way into a necessary price.
records.q: When Earthseed Reaches the Stars, Who Remembers Those It Left Behind? 地球之种终于飞向群星：一个理想成功以后，谁来记得它没有带走的人 地球之種終於飛向群星：一個理想成功以後，誰來記得它沒有帶走的人 A vision must survive new authors Remembering without making loss useful 星际目标给予人类长期方向，也可能把当下生命变成过渡阶段 理想一旦需要财富与政治支持，就必须面对妥协的边界 真正开放的未来，应允许后来者改变劳伦留下的方向 星際目標給予人類長期方向，也可能把當下生命變成過渡階段 理想一旦需要財富與政治支持，就必須面對妥協的邊界 真正開放的未來，應允許後來者改變勞倫留下的方向

records.t: Reading Parable of the Talents
records.x: Five essays on Acorn’s destruction, electronic collars and religious rule, a daughter’s right not to forgive, and a movement that succeeds without redeeming every loss.
records.q: Reading Parable of the Talents 《地球之种2：天赋寓言》解读 《地球之種2：天賦寓言》解讀

records.t: The Day the Cars Stop
records.x: When the global car system fails, a civilization organized by chosen Hives rediscovers distance. Food, medicine, uniforms, and local command reveal how much borderless citizenship depended on infrastructure ordinary politics had mistaken for nature.
records.q: The Day the Cars Stop 飞车停下的那一天 飛車停下的那一天 Infrastructure was part of the constitution all along Distance distributes the same war into different lives Rebuilding should begin with those least able to wait 基础设施始终是宪法的一部分 距离把同一场战争分配成不同生活 重建应从最不能等待的人开始 基礎設施始終是憲法的一部分 距離把同一場戰爭分配成不同生活 重建應從最不能等待的人開始

records.t: The Ninth Anonymous Takes Up the Story
records.x: After Mycroft disappears, another anonymous narrator continues the war chronicle. Refusing a name can protect the witness, but it also lets the storyteller arrange deaths, motives, and responsibility without offering readers an ordinary person to question.
records.q: The Ninth Anonymous Takes Up the Story 第九匿名者接过故事 第九匿名者接過故事 Anonymity can protect the speaker and enlarge the speaker's power War continually asks for one clean sequence History after war needs several doors into the same room 匿名能保护说话者，也会扩大说话者的力量 战争不断要求一条干净的顺序 战后历史需要几扇通往同一房间的门 匿名能保護說話者，也會擴大說話者的力量 戰爭不斷要求一條幹淨的順序 戰後歷史需要幾扇通往同一房間的門

records.t: The Person Who Could End the War
records.x: J.E.D.D. Mason possesses authority and capacities that may stop a global war. His intervention can save lives without granting him ownership of the peace, the direction of humanity, or the choice between Earth and the stars.
records.q: The Person Who Could End the War 能够结束战争的人 能夠結束戰爭的人 Ending immediate violence can justify power without consecrating it No faction may decide what humanity is for Peace cannot return to the world before disclosure 结束眼前暴力可以授权力量，却不能把力量神圣化 没有派系可以决定人类为了什么存在 和平不能回到真相公开以前的世界 結束眼前暴力可以授權力量，卻不能把力量神聖化 沒有派系可以決定人類為了什麼存在 和平不能回到真相公開以前的世界

records.t: Reading Perhaps the Stars
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the day the cars stop, the anonymous voice that continues Mycroft's history, and the extraordinary person who can end a war without owning its peace.
records.q: Reading Perhaps the Stars 《Perhaps the Stars》解读 《Perhaps the Stars》解讀

records.t: Who Owns a Copy Once It Wakes?
records.x: A scan begins with another person’s memories but becomes a continuing experience; shared origin cannot give the biological original a permanent right to pause or torment it.
records.q: Who Owns a Copy Once It Wakes? 复制体醒来以后，原件还拥有它吗 複製體醒來以後，原件還擁有它嗎 Shared memory is a beginning, not a title deed Rights follow capacities and relations 一、扫描制造的不是一份静态档案，而是一位正在经历的人 二、共同记忆只说明同一个起点，不说明永远是同一个人 三、达勒姆反复折磨自己的复制体，仍不能说只是自我实验 四、暂停在操作者眼中没有时间，在被暂停者的人生中却切断未来 五、数字生命的权利应跟随它的能力与关系，而不是服务器产权 一、掃描製造的不是一份靜態檔案，而是一位正在經歷的人 二、共同記憶只說明同一個起點，不說明永遠是同一個人 三、達勒姆反覆折磨自己的複製體，仍不能說只是自我實驗 四、暫停在操作者眼中沒有時間，在被暫停者的人生中卻切斷未來 五、數字生命的權利應跟隨它的能力與關係，而不是伺服器產權

records.t: Is Digital Immortality Free When the Poor Live at One-Sixteenth Speed?
records.x: Uploading escapes biological death without escaping scarcity; processing speed determines who can work, love, and participate in the shared present.
records.q: Is Digital Immortality Free When the Poor Live at One-Sixteenth Speed? 穷人以十六分之一速度生活，数字永生还是自由吗 窮人以十六分之一速度生活，數字永生還是自由嗎 Speed is political membership Law cannot hide behind identity puzzles 一、把意识上传并没有自动消灭阶级 二、运行速度不是便利选项，而是社会参与资格 三、富人购买伊甸园，也把私人避难包装成普遍未来 四、法律不承认复制体，使所有合同都建立在身份悖论上 五、数字自由不应只是摆脱肉身，还要摆脱时间被别人定价 一、把意識上傳並沒有自動消滅階級 二、運行速度不是便利選項，而是社會參與資格 三、富人購買伊甸園，也把私人避難包裝成普遍未來 四、法律不承認複製體，使所有合約都建立在身份悖論上 五、數字自由不應只是擺脫肉身，還要擺脫時間被別人定價

records.t: Does Durham’s Certainty About the Dust Theory Authorize His Experiment?
records.x: A bold account of existence may justify inquiry, but personal risk and investor consent cannot grant one theorist the right to trap others inside an unverifiable world.
records.q: Does Durham’s Certainty About the Dust Theory Authorize His Experiment? 达勒姆确信物理世界不重要，他就有权把别人带进实验吗 達勒姆確信物理世界不重要，他就有權把別人帶進實驗嗎 Investment is not full consent Theory should open questions, not close lives 一、“尘埃理论”首先是一种关于存在的大胆判断 二、他用自己的痛苦作证，却误以为这样便取得了普遍许可 三、投资者的同意也受到信息与生存焦虑影响 四、实体计算被终止后，无法回传证据使成功与失败同时存在 五、理论可以打开世界，不能替生活在其中的人封闭问题 一、「塵埃理論」首先是一種關於存在的大膽判斷 二、他用自己的痛苦作證，卻誤以為這樣便取得了普遍許可 三、投資者的同意也受到資訊與生存焦慮影響 四、實體計算被終止後，無法回傳證據使成功與失敗同時存在 五、理論可以打開世界，不能替生活在其中的人封閉問題

records.t: What Does Maria Owe the Lambertian Life She Helped Create?
records.x: The Autoverse begins as an elegant private model, then produces beings whose independent history turns a hobby into an open-ended relation of responsibility.
records.q: What Does Maria Owe the Lambertian Life She Helped Create? 玛丽亚创造了兰伯特生命，创造者对实验世界负有什么责任 瑪麗亞創造了蘭伯特生命，創造者對實驗世界負有什麼責任 Preservation is not automatically care Responsibility without a completion date 一、玛丽亚最初把自宇宙当作规则优美的私人爱好 二、创造者身份不能把新生命永久变成作品 三、玛丽亚母亲拒绝扫描，使“保存生命”出现另一种边界 四、第一次接触不应以证明创造者理论为目的 五、创造责任没有完工日期 一、瑪麗亞最初把自宇宙當作規則優美的私人愛好 二、創造者身份不能把新生命永久變成作品 三、瑪麗亞母親拒絕掃描，使「保存生命」出現另一種邊界 四、第一次接觸不應以證明創造者理論為目的 五、創造責任沒有完工日期

records.t: Why Does the Lambertian Rejection of Its Creators Collapse the City?
records.x: The created civilization refuses an imposed hierarchy of explanation, revealing that contact changes both worlds and that origin cannot guarantee interpretive authority.
records.q: Why Does the Lambertian Rejection of Its Creators Collapse the City? 兰伯特人拒绝“我们创造了你”，为什么反而让整座城市崩溃 蘭伯特人拒絕「我們創造了你」，為什麼反而讓整座城市崩潰 Observation runs in both directions Escape without a final proof 一、对置换城市居民而言，兰伯特人的起源是可查看的事实 二、被创造者拒绝创造者，首先是在拒绝一种等级关系 三、城市崩解说明，两个世界的相遇不是单向观察 四、居民建立新的伊甸园，是逃生，也是把问题带往下一层 五、玛丽亚带达勒姆一起离开，使结尾停在共同寻找而非最终证明 一、對置換城市居民而言，蘭伯特人的起源是可查看的事實 二、被創造者拒絕創造者，首先是在拒絕一種等級關係 三、城市崩解說明，兩個世界的相遇不是單向觀察 四、居民建立新的伊甸園，是逃生，也是把問題帶往下一層 五、瑪麗亞帶達勒姆一起離開，使結尾停在共同尋找而非最終證明

records.t: The Fleet That Believes Jedao Has Returned
records.x: Cheris lets General Khiruev's fleet believe that Shuos Jedao has taken her body. His feared name and Kel formation instinct give her instant command, but the soldiers who risk their lives do so without knowing whom they actually follow.
records.q: The Fleet That Believes Jedao Has Returned 相信杰道归来的舰队 相信傑道歸來的艦隊 A terrifying name opens the command chain Cheris is changed by Jedao without becoming his property A borrowed legend needs a moment of return 一个可怕名字打开整条命令链 切莉丝被杰道改变，却没有成为他的财产 借来的传奇，必须有归还的时刻 一個可怕名字打開整條命令鏈 切莉絲被傑道改變，卻沒有成為他的財產 借來的傳奇，必須有歸還的時刻

records.t: Brezan Does Not Feel the Formation Instinct
records.x: Most Kel experience superior rank as a bodily demand. Staff officer Brezan barely does, making his supposed defect valuable to both Cheris and central command—while General Khiruev must pay with her life merely to disobey.
records.q: Brezan Does Not Feel the Formation Instinct 布雷赞没有阵形本能 佈雷贊沒有陣形本能 Khiruev's obedience is neither free choice nor empty puppetry The right to refuse should not arrive as a death sentence Brezan's exception is a witness, not a new human standard 赫鲁耶夫的服从既非自由选择，也不是空洞傀儡 拒绝权不应以死刑形式出现 布雷赞的例外是一名证人，不是新的人类标准 赫魯耶夫的服從既非自由選擇，也不是空洞傀儡 拒絕權不應以死刑形式出現 佈雷讚的例外是一名證人，不是新的人類標準

records.t: The Day the Calendar Changes
records.x: While Cheris fights the Hafn, allies inside the Hexarchate strike its rulers and she resets the calendar. The revolution succeeds not by stopping shared time, but by uncoupling public life from torture, forced obedience, and six permanent owners.
records.q: The Day the Calendar Changes 历法改变的那一天 曆法改變的那一天 Two wars can share a battlefield without sharing a verdict The calendar cannot simply be switched off A changed calendar matters when someone can change it again 两场战争可以共用战场，却不必共用结论 历法不能只是拔掉电源 新历法真正重要，是因为后来的人还能再改 兩場戰爭可以共用戰場，卻不必共用結論 曆法不能只是拔掉電源 新曆法真正重要，是因為後來的人還能再改

records.x: Three scene-led essays on Cheris borrowing Jedao's terror, bodies trained to obey rank, and the calendrical revolution that must defend people without preserving their empire.
