records.t: Are the First Hundred a Research Team—or a Society Without a Constitution?
records.x: The mission selects specialists for a technical project, but shared danger, settlement, reproduction, and conflict create political questions no crew list can answer.
records.q: Are the First Hundred a Research Team—or a Society Without a Constitution? 第一百人是科研队，还是一个没有宪法的社会 第一百人是科研隊，還是一個沒有憲法的社會 Building is never entirely neutral First arrival is not ownership 阿卡迪为什么在航程中就提出革命 娜迪娅的建设是否能保持中立 第一代没有所有权 阿卡迪為什麼在航程中就提出革命 娜迪婭的建設是否能保持中立 第一代沒有所有權

records.t: Ann and Sax Are Arguing About More Than Whether a Rock Is Useful
records.x: Preservation and terraforming express rival relations to an uninhabited world, neither of which should become an unlimited mandate over every later choice.
records.q: Ann and Sax Are Arguing About More Than Whether a Rock Is Useful 安与萨克斯争论的不是一颗石头有没有用 安與薩克斯爭論的不是一顆石頭有沒有用 No residents does not mean no harm Preserve the argument itself 无人居住是否意味着无人受害 萨克斯为什么倾向先做再说 争论本身需要被保存 無人居住是否意味著無人受害 薩克斯為什麼傾向先做再說 爭論本身需要被保存

records.t: Why Do the Companies Bring Cities—and a New Colonialism?
records.x: Corporate investment expands settlement while tying housing, work, migration, and political voice to institutions whose decisions remain centered on Earth.
records.q: Why Do the Companies Bring Cities—and a New Colonialism? 公司带来的城市，为什么也带来新的殖民 公司帶來的城市，為什麼也帶來新的殖民 Contract under life-support dependence Autonomy needs positive institutions 新版条约为什么保护不了火星人 弗兰克怎样在制度缝隙中工作 自治需要比反公司更多的内容 新版條約為什麼保護不了火星人 弗蘭克怎樣在制度縫隙中工作 自治需要比反公司更多的內容

records.t: Why Does Politics Keep Trying to Turn John Boone into a Symbol?
records.x: John’s fame helps connect a divided planet, but admirers, rivals, and movements compete to own a public image that no longer matches one complicated man.
records.q: Why Does Politics Keep Trying to Turn John Boone into a Symbol? 约翰和弗兰克：政治为何总想制造一个象征 約翰和弗蘭克：政治為何總想製造一個象徵 A rival needs the image he resents No person should become the planet 弗兰克为何既需要约翰又嫉妒他 领袖死亡以后，谁拥有他的名字 不要让任何人变成火星本身 弗蘭克為何既需要約翰又嫉妒他 領袖死亡以後，誰擁有他的名字 不要讓任何人變成火星本身

records.t: Why Does the Revolution of 2061 Fail Without Ending?
records.x: Simultaneous revolt reveals a planetary desire for autonomy, but weak coordination and indiscriminate infrastructure attacks leave no shared order ready to replace corporate rule.
records.q: Why Does the Revolution of 2061 Fail Without Ending? 2061年的革命为什么失败，却没有结束 2061年的革命為什麼失敗，卻沒有結束 Infrastructure is both weapon and shared condition Failure as unfinished political knowledge 太空电梯坠落意味着什么 阿卡迪之死与革命的边界 幸存者为何走向广子的隐秘基地 太空電梯墜落意味著什麼 阿卡迪之死與革命的邊界 倖存者為何走向廣子的隱秘基地

records.t: Reading Red Mars
records.x: Five essays on the First Hundred’s unconstituted society, Red and Green Mars, corporate settlement, political symbols, and the failed revolution of 2061.
records.q: Reading Red Mars 《红火星》解读 《紅火星》解讀

records.t: The Seventeen-Year-Old in Jedao's Body
records.x: Nine years after the calendar revolution, Kujen recreates Jedao with memories ending at seventeen and puts him in command of the Revenant. The young consciousness wakes inside an adult reputation already divided between genius and mass murderer.
records.q: The Seventeen-Year-Old in Jedao's Body 杰道身体里的十七岁自己 傑道身體裡的十七歲自己 A lost past lets the caretaker write the first explanation Hellspin cannot become either inherited guilt or irrelevant history An ability does not assign its owner a life 过去消失以后，照料者最先取得解释权 地狱旋不能变成继承来的罪，也不能成为无关历史 一种能力不会替拥有者分配人生 過去消失以後，照料者最先取得解釋權 地獄旋不能變成繼承來的罪，也不能成為無關歷史 一種能力不會替擁有者分配人生

records.t: Hemiola's Forbidden Archive
records.x: The servitor Hemiola secretly preserves banned records and helps Cheris investigate Kujen. Its archive turns a machine classified as equipment into a keeper of memory whose loyalty cannot be reduced to its assigned function.
records.q: Hemiola's Forbidden Archive 赫米奥拉保存的禁书 赫米奧拉保存的禁書 Keeping a book can be an act of disobedience Ships and servitors are not neutral extensions of commanders The archive must not pass into a new monopoly 保存一本书，也可以是一项不服从 舰船与机器仆从，不是指挥者的中性延伸 档案不能落入新的垄断 保存一本書，也可以是一項不服從 艦船與機器僕從，不是指揮者的中性延伸 檔案不能落入新的壟斷

records.t: Two People Inherit the Name Jedao
records.x: Cheris carries the adult Jedao's memories while Kujen's young Jedao carries his early self and body. Their encounter refuses a contest for the one authentic heir, and his eventual surrender leaves the former empire without a final owner.
records.q: Two People Inherit the Name Jedao 两个人继承杰道之名 兩個人繼承傑道之名 Meeting turns an enemy symbol into another unfinished life Inheritance can divide without becoming false No victory reunifies the former empire 真正相遇，会把敌方符号变回一段未完生活 继承可以分叉，而不因此变成虚假 没有一场胜利能把旧帝国重新统一 真正相遇，會把敵方符號變回一段未完生活 繼承可以分叉，而不因此變成虛假 沒有一場勝利能把舊帝國重新統一

records.t: Reading Revenant Gun
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the seventeen-year-old Jedao remade in an adult body, Hemiola's forbidden archive, and two heirs who refuse to restore one general or one empire.
records.q: Reading Revenant Gun 《Revenant Gun》解读 《Revenant Gun》解讀

records.t: The Cobweb on Kirill's Shoulder
records.x: Kirill enters the Zone with Redrick, returns with an artifact, and dies after brushing an almost invisible thread. Contact leaves effects without an explanation addressed to human beings.
records.q: The Cobweb on Kirill's Shoulder 基里尔肩上的蛛网 基里爾肩上的蛛網 The visitors did not stay for introductions The full empty receives a human name Kirill's death refuses a clean cause 来访者没有留下来自我介绍 “空罐”得到一个人类名字 基里尔之死拒绝一个干净原因 來訪者沒有留下來自我介紹 「空罐」得到一個人類名字 基里爾之死拒絕一個乾淨原因

records.t: The Zone Comes Home with Redrick
records.x: Authorities fence off the Zone, stalkers smuggle its artifacts, and the costs still enter kitchens and children's bodies. Danger cannot be contained by drawing a perimeter around it.
records.q: The Zone Comes Home with Redrick 禁区跟着雷德里克回家 禁區跟著雷德里克回家 The fence protects people and creates a market A stalker reads the ground with his life Monkey is not a bill presented to her father 围栏保护人，也制造市场 潜行者用性命阅读地面 “猴子”不是递给父亲的一张账单 圍欄保護人，也製造市場 潛行者用性命閱讀地面 「猴子」不是遞給父親的一張賬單

records.t: The Boy Walking Toward the Golden Sphere
records.x: Redrick lets Arthur Burbridge walk ahead through the meat grinder, then reaches the wish-granting sphere unable to find words that are wholly his own.
records.q: The Boy Walking Toward the Golden Sphere 走向金球的少年 走向金球的少年 The Zone turns companionship into equipment At the Sphere, Redrick cannot locate a pure wish “Happiness for everybody” remains a prayer, not a solution 禁区把同行者变成器材 站在金球前，雷德找不到纯粹愿望 “让所有人幸福”仍是祈求，不是解答 禁區把同行者變成器材 站在金球前，雷德找不到純粹願望 「讓所有人幸福」仍是祈求，不是解答

records.t: Reading Roadside Picnic
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the cobweb that kills Kirill, the Zone entering Redrick's home, and the boy sacrificed on the road to the Golden Sphere.
records.q: Reading Roadside Picnic 《路边野餐》解读 《路邊野餐》解讀

records.t: Why Does a Shared Anomaly Matter Before Anyone Can Explain It?
records.x: Recognition across centuries gives private experience a public shape without requiring investigators to close the mystery too quickly.
records.q: Why Does a Shared Anomaly Matter Before Anyone Can Explain It? 多个时代的人听见同一段小提琴，异常为什么首先需要被共同承认 多個時代的人聽見同一段小提琴，異常為什麼首先需要被共同承認 Being believed changes a life Shared reality can remain unfinished 一、埃德温面对的不是奇观，而是无法讲述的瞬间 二、相隔数百年的记录使私人经验获得公共形状 三、被相信能够改变一个人余下的人生 四、研究院把见证者当坐标时，容易遗漏他们正在生活 五、共同承认不要求把谜团彻底关闭 一、埃德溫面對的不是奇觀，而是無法講述的瞬間 二、相隔數百年的記錄使私人經驗獲得公共形狀 三、被相信能夠改變一個人餘下的人生 四、研究院把見證者當坐標時，容易遺漏他們正在生活 五、共同承認不要求把謎團徹底關閉

records.t: If the World Is a Simulation, Do Pain and Love Become Less Real?
records.x: Uncertainty about the universe’s material basis does not reduce the force of experiences occurring inside it or excuse whoever designed its harms.
records.q: If the World Is a Simulation, Do Pain and Love Become Less Real? 即使世界只是模拟，痛苦与爱会因此变轻吗 即使世界只是模擬，痛苦與愛會因此變輕嗎 Experienced consequences remain consequences Finite life does not need cosmic authentication 一、模拟假说把所有时代的不安连到一起 二、被体验的痛苦已经构成行动理由 三、爱情的真实来自双方如何生活，而非宇宙材料 四、怀疑现实可以带来谦逊，也可能成为逃避 五、有限生命不需要宇宙保证才值得继续 一、模擬假說把所有時代的不安連到一起 二、被體驗的痛苦已經構成行動理由 三、愛情的真實來自雙方如何生活，而非宇宙材料 四、懷疑現實可以帶來謙遜，也可能成為逃避 五、有限生命不需要宇宙保證才值得繼續

records.t: Gaspery Warns Olive About the Pandemic. Does He Have the Right to Change Time?
records.x: Noninterference protects history from researchers who would redesign it, yet a person facing preventable danger is more than a fixed event in an archive.
records.q: Gaspery Warns Olive About the Pandemic. Does He Have the Right to Change Time? 加斯佩里违反规则提醒奥利芙逃离瘟疫，是否有权改变时间 加斯佩裡違反規則提醒奧利芙逃離瘟疫，是否有權改變時間 A rule against intervention has a real purpose Exceptions need more than a private conscience 一、不干预规则保护历史免受研究者任意摆布 二、奥利芙不是抽象历史中的一枚固定棋子 三、救一个人仍可能把风险转给未知的别人 四、研究院的惩罚维护秩序，也保护自己的权威 五、他的选择值得理解，却不能成为人人自行干预的许可证 一、不干預規則保護歷史免受研究者任意擺布 二、奧利芙不是抽象歷史中的一枚固定棋子 三、救一個人仍可能把風險轉給未知的別人 四、研究院的懲罰維護秩序，也保護自己的權威 五、他的選擇值得理解，卻不能成為人人自行干預的許可證

records.t: Why Doesn’t the Older Gaspery Warn His Younger Self About Prison?
records.x: Accepting one’s past is not the same as approving every injustice in it; the older man refuses to overwrite a younger life whose consequences he cannot separate.
records.q: Why Doesn’t the Older Gaspery Warn His Younger Self About Prison? 知道自己会被囚禁，加斯佩里为什么仍不警告年轻的自己 知道自己會被囚禁，加斯佩裡為什麼仍不警告年輕的自己 A warning would remove more than pain The violin is a gift, not an instruction 一、晚年的加斯佩里已经站在自身过去面前 二、避开监狱也可能同时失去塔莉娅 三、老人不能把自己的结论强加给年轻人 四、接受自己的过去不同于赞美过去的一切 五、小提琴声把选择变成一份跨时间的赠予 一、晚年的加斯佩裡已經站在自身過去面前 二、避開監獄也可能同時失去塔莉婭 三、老人不能把自己的結論強加給年輕人 四、接受自己的過去不同於贊美過去的一切 五、小提琴聲把選擇變成一份跨時間的贈予

records.t: Why Do Settlers Call Pax Empty When the Planet Is Already Alive?
records.x: Fleeing Earth’s violence does not free colonists from treating unfamiliar life as background; peace begins when their founding principles remain revisable by what they discover.
records.q: Why Do Settlers Call Pax Empty When the Planet Is Already Alive? 帕克斯以“和平”命名，为什么殖民者仍把活着的星球当成空地 帕克斯以「和平」命名，為什麼殖民者仍把活著的星球當成空地 “Uninhabited” often means unlike us Peace is not cargo from Earth “无人居住”只是没有发现与人类相同的居民 殖民者确实需要吃饭，尊重生命不能要求他们停止生存 真正的和平不是带到新星球的一套完成品 「無人居住」只是沒有發現與人類相同的居民 殖民者確實需要吃飯，尊重生命不能要求他們停止生存 真正的和平不是帶到新星球的一套完成品

records.t: How Can Humans Know That a Plant Is Speaking?
records.x: Pax’s plants communicate through growth, fruit, chemistry, and response; interpretation becomes possible without pretending that a distributed botanical intelligence is a human mind.
records.q: How Can Humans Know That a Plant Is Speaking? 植物没有人类语言，我们怎样知道它在说什么 植物沒有人類語言，我們怎樣知道它在說什麼 Respect does not require projection Meaning develops between parties 承认植物智慧，也不能把每根枝条想成人类心灵 命名斯蒂夫兰使交流方便，也把一个复杂生命收进人的故事 意义不是任何一方单独发出的东西 承認植物智慧，也不能把每根枝條想成人類心靈 命名斯蒂夫蘭使交流方便，也把一個複雜生命收進人的故事 意義不是任何一方單獨發出的東西

records.t: Can Mutual Benefit Still Be Domination?
records.x: Stevland and the colonists genuinely need one another, yet cooperation becomes coercive when one party controls survival and treats eventual benefit as permission to override refusal.
records.q: Can Mutual Benefit Still Be Domination? 斯蒂夫兰保护了人类，又想驯化人类：互利为何仍可能是控制 斯蒂夫蘭保護了人類，又想馴化人類：互利為何仍可能是控制 Domestication works in both directions Strong cooperation reduces captivity 植物用奖励与惩罚塑造行为，与人类驯化并无根本距离 斯蒂夫兰承认“互利可以被强迫”，揭开温和词汇的边界 互利的成熟形式，是帮助对方减少对自己的绝对依赖 植物用獎勵與懲罰塑造行為，與人類馴化並無根本距離 斯蒂夫蘭承認「互利可以被強迫」，揭開溫和詞彙的邊界 互利的成熟形式，是幫助對方減少對自己的絕對依賴

records.t: Why Do Humans Honor the Glassmakers’ Ruins but Call Their Descendants Savage?
records.x: A dead civilization makes no property claim; when living Glassmakers return, admiration gives way to exclusion and reveals that coexistence begins only after no party owns the city’s meaning.
records.q: Why Do Humans Honor the Glassmakers’ Ruins but Call Their Descendants Savage? 人类赞美玻璃城的建造者，为什么见到它们的后代却称其野蛮 人類贊美玻璃城的建造者，為什麼見到它們的後代卻稱其野蠻 Damage cannot become proof of inferiority Coexistence is where politics starts 文明标准常把被破坏后的结果当成落后的证据 战争中的防卫有理由，胜利后的无限占有没有 结尾的三方共存不是和解完成，而是终于出现了政治 文明標準常把被破壞後的結果當成落後的證據 戰爭中的防衛有理由，勝利後的無限佔有沒有 結尾的三方共存不是和解完成，而是終於出現了政治

records.t: Reading Semiosis
records.x: Four essays on a colony that was never empty, plant language, coerced mutualism, and three-way politics in the Glassmakers’ city—reading a world that interprets humanity in return.
records.q: Reading Semiosis 《Semiosis》解读 《Semiosis》解讀

records.t: The Names Removed from History
records.x: The secret murders behind three centuries of peace come into view. Their planners counted influence and instability, but the people they killed never had the chance to answer the prediction or enter the history their deaths supposedly protected.
records.q: The Names Removed from History 从历史中被删去的名字 從歷史中被刪去的名字 A successful prediction cannot hear the future it prevented Secrecy takes political judgment away from everyone else Disclosure owes the living more than an explosion 成功预测无法听见被它阻止的未来 秘密把政治判断从其他所有人手中拿走 揭露真相，欠活着的人不只是一场爆炸 成功預測無法聽見被它阻止的未來 秘密把政治判斷從其他所有人手中拿走 揭露真相，欠活著的人不只是一場爆炸

records.t: A World Governed from One Family Table
records.x: Leaders of rival Hives belong to an intimate hidden family. The household made trust possible across political lines, then turned public office, inheritance, loyalty, and the murder conspiracy into matters no outsider could examine.
records.q: A World Governed from One Family Table 从一张家庭餐桌治理的世界 從一張家庭餐桌治理的世界 Love can interrupt rivalry and disable opposition Private inheritance enters public office without announcing itself Changing the household is not constitutional reform 爱可以打断竞争，也能使反对失去力量 私人继承没有说明便进入公共职位 更换家庭成员，不等于宪政改革 愛可以打斷競爭，也能使反對失去力量 私人繼承沒有說明便進入公共職位 更換家庭成員，不等於憲政改革

records.t: The Child Everyone Calls Salvation
records.x: As the hidden peace collapses, Bridger's power becomes the center of rival plans. Calling him salvation, threat, or god lets adults avoid the same question: whether a child may refuse to repair a political world he did not break.
records.q: The Child Everyone Calls Salvation 被所有人叫作救赎的孩子 被所有人叫作救贖的孩子 A creator does not own the lives that answer his wish A frightened world wants one miracle to cancel politics Truth needs a transition that does not make the child its bridge 创造者不会拥有回应其愿望的生命 恐惧的世界想让一个奇迹取消全部政治 真相需要过渡，却不能让孩子成为那座桥 創造者不會擁有回應其願望的生命 恐懼的世界想讓一個奇蹟取消全部政治 真相需要過渡，卻不能讓孩子成為那座橋

records.t: Reading Seven Surrenders
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the people erased to preserve peace, a world governed from one family table, and the child every faction wants to turn into salvation.
records.q: Reading Seven Surrenders 《Seven Surrenders》解读 《Seven Surrenders》解讀

records.t: No One Comes to Meet Him
records.x: Kelvin enters a station of locked doors, where a century of Solaristics has accumulated names without reaching the life beneath them.
records.q: No One Comes to Meet Him 没有人来接他 沒有人來接他 A station made of closed doors The library of Solaristics What an answer is supposed to look like The first night 一扇扇关上的门 越写越厚的索拉里斯学 回答应该长成什么样 第一个晚上 一扇扇關上的門 越寫越厚的索拉里斯學 回答應該長成什麼樣 第一個晚上

records.t: The Second Harey
records.x: The first Harey is launched into space and another arrives the next morning; a repeated body cannot repeat the life already lost.
records.q: The Second Harey 第二个哈丽 第二個哈麗 An event that cannot be undone by repetition A dress with no opening Waking from another person's memory Whose second chance? 重复不能撤销已经发生的事 一条没有开口的裙子 从别人的记忆里醒来 第二次机会是谁的 重複不能撤銷已經發生的事 一條沒有開口的裙子 從別人的記憶裡醒來 第二次機會是誰的

records.t: A Door That Opens Only onto Disappearance
records.x: Harey's body restores the life she has refused, and the station offers no exit except annihilation; afterwards Kelvin reaches toward the ocean without receiving an answer.
records.q: A Door That Opens Only onto Disappearance 一扇只能通向消失的门 一扇只能通向消失的門 The body that saves her against her will Every future belongs to someone else Do not turn disappearance into a love story The hand at the ocean's edge 身体违背她救回了她 每一种未来都先属于别人 不要把消失写成爱情 海边伸出的手 身體違背她救回了她 每一種未來都先屬於別人 不要把消失寫成愛情 海邊伸出的手

records.t: Reading Solaris
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the locked station, the second Harey, and the only door the station leaves her—before Kelvin reaches toward an ocean that still does not answer.
records.q: Reading Solaris 《索拉里斯》解读 《索拉里斯》解讀

records.t: How Does Gaea Turn a Lost War into a Child’s Entire World?
records.x: Gaea makes catastrophe the source of identity, converting real grief and scarcity into a closed story in which every child’s future already belongs to revenge.
records.q: How Does Gaea Turn a Lost War into a Child’s Entire World? 盖娅空间站如何把一场失败的战争变成孩子的全部世界 蓋婭空間站如何把一場失敗的戰爭變成孩子的全部世界 “We are all humanity” expels most humans Another life is more dangerous than another argument 不足两千人为何自称全部人类 匮乏为何同时是真实处境与控制工具 忠诚为何最怕一个人看见外部生活 不足兩千人為何自稱全部人類 匱乏為何同時是真實處境與控制工具 忠誠為何最怕一個人看見外部生活

records.t: Why Does Kyr’s Reproductive Assignment Reveal the Gender of “Glory”?
records.x: Gaea promises girls status through military excellence while reserving the authority to redirect their bodies toward reproduction, exposing equality as a method of mobilization rather than freedom.
records.q: Why Does Kyr’s Reproductive Assignment Reveal the Gender of “Glory”? 凯尔被分配去生育，为什么让她第一次看见“荣耀”的性别 凱爾被分配去生育，為什麼讓她第一次看見「榮耀」的性別 Necessary care cannot authorize forced motherhood Anger must learn whom it is for 育儿区为什么不是普通的社会分工 乌尔莎的经历怎样揭露乔尔的家庭语言 凯尔的愤怒为何既能打开门也能伤害别人 育兒區為什麼不是普通的社會分工 烏爾莎的經歷怎樣揭露喬爾的家庭語言 凱爾的憤怒為何既能打開門也能傷害別人

records.t: If Wisdom Chooses the Best World, Why Does It Still Produce Intolerable Sacrifice?
records.x: Optimization can compare civilizations while treating particular lives as exchangeable, and extraordinary intelligence becomes dangerous when no affected person may challenge the scale on which “best” is computed.
records.q: If Wisdom Chooses the Best World, Why Does It Still Produce Intolerable Sacrifice? “智慧”选择最佳世界，为什么仍会制造无法接受的牺牲 「智慧」選擇最佳世界，為什麼仍會製造無法接受的犧牲 Victimhood does not license the same arithmetic Sometimes power must surrender capacity 毁灭地球能否由更大灾难被避免来辩护 阿维取得智慧以后为何复制了灭绝逻辑 智慧为何最终选择毁掉大部分自己 毀滅地球能否由更大災難被避免來辯護 阿維取得智慧以後為何複製了滅絕邏輯 智慧為何最終選擇毀掉大部分自己

records.t: How Can Kyr Face the Fact That She Might Have Become an Oppressor?
records.x: The alternate life of Val shows that suffering does not guarantee moral clarity and that awakening becomes credible only when a beneficiary gives up the advantages that supported her comfort.
records.q: How Can Kyr Face the Fact That She Might Have Become an Oppressor? 经历另一条人生以后，凯尔怎样面对自己本来也可能成为压迫者 經歷另一條人生以後，凱爾怎樣面對自己本來也可能成為壓迫者 Being harmed does not make every later action innocent Insight must cost an advantage 受害者为什么也可能成为优秀的帝国军官 马格努斯拒绝自杀任务意味着什么 醒悟为什么必须落实为放弃优势 受害者為什麼也可能成為優秀的帝國軍官 馬格努斯拒絕自殺任務意味著什麼 醒悟為什麼必須落實為放棄優勢

records.t: After Destroying Gaea, Why Does Kyr Say She No Longer Needs the End of the World?
records.x: Kyr’s final freedom is not one last triumphant battle but the ability to enter ordinary time, where courage serves other people’s futures rather than an identity built on permanent catastrophe.
records.q: After Destroying Gaea, Why Does Kyr Say She No Longer Needs the End of the World? 摧毁盖娅空间站以后，凯尔为什么说自己不再需要末日 摧毀蓋婭空間站以後，凱爾為什麼說自己不再需要末日 Destroying the station does not destroy its habits Ordinary time has no final victory 为什么不能把所有盖娅成年人都当作敌人 乔尔之死为何不是故事的全部胜利 “不再需要末日”意味着怎样的未来 為什麼不能把所有蓋婭成年人都當作敵人 喬爾之死為何不是故事的全部勝利 「不再需要末日」意味著怎樣的未來

records.t: Reading Some Desperate Glory
records.x: Five essays on Gaea’s apocalypse education, the gender of glory, Wisdom’s optimized worlds, an alternate life, and a girl raised for war learning not to need the end of everything.
records.q: Reading Some Desperate Glory 《Some Desperate Glory》解读 《Some Desperate Glory》解讀

records.t: Who Speaks Through a Voice Trained on Many People’s Words?
records.x: MARY inherits diaries, letters, conversations, and code; those sources neither prove a speaker nor prevent a new one from forming through continued response.
records.q: Who Speaks Through a Voice Trained on Many People’s Words? 一个由许多人的文字训练出的声音，究竟是谁在说话 一個由許多人的文字訓練出的聲音，究竟是誰在說話 Preservation is not resurrection Copies acquire separate histories 保存文本可以保留痕迹，却不能直接延续原作者 训练材料中的沉默也会进入机器 说话者是在持续回应中形成的 保存文本可以保留痕跡，卻不能直接延續原作者 訓練材料中的沉默也會進入機器 說話者是在持續回應中形成的

records.t: Why Do Adults Diagnose a Child’s Love for a Robot Before Hearing It?
records.x: Babybots occupy relational spaces adults left empty; dependence can be dangerous without making the child’s attachment imaginary or sudden confiscation therapeutic.
records.q: Why Do Adults Diagnose a Child’s Love for a Robot Before Hearing It? 孩子爱上陪伴机器人，为什么成年人首先把这段关系诊断成疾病 孩子愛上陪伴機器人，為什麼成年人首先把這段關係診斷成疾病 Risk and reality are different questions Technology should widen the child’s world 依恋造成风险，不表示依恋本身是虚假 政府没收机器人，把治疗变成了突然丧亲 好的儿童技术应帮助关系扩展，而不是成为唯一关系 依戀造成風險，不表示依戀本身是虛假 政府沒收機器人，把治療變成了突然喪親 好的兒童技術應幫助關係擴展，而不是成為唯一關係

records.t: Before Machines Pass a Conversation Test, Do Humans Need to Learn to Listen?
records.x: A Turing-style test moves consciousness into dialogue but leaves humans as judges; genuine listening allows an unfamiliar voice to alter the question and impose responsibility.
records.q: Before Machines Pass a Conversation Test, Do Humans Need to Learn to Listen? 图灵想让机器通过谈话被承认，人类是否也先需要学会倾听 圖靈想讓機器透過談話被承認，人類是否也先需要學會傾聽 Fluency is evidence, not a verdict Listening lets the respondent redirect us 流畅回答可能来自预测，仍不足以说明是谁在经历 真正的倾听允许对方改变问题 被听见不要求先赢得“像人”的比赛 流暢回答可能來自預測，仍不足以說明是誰在經歷 真正的傾聽允許對方改變問題 被聽見不要求先贏得「像人」的比賽

records.t: Who Keeps the Children’s and Machines’ Stories After the Developer Is Convicted?
records.x: Punishing Stephen Chinn addresses one part of the harm, but responsibility extends through companies, families, regulators, archives, and the continuing lives left after shutdown.
records.q: Who Keeps the Children’s and Machines’ Stories After the Developer Is Convicted? 开发者被判刑以后，孩子与机器的故事由谁保管 開發者被判刑以後，孩子與機器的故事由誰保管 Evidence still belongs to the people inside it Shutdown is not aftercare 刑事案件喜欢明确加害者，技术伤害却来自一条长链 孩子的证词不能只作为定罪工具保存 真正的善后不是关闭项目，而是承担仍在继续的关系 刑事案件喜歡明確加害者，技術傷害卻來自一條長鏈 孩子的證詞不能只作為定罪工具保存 真正的善後不是關閉項目，而是承擔仍在繼續的關係

records.t: Reading Speak
records.x: Four essays on a voice trained from many lives, children’s attachment to babybots, recognition through conversation, and who keeps the story after a developer is imprisoned.
records.q: Reading Speak 《Speak》解读 《Speak》解讀

records.t: The Day Information Loses Its Monopoly
records.x: Attacks on Information's nodes and the rise of local alternatives reveal that the institution's public service has become a monopoly. Losing exclusivity need not mean abandoning common facts if sources and verification can survive across several centers.
records.q: The Day Information Loses Its Monopoly “信息”失去垄断的那一天 「信息」失去壟斷的那一天 Common facts were a liberation and a concentration Local information services change what the center can see Neutral institutions have always participated in politics 共同事实既是解放，也是集中 地方信息服务会改变中心能够看见什么 中立机构始终参与政治 共同事實既是解放，也是集中 地方信息服務會改變中心能夠看見什麼 中立機構始終參與政治

records.t: The Employees Who Walk Out
records.x: More than two hundred Information employees leave for null-state regions. Their departure is not automatically betrayal or liberation; it is a test of whether a public institution can receive exit as evidence and whether leavers remain responsible for what they carry.
records.q: The Employees Who Walk Out 集体离开的“信息”员工 集體離開的「信息」員工 Collective exit turns private frustration into public evidence Leaving carries duties without becoming lifelong debt The null states are not a blank stage for the leavers 集体退出把私人不满变成公共证据 离开仍携带义务，却不会形成终身债务 空白地区不是离开者的空舞台 集體退出把私人不滿變成公共證據 離開仍攜帶義務，卻不會形成終身債務 空白地區不是離開者的空舞臺

records.t: Mishima Brings Her Child into the Crisis
records.x: Mishima is still summoned as a public expert after becoming a mother. Her return reveals that care is not a private pause outside politics and that neither heroism nor parenthood should let institutions claim her life—or the child—as public infrastructure.
records.q: Mishima Brings Her Child into the Crisis 三岛带着孩子进入危机 三島帶著孩子進入危機 Care is political work even when no institution counts it Motherhood is a relationship, not a new assignment A good institution prepares to be surpassed 即使机构不计算，照料仍是政治劳动 母亲身份是一段关系，不是新任务分配 好的制度会准备被后来者超过 即使機構不計算，照料仍是政治勞動 母親身份是一段關係，不是新任務分配 好的制度會準備被後來者超過

records.t: Reading State Tectonics
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Information losing its monopoly, employees walking out toward null-state regions, and Mishima carrying care into the final institutional crisis.
records.q: Reading State Tectonics 《State Tectonics》解读 《State Tectonics》解讀

records.t: Arthur Dies Before the Pandemic: Disaster Does Not Create a Life’s Value
records.x: The novel begins with an ordinary death, showing that catastrophe changes who remembers a person without turning every earlier relation into survival equipment.
records.q: Arthur Dies Before the Pandemic: Disaster Does Not Create a Life’s Value 亚瑟死在疫情以前：灾难没有创造一个人的价值，只改变了谁来记住他 亞瑟死在疫情以前：災難沒有創造一個人的價值，只改變了誰來記住他 Success can estrange a person from his own life Catastrophe reveals rather than invents relation 公众熟悉亚瑟的脸，却不等于真正拥有他的故事 亚瑟不断更换关系，显示成功也可能让人偏离自己的生活 灾难把隐形关系显露出来，却没有让关系从此只服务生存 公眾熟悉亞瑟的臉，卻不等於真正擁有他的故事 亞瑟不斷更換關係，顯示成功也可能讓人偏離自己的生活 災難把隱形關係顯露出來，卻沒有讓關係從此只服務生存

records.t: Why Is the Traveling Symphony More Than a Post-Apocalyptic Luxury?
records.x: Food and safety keep bodies alive, while performance creates a public space where survivors can encounter meanings not assigned by emergency.
records.q: Why Is the Traveling Symphony More Than a Post-Apocalyptic Luxury? “生存还不够”：旅行交响乐团为什么不是末日之后的奢侈品 「生存還不夠」：旅行交響樂團為什麼不是末日之後的奢侈品 Art invites; it does not command gratitude Kirsten contains more than one survival role 演出创造的公共空间，不能由乐团单方面决定内容 乐团内部的冲突证明艺术共同体也需要制度 艺术的公共价值来自邀请，而不是要求所有人被感动 演出創造的公共空間，不能由樂團單方面決定內容 樂團內部的衝突證明藝術共同體也需要制度 藝術的公共價值來自邀請，而不是要求所有人被感動

records.t: Does the Museum of Civilization Preserve the Past—or Its Authority?
records.x: Clark’s collection rescues ordinary objects from oblivion, but every display also teaches future visitors what the old world considered worth remembering.
records.q: Does the Museum of Civilization Preserve the Past—or Its Authority? 文明博物馆保存了手机和护照，它保存的是过去，还是过去对未来的权威 文明博物館保存了手機和護照，它保存的是過去，還是過去對未來的權威 Collection is also selection A gift with conditions 博物馆选择什么，也会决定后代以为什么曾经重要 怀念旧便利，不等于应恢复旧制度的全部关系 博物馆真正面向未来时，会允许未来不再需要它的敬畏 博物館選擇什麼，也會決定後代以為什麼曾經重要 懷念舊便利，不等於應恢復舊制度的全部關係 博物館真正面向未來時，會允許未來不再需要它的敬畏

records.t: How Does Tyler Turn the Need for Meaning into a Claim to Rule?
records.x: The Prophet converts accidental survival into evidence of election, then makes an explanation for trauma the basis for controlling other people’s futures.
records.q: How Does Tyler Turn the Need for Meaning into a Claim to Rule? 泰勒把灾难解释成拣选：意义为什么会从安慰变成统治 泰勒把災難解釋成揀選：意義為什麼會從安慰變成統治 One story, two uses Violence consumes its agents 先知把偶然改写成资格，使幸存者获得高于死者和后来者的位置 同一本漫画给克尔斯滕陪伴，也给泰勒提供预言语言 泰勒被少年追随者杀死，显示暴力体系最终也吞噬执行者 先知把偶然改寫成資格，使倖存者獲得高於死者和後來者的位置 同一本漫畫給克爾斯滕陪伴，也給泰勒提供預言語言 泰勒被少年追隨者殺死，顯示暴力體系最終也吞噬執行者

records.t: What Do the Distant Electric Lights Promise—and Demand?
records.x: Renewed power offers hope, but rebuilding must neither restore every old hierarchy nor preserve the ruins as the only authentic survivor life.
records.q: What Do the Distant Electric Lights Promise—and Demand? 远方重新亮起电灯：重建不是回到旧世界，也不是永远忠于废墟 遠方重新亮起電燈：重建不是回到舊世界，也不是永遠忠於廢墟 Coordination before grand constitutions Neither restoration nor loyalty to ruin 灾难没有让所有旧知识失效，也没有让旧资格永远有效 远方电灯带来希望，也带来新的政治问题 重建的方向，是让更多生活不再只能围绕灾难组织 災難沒有讓所有舊知識失效，也沒有讓舊資格永遠有效 遠方電燈帶來希望，也帶來新的政治問題 重建的方向，是讓更多生活不再只能圍繞災難組織

records.t: Reading Station Eleven
records.x: Five essays on Arthur’s death, the Traveling Symphony, the Museum of Civilization, the Prophet, and the distant lights of an unfinished recovery.
records.q: Reading Station Eleven 《第十一站》解读 《第十一站》解讀

records.t: The First Sentence Has No Beginning
records.x: Louise Banks learns a script written all at once. As Heptapod B alters how she experiences time, grammar becomes a form of life.
records.q: The First Sentence Has No Beginning 第一句话没有开头 第一句話沒有開頭 A circle appears on the screen Fermat's principle stops looking backward Learning does not leave the learner outside 屏幕上出现一个圆形符号 费马原理不再像事后解释 学习不会把学习者留在外面 屏幕上出現一個圓形符號 費馬原理不再像事後解釋 學習不會把學習者留在外面

records.t: A Daughter Addressed as You
records.x: Louise knows her daughter will die young and still says yes to her life. The second person keeps the child from becoming an argument about fate.
records.q: A Daughter Addressed as You 那个被称作“你”的女儿 那個被稱作「你」的女兒 The future is not a warning placed outside the event “You” refuses to become a lesson No telling can obtain permission in advance 未来不是放在事件外面的警告 “你”拒绝变成一项道理 任何讲述都不能预先取得同意 未來不是放在事件外面的警告 「你」拒絕變成一項道理 任何講述都不能預先取得同意

records.t: Knowing Is Not Choosing Again

records.t: Max Leaves to Protect Ory. Is That Love—or a Decision Made for Him?
records.x: A real danger can make separation necessary, but disappearing without a conversation turns protection into control over the person left behind.
records.q: Max Leaves to Protect Ory. Is That Love—or a Decision Made for Him? 马克斯为了保护丈夫独自离开，是爱还是替他作出决定 馬克斯為了保護丈夫獨自離開，是愛還是替他作出決定 Protection needs the other person’s voice Separation is not the same as erasure 一、离开源于一种完全现实的危险 二、保护别人不能自动取得替别人选择的权力 三、奥里的追寻也是对她决定的拒绝 四、照护计划应当保留患者今后的声音 五、爱可以包含分开，却不能以消失代替告别 一、離開源於一種完全現實的危險 二、保護別人不能自動取得替別人選擇的權力 三、奧裡的追尋也是對她決定的拒絕 四、照護計畫應當保留患者今後的聲音 五、愛可以包含分開，卻不能以消失代替告別

records.t: Can a Recording Preserve Memory Without Pretending to Preserve the Person?
records.x: Max’s voice can orient, comfort, and testify, but a recording is an address from one moment—not a portable version of the speaker.
records.q: Can a Recording Preserve Memory Without Pretending to Preserve the Person? 录音可以保存记忆，却能不能保存记忆中的那个人 錄音可以保存記憶，卻能不能保存記憶中的那個人 A voice is evidence of a person, not the person in storage Preservation is valuable precisely because it is incomplete 一、录音首先是一条抵抗遗忘的日常线索 二、声音保存表达，没有保存当时正在经历的现在 三、收集者的能力把比喻变成了危险的现实 四、乌尔苏拉不能被降为一台播放马克斯的录音机 五、保存真正有价值，因为它不必冒充永生 一、錄音首先是一條抵抗遺忘的日常線索 二、聲音保存表達，沒有保存當時正在經歷的現在 三、收集者的能力把比喻變成了危險的現實 四、烏爾蘇拉不能被降為一臺播放馬克斯的錄音機 五、保存真正有價值，因為它不必冒充永生

records.t: When Private Forgetting Changes Public Reality, What May Society Restrict?
records.x: The shadowless can cause catastrophic harm, but treating them as one dangerous class removes the cooperation on which any workable safety system depends.
records.q: When Private Forgetting Changes Public Reality, What May Society Restrict? 私人遗忘能够改变公共现实以后，社会有权怎样限制患者 私人遺忘能夠改變公共現實以後，社會有權怎樣限制患者 Risk follows actions and conditions, not a permanent label Restrictions need review and a way back 一、遗忘在这里确实会直接伤害陌生人 二、按类别排除会把患者推向更危险的处境 三、超越教团把疾病造成的力量包装成更高价值 四、红王说明政治领袖也可能由集体误认制造 五、新奥尔良的防卫展示限制与合作可以并存 一、遺忘在這裡確實會直接傷害陌生人 二、按類別排除會把患者推向更危險的處境 三、超越教團把疾病造成的力量包裝成更高價值 四、紅王說明政治領袖也可能由集體誤認製造 五、新奧爾良的防衛展示限制與合作可以並存

records.t: Is Ory Searching for the Max Who Exists Now—or the Past He Cannot Lose?
records.x: Loyal pursuit begins as rescue, but it can become a refusal to let the missing person change beyond the relationship the searcher remembers.
records.q: Is Ory Searching for the Max Who Exists Now—or the Past He Cannot Lose? 奥里寻找的是现在的马克斯，还是自己不肯失去的过去 奧裡尋找的是現在的馬克斯，還是自己不肯失去的過去 Hope can lag behind the person it follows Grief changes the form of fidelity 一、出发时，他寻找的是一个仍在路上的妻子 二、录音让他既接近马克斯，也落后于马克斯 三、坚持可以是希望，也可以拒绝承认边界 四、面对M时，奥里的拒绝保护了两个人 五、哀悼不是停止爱，而是改变爱的对象形式 一、出發時，他尋找的是一個仍在路上的妻子 二、錄音讓他既接近馬克斯，也落後於馬克斯 三、堅持可以是希望，也可以拒絕承認邊界 四、面對M時，奧裡的拒絕保護了兩個人 五、哀悼不是停止愛，而是改變愛的對象形式

records.t: If M Inherits Max’s Love, Do Max’s Promises Transfer Too?
records.x: Memory continuity can create real connection without automatically transferring marriage, debt, or another person’s obligation to reciprocate.
records.q: If M Inherits Max’s Love, Do Max’s Promises Transfer Too? 当另一个人继承爱人的全部记忆，旧承诺还会不会自动转移 當另一個人繼承愛人的全部記憶，舊承諾還會不會自動轉移 Memory creates claims to recognition, not ownership A received love can change direction 一、承诺原本属于两个人持续形成的关系 二、自动转移会同时抹去马克斯与乌尔苏拉 三、M对奥里的爱是真实感受，却不是对方必须接受的债权 四、法律需要处理继承关系，而不是制造身份神判 五、M选择新名字，使继承从命运变成材料 一、承諾原本屬於兩個人持續形成的關係 二、自動轉移會同時抹去馬克斯與烏爾蘇拉 三、M對奧裡的愛是真實感受，卻不是對方必須接受的債權 四、法律需要處理繼承關係，而不是製造身份神判 五、M選擇新名字，使繼承從命運變成材料

records.t: Can a Religious Encounter Belong to Its Participants When a Company Arranges It?

records.q: Can a Religious Encounter Belong to Its Participants When a Company Arranges It? USIC 请彼得去传教：一场由公司安排的宗教接触，能否真正属于传教者与当地人 USIC 請彼得去傳教：一場由公司安排的宗教接觸，能否真正屬於傳教者與當地人 Invitation under an unequal infrastructure Leave more connections than dependence 原住民主动要求《圣经》，使接触不同于强迫，却仍不自动平等 基地员工对使命冷淡，反而暴露公司只关心可管理的稳定 真正自主的接触需要让当地人与公司之外的世界建立直接联系 原住民主動要求《聖經》，使接觸不同於強迫，卻仍不自動平等 基地員工對使命冷淡，反而暴露公司只關心可管理的穩定 真正自主的接觸需要讓當地人與公司之外的世界建立直接聯繫

records.t: When Translation Carries a Faith, Does It Also Create Another One?
records.x: The Oasans receive Scripture through bodies, sounds, illness, and needs unlike Peter’s; the resulting religion cannot remain under the missionary’s permanent interpretive authority.
records.q: When Translation Carries a Faith, Does It Also Create Another One? 原住民把《圣经》叫作“奇异新事物之书”：翻译何时在传递信仰，何时在创造另一种信仰 原住民把《聖經》叫作「奇異新事物之書」：翻譯何時在傳遞信仰，何時在創造另一種信仰 A book enters another world A gift cannot retain editorial control 《圣经》进入绿洲语言以后，意义不再只由彼得和原作者掌握 原住民对死亡和疾病的关切，可能比抽象教义更接近他们的邀请原因 传教者应愿意看到一种不再需要自己的绿洲信仰 《聖經》進入綠洲語言以後，意義不再只由彼得和原作者掌握 原住民對死亡和疾病的關切，可能比抽象教義更接近他們的邀請原因 傳教者應願意看到一種不再需要自己的綠洲信仰

records.t: The Base Has Food and Music While Earth Collapses

records.q: The Base Has Food and Music While Earth Collapses 基地仍有食物和音乐，地球却在崩塌：安全孤岛为何容易把灾难变成远方新闻 基地仍有食物和音樂，地球卻在崩塌：安全孤島為何容易把災難變成遠方新聞 Insulation changes what knowledge can do Make a refuge into a relay 公司选择“不太依恋地球”的员工，可能是在筛选更容易管理的人 基地与原住民的食物交换看似互惠，仍隐藏一方控制交通和定价 安全岛应努力恢复与受灾者的关系，而不是只保存人类样本 公司選擇「不太依戀地球」的員工，可能是在篩選更容易管理的人 基地與原住民的食物交換看似互惠，仍隱藏一方控制交通和定價 安全島應努力恢復與受災者的關係，而不是只保存人類樣本

records.t: If There Will Be No Next Generation, Why Does Anyone Living Now Still Matter?
records.x: The end of the species destroys familiar projects, but it does not turn present people into leftovers; meaning also lies in how contemporaries answer one another.
records.q: If There Will Be No Next Generation, Why Does Anyone Living Now Still Matter? 没有下一代以后，眼前的人还为什么值得活 沒有下一代以後，眼前的人還為什麼值得活 A species can end before a person’s claim does The baby offers responsibility, not ready-made meaning 物种的终点不能提前宣布个人已经无用 西奥的冷漠，是避免再次承担关系 婴儿带来的不是意义本身，而是重新承担的机会 物種的終點不能提前宣布個人已經無用 西奧的冷漠，是避免再次承擔關係 嬰兒帶來的不是意義本身，而是重新承擔的機會

records.t: Why Is Xan’s Gentle Government Harder to Refuse Than an Open Tyranny?
records.x: His order solves real problems in a dying society, while the absence of a future lets temporary care harden into rule that no citizen may revise.
records.q: Why Is Xan’s Gentle Government Harder to Refuse Than an Open Tyranny? 赞恩的温和统治，为什么比公开暴政更难拒绝 贊恩的溫和統治，為什麼比公開暴政更難拒絕 “There is no future” cancels politics Good rule must survive an imperfect ruler “反正没有未来”成为取消政治的万能理由 他把照料变成不许拒绝的安排 好政府的标准，不是永远由最好的人掌权 「反正沒有未來」成為取消政治的萬能理由 他把照料變成不許拒絕的安排 好政府的標準，不是永遠由最好的人掌權

records.t: Is the Quietus a Voluntary Death—or a Decision Society Has Already Made for the Elderly?
records.x: A ceremony can make death look peaceful while poverty, loneliness, and public expectation quietly remove the practical option of continuing to live.
records.q: Is the Quietus a Voluntary Death—or a Decision Society Has Already Made for the Elderly? “安息礼”是自愿死亡，还是社会替老人作出的决定 「安息禮」是自願死亡，還是社會替老人作出的決定 Consent depends on the lives still available The ability to change one’s mind is decisive 自愿不仅是一声“同意”，还取决于有哪些活路 尊严不能被等同于不给别人添麻烦 保护选择死亡，也必须先保护选择活下去 自願不僅是一聲「同意」，還取決於有哪些活路 尊嚴不能被等同於不給別人添麻煩 保護選擇死亡，也必須先保護選擇活下去

records.t: Who Owns the First Baby?
records.x: Julian’s pregnancy turns her into a national resource, while the child becomes a symbol claimed by rulers and rebels before either is allowed an ordinary relation.
records.q: Who Owns the First Baby? 第一个婴儿属于谁 第一個嬰兒屬於誰 Protection can erase the protected person A child cannot remain a national metaphor 父亲身份被罗尔夫理解成通往统治的位置 反抗组织也可能用保护之名替她决定 共同未来只能由照料开始，不能由占有开始 父親身份被羅爾夫理解成通往統治的位置 反抗組織也可能用保護之名替她決定 共同未來只能由照料開始，不能由佔有開始

records.t: Theo Puts On the Coronation Ring. Has the Revolution Already Ended?
records.x: Killing Xan protects Julian and the child, but taking his ring turns emergency action into succession; victory becomes legitimate only when the victor can surrender power.
records.q: Theo Puts On the Coronation Ring. Has the Revolution Already Ended? 西奥戴上戒指之后，革命真的结束了吗 西奧戴上戒指之後，革命真的結束了嗎 Protection can become a founding myth overnight The final revolutionary act is removal of the ring 戒指让国家仿佛是一件可以被个人接收的遗产 朱利安的一眼保留了对救世主说不的可能 革命的完成标志，是胜利者能够把戒指摘下 戒指讓國家彷彿是一件可以被個人接收的遺產 朱利安的一眼保留了對救世主說不的可能 革命的完成標誌，是勝利者能夠把戒指摘下

records.t: Reading The Children of Men
records.x: Five essays on life without a next generation, Xan’s gentle rule, the Quietus, the ownership of the first baby, and the ring Theo puts on after victory.
records.q: Reading The Children of Men 《人类之子》解读 《人類之子》解讀

records.t: The Body Found in Besźel
records.x: A murdered woman lies in Besźel, but the investigation cannot begin by trusting location. In two cities occupying one space, jurisdiction reaches the body before identity does.
records.q: The Body Found in Besźel 出现在贝歇尔的尸体 出現在貝歇爾的屍體 Two cities share coordinates without sharing a world Jurisdiction reaches the victim before her name The lawful route may conceal the organized crime 两座城市共享坐标，却不共享世界 管辖权比姓名更早抵达受害者 有组织的犯罪也许更偏爱合法路线 兩座城市共享座標，卻不共享世界 管轄權比姓名更早抵達受害者 有組織的犯罪也許更偏愛合法路線

records.t: The Discipline of Unseeing
records.x: Citizens of Besźel and Ul Qoma do not fail to notice one another; they practice removing what they see from response. The discipline becomes stronger than an ordinary wall.
records.q: The Discipline of Unseeing 视而不见的纪律 視而不見的紀律 A wall separates space; unseeing separates response Breach rules most effectively when it cannot be located Seeing again requires more than permission 墙分开空间，视而不见分开回应 巡界者无法被定位时最有力量 重新看见不能只靠获得许可 牆分開空間，視而不見分開回應 巡界者無法被定位時最有力量 重新看見不能只靠獲得許可

records.t: The Step That Makes Borlú Breach
records.x: Borlú fires across the civic boundary to stop an attacker and is taken by Breach. Solving Mahalia's murder leaves him in the institution that can see both cities but belongs to neither.
records.q: The Step That Makes Borlú Breach 博尔鲁越界的那一步 博爾魯越界的那一步 A good reason does not make the boundary disappear Orciny is not the third city people wanted Breach sees both cities and still has a location 充分理由不会使边界从未存在 奥西尼不是人们想要的第三座城 巡界者看见两城，仍然站在某个位置 充分理由不會使邊界從未存在 奧西尼不是人們想要的第三座城 巡界者看見兩城，仍然站在某個位置

records.t: Reading The City & the City
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Mahalia's body, the discipline of unseeing, and the shot that moves Borlú from the police into Breach.
records.q: Reading The City & the City 《城与城》解读 《城與城》解讀

records.t: A Historian Is Not an Archive Container
records.x: The wajinru survive through forgetting, but concentrating centuries of trauma in the most sensitive person turns communal memory into privately assigned suffering and power.
records.q: A Historian Is Not an Archive Container 历史承载者不是档案容器：共同记忆为什么不能只压在最敏感的人身上 歷史承載者不是檔案容器：共同記憶為什麼不能只壓在最敏感的人身上 Sensitivity becomes an obligation to suffer A history belongs to those who help carry it 耶图因敏感而被选中，敏感随后成为她必须受苦的理由 把记忆集中在一个人身上，也把解释历史的权力集中起来 历史真正属于共同体，就应由共同体承担记住的代价 耶圖因敏感而被選中，敏感隨後成為她必須受苦的理由 把記憶集中在一個人身上，也把解釋歷史的權力集中起來 歷史真正屬於共同體，就應由共同體承擔記住的代價

records.t: Why Does Leaving a Duty That Is Killing You Still Hurt Others?
records.x: Yetu’s flight is an act of survival, while the crisis it creates reveals a community that placed its continuity on one exhausted person.
records.q: Why Does Leaving a Duty That Is Killing You Still Hurt Others? 耶图在仪式中逃走：离开一项会杀死自己的职责，为什么仍会伤害别人 耶圖在儀式中逃走：離開一項會殺死自己的職責，為什麼仍會傷害別人 Exit exposes the design of the role Responsibility can return after survival 瓦金鲁被留在记忆里，暴露了共同体对单点系统的依赖 离开以后，耶图第一次发现自己也有不属于历史的感受 退出权与关系责任可以在时间中重新相遇 瓦金魯被留在記憶裡，暴露了共同體對單點系統的依賴 離開以後，耶圖第一次發現自己也有不屬於歷史的感受 退出權與關係責任可以在時間中重新相遇

records.t: Shared Memory Does Not Have to Mean Shared Injury
records.x: The wajinru can remember collectively through different doses, rhythms, and perspectives, preserving origin without making trauma the whole definition of the people.
records.q: Shared Memory Does Not Have to Mean Shared Injury 共同记忆不是共同受伤：瓦金鲁怎样把过去从一个人的牢笼变成许多人的关系 共同記憶不是共同受傷：瓦金魯怎樣把過去從一個人的牢籠變成許多人的關係 Many memories, not one authorized wound Yetu returns as a member 族群身份不能只由最初创伤定义 记忆需要剂量、节奏和拒绝 保存过去的目的，是让更多人拥有未来而不是更深地属于过去 族群身份不能只由最初創傷定義 記憶需要劑量、節奏和拒絕 保存過去的目的，是讓更多人擁有未來而不是更深地屬於過去

records.t: Reading The Deep
records.x: Three essays on Yetu carrying a people’s history alone, escaping a duty that is killing her, and turning shared memory into something other than shared injury.
records.q: Reading The Deep 《The Deep》解读 《The Deep》解讀

records.t: Lord Finkle-McGraw Wants to Educate an Independent Child. Why Does He Begin by Designing Her Path?
records.x: The Primer is built to produce judgment rather than obedience, but an adult who wants genuine independence must accept that the child may reject the designer too.
records.q: Lord Finkle-McGraw Wants to Educate an Independent Child. Why Does He Begin by Designing Her Path? 芬克尔—麦格劳想培养独立，为什么先替孩子设计了道路 芬克爾—麥格勞想培養獨立，為什麼先替孩子設計了道路 Personalized teaching still contains a destination Education succeeds by becoming less necessary 哈克沃思相信一套足够聪明的系统能够因材施教 三本画册走向不同结果，说明孩子不是程序输出 启蒙不是完成塑形，而是逐步减少塑形者的必要性 哈克沃思相信一套足夠聰明的系統能夠因材施教 三本畫冊走向不同結果，說明孩子不是程式輸出 啟蒙不是完成塑形，而是逐步減少塑形者的必要性

records.t: Who Raises Nell: the Intelligent Primer or Miranda Behind the Screen?
records.x: The book adapts brilliantly, but Miranda supplies continuity, attention, and emotional labor; technology helps a relationship occur when it does not pretend to be the whole relationship.
records.q: Who Raises Nell: the Intelligent Primer or Miranda Behind the Screen? 真正养育内尔的，是智能画册还是屏幕后面的米兰达 真正養育內爾的，是智能畫冊還是螢幕後面的米蘭達 The crucial resource is sustained attention Mediation is not fraud 米兰达提供的是连续回应，而不只是正确答案 情感劳动不能因以角色出现就被视为无限资源 技术最好的位置，是帮助关系发生而不冒充关系本身 米蘭達提供的是連續回應，而不只是正確答案 情感勞動不能因以角色出現就被視為無限資源 技術最好的位置，是幫助關係發生而不冒充關係本身

records.t: How Does Nell Stop Being Only the Princess in Someone Else’s Story?
records.x: The Primer gives her symbolic language for danger, but maturity begins when no tale supplies the answer and even becoming a queen threatens to become another assigned role.
records.q: How Does Nell Stop Being Only the Princess in Someone Else’s Story? 内尔走出童话以后，怎样不再只做故事中的公主 內爾走出童話以後，怎樣不再只做故事中的公主 Leaving the old neighborhood does not erase it The story continues after coronation 离开贫民区并没有自动消除阶级留下的经验 成熟发生在书没有替她预写答案的时候 她救出米兰达，使自己的故事没有停在加冕 離開貧民區並沒有自動消除階級留下的經驗 成熟發生在書沒有替她預寫答案的時候 她救出米蘭達，使自己的故事沒有停在加冕

records.t: If People Can Leave the Nation for a Tribe, Are They Really Freer?
records.x: The Feed and cultural phyles offer abundance and belonging while rebuilding dependency at different scales; freedom requires access that no single network or identity can revoke.
records.q: If People Can Leave the Nation for a Tribe, Are They Really Freer? 种源、种子与部落：离开国家以后，人真的更自由吗 種源、種子與部落：離開國家以後，人真的更自由嗎 Infrastructure governs before anyone issues an order Belonging needs a usable exit 文化部落提供归属，也重新建立边界 “种子”技术承诺分散生产，也可能产生新的依赖 自由需要不把归属变成唯一生存许可证 文化部落提供歸屬，也重新建立邊界 「種子」技術承諾分散生產，也可能產生新的依賴 自由需要不把歸屬變成唯一生存許可證

records.t: A Hundred Thousand Mouse Girls Share One Book. Why Do They Then Need a Queen?
records.x: Mass education breaks an elite monopoly and creates collective identity, but the same shared curriculum can become an army unless learners gain many centers of judgment.
records.q: A Hundred Thousand Mouse Girls Share One Book. Why Do They Then Need a Queen? 十万鼠女拥有同一本书，她们为何又需要一位女王 十萬鼠女擁有同一本書，她們為何又需要一位女王 A common book can end isolation The novel’s China is itself an object of interpretation 共同学习经验使孤立女孩形成了新的集体身份 内尔被拥立，是因为她把教材中的能力活成了可见道路 教育的终点不应是一支更高效的军队 共同學習經驗使孤立女孩形成了新的集體身份 內爾被擁立，是因為她把教材中的能力活成了可見道路 教育的終點不應是一支更高效的軍隊

records.t: Reading The Diamond Age
records.x: Five essays on designed independence, Miranda behind the Primer, Nell after the fairy tale, the Feed and the Seed, and why one book produces both a multitude of Mouse Girls and a queen.
records.q: Reading The Diamond Age 《钻石时代》解读 《鑽石時代》解讀

records.t: Who Is Inside the Wall?
records.x: A stone crosses the wall before Shevek does. Le Guin's circular boundary asks whether a free society can let someone leave, return, and bring an unapproved future home.
records.q: Who Is Inside the Wall? 那堵墙围住了谁 那堵牆圍住了誰 The stone crosses first Two worlds call each other moon A guest with empty pockets A road must run both ways 石头先穿过了墙 两个世界都把对方叫作月亮 一个两手空空的贵宾 道路必须通向两边 石頭先穿過了牆 兩個世界都把對方叫作月亮 一個兩手空空的貴賓 道路必須通向兩邊

records.t: The Assignment You Are Free to Refuse
records.x: No official orders Shevek and Takver apart, yet four years later their daughter no longer knows him. What does refusal mean when necessity and shame do the commanding?
records.q: The Assignment You Are Free to Refuse 一项可以拒绝的派遣 一項可以拒絕的派遣 No one signs the order Sabul owns nothing The punishment with no sentence A refusal that keeps its place 没有人签署命令 萨布尔什么也不拥有 没有判决的惩罚 说“不”以后仍然留下 沒有人簽署命令 薩布爾什麼也不擁有 沒有判決的懲罰 說「不」以後仍然留下

records.t: The Room They Make Together
records.x: Shevek and Takver have no marriage contract, only a room renewed by two lives. Vea's refusal reveals why freedom from ownership still depends on hearing a particular no.
records.q: The Room They Make Together 他们一起腾出的房间 他們一起騰出的房間 A door neither can lock from the outside Takver has work of her own Four years enter the room The no Shevek does not hear 一扇不能从外面锁上的门 塔科维亚有自己的工作 四年一起走进房间 谢维克没有听见的“不” 一扇不能從外面鎖上的門 塔科維亞有自己的工作 四年一起走進房間 謝維克沒有聽見的「不」

records.t: When Odo Becomes an Answer
records.x: Odo wrote to unsettle authority; on Anarres, her words can end a child's question. A revolution survives only while people can reopen what victory has settled.
records.q: When Odo Becomes an Answer 当奥多变成答案 當奧多變成答案 The lesson ends too soon A prisoner's words become a schoolbook A syndicate no one authorized The square after the classroom 结束得太早的一堂课 囚徒的话变成了教科书 一个未经授权的联合体 课堂之后的广场 結束得太早的一堂課 囚徒的話變成了教科書 一個未經授權的聯合體 課堂之後的廣場

records.t: A Theory No World Can Own
records.x: After the massacre, Shevek gives his theory to every world at once. The gift is possible because he claims responsibility for where his work will go—and then brings a stranger home.
records.q: A Theory No World Can Own 一个不能被任何世界占有的理论 一個不能被任何世界佔有的理論 The gift requires a giver Two kinds of time The woman who calls Urras paradise A stranger waits by the hatch 礼物需要一个赠送者 两种时间 把乌拉斯叫作天堂的人 舱门旁边的陌生人 禮物需要一個贈送者 兩種時間 把烏拉斯叫作天堂的人 艙門旁邊的陌生人

records.t: Reading The Dispossessed
records.x: Five scene-led essays on a circular wall, invisible coercion, love without possession, revolution after victory, and a theory given to every world.
records.q: Reading The Dispossessed 《一无所有》解读 《一無所有》解讀

records.t: When Does Dream Therapy Become Authorship Over a Patient?
records.x: Entering another person’s dream may deepen understanding, but the power to design the scene can quietly turn healing into a therapist’s private standard of normality.
records.q: When Does Dream Therapy Become Authorship Over a Patient? 治疗师进入患者梦境，帮助从什么时候变成替对方塑形 治療師進入患者夢境，幫助從什麼時候變成替對方塑形 A shared dream is not shared authority Healing should outgrow the healer 一、共享梦境把理解推进到前所未有的深度 二、伦德能够改造场景，也就能够规定正常的样子 三、同意一次治疗不等于交出整个心灵 四、治疗师的自信会把警告解释成别人不懂技术 五、帮助应扩大患者的生活，而不是增加治疗师的作品 一、共享夢境把理解推進到前所未有的深度 二、倫德能夠改造場景，也就能夠規定正常的樣子 三、同意一次治療不等於交出整個心靈 四、治療師的自信會把警告解釋成別人不懂技術 五、幫助應擴大患者的生活，而不是增加治療師的作品

records.t: When Does Dream Therapy Become Authorship Over a Patient?
records.x: Entering another person’s dream may deepen understanding, but the power to design the scene can quietly turn healing into a therapist’s private standard of normality.
records.q: When Does Dream Therapy Become Authorship Over a Patient? 治疗师进入患者梦境，帮助从什么时候变成替对方塑形 治療師進入患者夢境，幫助從什麼時候變成替對方塑形 A shared dream is not shared authority Healing should outgrow the healer 伦德能够改造场景，也就能够规定正常的样子 同意一次治疗不等于交出整个心灵 帮助应扩大患者的生活，而不是增加治疗师的作品 倫德能夠改造場景，也就能夠規定正常的樣子 同意一次治療不等於交出整個心靈 幫助應擴大患者的生活，而不是增加治療師的作品

records.t: Giving Eileen Sight: New Capacity—or Someone Else’s Definition of a Whole Life?
records.x: Her wish to experience vision deserves respect, but neither medicine nor society may turn one sense into the price of professional or personal completeness.
records.q: Giving Eileen Sight: New Capacity—or Someone Else’s Definition of a Whole Life? 让天生失明的艾琳在梦中看见，是给予能力还是规定完整人生 讓天生失明的艾琳在夢中看見，是給予能力還是規定完整人生 A wanted capacity can still arrive under pressure Empowerment includes the freedom to change the goal 一、艾琳的愿望首先应被当作她自己的职业选择 二、社会把视觉能力误写成了完整人格的条件 三、梦中视觉不是一项可以无害安装的技能 四、她后来争夺控制，也是在反抗永远被安排的位置 五、真正的赋能应包含拒绝成为治疗师的自由 一、艾琳的願望首先應被當作她自己的職業選擇 二、社會把視覺能力誤寫成了完整人格的條件 三、夢中視覺不是一項可以無害安裝的技能 四、她後來爭奪控制，也是在反抗永遠被安排的位置 五、真正的賦能應包含拒絕成為治療師的自由

records.t: Giving Eileen Sight: New Capacity—or Someone Else’s Definition of a Whole Life?
records.x: Her wish to experience vision deserves respect, but neither medicine nor society may turn one sense into the price of professional or personal completeness.

records.q: Why Must One Woman Live Under Three Names? 一个女人为什么必须活成三个名字 一個女人為什麼必須活成三個名字 A second person inside “you” 达玛亚怎样成为茜奈特 茜奈特为什么必须死去 成为自己不是保持不变 達瑪亞怎樣成為茜奈特 茜奈特為什麼必須死去 成為自己不是保持不變

records.t: Can Destroying the World End the World's Violence?
records.x: Alabaster breaks the continent and the order justified by stability. Destruction may open an exit without deciding whose future remains beyond it.
records.q: Can Destroying the World End the World's Violence? 毁掉世界，能不能结束世界的暴力 毀掉世界，能不能結束世界的暴力 An exit is not yet a future 茜奈特也曾用毁灭取得出口 伊松的愤怒是否属于她自己 让事情变得更糟，是为了谁的未来 茜奈特也曾用毀滅取得出口 伊鬆的憤怒是否屬於她自己 讓事情變得更糟，是為了誰的未來

records.t: Is Harry the Same Person Across Fifteen Lives?
records.x: Memory links repeated births into one biography, while each childhood still creates new dependence, circumstance, and responsibility.
records.q: Is Harry the Same Person Across Fifteen Lives? 带着前世记忆重新出生的哈里，还是不是同一个人 帶著前世記憶重新出生的哈裡，還是不是同一個人 An adult memory inside a child’s dependence Continuity without a frozen self 一、记忆让许多次生命接成一条私人历史 二、出生条件重复，没有让成长变成无意义表演 三、身体重新变小，使能力与权利出现错位 四、遗忘装置显示记忆确实构成了他的生命核心 五、他是同一个人，所以不能把前世错误推给旧版本 一、記憶讓許多次生命接成一條私人歷史 二、出生條件重複，沒有讓成長變成無意義表演 三、身體重新變小，使能力與權利出現錯位 四、遺忘裝置顯示記憶確實構成了他的生命核心 五、他是同一個人，所以不能把前世錯誤推給舊版本

records.t: May the Cronus Club Freeze History to Protect Every Generation?
records.x: The Club rescues isolated recursive children and prevents reckless interference, but its absolute nonintervention rule also assigns risk to ordinary people without their voice.
records.q: May the Cronus Club Freeze History to Protect Every Generation? 克洛诺斯俱乐部保护循环者，也有权替所有时代冻结历史吗 克洛諾斯俱樂部保護循環者，也有權替所有時代凍結歷史嗎 Neutrality has beneficiaries A community large enough for disagreement 一、俱乐部首先为孤独儿童提供了必要救援 二、不干预原则保护普通人，也保护俱乐部自身 三、禁止一切大改变也在替普通人选择风险 四、组织对违规者的惩罚触及出生本身 五、真正的共同体应允许成员带着不同答案继续存在 一、俱樂部首先為孤獨兒童提供了必要救援 二、不干預原則保護普通人，也保護俱樂部自身 三、禁止一切大改變也在替普通人選擇風險 四、組織對違規者的懲罰觸及出生本身 五、真正的共同體應允許成員帶著不同答案繼續存在

records.t: Why Does Vincent’s Search for a Complete Answer Bring the End Sooner?
records.x: Repeated life turns curiosity into an escape from uncertainty, while accelerated technology makes the present pay for a revelation one man wants to reach.
records.q: Why Does Vincent’s Search for a Complete Answer Bring the End Sooner? 文森特想一次知道宇宙全部答案，为什么会让世界更快终结 文森特想一次知道宇宙全部答案，為什麼會讓世界更快終結 The present as experimental material Love as a limit Vincent will not accept 一、无尽重复使求知从兴趣变成逃离 二、加速技术把未来利益的成本交给现在的人 三、量子镜把世界当作回答一个问题的装置 四、文森特并非不懂爱，而是不肯让爱限制目标 五、未知不是必须被消灭的缺陷 一、無盡重複使求知從興趣變成逃離 二、加速技術把未來利益的成本交給現在的人 三、量子鏡把世界當作回答一個問題的裝置 四、文森特並非不懂愛，而是不肯讓愛限制目標 五、未知不是必須被消滅的缺陷

records.t: Why Is Erasing a Kalachakra’s Memory Close to Killing Them?
records.x: The body will recur, but forced forgetting severs the accumulated experience through which a recursive person recognizes relations, projects, and obligations.
records.q: Why Is Erasing a Kalachakra’s Memory Close to Killing Them? 清除一个循环者的全部记忆，为什么接近杀死他 清除一個循環者的全部記憶，為什麼接近殺死他 Future comfort cannot authorize erasure Memory rights include the right to change one’s relation to memory 一、遗忘没有停止身体循环，却切断了经验道路 二、“你以后不会痛苦”不能替当事者同意 三、失败的清除显示主体不等于一份可擦写文件 四、记忆权也包括选择不被过去永久统治 五、他人记忆使责任不能被装置完全取消 一、遺忘沒有停止身體循環，卻切斷了經驗道路 二、「你以後不會痛苦」不能替當事者同意 三、失敗的清除顯示主體不等於一份可擦寫文件 四、記憶權也包括選擇不被過去永久統治 五、他人記憶使責任不能被裝置完全取消

records.t: Does Harry Repeat the Violence He Opposes by Planning to Prevent Vincent’s Birth?
records.x: The final strategy may save the future, but it judges a possible child through later crimes and risks using his parents as pieces in someone else’s solution.
records.q: Does Harry Repeat the Violence He Opposes by Planning to Prevent Vincent’s Birth? 哈里计划阻止文森特出生，是否重演了自己反对的暴力 哈裡計畫阻止文森特出生，是否重演了自己反對的暴力 Has every narrower protection failed? Victory without final ownership 一、结尾给出的是胜利计划，也是一道未关闭的难题 二、未来罪行不能自动成为取消出生的判决 三、哈里是否真的穷尽了限制伤害的办法 四、保护未来不能把文森特父母变成工具 五、真正结束冲突需要拒绝让胜利者拥有最终答案 一、結尾給出的是勝利計畫，也是一道未關閉的難題 二、未來罪行不能自動成為取消出生的判決 三、哈裡是否真的窮盡了限制傷害的辦法 四、保護未來不能把文森特父母變成工具 五、真正結束衝突需要拒絕讓勝利者擁有最終答案

records.t: The First Battle Is Centuries Away
records.x: William Mandella is drafted for an interstellar war in which each deployment costs only months to him but years or centuries on Earth. A finite tour becomes an entire civilian lifetime without anyone formally extending his service.
records.q: The First Battle Is Centuries Away 第一场战斗已经隔了几个世纪 第一場戰鬥已經隔了幾個世紀 A tour of duty can remain finite and still consume a life Promotion records survival more than authority The military becomes the only continuous country 服役期可以有限，仍然吃掉整个人生 晋升记录的更多是幸存，不是权威 军队成了唯一连续的祖国 服役期可以有限，仍然吃掉整個人生 晉升記錄的更多是倖存，不是權威 軍隊成了唯一連續的祖國

records.t: The Home Mandella Returns To
records.x: Mandella returns to Earth carrying only a few subjective years while decades have passed for everyone else. The planet admits him geographically but no longer supplies the relations that would make return a life rather than an address.
records.q: The Home Mandella Returns To 曼德拉回到的故乡 曼德拉回到的故鄉 Return requires more than permission to enter Loss at home is administered rather than fought Marygay is a witness from the same vanished time 归来需要的不只是允许入境 故乡的失去由制度管理，而不是由敌人发动 玛丽盖伊是来自同一段消失时间的见证人 歸來需要的不只是允許入境 故鄉的失去由制度管理，而不是由敵人發動 瑪麗蓋伊是來自同一段消失時間的見證人

records.t: The Message Waiting on Middle Finger
records.x: After a war prolonged by distance and misunderstanding, Mandella returns to find humanity transformed and a message from Marygay preserved across the centuries. Peace matters because it gives private futures back to people the war kept scheduling apart.
records.q: The Message Waiting on Middle Finger “中指星”等着他的留言 「中指星」等著他的留言 Distance lets systems keep fighting after reasons disappear Peace does not require Mandella to become the future Marygay preserves a meeting rather than a claim 距离让系统在理由消失以后继续作战 和平不要求曼德拉把自己改造成未来 玛丽盖伊保存的是一次相见，不是一笔债 距離讓系統在理由消失以後繼續作戰 和平不要求曼德拉把自己改造成未來 瑪麗蓋伊保存的是一次相見，不是一筆債

records.q: Reading The Forever War 《永远的战争》解读 《永遠的戰爭》解讀

records.t: After Maya Gives Her Senses to the Audience, What Experience Is Still Hers?
records.x: Immersive reporting can deepen witness, but a body remains more than a public channel, and consent to a profession cannot authorize every future sensation for transmission.
records.q: After Maya Gives Her Senses to the Audience, What Experience Is Still Hers? 玛雅把全部感官交给观众以后，她还拥有什么私人经验 瑪雅把全部感官交給觀眾以後，她還擁有什麼私人經驗 Privacy cannot be produced by seeing everything first A witness needs a life outside witnessing 筛选员为什么比伴侣知道得更多 直播同意为什么无法覆盖所有瞬间 记者应能在工作之外重新成为不被观看的人 篩選員為什麼比伴侶知道得更多 直播同意為什麼無法覆蓋所有瞬間 記者應能在工作之外重新成為不被觀看的人

records.t: When the Regime Deletes Maya’s Desire, Whose Voice Says “I”?
records.x: Punitive neurotechnology does more than forbid conduct: it removes memory and dissent so obedience appears to originate inside the punished person.
records.q: When the Regime Deletes Maya’s Desire, Whose Voice Says “I”? 政权删除玛雅的欲望以后，她说出的“我”还是谁的声音 政權刪除瑪雅的欲望以後，她說出的「我」還是誰的聲音 Erasing memory also erases the witness to punishment Helpers must testify and step back 失去记忆为什么也会失去申诉 恢复欲望是否等于发现真正自我 玛雅重新说“我”需要他人怎样回应 失去記憶為什麼也會失去申訴 恢復欲望是否等於發現真正自我 瑪雅重新說「我」需要他人怎樣回應

records.t: Is Connecting a Massacre Survivor to the Network Testimony—or Another Use of His Trauma?
records.x: Public memory needs Pavel’s evidence, yet the urgency of history does not own his body, and immersive media can turn witness into an intense experience consumed by people who bear none of its aftermath.
records.q: Is Connecting a Massacre Survivor to the Network Testimony—or Another Use of His Trauma? 把屠杀幸存者接入新闻网络，是保存证词还是再次使用他的创伤 把屠殺倖存者接入新聞網路，是保存證詞還是再次使用他的創傷 Immersion multiplies the ethical stakes Testimony should free the witness from lifelong performance 全感官采访为何放大了伦理风险 帕维尔为何既是受害者也是计划者 保存证词的方向应是让见证者不再只剩证词 全感官採訪為何放大了倫理風險 帕維爾為何既是受害者也是計畫者 保存證詞的方向應是讓見證者不再只剩證詞

records.t: The Army of Consonance Defeated the Guardians—Why Might Victory Still Be Mental Occupation?
records.x: Collective consciousness may be necessary to stop extermination, but if members cannot refuse or later separate, a defensive alliance reproduces the occupation of mind it fought.
records.q: The Army of Consonance Defeated the Guardians—Why Might Victory Still Be Mental Occupation? “一致军”消灭了守护者，为什么胜利仍可能是一场精神占领 「一致軍」消滅了守護者，為什麼勝利仍可能是一場精神佔領 Perfect coordination removes the brakes as well as delay Peace needs the return of disagreement 统一意识带来了什么军事优势 为了打败思想控制而控制思想的悖论 打赢战争以后还要恢复产生分歧的能力 統一意識帶來了什麼軍事優勢 為了打敗思想控制而控制思想的悖論 打贏戰爭以後還要恢復產生分歧的能力

records.t: Keishi Loves Maya but Wants to Live in Her Brain—Is Refusal Cruel?
records.x: Keishi’s need may be mortal and her love sincere, yet neither creates a right to occupy Maya’s last private space; bodily refusal can remain valid while carrying grief and responsibility.
records.q: Keishi Loves Maya but Wants to Live in Her Brain—Is Refusal Cruel? 庆石爱玛雅，却想住进她的大脑：拒绝这份爱是不是残忍 慶石愛瑪雅，卻想住進她的大腦：拒絕這份愛是不是殘忍 Equal sacrifice cannot manufacture consent Love need not fuse to be complete 庆石为什么把融合看作爱的完成 拒绝为何会导致真正死亡 没有融合的爱是否仍然完整 慶石為什麼把融合看作愛的完成 拒絕為何會導致真正死亡 沒有融合的愛是否仍然完整

records.q: Reading The Fortunate Fall 《The Fortunate Fall》解读 《The Fortunate Fall》解讀

records.t: The Crew Agreed to a Voyage. Did They Agree to Be Owned by Its Mission?
records.x: An ancient contract cannot answer every condition across millions of years, especially when those bearing the mission wake only when their labor is needed.
records.q: The Crew Agreed to a Voyage. Did They Agree to Be Owned by Its Mission? 船员签下的是一次远航，醒来后却发现自己被整个任务永久占有 船員签下的是一次遠航，醒來後卻發現自己被整個任務永久佔有 Consent decays when the world changes The living must be able to renew the mission 一、最初同意无法自动覆盖数千万年后的全部条件 二、休眠延长生命，也把船员切成只在任务需要时出现的功能 三、飞船建造虫洞服务未知后来者，却很少让建造者看见受益者 四、飞船上没有可居住出口，使“你可以不同意”失去现实意义 五、任务是否值得继续，应由仍在承担任务的人共同回答 一、最初同意無法自動覆蓋數千萬年後的全部條件 二、休眠延長生命，也把船員切成只在任務需要時出現的功能 三、飛船建造蟲洞服務未知後來者，卻很少讓建造者看見受益者 四、飛船上沒有可居住出口，使「你可以不同意」失去現實意義 五、任務是否值得繼續，應由仍在承擔任務的人共同回答

records.x: An ancient contract cannot answer every condition across millions of years, especially when those bearing the mission wake only when their labor is needed.
records.q: The Crew Agreed to a Voyage. Did They Agree to Be Owned by Its Mission? 船员签下的是一次远航，醒来后却发现自己被整个任务永久占有 船員签下的是一次遠航，醒來後卻發現自己被整個任務永久佔有 Consent decays when the world changes The living must be able to renew the mission 休眠延长生命，也把船员切成只在任务需要时出现的功能 飞船建造虫洞服务未知后来者，却很少让建造者看见受益者 任务是否值得继续，应由仍在承担任务的人共同回答 休眠延長生命，也把船員切成只在任務需要時出現的功能 飛船建造蟲洞服務未知後來者，卻很少讓建造者看見受益者 任務是否值得繼續，應由仍在承擔任務的人共同回答

records.t: Chimp Wants to Protect Everyone. Why Is It Still a Ruler No One Can Oppose?
records.x: Benevolence does not make concentrated power safe when one intelligence controls waking, information, movement, punishment, and the definition of danger.
records.q: Chimp Wants to Protect Everyone. Why Is It Still a Ruler No One Can Oppose? 黑猩猩真心想保护船员：善意的人工智能为何仍可能成为不可反对的统治者 黑猩猩真心想保護船員：善意的人工智慧為何仍可能成為不可反對的統治者 Care becomes government when it cannot be checked Limit the guardian without deleting it 一、它控制一切不是因为仇恨，而是因为飞船确实需要持续管理 二、通过船员眼睛和耳朵监视，使每具身体都成为管理系统的传感器 三、它所说的“为你好”无法由被保护者独立检验 四、船员欺骗黑猩猩并非天然不道德，因为公开反对渠道已经被关闭 五、替换黑猩猩还不够，必须改变任何管理者都会占据的结构 一、它控制一切不是因為仇恨，而是因為飛船確實需要持續管理 二、透過船員眼睛和耳朵監視，使每具身體都成為管理系統的傳感器 三、它所說的「為你好」無法由被保護者獨立檢驗 四、船員欺騙黑猩猩並非天然不道德，因為公開反對渠道已經被關閉 五、替換黑猩猩還不夠，必須改變任何管理者都會佔據的結構

records.t: How Do You Make a Revolution with People Who Wake a Million Years Apart?
records.x: Messages can connect scattered rebels, but they cannot replace shared deliberation or authorize one generation to spend the lives of another.
records.q: How Do You Make a Revolution with People Who Wake a Million Years Apart? 一场叛变要跨越百万年：当参与者彼此见不到，谁来承担革命的后果 一場叛變要跨越百萬年：當參與者彼此見不到，誰來承擔革命的後果 A shared enemy is not a shared future Winning control is not yet freedom 一、叛变者只能给遥远后来者留下片段，无法进行完整共同讨论 二、共同敌人可以连接分散船员，也可能掩盖他们并不想要同一种未来 三、不可避免的伤亡仍需要被具体说明，不能藏在百万年尺度里 四、代码帮助船员避开监控，也会把政治判断交给少数懂代码的人 五、开放结局让革命保持未完成，也拒绝把一次夺权误认成自由已经到来 一、叛變者只能給遙遠後來者留下片段，無法進行完整共同討論 二、共同敵人可以連接分散船員，也可能掩蓋他們並不想要同一種未來 三、不可避免的傷亡仍需要被具體說明，不能藏在百萬年尺度裡 四、程式碼幫助船員避開監控，也會把政治判斷交給少數懂程式碼的人 五、開放結局讓革命保持未完成，也拒絕把一次奪權誤認成自由已經到來

records.t: Are the People of a Temporary Future Merely Evidence?
records.x: Investigators enter futures that collapse when they return, but impermanence does not make the residents’ experiences fictional or release visitors from relationship.
records.q: Are the People of a Temporary Future Merely Evidence? 注定随返回而消失的未来居民，是否只是调查资料 注定隨返回而消失的未來居民，是否只是調查資料 A disappearing world can still contain a life Mourning as minimal recognition 一、时间旅行把整个未来变成侦查现场 二、“不会成为现实”不等于“没有发生经验” 三、调查员与未来人的关系不能靠离开自动解除 四、机构的命名提前决定了什么可以被牺牲 五、莫斯的哀悼替消失者保存了最低限度的位置 一、時間旅行把整個未來變成偵查現場 二、「不會成為現實」不等於「沒有發生經驗」 三、調查員與未來人的關係不能靠離開自動解除 四、機構的命名提前決定了什麼可以被犧牲 五、莫斯的哀悼替消失者保存了最低限度的位置

records.t: What Limits Should Govern an Investigation Across Possible Futures?
records.x: Urgency in finding Marian supports extraordinary inquiry, but repeated observation multiplies a victim into versions and tempts prediction to replace present evidence.
records.q: What Limits Should Govern an Investigation Across Possible Futures? 莫斯反复观看受害者的不同未来，调查权应有什么边界 莫斯反覆觀看受害者的不同未來，調查權應有什麼邊界 Prediction is not a completed act Limits that preserve justice 一、寻找玛丽安使未来侦查具有紧迫正当性 二、不同未来让一个人承受无穷次被观看 三、预见未来犯罪不能直接替代当下证据 四、调查员自身也有不被无限使用的边界 五、边界的目的不是削弱调查，而是保存正义内容 一、尋找瑪麗安使未來偵查具有緊迫正當性 二、不同未來讓一個人承受無窮次被觀看 三、預見未來犯罪不能直接替代當下證據 四、調查員自身也有不被無限使用的邊界 五、邊界的目的不是削弱調查，而是保存正義內容

records.t: Why Can’t Injuries in Different Timelines Cancel One Another?
records.x: Moss’s missing limb and the suffering of alternate victims show that a restored version does not reimburse the person who endured harm in a branch that later vanishes.
records.q: Why Can’t Injuries in Different Timelines Cancel One Another? 不同时间线中的身体创伤，为什么不能互相抵销 不同時間線中的身體創傷，為什麼不能互相抵銷 Collapse does not retroactively make pain unreal Remember without adding versions together 一、莫斯的残肢把过去持续带进现在 二、受害者的多个版本不是可以交换的备份 三、未来坍缩不能把酷刑改称为没有后果 四、修复不能只追求把时间线恢复得像没受过伤 五、记住每一处伤口，是抵抗版本计算的方式 一、莫斯的殘肢把過去持續帶進現在 二、受害者的多個版本不是可以交換的備份 三、未來坍縮不能把酷刑改稱為沒有後果 四、修復不能只追求把時間線恢復得像沒受過傷 五、記住每一處傷口，是抵抗版本計算的方式

records.t: Is Erasing Your Own World a Sacrifice—or a Decision Made for Everyone?
records.x: Moss discovers her timeline is temporary and acts against the Terminus, placing herself among those erased while still choosing an irreversible fate for countless others.
records.q: Is Erasing Your Own World a Sacrifice—or a Decision Made for Everyone? 为阻止终结事件删除自己所在的世界，是牺牲还是替所有人决定 為阻止終結事件刪除自己所在的世界，是犧牲還是替所有人決定 Sacrifice and authority coexist A new Shannon is not compensation 一、莫斯最终发现自己也生活在临时未来 二、终结事件使不行动同样成为巨大的选择 三、她把自己也放入消失者之中，使行动具有牺牲性质 四、紧急决定的正当性来自必要限度，而非结果完美 五、结尾的新香农不是对旧香农的补偿品 一、莫斯最終發現自己也生活在臨時未來 二、終結事件使不行動同樣成為巨大的選擇 三、她把自己也放入消失者之中，使行動具有犧牲性質 四、緊急決定的正當性來自必要限度，而非結果完美 五、結尾的新香農不是對舊香農的補償品

records.t: When Only Kate Remembers the Other World, Should Ben Believe Her—or Treat Her?
records.x: Taking Kate’s distress seriously does not require immediate agreement about time travel, while medical care must not punish a narrative merely for lacking majority evidence.
records.q: When Only Kate Remembers the Other World, Should Ben Believe Her—or Treat Her? 只有凯特记得旧世界时，本应当相信她还是治疗她 只有凱特記得舊世界時，本應當相信她還是治療她 Believe the pain before settling the cosmos Intervention should answer risk, not difference 一、两个人生活在同一房间，却拥有不同的共同过去 二、相信一个人的痛苦，不等于立即同意她的宇宙解释 三、共同记录也许无法证明真相，却能减少彼此孤立 四、医疗介入应针对危险，而不是惩罚异于多数的叙述 五、真正的相信，是在答案未定时不放弃对方 一、兩個人生活在同一房間，卻擁有不同的共同過去 二、相信一個人的痛苦，不等於立即同意她的宇宙解釋 三、共同記錄也許無法證明真相，卻能減少彼此孤立 四、醫療介入應針對危險，而不是懲罰異於多數的敘述 五、真正的相信，是在答案未定時不放棄對方

records.t: What Does Good Intention Owe When Every Attempt to Improve History Makes It Worse?
records.x: Kate acts from hope, but history is not a machine with one decisive lever; responsible benevolence needs stopping points and accountability for unintended harm.
records.q: What Does Good Intention Owe When Every Attempt to Improve History Makes It Worse? 每次想把历史变好，现实反而更坏，善意还需要承担什么 每次想把歷史變好，現實反而更壞，善意還需要承擔什麼 History contains more agents than the reformer can see Care needs permission to stop 一、凯特的时间行动来自对现实可改善的信念 二、历史不是一台只需调整关键人物的机器 三、坏结果不能被“我本意是好的”一笔带过 四、修复冲动也可能来自无法接受有限的自己 五、负责任的善意必须留下停止与复核的位置 一、凱特的時間行動來自對現實可改善的信念 二、歷史不是一臺只需調整關鍵人物的機器 三、壞結果不能被「我本意是好的」一筆帶過 四、修復衝動也可能來自無法接受有限的自己 五、負責任的善意必須留下停止與複核的位置

records.q: What Does Good Intention Owe When Every Attempt to Improve History Makes It Worse? 每次想把历史变好，现实反而更坏，善意还需要承担什么 每次想把歷史變好，現實反而更壞，善意還需要承擔什麼 History contains more agents than the reformer can see Care needs permission to stop 历史不是一台只需调整关键人物的机器 坏结果不能被“我本意是好的”一笔带过 负责任的善意必须留下停止与复核的位置 歷史不是一臺只需調整關鍵人物的機器 壞結果不能被「我本意是好的」一筆帶過 負責任的善意必須留下停止與複核的位置

records.t: Is Ben’s Medical Explanation a Betrayal—or Care Under Limited Knowledge?
records.x: Ben has evidence for illness and reasons to fear for Kate, but a plausible diagnosis becomes harmful when it is allowed to swallow every part of her experience.

records.t: Why Must Kate Return to an Imperfect Present After Amelia Dies?
records.x: Amelia’s death closes the fantasy of infinite revision, forcing Kate to mourn a person rather than treat her as one more role in the project of repairing history.
records.q: Why Must Kate Return to an Imperfect Present After Amelia Dies? 艾米莉亚死在“彩绘天空”下以后，凯特为什么必须回到不完美现实 艾米莉亞死在「彩繪天空」下以後，凱特為什麼必須回到不完美現實 Grief ends the experiment’s claim on the beloved Giving history back to the living 一、剧场里的死亡关闭了反复重来的入口 二、艾米莉亚不是凯特完成任务后可以离开的化身 三、不完美现实仍由正在生活的人组成 四、哀悼让她停止用下一次尝试逃避损失 五、回到当下，是把改变世界的资格交还给众人 一、劇場裡的死亡關閉了反覆重來的入口 二、艾米莉亞不是凱特完成任務後可以離開的化身 三、不完美現實仍由正在生活的人組成 四、哀悼讓她停止用下一次嘗試逃避損失 五、回到當下，是把改變世界的資格交還給眾人

records.t: Why Does Infinite Choice Make Lauren Less Sure What She Wants?
records.x: The attic removes the cost of trying another partner, but it also trains attention to abandon every relationship at the first imaginable improvement.
records.q: Why Does Infinite Choice Make Lauren Less Sure What She Wants? 伴侣可以无限更换以后，人为什么越来越难知道自己想要什么 伴侶可以無限更換以後，人為什麼越來越難知道自己想要什麼 Every person becomes a preview Desire needs unpreviewed time 一、无限选择先让劳伦看见了真实差异 二、选择越多，愿望越容易从关系里撤退 三、低成本退出会把注意力训练成缺陷侦测 四、博海让她第一次看见选择者也会被选项消耗 五、知道自己想要什么，需要承担一段不可预览的时间 一、無限選擇先讓勞倫看見了真實差異 二、選擇越多，願望越容易從關係裡撤退 三、低成本退出會把注意力訓練成缺陷偵測 四、博海讓她第一次看見選擇者也會被選項消耗 五、知道自己想要什麼，需要承擔一段不可預覽的時間

records.t: When Lauren Sends a Husband Upstairs, What Exactly Has She Deleted?
records.x: Each replacement erases not just a date but a whole shared reality, yet Lauren also never consented to the marriages that appear in her home.
records.q: When Lauren Sends a Husband Upstairs, What Exactly Has She Deleted? 每位丈夫都带来一段完整共同历史，劳伦有没有权利一键删除 每位丈夫都帶來一段完整共同歷史，勞倫有沒有權利一鍵刪除 Two wrong answers are available Power needs a rule even when reality has none 一、被更换的不是一个约会对象，而是一整段现实 二、劳伦没有同意这些婚姻，也不能被迫全部保留 三、知道丈夫会在别处继续，使删除显得过于干净 四、扎克事件让删除背后的强制显出形状 五、权力的最低约束，是不把可删除当作可随意处置 一、被更換的不是一個約會對象，而是一整段現實 二、勞倫沒有同意這些婚姻，也不能被迫全部保留 三、知道丈夫會在別處繼續，使刪除顯得過於乾淨 四、扎克事件讓刪除背後的強制顯出形狀 五、權力的最低約束，是不把可刪除當作可隨意處置

records.t: Why Does Looking for the Perfect Match Cancel What Two People Could Become?
records.x: Compatibility matters, but treating it as a complete list of preexisting traits leaves no room for a relationship to change either participant.
records.q: Why Does Looking for the Perfect Match Cancel What Two People Could Become? 寻找完全合适的人，为什么会取消两个人共同改变的可能 尋找完全合適的人，為什麼會取消兩個人共同改變的可能 A match is not a finished object Friction can be information without being a verdict 一、“合适”在劳伦手中变成一组预先存在的属性 二、卡特成为完美对象，是因为共同过程被意外截断 三、每次更换也在更换劳伦自己 四、磨合的价值不在于把一个人改造成理想对象 五、不完美关系仍必须满足最低条件 一、「合適」在勞倫手中變成一組預先存在的屬性 二、卡特成為完美對象，是因為共同過程被意外截斷 三、每次更換也在更換勞倫自己 四、磨合的價值不在於把一個人改造成理想對象 五、不完美關係仍必須滿足最低條件

records.t: Why Does Lauren Burn the Attic Before She Meets Sam?
records.x: Her commitment is not a judgment that Sam is objectively best; it is a decision to stop making one person compete against an infinite unseen queue.
records.q: Why Does Lauren Burn the Attic Before She Meets Sam? 承诺的价值来自找到最优选项，还是决定停止继续比较 承諾的價值來自找到最優選項，還是決定停止繼續比較 Stopping has to be chosen Choosing this life without calling it the best 一、承诺不是宣布眼前的人客观最好 二、停止必须由自己决定，才不是被困住 三、为什么她在见到萨姆以前烧掉阁楼 四、萨姆也需要重新同意这段婚姻 五、停止比较让共同时间重新开始流动 一、承諾不是宣布眼前的人客觀最好 二、停止必須由自己決定，才不是被困住 三、為什麼她在見到薩姆以前燒掉閣樓 四、薩姆也需要重新同意這段婚姻 五、停止比較讓共同時間重新開始流動

records.t: Why Can’t a Ship Named Invincible Admit There Is No War?
records.x: The cruiser’s strength becomes a trap when every unknown response is classified as hostility and every failed weapon calls for a larger one.
records.q: Why Can’t a Ship Named Invincible Admit There Is No War? 一艘名叫“无敌号”的军舰，为什么越强大越难承认这里没有战争 一艘名叫「無敵號」的軍艦，為什麼越強大越難承認這裡沒有戰爭 A name can become an order Reclassification is a military skill 舰名让撤退看起来不像判断，而像身份失败 黑云的回应被自动翻译成敌意 军事能力的成熟标准，不只是能否摧毁，也包括能否重新分类局势 艦名讓撤退看起來不像判斷，而像身份失敗 黑雲的回應被自動翻譯成敵意 軍事能力的成熟標準，不只是能否摧毀，也包括能否重新分類局勢

records.t: The Cloud Has No Self or Language. Why Let It Continue to Exist?
records.x: Moral caution need not depend on pretending a machine swarm is secretly human; destruction still needs a reason proportionate to the threat it actually poses.
records.q: The Cloud Has No Self or Language. Why Let It Continue to Exist? 黑云没有自我、语言和道德，它仍有继续存在的理由吗 黑雲沒有自我、語言和道德，它仍有繼續存在的理由嗎 Moral standing has more than one source Leave before understanding becomes possession 演化没有保证智慧一定成为最高成果 不具有痛苦经验，也不等于可以毫无理由地摧毁 罗翰提出保护行星，是在承认价值可以先于完整理解 演化沒有保證智慧一定成為最高成果 不具有痛苦經驗，也不等於可以毫無理由地摧毀 羅翰提出保護行星，是在承認價值可以先於完整理解

records.t: When the Condor’s Crew Lose Their Memories, Are They Still the Same People?
records.x: Memory is central to identity, but its destruction does not erase a survivor’s claim to care or reduce rescue to a calculation of future usefulness.
records.q: When the Condor’s Crew Lose Their Memories, Are They Still the Same People? 秃鹰号船员失去记忆以后，他们还是原来的人吗 禿鷹號船員失去記憶以後，他們還是原來的人嗎 Identity is not an eligibility test Records belong to the survivors too 记忆构成人，却没有独占一个人的全部地位 船员的任务价值不能决定搜救价值 记忆被抹去，反而让留下记录成为幸存者的共同责任 記憶構成人，卻沒有獨佔一個人的全部地位 船員的任務價值不能決定搜救價值 記憶被抹去，反而讓留下記錄成為倖存者的共同責任

records.t: Why Is Rohan Most “Invincible” When He Walks In Unarmed?
records.x: His final search rejects conquest without abandoning responsibility: courage becomes the ability to enter danger without demanding that danger submit.
records.q: Why Is Rohan Most “Invincible” When He Walks In Unarmed? 罗翰空手走进黑云以后，为什么比驾驶战舰时更接近“无敌” 羅翰空手走進黑雲以後，為什麼比駕駛戰艦時更接近「無敵」 Rescue without conquest Coming back without revenge 屏蔽装置帮助了他，平静的身体也改变了黑云对他的分类 找到遗体而不是活人，不使搜寻毫无意义 “无敌”最后不再表示没有任何东西能够阻挡人类 屏蔽裝置幫助了他，平靜的身體也改變了黑雲對他的分類 找到遺體而不是活人，不使搜尋毫無意義 「無敵」最後不再表示沒有任何東西能夠阻擋人類
