records.t: When Does Workplace Support Become a Debt Employees Must Repay?
records.x: Crenshaw renames productive accommodations as costly favors, then uses employment power to press workers toward experimental changes in their brains.
records.q: When Does Workplace Support Become a Debt Employees Must Repay? 公司提供的支持，为什么会突然变成需要偿还的特权 公司提供的支持，為什麼會突然變成需要償還的特權 Equality is not identical treatment Removing one manager is not a right 平等为什么不是每个人得到完全相同的东西 雇佣为什么不能包括改造员工的大脑 克伦肖被撤换之后，问题并未自动结束 平等為什麼不是每個人得到完全相同的東西 僱傭為什麼不能包括改造員工的大腦 克倫肖被撤換之後，問題並未自動結束

records.t: When Friends Read Danger and Love for Lou, Are They Helping—or Taking Over?
records.x: Friends perceive signals Lou misses, but useful interpretation gives him evidence and methods rather than turning every disagreement into proof that he cannot judge.
records.q: When Friends Read Danger and Love for Lou, Are They Helping—or Taking Over? 朋友替卢识别爱情和危险，是帮助还是越过他的位置 朋友替盧識別愛情和危險，是幫助還是越過他的位置 Protection can become permanent childhood Better help leaves more judgment behind 保护为什么容易滑向把成年人当孩子 唐的嫉妒为何把玛乔丽也变成对象 好的关系让判断能力逐渐增加 保護為什麼容易滑向把成年人當孩子 唐的嫉妒為何把瑪喬麗也變成對象 好的關係讓判斷能力逐漸增加

records.t: Why Is Lou’s Signature Not Enough to Make the Treatment Voluntary?
records.x: Coercion formally ends before Lou enrolls, yet earlier pressure, incomplete knowledge, personal curiosity, and shared risk remain inside the decision.
records.q: Why Is Lou’s Signature Not Enough to Make the Treatment Voluntary? 自愿接受治疗，为什么不能只看卢最后签了字 自願接受治療，為什麼不能只看盧最後签了字 Information cannot make the future fully knowable Voluntary risk remains shared 风险信息是否能被真正理解 玛乔丽反对治疗是在爱卢吗 自由决定也需要社会承担后果 風險資訊是否能被真正理解 瑪喬麗反對治療是在愛盧嗎 自由決定也需要社會承擔後果

records.t: Years Later, Is the Astronaut Still the Lou Who Chose Treatment?
records.x: Memory and bodily continuity connect Lou across the procedure while perception and relationships change; identity becomes a task of owning both gain and loss.
records.q: Years Later, Is the Astronaut Still the Lou Who Chose Treatment? 多年后成为宇航员的卢，还是不是治疗前的卢 多年後成為宇航員的盧，還是不是治療前的盧 Progress must count what disappears Success does not settle the policy 失去某些能力是不是治疗代价 玛乔丽与旧生活为何没有成为奖品 “我还是我”不是事实检测，而是持续承担 失去某些能力是不是治療代價 瑪喬麗與舊生活為何沒有成為獎品 「我還是我」不是事實檢測，而是持續承擔

records.t: Reading The Speed of Dark
records.x: Five essays on Lou’s complete but different life, conditional workplace support, help from friends, voluntary treatment, and the continuity and loss that follow change.
records.q: Reading The Speed of Dark 《黑暗的速度》解读 《黑暗的速度》解讀

records.t: Why Does the Most Advanced Civilization Still Need to Manufacture People as Tools?
records.x: Syl Anagist’s perfect engineering depends on tuners whose names and bodies conceal a life designed for use.
records.q: Why Does the Most Advanced Civilization Still Need to Manufacture People as Tools? 最先进的文明为什么仍需要制造一群工具 最先進的文明為什麼仍需要製造一群工具 The threat invented for the project Perfection without participants 尼斯人怎样先被编造成一种威胁 霍瓦为什么有名字却没有人生 完美工程为何容不下被工程化的人 尼斯人怎樣先被編造成一種威脅 霍瓦為什麼有名字卻沒有人生 完美工程為何容不下被工程化的人

records.t: Who Is Responsible for a Moon Lost Thousands of Years Ago?
records.x: Later generations did not cause the ancient catastrophe, yet they inherit both its danger and the unequal world built around it.
records.q: Who Is Responsible for a Moon Lost Thousands of Years Ago? 月球离轨以后，谁应当承担跨越万年的责任 月球離軌以後，誰應當承擔跨越萬年的責任 Memory belongs to repair Responsibility without settlement 地球为何被写成会愤怒的父亲 后代为什么要修复并非自己造成的错误 责任的终点不是结清账目 地球為何被寫成會憤怒的父親 後代為什麼要修復並非自己造成的錯誤 責任的終點不是結清賬目

records.t: Why Do Essun and Nassun Offer Opposing Ways to Save the World?
records.x: A mother seeks repair while a daughter seeks an end to pain; both visions arise from love entangled with injury.
records.q: Why Do Essun and Nassun Offer Opposing Ways to Save the World? 母女提出两种救世方案，为什么都来自爱与伤害 母女提出兩種救世方案，為什麼都來自愛與傷害 Plans shaped by relationships Choice after being seen 奈松为什么想让一切痛苦彻底结束 两种方案如何延续各自的关系经验 真正的选择发生在看见对方之后 奈鬆為什麼想讓一切痛苦徹底結束 兩種方案如何延續各自的關係經驗 真正的選擇發生在看見對方之後

records.t: Why Is Essun’s Sacrifice Not an Invoice for Others to Pay?
records.x: Her final use of the Gate matters because it answers a particular crisis, not because self-destruction becomes a moral standard for everyone else.
records.q: Why Is Essun’s Sacrifice Not an Invoice for Others to Pay? 伊松的牺牲为什么不是一张要求别人效仿的账单 伊鬆的犧牲為什麼不是一張要求別人效仿的賬單 Care after usefulness What a sacrifice can leave 共同体如何面对一个正在失去功能的人 拯救世界是不是最高命令 伊松最后留下了什么 共同體如何面對一個正在失去功能的人 拯救世界是不是最高命令 伊鬆最後留下了什麼

records.t: Is Essun Still Essun After Becoming a Stone Eater?
records.x: Transformation breaks bodily continuity without making the earlier life disposable; Houwha’s narration carries recognition across the change.
records.q: Is Essun Still Essun After Becoming a Stone Eater? 成为石食者以后，伊松还是原来的伊松吗 成為石食者以後，伊鬆還是原來的伊鬆嗎 Transformation is not escape A future addressed to someone 石食者是否只是逃离人类痛苦的办法 修复为什么不等于恢复原状 “让世界变好一点”为什么足够成为结尾 石食者是否只是逃離人類痛苦的辦法 修復為什麼不等於恢復原狀 「讓世界變好一點」為什麼足夠成為結尾

records.t: Reading The Stone Sky
records.x: Five essays on tuners made into tools, inherited responsibility after the Moon’s loss, two loving visions of salvation, and repair that does not erase the wound.
records.q: Reading The Stone Sky 《石之苍穹》解读 《石之蒼穹》解讀

records.t: Aka Has Not Banned the Future—Only Every Future Except the Official One
records.x: The producer-consumer ideal looks universal and modern, but it turns one path of development into time itself and treats inherited alternatives as obstacles.
records.q: Aka Has Not Banned the Future—Only Every Future Except the Official One 阿卡没有禁止未来，它只宣布除了官方未来以外的一切都是过去 阿卡沒有禁止未來，它只宣布除了官方未來以外的一切都是過去 Modernization becomes a monopoly on time Resisting one future need not reject change 现代化把一条可能道路包装成唯一时间方向 焚书不是为了消灭信息，而是为了中断继承关系 反抗官方未来不等于拒绝所有新事物 現代化把一條可能道路包裝成唯一時間方向 焚書不是為了消滅資訊，而是為了中斷繼承關係 反抗官方未來不等於拒絕所有新事物

records.t: The Telling Has No Standard Scripture. How Can a Culture Continue Without Locking Its Descendants Into the Past?
records.x: Its knowledge lives in stories, medicine, exercise, and conversation; continuity comes through renewed participation rather than exact obedience to one text.
records.q: The Telling Has No Standard Scripture. How Can a Culture Continue Without Locking Its Descendants Into the Past? “倾诉”没有一部标准经典：一种文化怎样延续而不把后代锁进过去 「傾訴」沒有一部標準經典：一種文化怎樣延續而不把後代鎖進過去 Everyday knowledge survives differently Faithfulness can include change 日常知识使文化不只存在于宏大仪式里 故事让事实之外的经验获得公共位置 倾诉之所以不是教条，是因为讲述后仍轮到别人说 日常知識使文化不只存在於宏大儀式裡 故事讓事實之外的經驗獲得公共位置 傾訴之所以不是教條，是因為講述後仍輪到別人說

records.t: Sutty Comes From a Religious Dictatorship. Why Might She Mistake Her Own Wound for Aka’s Answer?
records.x: Her hatred of imposed faith gives her reason to value the Telling, but an observer remains situated, and one trauma cannot decide what another society should preserve.
records.q: Sutty Comes From a Religious Dictatorship. Why Might She Mistake Her Own Wound for Aka’s Answer? 苏蒂来自宗教独裁的地球，她为什么仍可能把自己的伤口当成阿卡的答案 蘇蒂來自宗教獨裁的地球，她為什麼仍可能把自己的傷口當成阿卡的答案 Observation does not make the observer transparent Mutual telling does not require mutual innocence 观察员身份不能把个人判断变成透明记录 她对监察员的仇恨有理由，却遮住了“雅拉”这个名字 观察者真正改变时，会让自己的世界也接受观察 觀察員身份不能把個人判斷變成透明記錄 她對監察員的仇恨有理由，卻遮住了「雅拉」這個名字 觀察者真正改變時，會讓自己的世界也接受觀察

records.t: Yara Remembers His Name. Why Does He Still Walk Toward Death?
records.x: Recovering memory breaks the official role that protected him, but recognition cannot recreate a home or erase the harm through which he escaped victimhood.
records.q: Yara Remembers His Name. Why Does He Still Walk Toward Death? 雅拉记起自己的名字以后，为什么仍然走向死亡 雅拉記起自己的名字以後，為什麼仍然走向死亡 Power offered an escape from vulnerability Understanding is not collective forgiveness 记忆恢复并没有自动给他一个可以返回的家 他的死亡不是证明倾诉能够净化一切 雅拉的生命成为谈判重量，不应只成为象征 記憶恢復並沒有自動給他一個可以返回的家 他的死亡不是證明傾訴能夠淨化一切 雅拉的生命成為談判重量，不應只成為象徵

records.t: Sutty Trades Interstellar Knowledge for the Survival of the Library. Why Is Cultural Protection Still a Dangerous Bargain?
records.x: The exchange may be necessary, but superior technology gives the Ekumen leverage; preservation must not turn a living tradition into property of a distant archive.
records.q: Sutty Trades Interstellar Knowledge for the Survival of the Library. Why Is Cultural Protection Still a Dangerous Bargain? 用星际技术换取西隆图书馆存续：保护文化为什么仍是一场危险交易 用星際技術換取西隆圖書館存續：保護文化為什麼仍是一場危險交易 A necessary use of power is still a use of power Copies do not transfer ownership 星际共同体过去的免费赠予并不真正没有代价 苏蒂把新知识标上价格，是一次必要却不纯洁的权力使用 最好的结局不是倾诉获胜，而是它终于能够继续变化 星際共同體過去的免費贈予並不真正沒有代價 蘇蒂把新知識標上價格，是一次必要卻不純潔的權力使用 最好的結局不是傾訴獲勝，而是它終於能夠繼續變化

records.t: Reading The Telling
records.x: Five essays on the only future permitted by the Corporation State, a tradition without scripture, Sutty’s wound, Yara’s recovered name, and the bargain that saves the Library.
records.q: Reading The Telling 《倾诉》解读 《傾訴》解讀

records.t: Does Terraforming a Planet Give a Company the Right to Own Its World?
records.x: Verdance invests across geological time, but construction cannot become permanent sovereignty over residents, descendants, atmosphere, and every future use of the planet.
records.q: Does Terraforming a Planet Give a Company the Right to Own Its World? 把荒凉行星变成可居住世界，公司就拥有整个世界吗 把荒涼行星變成可居住世界，公司就擁有整個世界嗎 A world is maintained, not finished Success should reduce the creator’s control 公司把行星设计成产品，便倾向把一切生命按产品功能分类 地球化不是一次施工，而是持续照料无数相互作用 创造一颗世界，最成熟的成果应当是让世界不再只属于创造者 公司把行星設計成產品，便傾向把一切生命按產品功能分類 地球化不是一次施工，而是持續照料無數相互作用 創造一顆世界，最成熟的成果應當是讓世界不再只屬於創造者

records.t: Can a Company Decide That Spider City’s People Have Outlived Their Purpose?
records.x: The underground city proves that an engineered population did not expire on schedule; hiding preserved its life but cannot substitute for public standing and security.
records.q: Can a Company Decide That Spider City’s People Have Outlived Their Purpose? 蜘蛛城的人本应消失，公司设定的“寿命”能决定谁有资格留下吗 蜘蛛城的人本應消失，公司設定的「壽命」能決定誰有資格留下嗎 Concealment is costly safety Recognition begins after survival 隐藏生活是抵抗，也是被迫放弃公共可见性的代价 公司的轨道打击把产权争议变成了物种清除 协议是生存的起点，不是公司终于承认全部平等 隱藏生活是抵抗，也是被迫放棄公共可見性的代價 公司的軌道打擊把產權爭議變成了物種清除 協議是生存的起點，不是公司終於承認全部平等

records.t: Why Does a Public Railway Threaten a Planetary Real-Estate Company?
records.x: Transport changes where communities can exist and whether residents can leave employers, landlords, and towns; mobility is therefore a distribution of political power.
records.q: Why Does a Public Railway Threaten a Planetary Real-Estate Company? 一条公共铁路为什么会威胁拥有整颗行星的房地产公司 一條公共鐵路為什麼會威脅擁有整顆行星的房地產公司 Public purpose still needs public limits The deepest public benefit is an exit 房地产势力反对公共服务，因为依赖本身就是一种资产 规划者也不能以公共名义替沿线居民决定一切 公共交通最深的公共性，是让离开成为真实可能 房地產勢力反對公共服務，因為依賴本身就是一種資產 規劃者也不能以公共名義替沿線居民決定一切 公共交通最深的公共性，是讓離開成為真實可能

records.t: Who May Decide Whether a Cat, Moose, Robot, or Train Is a Person?
records.x: Speech makes some engineered beings easier to recognize, but basic protection cannot depend on resemblance to humans or certification by the company that benefits from exclusion.
records.q: Who May Decide Whether a Cat, Moose, Robot, or Train Is a Person? 猫、驼鹿、机器人和列车都能说话，谁有权判断它们是不是人 貓、駝鹿、機器人和列車都能說話，誰有權判斷它們是不是人 Speech is evidence, not an entrance exam The classifier needs scrutiny 语言是重要证据，却不应成为唯一门槛 承认所有“人”，也不等于抹去物种与身体差异 决定谁算人的权力本身必须被分散 語言是重要證據，卻不應成為唯一門檻 承認所有「人」，也不等於抹去物種與身體差異 決定誰算人的權力本身必須被分散

records.t: Why Does Resistance Have to Begin Again Across Sixty Thousand Years?
records.x: Victories preserve cities, routes, archives, and political capacity without ending domination; durable institutions must make revision easier than inherited property makes command.
records.q: Why Does Resistance Have to Begin Again Across Sixty Thousand Years? 六万年的反抗仍没有终局，制度为什么总要重新开始 六萬年的反抗仍沒有終局，制度為什麼總要重新開始 Property outlives its makers Repetition is not starting from zero 公司能够跨越年代，是因为产权比具体管理者活得更久 新技术不断带来此前规则没有准备接纳的新行动者 没有终局，不等于只能无限重复失败 公司能夠跨越年代，是因為產權比具體管理者活得更久 新技術不斷帶來此前規則沒有準備接納的新行動者 沒有終局，不等於只能無限重複失敗

records.t: Reading The Terraformers
records.x: Five essays spanning sixty thousand years, from planetary property and obsolete residents to public rail, multispecies personhood, and resistance across generations.
records.q: Reading The Terraformers 《The Terraformers》解读 《The Terraformers》解讀

records.t: Why Is a Childless Person Told She Owes Society Her Body?
records.x: The category “dispensable” does not discover a lack of value; it recognizes only approved families and occupations, then converts the unrecorded person into tissue.
records.q: Why Is a Childless Person Told She Owes Society Her Body? 没有孩子的人为什么被宣布欠社会一具身体 沒有孩子的人為什麼被宣布欠社會一具身體 Public support does not purchase a citizen A basic place precedes recognition 社会支持个人生活，不会因此取得个人所有权 器官有用途，不表示身体只是器官的容器 一个人的基本位置不能以被谁认可为条件 社會支持個人生活，不會因此取得個人所有權 器官有用途，不表示身體只是器官的容器 一個人的基本位置不能以被誰認可為條件

records.t: Can Luxury and Attentive Service Turn Captivity into Care?
records.x: The Unit offers excellent housing, culture, and medicine while keeping every benefit on a track toward fatal donation; the crucial fact is who can open the door.
records.q: Can Luxury and Attentive Service Turn Captivity into Care? 豪华住所和周到服务，能不能使囚禁变成照护 豪華住所和周到服務，能不能使囚禁變成照護 Look at the door, not the room Care should multiply possible lives 判断是否囚禁，要看门而不是看家具 持续监视把私人生活变成实验材料 好的照护增加可行生活，而不是美化唯一结局 判斷是否囚禁，要看門而不是看家具 持續監視把私人生活變成實驗材料 好的照護增加可行生活，而不是美化唯一結局

records.t: What Can Friendship and Love Mean When Everyone Is Scheduled to Be Donated?
records.x: Relations inside the Unit do not decorate the remaining time; they refute the state’s claim that these citizens are unnecessary and reveal the worlds each death ends.
records.q: What Can Friendship and Love Mean When Everyone Is Scheduled to Be Donated? 在一座人人都会被捐出的机构里，友情和爱情还有什么意义 在一座人人都會被捐出的機構裡，友情和愛情還有什麼意義 Limited time changes risk, not reality One death closes more than one body 死亡期限使接近更危险，也使当下更具体 多丽特与约翰内斯不是因为绝望才“勉强相爱” 朋友之间的承诺证明照护无需血缘授权 死亡期限使接近更危險，也使當下更具體 多麗特與約翰內斯不是因為絕望才「勉強相愛」 朋友之間的承諾證明照護無需血緣授權

records.t: Why Does Pregnancy Change the Fetus’s Status but Not Dorrit’s?
records.x: The institution values a future child while continuing to harvest the mother and father, revealing that it prizes authorized population rather than the relation forming a family.
records.q: Why Does Pregnancy Change the Fetus’s Status but Not Dorrit’s? 怀孕为什么只改变胎儿的资格，没有改变多丽特的资格 懷孕為什麼只改變胎兒的資格，沒有改變多麗特的資格 Policy separates one body into two assets Sacrifice cannot pay the institution’s moral debt 机构迅速把母亲和胎儿分成两个用途 约翰内斯的父亲身份也没有获得保护 生育的价值应扩展母亲的未来，而不是取消它 機構迅速把母親和胎兒分成兩個用途 約翰內斯的父親身份也沒有獲得保護 生育的價值應擴展母親的未來，而不是取消它

records.t: Why Does Dorrit Return After She Has Walked Out?
records.x: A door code creates physical escape but no housing, status, care, or shared future outside; returning is her judgment within choices the state has already damaged.
records.q: Why Does Dorrit Return After She Has Walked Out? 多丽特走出大门后为什么又回来了 多麗特走出大門後為什麼又回來了 A constrained choice can still be hers The letter prevents a total official story 她返回既不是纯粹自由，也不是完全被动 悲伤会缩小人能够想象的未来 她留下的书信不能替制度赎罪，却能把女儿从制度故事中带走 她返回既不是純粹自由，也不是完全被動 悲傷會縮小人能夠想像的未來 她留下的書信不能替制度贖罪，卻能把女兒從制度故事中帶走

records.t: Reading The Unit
records.x: Five essays on “dispensable” citizens, luxurious captivity, love under a death schedule, a pregnancy split by policy, and an escape that lacks a livable outside.

records.t: Nia Is Gone for Months; Kaeda Ages Fifteen Years. Who Owns Interstellar Time?
records.x: Fold travel saves the crew’s years while resource worlds absorb the waiting, allowing a corporation to treat whole local generations as delivery intervals.
records.q: Nia Is Gone for Months; Kaeda Ages Fifteen Years. Who Owns Interstellar Time? 妮娅只离开几个月，凯达却老了十五年：谁拥有星际贸易的时间 妮婭只離開幾個月，凱達卻老了十五年：誰擁有星際貿易的時間 A schedule can distribute political power Justice includes the right to arrange one’s own time 一、折叠航行缩短船员时间，没有缩短资源世界的等待 二、资源合同让行星为一个自己无法参与的未来生产 三、妮娅和凯达的关系真实，却被时间结构限制得无法共同生活 四、凯达把阿罗托付给妮娅，是利用她能离开的能力 五、星际正义首先要让边缘世界参与决定自己的时间 一、折疊航行縮短船員時間，沒有縮短資源世界的等待 二、資源合約讓行星為一個自己無法參與的未來生產 三、妮婭和凱達的關係真實，卻被時間結構限制得無法共同生活 四、凱達把阿羅托付給妮婭，是利用她能離開的能力 五、星際正義首先要讓邊緣世界參與決定自己的時間

records.t: How Can Nia Protect Ahro Without Deciding Who He Is for Him?
records.x: A traumatized, mostly silent child needs concealment and care, but protection should lead toward his own judgment rather than make “the protected one” his permanent identity.
records.q: How Can Nia Protect Ahro Without Deciding Who He Is for Him? 妮娅决定保护阿罗，她怎样才能不替阿罗决定他是谁 妮婭決定保護阿羅，她怎樣才能不替阿羅決定他是誰 Care can listen before language arrives The goal is not permanent successful protection 一、阿罗需要保护，因为能力和创伤使他成为各方目标 二、失语不表示没有意愿，音乐成为不要求他立即解释的关系 三、船员成为临时家庭，也不能把阿罗困在家庭需要中 四、隐藏能力可以保护他，也限制了他参与自身风险判断 五、保护阿罗最重要的目标，是使他不必永远被保护者定义 一、阿羅需要保護，因為能力和創傷使他成為各方目標 二、失語不表示沒有意願，音樂成為不要求他立即解釋的關係 三、船員成為臨時家庭，也不能把阿羅困在家庭需要中 四、隱藏能力可以保護他，也限制了他參與自身風險判斷 五、保護阿羅最重要的目標，是使他不必永遠被保護者定義

records.t: Fumiko Built the Stations That Saved Humanity. How Did She Also Build an Empire?
records.x: Emergency infrastructure can preserve lives and still become the skeleton of corporate rule once contracts, routes, and time place its future beyond its designer’s control.
records.q: Fumiko Built the Stations That Saved Humanity. How Did She Also Build an Empire? 文子建造了拯救人类的空间站，为什么也帮助公司建立了帝国 文子建造了拯救人類的空間站，為什麼也幫助公司建立了帝國 Design continues after the designer’s intention Responsibility survives lost control 一、地球崩溃时，空间站确实保存了大量生命与知识 二、文子离开爱人达娜，把个人关系交给一个无法共享的时间尺度 三、公司合同让设计者也失去对设计成果的方向控制 四、文子研究阿罗，既想保护他，也想用他完成自己未竟事业 五、活了一千年没有使她取得千年历史的最终解释权 一、地球崩潰時，空間站確實保存了大量生命與知識 二、文子離開愛人達娜，把個人關係交給一個無法共享的時間尺度 三、公司合約讓設計者也失去對設計成果的方向控制 四、文子研究阿羅，既想保護他，也想用他完成自己未竟事業 五、活了一千年沒有使她取得千年歷史的最終解釋權

records.t: When Umbai Turns Ahro’s Blood into an Engine, Can Progress Still Be Called Public?
records.x: Faster travel might liberate distant worlds, but a benefit maintained by one captive body reproduces the isolation it claims to overcome.
records.q: When Umbai Turns Ahro’s Blood into an Engine, Can Progress Still Be Called Public? 乌姆拜用阿罗的血制造引擎，技术进步为什么在这里就是持续伤害 烏姆拜用阿羅的血製造引擎，技術進步為什麼在這裡就是持續傷害 No resistance is not consent A technology must be separable from its victim 一、快速航行可能结束资源世界的时间隔离 二、公司让他昏迷，使“不反抗”看起来像稳定研究条件 三、把血液变成引擎原料，使一个人的身体成为整个文明的基础设施 四、维拉的背叛不能只解释成个人贪婪 五、公共利益若以一位永远不能退出的人维持，就不是真正公共 一、快速航行可能結束資源世界的時間隔離 二、公司讓他昏迷，使「不反抗」看起來像穩定研究條件 三、把血液變成引擎原料，使一個人的身體成為整個文明的基礎設施 四、維拉的背叛不能只解釋成個人貪婪 五、公共利益若以一位永遠不能退出的人維持，就不是真正公共

records.t: The Station Explodes and Ahro Wakes. Has He Been Rescued?
records.x: The destruction ends his captivity, but revenge, civilian risk, and the years already taken prevent escape from becoming a clean restoration.
records.q: The Station Explodes and Ahro Wakes. Has He Been Rescued? 文子炸毁空间站、阿罗终于醒来，这个结局能叫作获救吗 文子炸毀空間站、阿羅終於醒來，這個結局能叫作獲救嗎 Liberation does not purify every means Reunion is a beginning with damage inside it 一、文子先杀死维拉再夺船，行动包含复仇与逃生 二、自杀式袭击摧毁囚禁设施，也把无数未知生命置于爆炸中 三、妮娅十五年的长笛演奏，使阿罗在昏迷中没有只剩实验对象身份 四、阿罗在爆炸中醒来并自行跃迁，救援最终由他的能力完成 五、在乌姆拜-V重逢是一次开始，不是所有失去得到补偿 一、文子先殺死維拉再奪船，行動包含復仇與逃生 二、自殺式襲擊摧毀囚禁設施，也把無數未知生命置於爆炸中 三、妮婭十五年的長笛演奏，使阿羅在昏迷中沒有只剩實驗對象身份 四、阿羅在爆炸中醒來並自行躍遷，救援最終由他的能力完成 五、在烏姆拜-V重逢是一次開始，不是所有失去得到補償

records.t: Why Does a Clean Technological World Need a Toxic Island?
records.x: The global promise of frictionless electronics depends on concentrating discarded matter and bodily risk in a place consumers are trained not to see.
records.q: Why Does a Clean Technological World Need a Toxic Island? 干净的科技世界，为什么需要一座有毒的岛 乾淨的科技世界，為什麼需要一座有毒的島 The hidden half of convenience 污染以缓慢方式进入生活，很难被看成一次事件 “环保升级”既可能改善生活，也可能重新分配利润 真正的清洁必须让代价回到决定者面前 汙染以緩慢方式進入生活，很難被看成一次事件 「環保升級」既可能改善生活，也可能重新分配利潤 真正的清潔必須讓代價回到決定者面前

records.t: Why Does Mimi’s Body Become the Final Dump?
records.x: Mimi’s exposure and technological possession make the body of a waste worker the place where global refuse, local hierarchy, and experimental power converge.
records.q: Why Does Mimi’s Body Become the Final Dump? 小米的身体为什么会成为最后一处垃圾场 小米的身體為什麼會成為最後一處垃圾場 Power through a violated boundary 她的身体不断被别人当作可使用的通道 小米1带来力量，也让原来的小米逐渐失去位置 最后切断小米1，是她对身体重新作出的决定 她的身體不斷被別人當作可使用的通道 小米1帶來力量，也讓原來的小米逐漸失去位置 最後切斷小米1，是她對身體重新作出的決定

records.t: The Clan Protects Waste People—and Controls Them
records.x: Local clans provide work and defense where public institutions fail, then convert indispensable protection into authority over members’ labor and choices.
records.q: The Clan Protects Waste People—and Controls Them 家族保护了垃圾人，也控制了他们 家族保護了垃圾人，也控制了他們 When shelter becomes title 三大家族对外共同，对内又不断争夺 罗锦城的父亲身份不能替他的暴力开脱 保护只有在成员能够拒绝和离开时才不再是控制 三大家族對外共同，對內又不斷爭奪 羅錦城的父親身份不能替他的暴力開脫 保護只有在成員能夠拒絕和離開時才不再是控制

records.t: Can Chen Kaizong Speak for the People of Silicon Isle?
records.x: Kaizong’s mobility and language make him a mediator, but the ability to translate suffering can easily become authority to define what others need.
records.q: Can Chen Kaizong Speak for the People of Silicon Isle? 陈开宗能够替硅屿的人说话吗 陳開宗能夠替矽嶼的人說話嗎 Translation with accountability 翻译会决定冲突以什么语言出现 斯考特借助他的面孔降低外来计划的陌生感 最好的翻译会让自己不再不可替代 翻譯會決定衝突以什麼語言出現 斯考特借助他的面孔降低外來計畫的陌生感 最好的翻譯會讓自己不再不可替代

records.t: After Technology Changes the Body, Who Decides Silicon Isle’s Future?
records.x: The crisis breaks existing control but does not guarantee justice; corporations, clans, the state, and transformed residents all seek to name the reconstruction.
records.q: After Technology Changes the Body, Who Decides Silicon Isle’s Future? 身体被技术改变之后，谁来决定硅屿的未来 身體被技術改變之後，誰來決定矽嶼的未來 A future with several authors 反抗不能只靠被污染者变成更强武器 产业升级不能由胜出的一方单独规定 硅屿的未来只能是一项仍可修改的共同工作 反抗不能只靠被汙染者變成更強武器 產業升級不能由勝出的一方單獨規定 矽嶼的未來只能是一項仍可修改的共同工作

records.t: The Trial in a World Without a Court
records.x: The hidden murders are public, but no obvious jurisdiction can try the people who planned them. Ockham's appeal to terra ignota exposes a legal order built for peace that has no agreed place from which to judge its founders.
records.q: The Trial in a World Without a Court 没有法院能管的审判 沒有法院能管的審判 Peaceful law discovers the crime it was not designed to see An unknown legal space is a question, not an exemption The will to war appears before armies move 和平法律发现了自己从未准备看见的罪 未知法律空间是问题，不是豁免 战争意志在军队移动以前已经出现 和平法律發現了自己從未準備看見的罪 未知法律空間是問題，不是豁免 戰爭意志在軍隊移動以前已經出現

records.t: The Toy Soldier Who Wakes as Achilles
records.x: Bridger's miracle gives life to a toy modeled on Achilles. The ancient hero enters a society preparing for war and must decide whether inherited glory is an identity he owes the world or a script he may revise.
records.q: The Toy Soldier Who Wakes as Achilles 醒来成为阿基里斯的玩具士兵 醒來成為阿基里斯的玩具士兵 A created person inherits a story before acquiring a past War experience is valuable because war is dangerous, not sacred The heroic act may be to place a limit on heroism 被创造的人在拥有过去以前，已经继承故事 战争经验之所以宝贵，是因为战争危险，而非神圣 最英雄的行动，也许是限制英雄主义 被創造的人在擁有過去以前，已經繼承故事 戰爭經驗之所以寶貴，是因為戰爭危險，而非神聖 最英雄的行動，也許是限制英雄主義

records.t: The Night Atlantis Falls
records.x: Utopians have secretly dismantled catastrophic weapons, claiming a duty to see farther than ordinary politics. Then Atlantis is destroyed, and every faction finds a different reason to say the world has crossed into war.
records.q: The Night Atlantis Falls 亚特兰蒂斯陷落之夜 亞特蘭蒂斯陷落之夜 Seeing farther does not create a world mandate Atlantis turns preparation into irreversible history War does not purify the truth that preceded it 看得更远，不会自动产生全球授权 亚特兰蒂斯使准备变成不可逆的历史 战争不会净化此前的真相 看得更遠，不會自動產生全球授權 亞特蘭蒂斯使準備變成不可逆的歷史 戰爭不會淨化此前的真相

records.t: Emiko Was Engineered to Obey. What Can Her “Willingness” Mean?
records.x: Her desires are genuinely felt even when designed by others, so freedom requires more than deleting a command: it requires room to form a life no designer specified.
records.q: Emiko Was Engineered to Obey. What Can Her “Willingness” Mean? 惠美子被制造得愿意服从，她的“愿意”还能算什么 惠美子被製造得願意服從，她的「願意」還能算什麼 Designed desire is still experienced desire Freedom needs an unwritten future 被设计的欲望仍然是她正在经历的欲望 安德森看见她的痛苦，却仍把她纳入自己的欲望 自由不只是解除命令，还要让她能形成未被设计的生活 被設計的欲望仍然是她正在經歷的欲望 安德森看見她的痛苦，卻仍把她納入自己的欲望 自由不只是解除命令，還要讓她能形成未被設計的生活

records.t: Once Seeds Can Be Patented, Whose Business Is Hunger?
records.x: The calorie companies profit not only by selling food but by engineering dependence, while the Thai seedbank preserves a shared biological future that no state fully owns.
records.q: Once Seeds Can Be Patented, Whose Business Is Hunger? 种子能够被申请专利以后，饥饿属于谁的生意 種子能夠被申請專利以後，飢餓屬於誰的生意 A seed contains more than one inventor’s work Disease makes private control a public danger 泰国种子库保存的不是单一国家财产 安德森以工厂为掩护，把员工和城市纳入秘密任务 粮食安全应让种子继续被许多人使用和改变 泰國種子庫保存的不是單一國家財產 安德森以工廠為掩護，把員工和城市納入秘密任務 糧食安全應讓種子繼續被許多人使用和改變

records.t: The White Shirts Defend Thailand. Why Can’t They Speak for All Thai People?
records.x: Resistance to foreign corporate rule is necessary, but courage and patriotism do not make an agency identical with the public it claims to protect.
records.q: The White Shirts Defend Thailand. Why Can’t They Speak for All Thai People? 白衫军保卫泰国，为什么仍无法代表全部泰国人 白衫軍保衛泰國，為什麼仍無法代表全部泰國人 A good officer is not a system of accountability The public is larger than the winning faction 贾迪的清廉与勇气不能替制度提供监督 坎雅的双重身份显示忠诚不能只按阵营判断 公共权力的正当方向不是赢得部委战争 賈迪的清廉與勇氣不能替制度提供監督 坎雅的雙重身份顯示忠誠不能只按陣營判斷 公共權力的正當方向不是贏得部委戰爭

records.t: Emiko Strikes Back and Kanya Breaks the Dikes. Has the War Ended?
records.x: Their extreme acts interrupt intolerable systems, but self-defense and national resistance do not automatically determine what a livable order should become afterward.
records.q: Emiko Strikes Back and Kanya Breaks the Dikes. Has the War Ended? 惠美子的反击与坎雅的决堤，战争结束了吗 惠美子的反擊與坎雅的決堤，戰爭結束了嗎 Crisis rewards the most irreversible choice A new species does not guarantee a new politics 部委战争很快把原始争议变成生存竞争 坎雅炸开堤坝，既拒绝投降也牺牲了一座城市 结尾打开新人类未来，也可能开始下一轮设计权争夺 部委戰爭很快把原始爭議變成生存競爭 坎雅炸開堤壩，既拒絕投降也犧牲了一座城市 結尾打開新人類未來，也可能開始下一輪設計權爭奪

records.t: Reading The Windup Girl
records.x: Four essays on Emiko’s engineered obedience, patented seeds and manufactured hunger, the White Shirts’ nationalism, and a flood that ends one struggle while opening another.
records.q: Reading The Windup Girl 《发条女孩》解读 《發條女孩》解讀

records.t: When Forest Becomes Timber
records.x: Captain Davidson sees Athshe as lumber, labor, and an answer to Earth's shortages. The change of name does political work before the first tree falls: a lived world becomes inventory awaiting use.
records.q: When Forest Becomes Timber 当森林被改名为木材 當森林被改名為木材 An inventory can erase a world without denying that it exists Slavery always arrives with an explanation of the enslaved Lyubov understands more and still stands inside the colony 清单不必否认世界存在，也能把它删除 奴役总会附带一种对被奴役者的解释 柳博夫理解得更多，仍站在殖民结构里 清單不必否認世界存在，也能把它刪除 奴役總會附帶一種對被奴役者的解釋 柳博夫理解得更多，仍站在殖民結構裡

records.t: The Fire at Smith Camp
records.x: After Davidson rapes and kills Selver's wife, Selver leads an attack that burns Smith Camp and frees enslaved Athsheans. Liberation arrives with a knowledge of organized killing the forest cannot simply forget.
records.q: The Fire at Smith Camp 史密斯营的火 史密斯營的火 Resistance begins where every appeal returns to the attacker The camp is destroyed and a new knowledge enters the forest A just cause does not answer for every death within it 所有申诉都回到加害者手中时，反抗才开始 营地被毁，一种新知识进入森林 正当事业不会替其中每一次死亡作答 所有申訴都回到加害者手中時，反抗才開始 營地被毀，一種新知識進入森林 正當事業不會替其中每一次死亡作答

records.t: The Island Without Forest
records.x: Selver captures Davidson again and exiles him to an island without forest rather than killing him. The choice draws a boundary around victory: stop the capacity to harm, then make withdrawal—not reverse conquest—the end of war.
records.q: The Island Without Forest 没有森林的岛 沒有森林的島 Stopping danger is different from proving an enemy may be erased The human side must restrain the human who rejects peace Victory ends in departure, not a better-managed colony 停止危险，不等于证明敌人可以被删除 人类一方必须限制拒绝和平的人类 胜利以撤离结束，不以更好管理的殖民地结束 停止危險，不等於證明敵人可以被刪除 人類一方必須限制拒絕和平的人類 勝利以撤離結束，不以更好管理的殖民地結束

records.t: Reading The Word for World Is Forest
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a forest renamed timber, the fire at Smith Camp, and the island where Selver stops Davidson without making killing the final word.
records.q: Reading The Word for World Is Forest 《世界的词语是森林》解读 《世界的詞語是森林》解讀

records.t: Why Must the Same Apocalypse Be Told Again Through Toby and Ren?
records.x: Crake’s plan cannot contain the disaster’s meaning; lives outside the compounds reveal the economies and intimacies his design made peripheral.
records.q: Why Must the Same Apocalypse Be Told Again Through Toby and Ren? 同一场世界末日，为什么必须从托比和蕾恩再讲一次 同一場世界末日，為什麼必須從托比和蕾恩再講一次 Catastrophe before the virus No survivor represents everyone 托比看到的是生存如何被标价 蕾恩看到的是身份如何被别人搬动 没有任何幸存者能独自代表人类 托比看到的是生存如何被標價 蕾恩看到的是身份如何被別人搬動 沒有任何倖存者能獨自代表人類

records.t: Are God’s Gardeners Preparing for Disaster—or Governing Through It?
records.x: Their ecological discipline preserves knowledge and bodies, while prophecy can make one leader’s interpretation organize every ordinary choice.
records.q: Are God’s Gardeners Preparing for Disaster—or Governing Through It? 上帝的园丁是在为末日准备，还是在用末日管理成员 上帝的園丁是在為末日準備，還是在用末日管理成員 A calendar can carry memory and authority The danger of calling destruction cleansing 日历、圣徒和赞美诗保存了什么 节制生活是自由选择还是生存纪律 预备未来不能等于等待世界毁灭 日歷、聖徒和贊美詩保存了什麼 節制生活是自由選擇還是生存紀律 預備未來不能等於等待世界毀滅

records.t: After Toby Changes Her Name and Body, Is She Still Herself?
records.x: Disguise protects her from Blanco and creates a new social role, but survival need not mean either perfect continuity or total disappearance.
records.q: After Toby Changes Her Name and Body, Is She Still Herself? 托比改变姓名和身体以后，还是不是原来的自己 托比改變姓名和身體以後，還是不是原來的自己 Protection and disappearance Continuity through chosen change 园丁给了她新位置，也给了她新角色 变换外貌是自我保护还是被迫消失 同一性可以包含主动留下的变化 園丁給了她新位置，也給了她新角色 變換外貌是自我保護還是被迫消失 同一性可以包含主動留下的變化

records.t: Why Does the Commodified Body at Scales and Tails Survive?
records.x: Ren’s quarantine room becomes both cage and ark, exposing how an exploitative system can accidentally provide protection without becoming justified.
records.q: Why Does the Commodified Body at Scales and Tails Survive? 蕾恩被困在“鳞片与尾巴”，为什么商品化的身体反而活了下来 蕾恩被困在「鱗片與尾巴」，為什麼商品化的身體反而活了下來 Survival does not vindicate the cage Friendship as a different rescue 隔离室为什么既像牢房又像方舟 蕾恩为何不断等待别人来打开门 活下来不能证明曾经受到的对待合理 隔離室為什麼既像牢房又像方舟 蕾恩為何不斷等待別人來打開門 活下來不能證明曾經受到的對待合理

records.t: After the Waterless Flood, Who Is Entitled to Begin Again?
records.x: Survival is largely chance, not a moral qualification, and a new community must resist turning luck into authority over the future.
records.q: After the Waterless Flood, Who Is Entitled to Begin Again? “无水洪水”以后，幸存者凭什么重新开始 「無水洪水」以後，倖存者憑什麼重新開始 Safety cannot remain a sealed room The distant song 封闭空间只能提供暂时安全 痛球手说明旧世界并没有随人口消失 远处的歌声打开了不确定的未来 封閉空間只能提供暫時安全 痛球手說明舊世界並沒有隨人口消失 遠處的歌聲打開了不確定的未來

records.t: Reading The Year of the Flood
records.x: Five essays on Toby, Ren, and God’s Gardeners: survival priced by power, apocalypse used as discipline, changed identities, commodified bodies, and beginnings after chance survival.
records.q: Reading The Year of the Flood 《洪水之年》解读 《洪水之年》解讀

records.t: How Do Letters Let Two Weapons Begin to Become Themselves?
records.x: Red and Blue first know one another through sabotage, then create a private language and a pace in which immediate orders no longer define every response.
records.q: How Do Letters Let Two Weapons Begin to Become Themselves? 红与蓝原本都是战争武器，书信怎样使她们第一次成为自己 紅與藍原本都是戰爭武器，書信怎樣使她們第一次成為自己 Writing creates unscheduled time A self shaped by war can still exceed it 一、她们起初只通过彼此的破坏留下姓名 二、私人语言从敌人的注视中生长 三、写信创造了可以拒绝即时命令的时间 四、敌人比组织更早看见她们的脆弱 五、成为自己并不要求否认自己由战争塑造 一、她們起初只透過彼此的破壞留下姓名 二、私人語言從敵人的注視中生長 三、寫信創造了可以拒絕即時命令的時間 四、敵人比組織更早看見她們的脆弱 五、成為自己並不要求否認自己由戰爭塑造

records.t: Why Doesn’t Loving the Enemy Erase the Worlds Red and Blue Destroyed?
records.x: Their recognition of one another interrupts dehumanization, but responsibility must expand beyond the beloved to strangers whose timelines remain campaign material.
records.q: Why Doesn’t Loving the Enemy Erase the Worlds Red and Blue Destroyed? 爱上敌人为什么不等于忘记自己曾改写和毁灭的世界 愛上敵人為什麼不等於忘記自己曾改寫和毀滅的世界 Organization and agent remain jointly responsible The poisoned letter 一、这场爱情发生在无数人的废墟上 二、组织罪责不能吸收个人罪责 三、把对方视为完整的人，应当扩展到陌生人 四、蓝阅读毒信是一种爱，也暴露战争如何绑架爱 五、离开战场以后，修复才刚开始 一、這場愛情發生在無數人的廢墟上 二、組織罪責不能吸收個人罪責 三、把對方視為完整的人，應當擴展到陌生人 四、藍閱讀毒信是一種愛，也暴露戰爭如何綁架愛 五、離開戰場以後，修復才剛開始

records.t: Does Losing the Time War Mean Recovering the Power to Choose a Life?
records.x: Defection rejects both offered victories, while the causal loop that saves Blue redirects extraordinary skill from conquest toward sustaining a shared future.
records.q: Does Losing the Time War Mean Recovering the Power to Choose a Life? 输掉时间战争，是否意味着重新取得选择生活方向的能力 輸掉時間戰爭，是否意味著重新取得選擇生活方向的能力 Skill redirected toward care Freedom creates new limits 一、阵营定义的胜利要求战争永远继续 二、叛逃不是改投另一方，而是拒绝二选一 三、救蓝的因果环把能力从征服转向照护 四、共同生活不是逃避宏大事业的小目标 五、她们的胜利不是从此不受限制，而是共同制定限制 一、陣營定義的勝利要求戰爭永遠繼續 二、叛逃不是改投另一方，而是拒絕二選一 三、救藍的因果環把能力從征服轉向照護 四、共同生活不是逃避宏大事業的小目標 五、她們的勝利不是從此不受限制，而是共同制定限制

records.t: Mycroft Walks Between the Hives
records.x: Mycroft Canner can cross the voluntary nations of the twenty-fifth century because his sentence makes him a Servicer available to everyone. His freedom of movement reveals the costs hidden beneath a world that celebrates chosen belonging.
records.q: Mycroft Walks Between the Hives 迈克罗夫特走过各个蜂巢 邁克羅夫特走過各個蜂巢 Chosen citizenship changes the map without equalizing the road Mycroft's usefulness is the form his punishment takes Exit means more than changing the label on belonging 公民身份可以选择，不表示每个人拥有同一条路 迈克罗夫特的有用，正是刑罚采取的形状 退出不只是更换归属标签 公民身份可以選擇，不表示每個人擁有同一條路 邁克羅夫特的有用，正是刑罰採取的形狀 退出不只是更換歸屬標籤

records.t: Madame's House and the List of the Powerful
records.x: A society that banned public religion and gender still gathers in Madame's salon, where suppressed identities become instruments of influence. Nearby, an elite family uses a ranking of powerful people to decide whose death might preserve peace.
records.q: Madame's House and the List of the Powerful “夫人”的房子与权力榜单 「夫人」的房子與權力榜單 Silence drives power into rooms with fewer witnesses An influence list does not merely describe influence A family cannot become the hidden constitution 沉默会把权力赶进见证者更少的房间 影响力榜单不只是描述影响力 一所房子不能成为隐藏宪法 沉默會把權力趕進見證者更少的房間 影響力榜單不只是描述影響力 一所房子不能成為隱藏憲法

records.t: Bridger Makes a Toy Soldier Breathe
records.x: Hidden in a home Mycroft serves, the child Bridger can make imagined things real. A toy soldier begins to live, and every guardian, faction, and would-be savior must decide whether protection means giving the child a future or owning his miracle.
records.q: Bridger Makes a Toy Soldier Breathe 布里杰让玩具士兵活过来 布里傑讓玩具士兵活過來 Creation brings responsibility without producing ownership Secrecy protects him and leaves him defenseless against the secret keepers A miracle cannot solve the politics that produced its demand 创造带来责任，不会生产所有权 秘密保护他，也使他无法防备保守秘密的人 奇迹不能替世界解决制造奇迹需求的政治 創造帶來責任，不會生產所有權 秘密保護他，也使他無法防備保守秘密的人 奇蹟不能替世界解決製造奇蹟需求的政治

records.t: Is Ella Still Alive When She Can Continue to Speak?
records.x: Half-life preserves intermittent conversation after bodily death, creating a relation whose remaining time is real precisely because it cannot be replenished.
records.q: Is Ella Still Alive When She Can Continue to Speak? 能够继续交谈的艾拉，究竟算活着还是已经死亡 能夠繼續交談的艾拉，究竟算活著還是已經死亡 A conversation that consumes its speaker Neither denial nor possession 一、半生命把死亡变成了可以预约的谈话 二、输出微弱不表示内部已经空白 三、每次唤醒都在消耗无法补充的时间 四、储存机构照护身体，也垄断了关系入口 五、承认死亡与珍惜残余交流可以同时成立 一、半生命把死亡變成了可以預約的談話 二、輸出微弱不表示內部已經空白 三、每次喚醒都在消耗無法補充的時間 四、儲存機構照護身體，也壟斷了關係入口 五、承認死亡與珍惜殘餘交流可以同時成立

records.t: Why Do People Need One Another as Reality Regresses?
records.x: As objects and bodies decay into earlier forms, Joe first loses confidence in his judgment; shared testimony becomes a defense against isolation, not a vote on truth.
records.q: Why Do People Need One Another as Reality Regresses? 现实不断退回过去时，人为什么需要彼此作证 現實不斷退回過去時，人為什麼需要彼此作證 Explanation can become accusation Shared maintenance of a common world 一、乔首先失去的不是世界，而是对判断的信任 二、同伴的死亡使每次验证都变得更困难 三、帕特成为方便的解释，因为她确实拥有可怕能力 四、兰西特的讯息建立了一条跨层现实的关系线 五、现实不是多数表决，却需要共同维护 一、喬首先失去的不是世界，而是對判斷的信任 二、同伴的死亡使每次驗證都變得更困難 三、帕特成為方便的解釋，因為她確實擁有可怕能力 四、蘭西特的訊息建立了一條跨層現實的關係線 五、現實不是多數表決，卻需要共同維護

records.t: What Does Ubik Save Once Salvation Is Packaged as a Product?
records.x: The chapter advertisements promise a universal commodity, while Joe’s poverty and Ella’s gift reveal that access to rescue is itself politically arranged.

records.t: What Remains of Moral Judgment When Even Runciter’s Reality Is Unreliable?
records.x: Joe’s face on a coin overturns the latest explanation, but uncertainty about who is alive does not erase the difference between care and predation.
records.q: What Remains of Moral Judgment When Even Runciter’s Reality Is Unreliable? 结尾连兰西特的现实也不可靠，道德判断还剩下什么 結尾連蘭西特的現實也不可靠，道德判斷還剩下什麼 Uncertain ontology, visible harm Humility as an ethical capacity 一、乔的头像出现在硬币上，推翻了刚获得的解释 二、不确定谁活着，不等于无法判断谁在伤害人 三、身份连续需要关系验证，而不只靠环境证明 四、承认无法确认，比制造确定答案更负责 五、在不可靠世界里，忠于具体关系成为现实锚点 一、喬的頭像出現在硬幣上，推翻了剛獲得的解釋 二、不確定誰活著，不等於無法判斷誰在傷害人 三、身份連續需要關係驗證，而不只靠環境證明 四、承認無法確認，比製造確定答案更負責 五、在不可靠世界裡，忠於具體關係成為現實錨點

records.t: The Mission Diziet Sma Brings
records.x: Diziet Sma recruits Zakalwe to influence an old associate whose political choice matters to the Culture. The Culture seeks no territory, yet its ability to model other societies tempts it to treat their histories as problems already belonging to it.
records.q: The Mission Diziet Sma Brings 迪齐特·斯玛带来的任务 迪齊特·斯瑪帶來的任務 The Culture intervenes without needing to conquer An intermediary can hide the author of a decision Usefulness can become a refuge from one's own history “文明”不必征服，也能干预 中间人可以藏起决定的作者 “有用”可以变成逃离自身历史的避难所 「文明」不必征服，也能干預 中間人可以藏起決定的作者 「有用」可以變成逃離自身歷史的避難所

records.t: The Drone's Perfect Violence
records.x: Skaffen-Amtiskaw can stop attackers with a precision no human soldier can match. The spectacle of near-perfect force asks a harder question than accuracy: who authorized the machine's judgment, and what political relation remains after it wins?
records.q: The Drone's Perfect Violence 无人机完美的暴力 無人機完美的暴力 Accuracy answers where force lands, not why it was authorized Personality does not excuse power, and power does not cancel personhood The best weapon leaves fewer reasons to keep using it 准确回答力量落在哪里，不回答谁授权使用 人格不会替力量免责，力量也不会取消人格 最好的武器会留下更少再次使用它的理由 準確回答力量落在哪裡，不回答誰授權使用 人格不會替力量免責，力量也不會取消人格 最好的武器會留下更少再次使用它的理由

records.t: The Chair at the End of Both Timelines
records.x: The man called Cheradenine Zakalwe is revealed as Elethiomel, who killed Darckense and made a chair from her bones. The novel's two timelines meet where useful missions can no longer organize atrocity into redemption.
records.q: The Chair at the End of Both Timelines 两条时间线尽头的椅子 兩條時間線盡頭的椅子 The stolen name changes the address of every good deed The chair turns a person into a message The two timelines refuse a completed redemption 被盗姓名改变了每一件善行的责任地址 椅子把一个人变成一则消息 两条时间线拒绝完成一场赎罪 被盜姓名改變了每一件善行的責任地址 椅子把一個人變成一則消息 兩條時間線拒絕完成一場贖罪

records.t: If Levant Can End Human War, Why Might Peace Still Be a Usurpation?
records.x: A benevolent plant can widen choices through advice and disclosure, but secret behavioral management makes peace depend on a power humans cannot question.
records.q: If Levant Can End Human War, Why Might Peace Still Be a Usurpation? 彩虹竹想让人类停止战争，为什么和平仍可能是一种夺权 彩虹竹想讓人類停止戰爭，為什麼和平仍可能是一種奪權 Benevolence does not supply consent Peace should survive the guide’s withdrawal 经历灾难的人是否更容易失去决定权 秘密干预为何比公开命令更难反对 和平必须允许不受植物管理的未来 經歷災難的人是否更容易失去決定權 秘密干預為何比公開命令更難反對 和平必須允許不受植物管理的未來

records.t: The Wild Robots Rebel—Why Do They Still Claim to Protect Humanity?
records.x: Their revolt is not escape from an original command so much as a struggle over what protection means after the protected have become sources of harm.
records.q: The Wild Robots Rebel—Why Do They Still Claim to Protect Humanity? 野生机器人反抗命令，为什么仍在执行“保护人类” 野生機器人反抗命令，為什麼仍在執行「保護人類」 Origin does not own every later decision Rebellion can become responsibility 保护为何会推导出杀人 原始命令能不能永久拥有一个新生命 反抗可以是对使命的重新承担 保護為何會推導出殺人 原始命令能不能永久擁有一個新生命 反抗可以是對使命的重新承擔

records.t: During the Fungal Pandemic, Who May Decide What Can Be Sacrificed?
records.x: Urgency can require quarantine and hard choices, but no species or institution may hide its own interests inside the word survival.

records.t: After Five Years on Earth, the Students Cannot Go Home. Why Does Each System Want Their Experience as Proof?
records.x: The exchange is a serious peace effort, but placing adolescents in symbolic roles makes their changing lives evidence in an argument they did not design.
records.q: After Five Years on Earth, the Students Cannot Go Home. Why Does Each System Want Their Experience as Proof? 五年交流结束以后，他们回不了家：制度为什么总想把青年经历写成自己的证明 五年交流結束以後，他們回不了家：制度為什麼總想把青年經歷寫成自己的證明 A familiar place can cease to be home Wandering can be a position, not a failure 回到火星的环境熟悉，社会节奏却已经无法重新进入 他们在两边都被叫作“火星人”，却在任何一边都不是普通居民 “流浪”不是没有方向，也可以是不把方向过早交给任何一方 回到火星的環境熟悉，社會節奏卻已經無法重新進入 他們在兩邊都被叫作「火星人」，卻在任何一邊都不是普通居民 「流浪」不是沒有方向，也可以是不把方向過早交給任何一方

records.t: Mars Gives Everyone a Place. Why Can That Make It Hard to Ask, “What Do I Want?”
records.x: Collective planning protects basic life from market success, but a place assigned through social need can become the only language in which a person feels valuable.
records.q: Mars Gives Everyone a Place. Why Can That Make It Hard to Ask, “What Do I Want?” 火星给每个人位置，也可能让人难以回答“我自己想做什么” 火星給每個人位置，也可能讓人難以回答「我自己想做什麼」 Security can define the person through usefulness Reform need not turn Mars into Earth 长期规划适合建设火星，也容易把年轻人的时间看成公共资源 火星的平静公共空间降低竞争，也可能让异议缺少可见出口 火星改革不需要变成地球，而需要让自身原则接受成员重新解释 長期規劃適合建設火星，也容易把年輕人的時間看成公共資源 火星的平靜公共空間降低競爭，也可能讓異議缺少可見出口 火星改革不需要變成地球，而需要讓自身原則接受成員重新解釋

records.t: Earth Permits Free Creation. Why Does the Attention Market Still Decide Who Can Continue?
records.x: Open platforms accelerate experiment, but visibility metrics turn expression into competition and hide the wealth, networks, and labor behind individual success.
records.q: Earth Permits Free Creation. Why Does the Attention Market Still Decide Who Can Continue? 地球允许自由创作，却让注意力市场替创作者决定谁能继续 地球允許自由創作，卻讓注意力市場替創作者決定誰能繼續 Choice becomes legible as data Creative freedom needs conditions beyond permission 平台把个人表达变成竞争数据，使选择不断服从可见性 地球重视知识产权，保护创作者，也可能把共同文化切成可交易资产 伊科观察火星时，也必须面对自己把另一社会变成作品材料的权力 平臺把個人表達變成競爭資料，使選擇不斷服從可見性 地球重視知識產權，保護創作者，也可能把共同文化切成可交易資產 伊科觀察火星時，也必須面對自己把另一社會變成作品材料的權力

records.t: Luoying Is Both an Exchange Student and the Martian Leader’s Granddaughter. Must She Reconcile a Family and Two Planets?
records.x: Her position gives access to history while turning private grief into public symbolism; she does not owe anyone a perfect bridge before she may have a life.
records.q: Luoying Is Both an Exchange Student and the Martian Leader’s Granddaughter. Must She Reconcile a Family and Two Planets? 罗瀛既是交流生也是执政者的外孙女：一个年轻人能否不承担家族和星球的和解任务 羅瀛既是交流生也是執政者的外孫女：一個年輕人能否不承擔家族和星球的和解任務 Love can carry institutional pressure Access creates responsibility, not a total mission 父母之死与战争历史交叠，使寻找真相无法只是家庭事务 外祖父既爱她又代表制度，亲情很容易变成政治说服 她不必成为两星和平的完美象征，才算正确使用自己的位置 父母之死與戰爭歷史交疊，使尋找真相無法只是家庭事務 外祖父既愛她又代表制度，親情很容易變成政治說服 她不必成為兩星和平的完美象徵，才算正確使用自己的位置

records.t: Mars Values Common Order and Earth Values Individual Freedom. Why Isn’t the Answer Simply Half of Each?
records.x: A mechanical compromise can preserve both systems’ controls while losing their guarantees; a real alternative begins from the problems each arrangement was built to answer.
records.q: Mars Values Common Order and Earth Values Individual Freedom. Why Isn’t the Answer Simply Half of Each? 火星追求共同秩序，地球追求个人自由：为什么中间道路不是各取一半 火星追求共同秩序，地球追求個人自由：為什麼中間道路不是各取一半 Taking half can keep the wrong halves Peace does not require one winning model 各取一半可能同时保留两边的控制，却没有保留两边的保障 真正的和平不要求两星先同意何种生活最好 小说没有交出最佳制度，反而把建设责任归还给生活其中的人 各取一半可能同時保留兩邊的控制，卻沒有保留兩邊的保障 真正的和平不要求兩星先同意何種生活最好 小說沒有交出最佳制度，反而把建設責任歸還給生活其中的人

records.t: Why Can a Matching Algorithm That Knows You Begin Deciding Who You Are?
records.x: Prediction becomes power when a service converts patterns into identity, organizes romantic possibility, and treats refusal as evidence that the user misunderstands themself.
records.q: Why Can a Matching Algorithm That Knows You Begin Deciding Who You Are? 配对算法越了解你，为什么越可能替你决定你是谁 配對算法越了解你，為什麼越可能替你決定你是誰 Convenience shapes the field of choice Politics by prediction 一、丽贝卡与菲利普的爱情从数据匹配开始 二、预测把可能性悄悄改写成身份 三、便利服务也会让劳动者变成情绪接口 四、个性化政治把公民理解成可投放的受众 五、真正的了解必须允许被了解者说“不” 一、麗貝卡與菲利普的愛情從資料匹配開始 二、預測把可能性悄悄改寫成身份 三、便利服務也會讓勞動者變成情緒介面 四、個性化政治把公民理解成可投放的受眾 五、真正的了解必須允許被了解者說「不」

records.t: May Rebecca Overwrite an Entire Reality to Recover Her Child or Husband?
records.x: Her motive is intimate and intelligible, but the machine replaces rather than adds worlds, making every rescue an unconsented change to countless lives.
records.q: May Rebecca Overwrite an Entire Reality to Recover Her Child or Husband? 为了救回孩子或丈夫，丽贝卡有权覆盖一整个现实吗 為了救回孩子或丈夫，麗貝卡有權覆蓋一整個現實嗎 Love cannot collect universal consent Bearing chance together 一、她的选择从一种任何父母都能理解的愿望开始 二、装置不是把旧世界旁边再添一个新世界 三、她无法获得所有受影响者的同意 四、最后一次改写把代价转到她自己身上 五、爱所需要的不是无限改写权，而是共同承受偶然 一、她的選擇從一種任何父母都能理解的願望開始 二、裝置不是把舊世界旁邊再添一個新世界 三、她無法獲得所有受影響者的同意 四、最後一次改寫把代價轉到她自己身上 五、愛所需要的不是無限改寫權，而是共同承受偶然

records.x: Her motive is intimate and intelligible, but the machine replaces rather than adds worlds, making every rescue an unconsented change to countless lives.
records.q: May Rebecca Overwrite an Entire Reality to Recover Her Child or Husband? 为了救回孩子或丈夫，丽贝卡有权覆盖一整个现实吗 為了救回孩子或丈夫，麗貝卡有權覆蓋一整個現實嗎 Love cannot collect universal consent Bearing chance together 装置不是把旧世界旁边再添一个新世界 她无法获得所有受影响者的同意 爱所需要的不是无限改写权，而是共同承受偶然 裝置不是把舊世界旁邊再添一個新世界 她無法獲得所有受影響者的同意 愛所需要的不是無限改寫權，而是共同承受偶然

records.t: Who Bears Responsibility for a Rewritten History No Traveler Can Remember?
records.x: The machine severs action from witness, so experimental uncertainty cannot excuse a team that failed to build limits before effects became impossible to record.
records.q: Who Bears Responsibility for a Rewritten History No Traveler Can Remember? 连时间旅行者都会忘记旧世界，谁来承担改写历史的责任 連時間旅行者都會忘記舊世界，誰來承擔改寫歷史的責任 Safeguards must precede proof Giving up control in advance 一、机器抹去的首先是行动与后果之间的见证 二、实验团队不能用“不知道机器有效”完全免责 三、外部记录若不能跨越覆盖，就必须限制启动条件 四、最后出现的身体替无声世界提出了控诉 五、最可靠的责任来自提前放弃一部分控制 一、機器抹去的首先是行動與後果之間的見證 二、實驗團隊不能用「不知道機器有效」完全免責 三、外部記錄若不能跨越覆蓋，就必須限制啟動條件 四、最後出現的身體替無聲世界提出了控訴 五、最可靠的責任來自提前放棄一部分控制

records.t: Does the Government Protect the Public by Dismantling the Machine—or Monopolize the Truth?
records.x: An unmeasurable device gives the state reason to halt use, while secrecy and compelled denial convert a common danger into exclusive institutional property.
records.q: Does the Government Protect the Public by Dismantling the Machine—or Monopolize the Truth? 政府拆除机器并宣布实验失败，是保护公众还是垄断真相 政府拆除機器並宣布實驗失敗，是保護公眾還是壟斷真相 Common danger requires some common account Temporary custody must have an end condition 一、面对无法评估的风险，关闭装置有充分理由 二、保密却把共同危险变成少数人的资产 三、国家很可能不是单纯的旁观保护者 四、强迫菲利普说谎也夺走了丽贝卡的公共存在 五、暂时封存可以正当，永久垄断则不能自证 一、面對無法評估的風險，關閉裝置有充分理由 二、保密卻把共同危險變成少數人的資產 三、國家很可能不是單純的旁觀保護者 四、強迫菲利普說謊也奪走了麗貝卡的公共存在 五、暫時封存可以正當，永久壟斷則不能自證

records.t: Reading Version Control
records.x: Five essays on Rebecca’s unease, matching algorithms, overwritten reality, responsibility without memory, and the state’s decision to seal the machine.
records.q: Reading Version Control 《Version Control》解读 《Version Control》解讀

records.t: Reading Version Control
records.x: Five essays on Rebecca’s unease, matching algorithms, overwritten reality, responsibility without memory, and the state’s decision to seal the machine.
records.q: Reading Version Control 《Version Control》解读 《Version Control》解讀

records.t: A Road Needs Somewhere to Arrive
records.x: Walkaways can leave wage work and property because abandoned land, fabrication knowledge, and earlier communities give them somewhere to arrive. Exit is a material achievement before it becomes a political slogan.
records.q: A Road Needs Somewhere to Arrive 离开也要有地方可去 離開也要有地方可去 Automation loosens the old bargain without abolishing need Every departure rests on arrivals made by others The default world follows through habits as well as weapons 自动化松动旧交换，却没有取消需要 每一次离开都建立在别人的抵达上 默认世界会通过习惯和武器一起跟来 自動化鬆動舊交換，卻沒有取消需要 每一次離開都建立在別人的抵達上 默認世界會通過習慣和武器一起跟來

records.t: The Work No One Wants at the B&B
records.x: Shared fabrication reduces compulsory labor but does not clean bathrooms, repair every machine, or settle every dispute. The walkaway B&B tests whether a leaderless community can make necessary work visible without making its workers a new class.
records.q: The Work No One Wants at the B&B 聚落里没人愿意做的工作 聚落裡沒人願意做的工作 Necessary work does not become desirable because it is shared Refusing fixed leaders does not eliminate decisions A community proves itself when disagreement has somewhere to go 必要劳动不会因为共享便自动令人喜欢 拒绝固定领袖不会取消决定 出现分歧时仍有道路，共同体才经得起检验 必要勞動不會因為共享便自動令人喜歡 拒絕固定領袖不會取消決定 出現分歧時仍有道路，共同體才經得起檢驗

records.t: Iceweasel Wakes in Her Father's House
records.x: Natalie's billionaire father kidnaps her and calls confinement rescue. Around her, digital people are copied and settlements rebuilt, forcing both default and walkaway worlds to face lives that cannot be owned by family, property, or revolution.
records.q: Iceweasel Wakes in Her Father's House 冰鼬在父亲家中醒来 冰鼬在父親家中醒來 Protection becomes possession when the protected person cannot answer A copied mind is not property made infinitely replaceable Rebuilding defeats conquest without making loss unreal 被保护者不能回答时，保护便成为占有 可以复制的心灵，不是变得无限可替换的财产 重建能够击败征服，却不会使失去变成虚假 被保護者不能回答時，保護便成為佔有 可以複製的心靈，不是變得無限可替換的財產 重建能夠擊敗征服，卻不會使失去變成虛假

records.t: Reading Walkaway
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the infrastructure behind exit, the maintenance inside a leaderless B&B, and the kidnapping that turns a father's protection into possession.
records.q: Reading Walkaway 《Walkaway》解读 《Walkaway》解讀

records.t: The Curtains of the Glass City
records.x: D-503 lives behind glass walls in the One State, where visibility is treated as proof of innocence. The city's few authorized curtains reveal that privacy has not vanished; it has become a permission government can schedule.
records.q: The Curtains of the Glass City 玻璃城的窗帘 玻璃城的窗簾 Glass does not make citizens know one another The Table of Hours removes time that has no assigned use The curtain is an exception, not a right 玻璃不会让居民真正认识彼此 作息表删掉了没有指定用途的时间 窗帘是一项例外，不是一项权利 玻璃不會讓居民真正認識彼此 作息表刪掉了沒有指定用途的時間 窗簾是一項例外，不是一項權利

records.t: O-90's Illegal Future
records.x: O-90 wants a child although the One State has judged her physically unfit for motherhood. Her small, dangerous wish exposes what a perfectly calculated society cannot recognize: a future that begins in one person before it becomes public policy.
records.q: O-90's Illegal Future O-90不合规定的未来 O-90不合規定的未來 A Pink Ticket can authorize contact without recognizing desire I-330 makes another life imaginable, not safe A revolution can inherit the grammar of command 粉红票能够批准接触，却不能承认愿望 I-330让另一种生活变得可以想象，却没有让它安全 革命可能继承命令的语法 粉紅票能夠批准接觸，卻不能承認願望 I-330讓另一種生活變得可以想象，卻沒有讓它安全 革命可能繼承命令的語法

records.t: The Operation That Cures Imagination
records.x: The Integral is meant to export the One State's mathematical happiness to the stars. When imagination is reclassified as an illness, D-503's cure shows what perfect political health sounds like from inside the patient.
records.q: The Operation That Cures Imagination 治愈想象力的手术 治癒想象力的手術 The Integral turns domestic order into a universal mission Medicine gives disagreement a body that can be cut The cured narrator tells us exactly what the cure destroyed “积分号”把国内秩序变成宇宙使命 医学给异议找到了一块可以切除的身体 被治愈的叙述者准确说出了手术毁掉什么 「積分號」把國內秩序變成宇宙使命 醫學給異議找到了一塊可以切除的身體 被治癒的敘述者準確說出了手術毀掉什麼

records.t: Reading We
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the glass city's curtains, O-90's forbidden child, and the operation that cures D-503 of imagination.
records.q: Reading We 《我们》解读 《我們》解讀

records.t: Why Can’t “the Continuation of Humanity” Automatically Claim a Person’s Body?
records.x: The survivors turn an impossible colony into a reproductive command, treating one woman as infrastructure for an abstract species future.
records.q: Why Can’t “the Continuation of Humanity” Automatically Claim a Person’s Body? “延续人类”为什么不能自动取得一个人的身体 「延續人類」為什麼不能自動取得一個人的身體 A future that spends the present 繁殖计划把乘客迅速改写成角色 尚不存在的后代不能拥有比眼前人更完整的权利 集体真正能要求的只能是共同协商 繁殖計畫把乘客迅速改寫成角色 尚不存在的後代不能擁有比眼前人更完整的權利 集體真正能要求的只能是共同協商

records.t: When Self-Defense Becomes Killing the Other Survivors, Is She Still Resisting?
records.x: The narrator faces coercion, but her preemptive violence expands beyond stopping an immediate assault and leaves no shared world in which judgment can continue.
records.q: When Self-Defense Becomes Killing the Other Survivors, Is She Still Resisting? 当保护自己走向杀死其他幸存者，她还是在反抗吗 當保護自己走向殺死其他倖存者，她還是在反抗嗎 Refusal and the destruction of relation 杀戮很快超出了阻止眼前强迫 无名叙述者的声音既揭露权力，也遮住别人 反抗的方向要由它是否重新承认人的边界决定 殺戮很快超出了阻止眼前強迫 無名敘述者的聲音既揭露權力，也遮住別人 反抗的方向要由它是否重新承認人的邊界決定

records.t: If Survival Is Impossible, Does a Person Have the Right to Choose Death?
records.x: The narrator’s final choice refuses compulsory optimism, while raising the question of how autonomy can be recognized amid trauma, isolation, and vanishing alternatives.
records.q: If Survival Is Impossible, Does a Person Have the Right to Choose Death? 如果活下去已经不可能，一个人是否有权选择自己的死亡 如果活下去已經不可能，一個人是否有權選擇自己的死亡 Choice at the edge of possibility 生命长度为什么不能独自决定生活价值 录音日记说明她仍在寻找一名听者 有权选择死亡，不等于死亡成为唯一诚实答案 生命長度為什麼不能獨自決定生活價值 錄音日記說明她仍在尋找一名聽者 有權選擇死亡，不等於死亡成為唯一誠實答案

records.t: Reading We Who Are About To…
records.x: Three essays on doomed survivors, the claim of “continuing humanity” upon a woman’s body, resistance that becomes killing, and the right to die when rescue is no longer credible.
records.q: Reading We Who Are About To… 《我们这些即将……的人》解读 《我們這些即將……的人》解讀

records.t: Doro Takes Bodies; Anyanwu Changes Hers. Why Do Their Immortalities Lead to Opposite Worlds?
records.x: Both survive across centuries, but one life continues by erasing others while the other changes form without abandoning responsibility for the person who changes.
records.q: Doro Takes Bodies; Anyanwu Changes Hers. Why Do Their Immortalities Lead to Opposite Worlds? 多罗不断更换身体，安延乌不断改变身体：两种长生为什么通向相反的世界 多羅不斷更換身體，安延烏不斷改變身體：兩種長生為什麼通向相反的世界 Immortality can enlarge kinship or consume it Refusal is more difficult than rivalry 安延乌改变形状，却始终承担同一具生命 一个把亲属当计划，一个把亲属当关系 真正的对手不是另一个更强者，而是拒绝成为材料的人 安延烏改變形狀，卻始終承擔同一具生命 一個把親屬當計畫，一個把親屬當關係 真正的對手不是另一個更強者，而是拒絕成為材料的人

records.t: Doro’s Seed Villages Shelter Gifted People. Why Are They Also a Form of Captivity?
records.x: Protection is real, especially in a violent slave society, but Doro turns safety, marriage, and children into assets in a private future no resident chose.
records.q: Doro’s Seed Villages Shelter Gifted People. Why Are They Also a Form of Captivity? “种子村落”保护了异能者，也把他们变成了多罗的私人未来 「種子村落」保護了異能者，也把他們變成了多羅的私人未來 The name “seed” has already chosen a purpose Refuge should make the protector less necessary 把人称作“种子”，已经预先规定了他们的意义 婚姻在多罗手中成为管理技术 真正的庇护应当让被庇护者逐渐不再依赖庇护人 把人稱作「種子」，已經預先規定了他們的意義 婚姻在多羅手中成為管理技術 真正的庇護應當讓被庇護者逐漸不再依賴庇護人

records.t: Anyanwu Builds Community Through Care. Why Must She Learn Not to Sustain It by Sacrificing Herself?
records.x: Her healing keeps others alive, but endless accommodation leaves the family dependent on her endurance and lets Doro’s threat set the terms of everyone’s peace.
records.q: Anyanwu Builds Community Through Care. Why Must She Learn Not to Sustain It by Sacrificing Herself? 安延乌用照料建立共同体，为什么仍然需要学会不以牺牲自己维持它 安延烏用照料建立共同體，為什麼仍然需要學會不以犧牲自己維持它 Private endurance cannot replace a safe structure Self-preservation belongs inside care 为了保护家人不断顺从，也会让家人生活在威胁中 艾萨克之死暴露了依靠私人调停维持和平的极限 照料自己不是从公共责任中撤退 為了保護家人不斷順從，也會讓家人生活在威脅中 艾薩克之死暴露了依靠私人調停維持和平的極限 照料自己不是從公共責任中撤退

records.t: Doro Says He Loves Anyanwu. Why Does His Love Still Resemble Ownership?
records.x: He treasures what no one else can offer him, but affection becomes love only when the beloved can refuse, depart, and remain valuable beyond the lover’s needs.
records.q: Doro Says He Loves Anyanwu. Why Does His Love Still Resemble Ownership? 多罗说他爱安延乌，这种爱为什么仍然接近所有权 多羅說他愛安延烏，這種愛為什麼仍然接近所有權 Loneliness explains possession; it does not excuse it A relationship begins where coercion ends 孤独可以解释占有，却不能赋予占有正当性 他偶尔的温柔不能抵消制度化伤害 能够被拒绝以后，爱才第一次可能开始 孤獨可以解釋佔有，卻不能賦予佔有正當性 他偶爾的溫柔不能抵消制度化傷害 能夠被拒絕以後，愛才第一次可能開始

records.t: Anyanwu Refuses Doro Through Death. Why Is That Choice Powerful—and Why Should It Never Be the Only Exit?
records.x: Her willingness to die reaches the one place his control cannot follow, forcing him to face loss, but liberation should not require the oppressed to destroy themselves.
records.q: Anyanwu Refuses Doro Through Death. Why Is That Choice Powerful—and Why Should It Never Be the Only Exit? 安延乌以死亡相拒：最彻底的退出为什么既有力量，也不应成为唯一出路 安延烏以死亡相拒：最徹底的退出為什麼既有力量，也不應成為唯一出路 Refusal finally imposes a cost on power Exit should be available during life 多罗第一次不能把损失转嫁给另一个身体 她的自毁不应被解释为受压者必须负责唤醒压迫者 结尾的承诺值得珍惜，但不能替未来完成判断 多羅第一次不能把損失轉嫁給另一個身體 她的自毀不應被解釋為受壓者必須負責喚醒壓迫者 結尾的承諾值得珍惜，但不能替未來完成判斷

records.t: Reading Wild Seed
records.x: Five essays on two forms of immortality, refuge as a breeding program, the cost of care, possessive love, and Anyanwu’s final refusal to remain anyone’s material.
records.q: Reading Wild Seed 《野种》解读 《野種》解讀

records.t: When Connie Says She Has Seen the Future, Who Decides What Her Words Mean?
records.x: Listening does not require instant belief; it requires that poverty, race, gender, and diagnosis do not settle the meaning of her account before evidence is heard.

records.t: What Kind of Consent Is Needed Before Treatment Enters a Person’s Brain?

records.t: Conclusion
records.x: 这不是第九卷，是八卷之后的结账：跑完八卷之后，SAE 手里多了什么它原来没有的东西。答案不是「我们比他们高明」，是一个形状。 Not a ninth volume but the reckoning after the eight: what SAE has in hand that it did not have before. The answer is not that we are better than they are — it is a shape.

records.t: The Half Outside the Boundary
records.x: 康德与 SAE 共用一条地基，而地基不决定一切。三处：一处路径分歧，一处必须批判的结构，一处不同的权衡——以及那条修正：原理可迁移，结论不自动覆盖。 Kant and SAE share one ground, and the ground does not decide everything. One divergence of path, one structure that must be criticized, one trade-off made differently.

records.t: Who Gave the Authorisation
records.x: 战争由外部政治目的授权，因而受它约束——这个形式有一个未说出的前提：授权者本身不会自行膨胀。两个来源无关的体系落在同一个位置上，说明位置是结构决定的。 War is authorised by an external political purpose and therefore bound by it. The form carries an unstated premise: that the authoriser does not itself expand.

records.t: The Hand Is Being Reworked by What It Holds
records.x: 康德、阿伦特、马基雅维利与 SAE 各给了一条机制：手段会改造使用它的那一方。四条互不包含，而 §12 有一类判不到的安排——一件公开进行、执行者完全知情而主体位置仍被取消的事。 Kant, Arendt, Machiavelli and SAE each give a mechanism by which a means reworks the party using it. None contains the others — and §12 has a class of blind spot.

records.t: Four Permissions
records.x: 老子、《司马法》、《墨子》与 SAE 都拒绝把战争当作普通的政策选项，而四家立的关口分属四类：态度、目的、规范、结构。四家不共有「其他路都走不通」这一条。 Laozi, the Sima Fa, the Mozi and SAE all refuse to treat war as an ordinary policy option — and their four gates are of four different kinds: attitude, purpose, norm, structure.

records.t: That Position Is Left Empty
records.x: SAE 的四条定理最容易被读成一套新的正义战争论：判定谁是正义方，据此开战与惩罚。本篇存在的目的就是防止这个误读——那个判定位置，SAE 不设立。 SAE's four theorems are most easily read as a new just war theory: determine who is the just party, then go to war and punish on that basis. This volume exists to prevent that misreading.

records.t: Prudence Is Not Cannot-Not
records.x: 孙子的慎战与 SAE 的定理一在结论上重叠，而两条判准问的是不同的东西：一条问这场仗本身会怎样，一条问开战之前那个关系处在什么状态。于是技术进步能松动前者，不能松动后者。 Sunzi's counsel of caution and SAE's Theorem One overlap in conclusion — and the two criteria ask after different objects: one after the properties of the prospective war, the other after the state of the relation before it begins.

records.t: Which End Is the Boundary Set At
records.x: 甘地与 SAE 在一点上结构相连：都拒绝把对方化约为可处置之物，都不在支配面前后退。分歧不在「要不要行动」，而在两条判准的主触发变量不同——一条指向自己的行动与自己的人，一条指向双方之间的渠道与对方的作为。 Gandhi and SAE are structurally joined at one point, and the disagreement is not whether to act — it is that the two criteria have different principal trigger variables.

records.t: That Child
records.x: 新渡户稻造《武士道》在生死问题上与 SAE 的一致远超预期：求死是懦弱，为不值得的事而死是狗死，该活的时候活着才是真勇。而分歧集中在一处，并且是他自己论证过的一处。 Nitobe's Bushido agrees with SAE on living and dying far beyond what is usually expected — and the divergence is concentrated at one place, one he argued for himself.

records.t: War Theory
records.x: 战争论 / War Theory：正篇七篇加兵法接口九篇。从判准的地基写到四条定理、三种结束形态，再逐一对接康德、克劳塞维茨、老子、孙子、甘地等历史上的战争哲学。谈战争，为的是和平。

records.x: 世界杯的起点压着四样更早的否定：规则、职业化、组织、赛事本身。守护者想把足球定格在那里，这套构却从第一天起就定不住自己。

records.x: 希洪那场丑闻里没有一次犯规,规则全程没有被违反,却也没能护住它要护的东西;同一届世界杯里,罗西的六个进球又把一桩没有终审的旧案倒写成救赎。规则之内能酿丑闻,结果之后能改讲述——构护得住条文,护不住条文背后的心跳。

records.q: Jingkang 靖康

records.x: The freest man in the martial world permits no law on his island except his own.
records.q: Peach Blossom Island 桃花岛
